{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_schedule_update_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_schedule_update_status    @schedule_id         int,    @status_code         smallint,    @exit_code           int,    @exit_module         smallint,    @status              varchar(254) = null,    @current_time        datetime = null,    @module              smallint = null,    @level               smallint = null as    if (@status_code = -99)       set @status_code = null     if exists (select schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\t\t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id and status_code = 0 and next_task_seq = -1)       return  \tif (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) \t\tset @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code, \t\t\t exit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\t exit_module = @exit_module,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id  --LB#40844 \tif(@status_code >=0 and @current_time is not null) \tbegin \t\texec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@current_time \tend     if ( @current_time is not null )       exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_session", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_session    @computer_id      int,    @status           varchar (254) as    declare  @schedule_id      int,             @event_id         int,             @cond_seq         int,             @next_task_seq    int,             @found            int     set @found = null     select @schedule_id = schedule_id, @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @next_task_seq = next_task_seq from event_schedule       where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code = -3 and computer_id = @computer_id     if (@schedule_id is not null)    begin       select @found = event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq       if (@found is null)          select @found = event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq    end     if (@found is not null)    begin       begin transaction        update event_schedule set status_code = NULL, status = @status where schedule_id = @schedule_id        if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @status varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_set_next_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_set_next_task \t@schedule_id int as \tdeclare @next_seq_id int \tdeclare @retval int  \tselect top 1 @next_seq_id = t.task_seq \t\tfrom task t\tinner join event_schedule es on es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq and es.event_id = t.event_id \t\twhere es.schedule_id = @schedule_id and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq \t\torder by task_seq  \tif (@next_seq_id is not null) \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction  \t\tupdate event_schedule set next_task_seq = @next_seq_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tif (@@error = 0) \t\t\tcommit transaction \t\telse \t\t\trollback transaction  \t\tset @retval = @next_seq_id \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tset @retval = -1 \tend  \treturn @retval ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghost_cmdline", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghost_cmdline]    @event_id\tint,    @new_session_name varchar(50) as    declare @tran int    declare @old_session_name varchar(50)    set @tran = @@trancount     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task  \t  set @old_session_name = SUBSTRING(addl_cmdline,CHARINDEX('\"', addl_cmdline , 1) + 1,LEN(addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('\"', addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('\"', REVERSE(addl_cmdline))), \t  ghcastsrv_cmdline = case when ghcastsrv_cmdline is not null then replace(ghcastsrv_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) else NULL end, \t  addl_cmdline =  replace(addl_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) \t  where event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @new_session_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghostcast_setting", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghostcast_setting]    @event_id\tint,    @ghostcast_setting varchar(10) as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     set @ghostcast_setting = ' ' + @ghostcast_setting     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task set ghcastsrv_cmdline =  \t  case   when CHARINDEX(' -N',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -N%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -T',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -T%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -O',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -O%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)           END \t  where event_id = @event_id and ghcastsrv_cmdline is not NULL             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @ghostcast_setting varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128),    @newpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction  \t\tupdate    copyfile_task \t\tset       password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    script_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          exec_password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (exec_username) = lower (@username)) and (exec_password = @oldpassword) \t\t--the install_task.username and install_task.exec_username appear to always be the same so do not add to the count set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    capture_pct_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar, @newpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_unattend_var", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure upd_unattend_var     @var_id int,     @default_val int,     @var_name varchar(254),     @var_desc varchar(254),     @var_type smallint,     @val_value varchar(256),     @val_displayed [description]=@var_desc, [type]=@var_type                        where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      if(@old_type = 0 and @var_type != 0)     begin       delete from unattend_vars_value where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and unattend_vars_value_id <> @default_val     end      if(@var_type != 0)     begin       update unattend_vars_value set [value]=@val_value, name_displayed=@val_displayed                       where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val     end      if(@var_type = 0)     begin       set @default_val=NULL        select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from (@default_val is null)       begin         insert into unattend_vars_value(unattend_vars_id, [value], name_displayed, [default])                     values(@var_id, @val_value, @val_displayed, 1)          select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                     where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value]=@val_value       end       else       begin         update {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_static_routes_config_items", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing  create procedure wc_del_static_routes_config_items    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint  as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this config_static_route_item    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @config_item_id is not null    begin        -- delete the static routing records of configItemId       begin transaction         delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_static_routes_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "   -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static routing create procedure wc_del_static_routes_config_set    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null   as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id     if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- delete the static routing set entries       begin transaction        \t    delete config_static_route_set where config_set_id = @configSetId                       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction       end       else          commit transaction    end   ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_generate_first_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_generate_first_computer_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64) output as    -- get the name range data from the config_set record    declare @method smallint, @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @method = cname_method, @fixed = cname_fixed, @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append,       @numbers = cname_numbers from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       if @numbers = 1 -- numeric portion       begin          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))          else             set @name = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed       end       else -- alpha portion       begin          -- convert number to ascii character values          declare @alpha varchar(64)          set @alpha = ''          while @addl >= 0          begin                         declare @dval smallint             set @dval = @addl % 26             set @addl = @addl / 26             set @alpha = @alpha + char(@dval + 97)             set @addl = @addl - 1          end          -- reverse the character order to form the final string          set @alpha = reverse(@alpha)          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + @alpha          else             set @name = @alpha + @fixed       end    end    else       set @name = null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_have_computer_for_vm", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_have_computer_for_vm    @vm_uuid varchar(128),    @host_uuid varchar(128),    @vc_computer varchar(256) as    declare @vm_comp_id int        select @vm_comp_id = computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)        if @vm_comp_id is not null    begin       update computer set virtual_machine_host_group_id =           (select virtual_machine_host_group_id from virtual_machine_host_group where computer = @vc_computer),          virtual_machine_host_id = (select computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@host_uuid))          where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)                 select 1    end    else    begin       select 0    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@vm_uuid varchar, @host_uuid varchar, @vc_computer varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_ip    @ip varchar(16),    @ip_out varchar(16) output as    -- break the IP address into integer octet values    declare @octet1 int, @octet2 int, @octet3 int, @octet4 int    declare @dot_index1 int, @dot_index2 int    select @dot_index1 = charindex('.', @ip)    set @octet1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @dot_index1 - 1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index1 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet2 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet3 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = len(@ip)    set @octet4 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - (@dot_index1 - 1)) as int)     -- increment octet values as needed to increment the ip    if @octet4 < 255       set @octet4 = @octet4 + 1    else    begin       set @octet4 = 1       if @octet3 < 255          set @octet3 = @octet3 + 1       else       begin          set @octet3 = 0          if @octet2 < 255             set @octet2 = @octet2 + 1          else          begin             set @octet2 = 0             if @octet1 < 255                set @octet1 = @octet1 + 1             else             begin                set @octet1 = 1                set @octet2 = 1                set @octet3 = 1                set @octet4 = 1             end          end       end    end     set @ip_out = cast(@octet1 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet2 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet3 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet4 as varchar(3)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ip varchar, @ip_out varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64),    @name_out varchar(64) output as    -- Get the name range information from the config_set record    declare @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append, @numbers = cname_numbers,       @fixed = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id    if len(@name) = 0       exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @config_set_id, @name     -- Split the fixed and variable text in the @name passed in    declare @variable_text varchar(64)    declare @fixed_pos int    set @fixed_pos = charindex(@fixed, @name)    if @fixed_pos > 1 -- prefix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, 1, @fixed_pos - 1)    else -- postfix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, len(@fixed) + 1, len(@name) - len(@fixed))           -- Increment the @variable_text    if @numbers = 1    begin       -- numeric variable       set @addl = cast(@variable_text as smallint) + 1       if @append = 1          set @name_out = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))       else          set @name_out = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed    end    else    begin       -- alpha variable       -- test for all Z characters       set @variable_text = upper(@variable_text)       declare @z_count int, @z_loc int       set @z_loc = 0       set @z_count = 0       set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text)       while @z_loc > 0       begin          set @z_count = @z_count + 1          set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text, @z_loc + 1)       end       if len(@variable_text) = @z_count       begin          -- reset to all A characters and add A to the end          set @name_out = replace(@variable_text, 'Z', 'A')          set @name_out = @variable_text + 'A'       end       else       begin          -- advance all needed characters          declare @addl_out varchar(64)          set @addl_out = ''                    declare @char int          declare @increment_done smallint          set @increment_done = 0          while len(@variable_text) > 0          begin             set @char = ascii(substring(@variable_text, len(@variable_text), 1))             if @increment_done = 0             begin                if @char = 90                   set @char = 65                else                begin                   set @char = @char + 1                   set @increment_done = 1                end             end              set @addl_out = @addl_out + char(@char)              if len(@variable_text) > 1                set @variable_text = substring(@variable_text, 1, len(@variable_text) - 1)             else                set @variable_text = ''          end          set @addl_out = reverse(@addl_out)          if @append = 1             set @name_out = @fixed + @addl_out          else             set @name_out = @addl_out + @fixed       end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar, @name_out varchar OUT)"}

declare @single int       set @single = @bayIdx       if @bayIdx is null          select @bayIdx = max(idx) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @missingBay smallint               set @bayIdx = null                select @bayIdx = bay_id from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId                   and idx = @missingBay                if @bayIdx is not {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_condition", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_condition \t@job \tint, \t@name\tvarchar(64) as \tdeclare @condition   int    \tselect @condition = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id = @job    \tif @condition is null \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\tinsert into event_condition (event_id, cond_seq, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (@job, 1, null) \t\tif(@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t\t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @condition = -1 \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\tcommit transaction \t\t\tset @condition = 0 \t\tend \tend    \telse \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\t\tupdate event_condition set cond_seq = @condition + 1 \t\t\t\twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition \t\tif (@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t      \trollback transaction \t\t\tset @condition = -1 \t\tend \t   \telse \t      \tcommit transaction \tend  \tif @condition > -1 \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\t \t\t\tinsert into event_condition (event_id, cond_seq, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (@job, @condition, @name) \t \t\tif (@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t      \t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @condition = -1 \t\tend \t   \telse \t      \t\tcommit transaction \tend  \tselect @condition as cond_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_del_set_right", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_del_set_right    @right int,    @user int,    @grant smallint as    -- determine if the right already exists    declare @granted smallint    select @granted = count(user_id) from securityprivilegelink        where [user_id] = @user and privilege_id = @right     if @granted is null       -- add a new right       if @grant = 1          insert into securityprivilegelink (privilege_id, [user_id])          values (@right, @user)    else       -- remove an existing right       if @grant = 0          delete from securityprivilegelink where privilege_id = @right          and [user_id] = @user ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@right int, @user int, @grant smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_dnsSuffix", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "   -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix create procedure wc_ins_dnsSuffix     @job\t\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,     @dnsSuffix\t\tvarchar(256),    @order                         smallint,    @configSetId int = null,    @computerId int = null as   begin transaction   if @computerId is null     begin                             -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this dns_suffix     if @configSetId is null       begin        select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task       end          -- insert the new dns_suffix record          insert into dns_suffix ( [id], dns_suffix, [order] ) values (@configSetId,  @dnsSuffix, @order )          end      else   --If the new computer is created than                insert into dns_suffix ([id],  dns_suffix, [order] ) values (@computerId, @dnsSuffix, @order)            -- handle errors/commit transaction                if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction        end       else          commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @dnsSuffix varchar, @order smallint, @configSetId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_dnsSuffixItem", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix create procedure wc_ins_dnsSuffixItem    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint,     @order\t\tsmallint,    @dnsSuffix\t\tvarchar(256)     as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task  --  declare @config_set_id int  -- select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task      --  where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task    --declare @config_item_id int    --select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id      -- and target_computer_id = @computer     if @config_item_id  is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          insert into dns_suffix ( [id],dns_suffix, [order] ) values (@config_item_id, @dnsSuffix, @order)              -- handle errors/commit transaction            if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int, @order smallint, @dnsSuffix varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_enclosure    @name  varchar(64),    @model varchar(64),    @bayCount int,    @rack  int,    @ip varchar(20) = null,    @community varchar(256) = null as    -- ensure rack exists    declare @enclosureId int    declare @rackId int    declare @manuf smallint    select @rackId = rack_id, @manuf = manuf_rack from physical_rack where rack_id = @rack     if @rackId is not null and @manuf = 0    begin       -- avoid duplicate enclosures       select @enclosureId = enclosure_id from physical_enclosure where real_name = @name       if @enclosureId is null       begin          -- insert enclosure          exec @enclosureId = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'           insert into physical_enclosure(rack_id, enclosure_id, [name], real_name, model, bay_count, ip_address, community)              values (@rackId, @enclosureId, @name, @name, @model, @bayCount, @ip, @community)       end    end    else       set @enclosureId = -1     return @enclosureId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @model varchar, @bayCount int, @rack int, @ip varchar, @community varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_filter", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- PRD item 7.1.7_and_7.1.8 Active and Inactive computer Filter  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_filter \t@name\tvarchar(64) as \tdeclare @filter   int \tselect @filter = max(filter_id) from filter \tif @filter is null \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\tinsert into filter (filter_id, folder_id, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (8000001, null, null) \t\tif(@@error != 0)\t \t\tbegin \t\t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @filter = -1 \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\tcommit transaction \t\t\tset @filter = 0 \t\tend \tend  \telse if @filter > -1 \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\t \t\t\tinsert into filter (filter_id, folder_id, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (@filter+1, null, @name) \t \t\tif (@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t      \t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @filter = -1 \t\tend \t   \telse \t      \t\tcommit transaction \tend  \tselect @filter+1 as filter_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_filter_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- PRD item 7.1.7_and_7.1.8 Active and Inactive computer Filter  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_filter_item    @filter int,    @field int,    @operation int,    @value varchar(256) = null,    @drive varchar(8) = null,    @conjunct smallint = -1 as    -- get the next filter  item id    declare @item   int    select @item = max(item_seq) from filter_condition where filter_id = @filter     if @item is null       set @item = 0    else       set @item = @item + 1     begin transaction     \tinsert into filter_condition (filter_id, item_seq, field_type, oper_type, key_value, drive, conjunct) \t\tvalues (@filter, @item, @field, @operation, @value, @drive, @conjunct)     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @item as item_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@filter int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_folder", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_folder    @name          varchar(64) = null,    @parentId     int = -10 as    begin transaction     declare @folderId int    set @folderId = null    exec @folderId = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'     if(@name is null)       set @name = 'New Folder ' + cast((@folderId - 1000000) as varchar)      if(@parentId = -10)       set @parentId = null        if(@folderId != 0)       insert into event_folder ( folder_id, name, parent_id )        values ( @folderId, @name, @parentId )     if (@@error != 0 or @folderId = 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @folderId as FolderId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @parentId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_install_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create varchar(254),    @pkg_title varchar(64) = '', --Bug #32636    @pkg_desc varchar(254) = '', --Bug #32636    @pkg_ver float = 0,   --Bug #32636    @pkg_creation int = 0, -- DE 2.19    @exec_username varchar(128),    @exec_password varchar(128),    @svs_action int, -- DE 2.19    @svs_action_force smallint, -- DE 2.19    @svs_layer_guid varchar(36) as    -- collect the highest task sequence value for the event/condition    declare @taskSeq   int    select @taskSeq = task_seq from task where task_seq =        (select top 1 task_seq from task         where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq        order by task_seq desc)    -- increment to get available task sequence slot    if @taskSeq is null       set @taskSeq = 0    else       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1     -- insert a new task    begin transaction       insert into task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 15)       insert into install_task \t     (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, install_file, username, [password], addl_cmd_line,           all_users, pkg_type, quiet_mode, pkg_password, aclient_to_download, download_directory,           recurse_dir, cmdline_params, pkg_title, pkg_desc, pkg_ver, pkg_mod_time, exec_username , exec_password, svs_action, svs_action_force, svs_layer_guid)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, @filename, (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 0)    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction     -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @filename varchar, @username varchar, @password varchar, @commandLine varchar, @allUsers smallint, {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_job", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_job    @name         varchar(128) = null,    @folder_id    int = -10,    @folder_name  varchar(64) = NULL,    @add_number   int = 0,    @default_event_name\tvarchar(64) = 'New Job',    @default_folder_name varchar(64) = 'New Folder',    @description   varchar(254) = null as    declare @event_id int     exec @event_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_ID'     if (@event_id = 0)    begin       return -1    end     if (@name is null or @name = '')    begin       select @name = @default_event_name    end     if (@add_number > 0)    begin       select @name = @name + ' ' + cast((@event_id - 2000006) as varchar(30))    end     if ( @folder_id < 1 and @folder_name is null)    begin       begin transaction       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description], version) values (@event_id, @name, @description, 1)     end    else    begin       declare @temp_folder_id int        if (@folder_name is null or @folder_name = '')          set @folder_name = @default_folder_name        if (@folder_id < 1)       begin          set @folder_id = null          select @folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where [name] = @folder_name          if (@folder_id is null)             exec @folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'          if (@@error != 0)             set @folder_id = null       end        if (@folder_id is null)          set @temp_folder_id = 1       else          select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id              begin transaction       if (@temp_folder_id) is null          insert into event_folder (folder_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @folder_name)       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description], folder_id, version)           values (@event_id, @name, @description, @folder_id, 1)    end        if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction            select @event_id as event_id    return @event_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @folder_id int, @folder_name varchar, @add_number int, @default_event_name varchar, @default_folder_name varchar, @description varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_loggedon_users", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_ins_loggedon_users    @user_name       varchar(128),     @full_name       varchar(128) as    declare @new_id int    set @new_id = null      insert into loggedon_users (  [user_name], full_name ) values ( @user_name,@full_name )     select @new_id = [user_id] from loggedon_users where [user_name] = @user_name     if (@@error != 0) \treturn 0    return @new_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user_name varchar, @full_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS setting for nic    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    --    -- get the highest nic_id from existing nic_config_item records    declare @maxNicId int    select @maxNicId = max(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId     -- test for valid records    declare @nicId int    set @nicId = @maxNicId    if @configItemId is not null and @maxNicId is not null    begin       -- generate the generic NIC description       set @nicId = @nicId nic_config_item (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, ip_domain, ip_dns,              ip_wins, nic_desc, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp) values (@configItemId, @nicId, @ipMethod, @domainSuffix, {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_static_routes_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "   -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static routing create procedure wc_ins_static_routes_config_item    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint,     @destination\t\tchar(16),    @netmask\t\tchar(16),    @gateway\t\tchar(16),    @interface\t\tchar(16),    @metric\t\tsmallint,    @flag\t\tchar(16),    @ref\t\t\tsmallint,    @use\t\t\tsmallint     as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this static route    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @config_item_id  is not null    begin       -- update the config_static_route_item record       begin transaction \t insert into config_static_route_item (config_item_id,destination,netmask,gateway,interface,metric,flag,ref,[use]) values (@config_item_id, @destination, @netmask, @gateway, @interface, @metric, @flag, @ref, @use)        -- handle errors/commit transaction            if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int, @destination char, @netmask char, @gateway char, @interface char, @metric smallint, @flag char, @ref smallint, @use smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_upate_agent_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_upate_agent_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @task_type   int as    -- collect the highest task sequence value for the event/condition    declare @taskSeq   int    select @taskSeq = task_seq from task where task_seq =        (select top 1 task_seq from task         where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq        order by task_seq desc)    -- increment to get available task sequence slot    if @taskSeq is null       set @taskSeq = 0    else       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1     -- insert a new task    begin transaction       insert into task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type)\t--, type_code)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, @task_type)\t--, null)        insert into task_return_handlers          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, ret_code)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 0)    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction     -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @task_type int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder with level as 1 in temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder with level = level + 1 and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table \tFind max level value which will be max depth for given folder */  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x  @folder_id as int  as  --This SP is same as wc_sel_child_folder_depth but for import where tables are different.  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from x_event_folder where parent_id =@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom x_event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folders", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folders \t@parent_id int as \tif @parent_id = -10 \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id is null \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id = @parent_id \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@parent_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_comp_listview", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_comp_listview \t@id int as \tif @id = -1 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id is null and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse if @id between 5000001 and 8000000 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere computer_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse \tbegin\t \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)  \texec('create table dbo.'+@branch_tablename+ \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(64), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))') \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \tif @id >= 5000001 and @id <= 8000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the computer node \t\t--exec('insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer where computer_id =' +@id) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from computer where computer_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t-- Get the group_id \t\tselect @id = group_id from computer where computer_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get groups down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -1 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the group node \t\t--insert into ##wc_branch (name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, group_id as id, 'group' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer_group where group_id = @id \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) select name, group_id as id, ''group'' as type from computer_group where group_id = @intid'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Computers'', -1, ''group'')')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResults = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_configuration", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_configuration \t@job\t\t\tint, \t@condition\t\tint, \t@task\t\t\tint, \t@computer\t\tint as \tdeclare @configSetId int \tselect @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \t\twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task \tdeclare @configItemId int \tselect @configItemId = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @configSetId \t\tand target_computer_id = @computer  \tselect * from config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId         -- Changed for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & 7.1.53 DNS Suffix         select * from dns_suffix where [id] = @configItemId         select * from config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @configItemId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_name    @id int as    --select computer_id as [id], [name], 'Computer' as type from computer where computer_id = @id    -- Bug #41543 - Rilo controls are missing from the all computers view in the web console     select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c \tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \twhere c.computer_id = @id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_schedules", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_schedules \t@computer_id int as \t\t--Bug #40255: Web Console not showing all computers that have been scheduled for a job \t\tselect\tschd.schedule_id, schd.computer_id, schd.event_id, schd.cond_seq, schd.next_task_seq, schd.start_time, schd.recur_value , schd.recur_type , schd.status_code , schd.status, schd.broker_time, schd.defer_mins, schd.config_choice_id, schd.end_time, schd.dep_schedule_id, schd.user_id, schd.initial_deployment, schd.redeploy_history_id, schd.calling_event, schd.rip_replace_event, schd.exit_code, schd.exit_module, schd._nslastsent,  \t\t\t\tevnt.[name] as 'job_name', comp.[name] as 'computer_name', evntinfo.job_exec_time as 'job_execution_time' \t\tfrom event_schedule as schd  \t\tleft outer join event as evnt on evnt.event_id = schd.event_id \t\tleft outer join computer as comp on schd.computer_id = comp.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join event_schedule_info as evntinfo on schd.schedule_id = evntinfo.schedule_id \t\twhere schd.computer_id = @computer_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_permissions", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of permissions for the given user and object create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_permissions    @userId int,    @objectId int as    declare @permission int     --create temp table    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_permissions') is not null       drop table ##wc_last_effective_permissions    create table dbo.##wc_last_effective_permissions (permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)        --get permissions that apply to the object    if @objectId = 2000001 --init_deploy       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where initial_deployment = 1    else if (@objectId >= 1 and @objectId < 1000001) or @objectId = -1 --comp_group, ALL_COMPUTERS       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer_group = 1    else if @objectId = -7 --new_comp_group       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where new_computer_group = 1    else if @objectId >= 5000001 and @objectId <= 8000000 --comp       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer = 1    else if (@objectId >= 11000001 and @objectId < 14000001) or @objectId = -9 --physical_device       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where physical_device = 1    else if @objectId >= 1000001 and @objectId < 2000001 or @objectId = -10 --event_folder       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event_folder = 1    else if @objectId > 2000001 and @objectId < 3000001 --event       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event = 1    else       goto DONE        declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @permissionType varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0      select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights     open permissions_cursor    fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each permission       if @isAdmin > 0 --@isAdmin = 1 When user has admin rights and gets admin rights from one or more admin groups.       begin          select @permissionType = [name] from securitypermission where permission_id = @permission          insert into ##wc_last_effective_permissions values (@permission, 1, @permissionType, @fromAdmin, @permSource,'Administrative Rights', 'Administrative Group',0, @fromGroup)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_permission @userId, @permission, @objectId, 0        fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission    end          -- cleanup cursor    close permissions_cursor    deallocate permissions_cursor     DONE:  --select temp table     select * from ##wc_last_effective_permissions ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @objectId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_rights", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of rights for the user create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_rights     @userId int, \t@tableName varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights' as    declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @rightName varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once    -- Bug #63690     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0,@tableName      --select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights    declare\t@sql    nvarchar(512), \t\t\t@params nvarchar(512) \t\t\t \tset @sql = 'select @SqlisAdmin = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource, @SqlfromGroup = fromGroup from '+@tableName \t \tset @params = N'@SqlisAdmin int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromAdmin smallint OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlpermSource int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromGroup int OUTPUT' \t\t\t\t \texec sp_executesql @sql,@params,@SqlisAdmin=@isAdmin output, @SqlfromAdmin = @fromAdmin output, @SqlpermSource=@permSource output, @SqlfromGroup=@fromGroup output      --make sure temp table is empty    -- Bug #63690    --if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is not null    --   delete from ##wc_last_effective_rights    if object_id(''+@tableName+'') is not null \texec('delete from '+@tableName)        declare rights_cursor cursor for          select privilege_id, [name]          from securityprivilege     open rights_cursor    fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each right       if @isAdmin = 1       begin          select @rightName = [name] from securityprivilege where privilege_id = @right          -- Bug #63690          --insert into ##wc_last_effective_rights values (@right, 1, @rightName, @fromAdmin, @permSource, @fromGroup)          declare @sqlQuery as varchar(128) \t\t set @sqlQuery = 'insert into '+ @tableName +' values ('+cast(@right as varchar(10))+',1,'''+@rightName+''','+cast(@fromAdmin as varchar(10))+','+cast(@permSource as varchar(10))+','+cast(@fromGroup as varchar(10))+')' \t\t exec (@sqlQuery)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_right @userId, @right, 0,@tableName        fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName    end          -- cleanup cursor    close rights_cursor    deallocate rights_cursor      --select temp table   -- Bug #63690    --select * from ##wc_last_effective_rights    exec ('select * from '+@tableName) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @tableName varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_enclosure    @enclosure int as    select e.enclosure_id, e.rack_id, e.[name], e.real_name, e.manuf, e.model, e.bay_count,       e.change_method, e.event_id, e.wait_timeout, e.ip_address, e.community, e.initial_event_id,       r.manuf_rack from physical_enclosure e, physical_rack r     where e.rack_id = r.rack_id and e.enclosure_id = @enclosure ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@enclosure int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_enclosure_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_enclosure_children    @id int as    -- get computers in the bays in the enclosure passed in    -- Bug #41543    select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type,'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end        from physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id        where e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and e.enclosure_id = @id       and b.computer_id = c.computer_id and b.initial_event_id is null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_computers", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_find_computers \t@phrase varchar(128) as \tselect a.computer_id as id, a.name, a.icon, a.status  \tfrom computer a  \twhere a.name like @phrase or  \t\ta.computer_name like @phrase or  \t\ta.ip_hostname like @phrase or  \t\ta.logged_on_user like @phrase or  \t\ta.lic_os_user like @phrase or  \t\ta.serial_num like @phrase or  \t\ta.asset_tag like @phrase or  \t\ta.uuid like @phrase or  \t\ta.os like @phrase or  \t\ta.computer_id like @phrase or  \t\ta.computer_id in  \t\t\t( select b.computer_id from nics b  \t\t\twhere b.mac_addr like @phrase) or \t\ta.computer_id in \t\t\t( select c.id from nic_interface c \t\t\twhere c.ip like @phrase ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@phrase varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_computers_9x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_find_computers_9x    @search varchar(128) as    select a.computer_id as id, a.name, a.icon, a.status from computer a     where (a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows 95%')        or a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows 98%')        or a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows Millennium%'))       and (a.name like @search or        a.computer_name like @search or        a.ip_hostname like @search or        a.logged_on_user like @search or        a.lic_os_user like @search or        a.serial_num like @search or        a.asset_tag like @search or        a.uuid like @search or        a.os like @search or        a.computer_id like @search or        a.computer_id in           ( select b.computer_id from nics b           where b.mac_addr like @search) or       a.computer_id in          ( select c.id from nic_interface c          where c.ip like @search )) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@search varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task    @phrase varchar(128),    @task smallint,    @folderid int as \tif @folderid > -10 \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) -- Don't get Initial Deployment \t\t\tand a.folder_id = @folderid \telse \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@phrase varchar, @task smallint, @folderid int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(128),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subfolder table (for folder IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folders_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_folders_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_folders_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @id        -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end     -- loop through subfolders to gather all children job IDs    declare @subfolder int    select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    while @subfolder is not null    begin       -- get subfolders of this folder       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @subfolder       -- remove this folder from subfolder table       delete from #wc_folders_to_check where [id] = @subfolder       -- get jobs in this folder -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @subfolder       -- get the next subfolder       set @subfolder = null       select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id = @id       -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folderlevel", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.66 Copy job folder create procedure wc_sel_folderlevel  @folder_id int, @level int =1 as \tdeclare @parent_id int \tselect @parent_id=parent_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id \tif @parent_id is not null \tbegin \t\tset @level=@level+1 \t\texec wc_sel_folderlevel @parent_id, @level \tend \telse \t\tselect @level ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int, @level int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subgroup table (for group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_groups_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_groups_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_groups_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root -- Bug #41543 \tinsert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) \t  select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t    left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t    left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t   where c.group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)  \t select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t   left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t   left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id \t where c.group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @id          order by [name]    end     -- loop through subgroups to gather all children computer IDs    declare @subgroup int    select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    while @subgroup is not null    begin       -- get subgroups of this group       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @subgroup       -- remove this group from subgroup table       delete from #wc_groups_to_check where [id] = @subgroup       -- get computers in this group -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) \tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id \twhere c.group_id = @subgroup \torder by c.[name]       -- get the next subgroup       set @subgroup = null       select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer/group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state           from computer where group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer where group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_history", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- PRD item 7.1.46 Allow Administrator to Delete History create procedure dbo.wc_sel_history \t @computer_id \t\tint as \tselect  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id,s.complete_time, s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.user_log, l.user_name, h.app_id,ea.alias,ea.app_path,ea.description, \tconvert(varchar(30),s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time  --Bug #33984 \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id              left outer  join  loggedon_users l on \t\t  s.system_logon_user_id = l.user_id \tleft join external_application ea  \t\ton h.app_id=ea.app_id \t  \twhere (s.status_code is not null)  and    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id)  \torder by h.history_id desc  select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id, h.task_type, h.complete_time, s.[module], s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.status_code, s.status, s.complete_time,s.level,s.return_code_result, \tconvert(varchar(30), s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time, --Bug #33984 \txml_task \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id \twhere    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id ) and h.history_id in (select history_id from status_log_view where status_code is not null)  --Bug #33984 \torder by h.complete_time desc ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename) \t\t \texec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename + \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(128), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))')  \tif @id >= 2000001 and @id <= 3000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the job node \t\tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \t\tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event where event_id = @intid'  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int' \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id  \t\t \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event where event_id ='+ @intid)  \t\t-- Get the folder_id \t\tselect @id = folder_id from event where event_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get folders down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -10 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the folder node \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event_folder where folder_id = @intid';  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid=@id ; \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event_folder where folder_id =' + @id) \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Jobs'', -10, ''folder'')')\t-- Return the completed branch list  \tif @selectResults = 1 \t\texec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_domains", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_domains  \t@jobids    varchar(254)  as  begin transaction \t \tselect msnet_domain_name from config_set  where  \tmsnet_domain_name is not null  \tand config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids)))  \tif @@error != 0 \t\trollback transaction \telse \t\tcommit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_license_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_license_info as    --select * from license_info    --Bug #28067    \tselect remain_days, total_days,serial_number, server as totalserver, client as totalclient, pda as totalpda, nodes as totalnodes  from license_info \t \t--1 \tselect count (computer_id) as server from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 1 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--2 \tselect count (computer_id) as client from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 3 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--3 \tselect count (computer_id) as pda from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 2 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--7 total \tselect count (computer_id) as nodes from computer  where limited_license = 0 and  \tcomputer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_physical_device_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_physical_device_children    @id int -- this param is for compatability and is not used in the procedure as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_physical_device_children') is not null       drop table #wc_physical_device_children    create table dbo.#wc_physical_device_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543     -- iterate through all of the racks    declare @rackId int    declare rack_cursor cursor for       select rack_id from physical_rack    open rack_cursor    fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- get computers in the bays in the enclosures in this rack       -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_physical_device_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)             select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end              from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id              where r.rack_id = e.rack_id and r.rack_id = @rackId              and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and b.computer_id = c.computer_id              and b.initial_event_id is null       -- get next rack ID       fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    end    -- cleanup cursor    close rack_cursor    deallocate rack_cursor     select * from #wc_physical_device_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}
