{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_reb_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_reb_branch    @id int,    @selectResult int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))    if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null       exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)     exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename +       '([level] int IDENTITY,        [name] varchar(64),        [id] int NOT NULL,        type varchar(20))')  \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500)    -- If node is a Bay    if @id >= 13000001 and @id <= 14000000    begin       -- Get the bay node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)          -- select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type         -- from physical_bay where bay_id = @id') \t\t \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_bay where bay_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ;        -- Get the enclosure_id       select @id = enclosure_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @id    end\t     -- If node is an Enclosure    if @id >= 12000001 and @id <= 13000000    begin       -- Get the enclosure node      -- exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)         -- select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type         -- from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id') \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t       -- Get the rack_id       select @id = rack_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id    end     -- If node is a Rack    if @id >= 11000001 and @id <= 12000000    begin       -- Get the rack node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename +'([name], [id], type)        --  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type        --  from physical_rack where rack_id = @id')  \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_rack where rack_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t    end     -- Add Physical Devices node    --insert into @branch_tablename ([name], [id], type)      -- select 'Physical Devices' as [name], -9 as [id], 'physical devices' as type \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)       select ''Physical Devices'' as [name], -9 as [id], ''physical devices'' as type')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResult = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + 'order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_required_domains", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_required_domains  \t@jobids    varchar(8000), \t@compids    varchar(8000)  as \t--Query on config_set and Config_item table to fetch all required domains. \tselect lower(msnet_domain_name) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_domain_name is not null and msnet_domain_name <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_dns_domain is not null and msnet_dns_domain <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \tunion \tselect lower(domain_name) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere (msnet_dns_domain is null or msnet_dns_domain='')  \t\tand config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \t \t--Query to check whether we should check for computer domain information \t-- IF count is > 0  then check for computer domains as well \tselect count(*) from config_set, config_task  \twhere \tconfig_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_set.config_set_id \t\tand ((use_existing_data=1 and msnet_is_domain_member is null) or (msnet_is_domain_member=1 and ((msnet_domain_name ='' or msnet_domain_name is null) and ( msnet_dns_domain ='' or msnet_dns_domain is null) )) or (use_existing_data=1 and reconfig=1))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar, @compids varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_codes", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_codes    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    \tint as    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_return_code') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_return_code  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_return_code \t\t(code\t\tvarchar(11), \t\t handler\t\tint, \t\t result \t\tint, \t\t status   varchar(256))  \t-- store the default handler \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect 'default' as code, on_fail as handler, on_fail as result, null as status \t\tfrom task where event_id=@jobId and   \t\tcond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq  \t-- get the rest of the handlers \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect ret_code as code, handler, result, status from task_return_handlers \t\twhere event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and\ttask_seq=@taskSeq  \tselect * from ##wc_return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_handler_jobs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_handler_jobs    @jobId int as    -- make a temporary table to store the IDs in    if object_id ('#wc_handler_ids') is null       create table dbo.#wc_handler_ids (job int, primary key (job))    -- store the calling job    insert into #wc_handler_ids values (@jobId)     -- declare needed variables    declare @newJobCount int    declare @handler int    declare @job int    declare @fail int     -- loop through all discovered jobs repeatedly until no new linked jobs are found    set @newJobCount = 1    while @newJobCount > 0    begin       set @newJobCount = 0       -- make a cursor to step through all discovered jobs       declare job_cursor cursor for          select job from #wc_handler_ids       open job_cursor       fetch next from job_cursor into @job       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          -- loop through the linked jobs          -- make a cursor to step through all linked task_return_handlers jobs          declare handler_cursor cursor for             select distinct(handler) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @job                and handler > 2000000 and handler < 3000001 and handler not in --Bug 27827                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open handler_cursor          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@handler)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          end          -- cleanup cursor          close handler_cursor          deallocate handler_cursor           -- make a cursor to step through all linked on_fail jobs          declare fail_cursor cursor for             select distinct(on_fail) from task where event_id = @job                and on_fail > 2000000 and on_fail < 3000001 and event_id not in                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open fail_cursor          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@fail)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          end          -- cleanup cursor          close fail_cursor          deallocate fail_cursor                  fetch next from job_cursor into @job       end       -- cleanup cursor       close job_cursor       deallocate job_cursor    end     -- return the list of jobs discovered    select job from #wc_handler_ids    drop table #wc_handler_ids ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_schedule1", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_schedule1 \t@schedule int as \tdeclare @user int \tselect @user = su.[user_id] from securityuser su, event_schedule es  \twhere es.schedule_id = @schedule and es.[user_id] = su.[user_id]  \tif @user is null \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\t'gznFiP' as 'user_name', 'gznFiP' as user_full_name, '' as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\tu.[name] as 'user_name', u.fullname as user_full_name, u.domain as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e, securityuser u \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \t\t\tand u.[user_id] = s.[user_id] \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_security_authenticate", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_authenticate \t@username \t\tvarchar(64), \t@password\t\tvarchar(64), \t@domain\t\t\tvarchar(50) = null, \t@upnname\t\tvarchar(128) = null as \tdeclare @authenticated tinyint \tset @authenticated = 0 \t \tdeclare @matchUser\tvarchar(64)         declare @matchUPN\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchPwd\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchNetdom    varchar(64) \tdeclare @userId\tint \tdeclare @ad_user smallint  \tif @domain is not null and len(@domain) > 0 \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for  \t\t\tselect [name], upnname, domain, netbiosdomain, [user_id]  \t\t\tfrom securityuser \t\t\twhere (deleted is null or deleted=0) --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\t\t\t\t\t \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif (@matchUser = @username or @matchUPN = @upnname) and (upper(@domain) = upper(@matchPwd) or upper(@matchNetdom) = upper(@domain)) -- @matchPwd is the domain name \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for select [name], [password], [user_id], ad_user from securityuser  where deleted is null or deleted=0  --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif @matchUser = @username and @matchPwd = @password and @ad_user = 0 \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \t \tif @authenticated = 1 and len(@domain) > 0 \t\tset @authenticated = 2 \telse  \t\tset @matchUser = @username --Bug #39428  \tselect @authenticated as authenticated, @userId as [user_id], @matchUser as securityuser ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar, @domain varchar, @upnname varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_computer_location", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_upd_computer_location    @computer_id   int,    @site          varchar(128),    @dept          varchar(128),    @mailstop      varchar(128),    @contact       varchar(128),    @email         varchar(128),    @phone         varchar(128) as    declare @compId int    select @compId = computer_id from location where computer_id=@computer_id      begin transaction    if @compId is null \tbegin  \t\tinsert into location (computer_id, site, dept, mailstop, contact,  \t\t\t\temail, phone) values (@computer_id,  @site, @dept, @mailstop, @contact, \t\t\t\t@email, @phone) \tend    else \tbegin \t\tupdate location set [site] = @site, [dept] = @dept, [mailstop] = @mailstop, \t\t\t[contact] = @contact, [email] = @email, [phone] = @phone \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \tend    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @site varchar, @dept varchar, @mailstop varchar, @contact varchar, @email varchar, @phone varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item\t\t\tint,    @field\t\t\tint,    @operation\t    int,    @value\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null,    @drive\t\t\tvarchar(8)   = null,    @conjunct\t    smallint     = -1,    @token\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null as    begin transaction        update condition_item set field_type = @field, oper_type = @operation, key_value = @value,           drive = @drive, conjunct = @conjunct, token = @token          where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint, @token varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,    @item1\t\tint,    @item2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId\t\t\tint,    @conditionId1\tint,    @conditionId2\tint as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@tempCondId \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as \tupdate config_item  \tset  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  \twhere Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) \tand config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  \t@itemId int as  \tdeclare @domain_name as varchar(512) \tdeclare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)\t  \t-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name \tselect    \t\t@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, \t\t@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))\t\t \t\twhen '' then domain_name \t\telse msnet_dns_domain \t\tend -- case \tfrom config_item  \twhere config_item_id=@itemId  \t-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it \tif @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 \tbegin \t\tselect @username=username, @password=[password]  \t\tfrom domain_accounts  \t\twhere domain=@domain_name\t\t \t \t\tupdate config_item  \t\tset  \t\tmsnet_domain_username=@username, \t\tmsnet_domain_password=@password \t\twhere config_item_id=@itemId \tend\t ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_from_comp", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_comp    @itemId      int,    @computerId  int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with computer record data    declare computer_cursor cursor for       select lic_os_user, lic_os_org, lic_os_key, ip_hostname, computer_name, domain_member,          domain_name, nw_pref_server, {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_ip    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int,    @nic_id int as    -- test for a static IP range    declare @master_ip varchar(16), @duplicate_ip varchar(16), @final_ip varchar(16)    declare @interface_name varchar(64)    declare @interface_id int    declare config_ip_cursor cursor for       select ip, [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @config_set_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open config_ip_cursor    declare item_ip_cursor cursor for       select interface_id from nic_interface where [id] = @config_item_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open item_ip_cursor    fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name    fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       if len(@master_ip) > 0       begin          -- test for duplicate IP usage          set @duplicate_ip = @master_ip          set @final_ip = @master_ip          declare @computer_id int          select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id          while @duplicate_ip is not null          begin             set @duplicate_ip = null             -- test for another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface where [id] >= 5000001 and [id] <= 8000000                 and [id] != @computer_id and ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                and c.target_computer_id != @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to this computer IN THIS CONFIG that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                 and c.target_computer_id = @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip and c.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and [name] != @interface_name             -- get a new IP if a duplicate was found             if @duplicate_ip is not null                exec wc_increment_ip @duplicate_ip, @final_ip output          end           -- update the config_item nic_interface ip value to the non-duplicate found          update nic_interface set ip = @final_ip where interface_id = @interface_id       end        fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name       fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    end    close config_ip_cursor    deallocate config_ip_cursor    close item_ip_cursor    deallocate item_ip_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int, @nic_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_name    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int as    -- test for a name range    declare @method smallint    select @method = cname_method from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       -- test for duplicate name usage       declare @duplicate_name varchar(64), @final_name varchar(64)       --PRD item 7.1.12 Use token: To remove the addition of network adapter       select @final_name = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id       if @final_name in ('%NAME%','%SERIALNUM%','%NODENAME%','%NIC1MACADDR%','%NIC2MACADDR%', \t\t\t'%NIC3MACADDR%','%NIC4MACADDR%','%NIC5MACADDR%','%NIC6MACADDR%','%NIC7MACADDR%','%NIC8MACADDR%') \t update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           \twhere config_item_id = @config_item_id       else       begin       select @final_name = computer_name from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       set @duplicate_name = @final_name       declare @computer_id int       select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       while @duplicate_name is not null       begin          set @duplicate_name = null          -- test for another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from computer where computer_name = @final_name             and computer_id != @computer_id          -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from config_item where target_computer_id != @computer_id             and computer_name = @final_name          -- get a new name if a duplicate was found          if @duplicate_name is not null             exec wc_increment_name @config_set_id, @duplicate_name, @final_name output       end       -- update the config_item computer_name, ip_hostname to the non-duplicate value generated       update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           where config_item_id = @config_item_id    end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic \t@computer_id int, \t@mac_addr varchar(36), \t@ip_use_dhcp smallint, \t@ip_domain varchar(128), \t@ip_dns varchar(512), \t@ip_wins varchar(512), \t@nic_pci_bus int, \t@nic_pci_device int, \t@nic_pci_function int, \t@nic_device_id int, \t@nic_vendor_id int, \t@nic_desc varchar(64), \t@nic_location varchar(64), \t@interface_id int, \t@id int, \t@nic_id int, \t@name varchar(64), \t@ip varchar(16), \t@mask varchar(16), \t@gateway varchar(16), \t@broadcast varchar(16), \t@state int \t as \tbegin \t\tupdate nics set nics.mac_addr = @mac_addr, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_use_dhcp = @ip_use_dhcp, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_domain = @ip_domain, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_dns = @ip_dns, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_wins = @ip_wins, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_bus = @nic_pci_bus, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_device = @nic_pci_device, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_function = @nic_pci_function, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_device_id = @nic_device_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_vendor_id = @nic_vendor_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_desc = @nic_desc, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_location = @nic_location \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere nics.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\tupdate  nic_interface set\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.id = @id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.name = @name, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.ip = @ip, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.mask = @mask, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.gateway = @gateway, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.broadcast = @broadcast, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.state = @state \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere  nic_interface.interface_id = @interface_id; {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint = 1,--PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configItemId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_item_id = @configItemId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @interfaceId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int, @last smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_set record       begin transaction          update nic_config_set set ip_method = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp,wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_set_id = @configSetId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0,    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@nicId int, @interfaceId int, @last smallint, @jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS1", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing    @itemId int,    @id int,    @nicId int as    declare @name varchar(64)    declare @ip varchar(16), @mask varchar(16), @gateway varchar(16), @broadcast varchar(16)    declare @state int, @interfaceCount int    set @interfaceCount = 0    -- incremental IP for updates from config_set    declare @increment_ip bit    if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000       set @increment_ip = 1    declare nic_interface_cursor cursor for       select [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state from nic_interface where id = @id       and nic_id = @nicId order by interface_id    open nic_interface_cursor    fetch next from nic_interface_cursor       into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    --Bug #43065 To save computer nic_interface data.    declare @iname varchar(64), @iip varchar(16), @imask varchar(16),        @igateway varchar(16), @ibroadcast varchar(16), @istate int   if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000   begin    select @iname = name, @iip = ip, @imask = mask, @igateway = gateway, @ibroadcast = broadcast, @istate = state from      nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId          if @name is null or len(@name) = 0       set @name = @iname    if @ip is null or len(@ip) = 0       set @ip = @iip    if @mask is null or len(@mask) = 0       set @mask = @imask    if @gateway is null or len(@gateway) = 0       set @gateway = @igateway    if @broadcast is null or len(@broadcast) = 0       set @broadcast = @ibroadcast    if @state is null        set @state = @istate        end    -- remove existing nic_interface objects and always add new ones    delete from nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId     -- update nic_inteface table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- create new record       insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state)          values (@itemId, @nicId, @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state)              if @increment_ip = 1          exec wc_upd_next_ip @id, @itemId, @nicId                 fetch next from nic_interface_cursor          into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    end     close nic_interface_cursor    deallocate nic_interface_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @id int, @nicId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fn_get_comparable_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function fn_get_comparable_ip (  @ip varchar(15) ) returns bigint as begin  \tdeclare @ip_part1 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part2 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part3 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part4 bigint \tdeclare @first_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @second_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @third_dot_pos smallint  \tset @first_dot_pos = charindex('.', @ip) \tif @first_dot_pos = 0 \t\treturn cast(@ip as bigint)  \tset @second_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@first_dot_pos + 1) \tset @third_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@second_dot_pos + 1)  \tset @ip_part4 = cast(substring(@ip, @third_dot_pos + 1, len(@ip)) as bigint)  \tif(@first_dot_pos!=0) \tbegin \t\tset @ip_part1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part2 = cast(substring(@ip, @first_dot_pos + 1, @second_dot_pos - @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part3 = cast(substring(@ip, @second_dot_pos + 1, @third_dot_pos - @second_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \tend  \treturn @ip_part1 * 1000000000 + @ip_part2 * 1000000 + @ip_part3 * 1000 + @ip_part4  end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( bigint OUT, @ip varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "SplitIDs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function SplitIDs (  @OrderList varchar(8000) ) returns @ParsedList table (  ID int ) as begin \tdeclare @OrderID varchar(10), @Pos int  \tset @OrderList = ltrim(rtrim(@OrderList))+ ',' \tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1)  \tif replace(@OrderList, ',', '') <> '' \tbegin \t\twhile @Pos > 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tset @OrderID = ltrim(rtrim(left(@OrderList, @Pos - 1))) \t\t\tif @OrderID <> '' \t\t\tbegin \t\t\tinsert into @ParsedList (ID) \t\t\tvalues (cast(@OrderID as int)) --Use Appropriate conversion \t\tend  \t\tset @OrderList = right(@OrderList, len(@OrderList) - @Pos) \t\tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1) \tend end  return end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@OrderList varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "complete_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.complete_schedule \t@schedule_id     int, \t@exit_code       int, \t@status_code     int, \t@exit_module     smallint, \t@next_start_time datetime, \t@current_time    datetime, \t@status          varchar( 256 ), \t@level           smallint, \t@next_task_seq   int,\t -- this is ignored if @next_start_time is not null \t@taskresult      int as \tbegin transaction  \t-- first insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, 0, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult  \t-- now insert and fix up history for this item \texec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id  \t-- update the event schedule table \tif( @next_start_time is null ) \tbegin \t   -- Right now we never want to leave the next_task_seq as null for a completed schedule. \t   -- If it is null, set it to whatever the last sequence was \t   if( @next_task_seq is null ) \t   begin \t      select @next_task_seq = next_task_seq \t         from event_schedule \t   \t     where schedule_id = @schedule_id \t   end  \t\tDECLARE @called_status varchar(MAX),                 @calling_id    int,                 @dependent_id  int  \t\tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \t\tBEGIN \t\t\tDECLARE @event_name    varchar(128) \t\t\tSELECT  @event_name = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN') \t\t\t\tFROM event          AS e \t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\tWHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\t\tIF (@status_code = 0) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Called Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- clear dependent schedule id and set success status for calling schedule \t\t\t\tUPDATE    event_schedule \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL \t\t\t\t\tWHERE schedule_id = @calling_id \t\t\tEND \t\t\tELSE IF (@status_code = 1) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE    es \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  status_code = 1, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL, \t\t\t\t\t\t  next_task_seq = nts.next_task_seq, \t\t\t\t\t\t  end_time = @current_time \t\t\t\t\tFROM  event_schedule AS es \t\t\t\t\tJOIN ( \t\t\t\t\t\tSELECT s.schedule_id, MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tFROM script_task AS t \t\t\t\t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\t\t\t\tWHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tGROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\tWHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE es \t\t\t\t\tSET status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\tstatus_code = 1, {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_new_snmp_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  CREATE procedure ins_new_snmp_enclosure   @name varchar(64),   @manuf varchar(64),   @model varchar(64),   @ip_address varchar(20),   @community varchar(256),   @rack_name varchar(64) as   declare @enclosure_id as int,           @tran int,           @status int,           @rack_id int,           @org_name varchar(64)    set @tran = @@trancount    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    select @rack_id=rack_id from physical_rack where name=@rack_name    if(@rack_id is null)   begin     exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'      insert into physical_rack(rack_id, name, real_name, manuf_rack)       values(@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, 1)   end    select @enclosure_id=enclosure_id, @org_name=name from physical_enclosure where manuf=@manuf and model=@model       and ip_address=@ip_address and community=@community and rack_id=@rack_id    if (@enclosure_id is null)   begin     exec @enclosure_id = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'      insert into physical_enclosure(enclosure_id, name, real_name, manuf, model, ip_address, community, rack_id)       values(@enclosure_id, @name, @name, @manuf, @model, @ip_address, @community, @rack_id)      set @status = 1   end   else   begin     if(@org_name = @name)       set @status = 0     else     begin       set @status = 2       update physical_enclosure set name=@name, real_name=@name where enclosure_id=@enclosure_id     end   end    if (@@error != 0)   begin     if (@tran = 0)       rollback transaction   end    if (@tran = 0)   begin     commit transaction     select @enclosure_id, @status   end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @manuf varchar, @model varchar, @ip_address varchar, @community varchar, @rack_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_nic_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_nic_interface    @id int,    @nic_id int,    @interface_id int, \t\t -- -1 means use existing    @name varchar( 64 ) = null,    @ip varchar( 16 ) = null,    @netmask varchar( 16 ) = null,    @gateway varchar( 16 ) = null,    @broadcast varchar( 16 ) = null,    @state int = null as    declare @last_id int    declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     if( -1 = @interface_id )    begin       -- we don't have an existing id, just insert the data and let SQL generate one       insert into nic_interface          ( [id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state )          values          ( @id, @nic_id, @name, @ip, @netmask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state )        -- save the inserted identity so we can return it       set @last_id = @@identity    end    else    begin       -- update the data       update nic_interface  \t     set [id] = @id, nic_id = @nic_id,              [name] = @name, ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,  \t\t\tbroadcast = @broadcast, state = @state          where interface_id = @interface_id              -- the last identity was passed in but return it anyway       set @last_id = @interface_id    end     if( @@error != 0 )    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return -1    end    else    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          commit transaction       return @last_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @nic_id int, @interface_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_nic_interface_for_init_deploy", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_nic_interface_for_init_deploy    @computer_id\t\tint as \tbegin transaction  \tif not exists (select computer_id from nics where computer_id = @computer_id) \t\tinsert into nics (computer_id, nic_id) values (@computer_id, 0)  \tdelete nic_interface where [id] = @computer_id  \tupdate nics \t\tset ip_use_dhcp = nci.ip_use_dhcp, \t\t\tip_domain = nci.ip_domain, \t\t\tip_dns = nci.ip_dns, \t\t\tip_wins = nci.ip_wins \t\tfrom nics n, nic_config_item nci \t\twhere n.computer_id = @computer_id \t\t\tand n.nic_id = nci.nic_id  \tinsert nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state) \t\tselect @computer_id, nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state \t\tfrom nic_interface where [id] = (select config_item_id from config_item where target_computer_id = @computer_id)  \tif @@error = 0 \t\tcommit transaction \telse \t\trollback transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_redeploy_event", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_redeploy_event    @computer_id   int,    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    declare @new_time         datetime,            @schedule_id      int,            @max_history_id   int,            @bootoption_id    int     set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @start_time)     begin transaction     update event_schedule       set start_time = @new_time       where computer_id = @computer_id           and start_time <= @start_time           and status_code = null     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     if (@schedule_id = 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     select @max_history_id = max(history_id) from history_view where computer_id = @computer_id     insert into event_schedule       (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, cond_seq, next_task_seq, start_time, redeploy_history_id, rip_replace_event)    values       (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, null, 0, @start_time, @max_history_id, 1)     select top 1 @bootoption_id=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@event_id order by task_seq    if(@bootoption_id = 1 or @bootoption_id is null)    begin      exec @bootoption_id=sel_default_bootoption_id    end     select @bootoption_id as bootoption_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @start_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure [dbo].[mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task]     @schedule_id   int,     @operation_str varchar(64) as begin \tDECLARE   @calling_id   int \tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int \tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id         AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \tBEGIN \t\tDECLARE @failure_code int,                 @exit_code    int, \t\t        @taskresult   int, \t\t        @exit_module  smallint, \t\t        @level        smallint, \t\t        @current_time datetime         SELECT  @failure_code = 1,                 @exit_code    = 19501,                 @taskresult   = 0,                 @exit_module  = 16,                 @level        = 3,                 @current_time = GETDATE()  \t\tDECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tDECLARE @errstatus   varchar(MAX);         SELECT  @errstatus = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @eventname + '] Was ' + @operation_str \t\t \t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @errstatus, @failure_code, @exit_code, @exit_module,                                  @level, @taskresult  \t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE es             SET status          = @errstatus,                 status_code     = @failure_code,                 dep_schedule_id = NULL,                 next_task_seq   = nts.next_task_seq,                 end_time        = @current_time             FROM event_schedule AS es             JOIN (                 SELECT    s.schedule_id,                           MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq,                           t.cond_seq                     FROM  script_task    AS t                     JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id                     WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq                     GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq                  ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq             WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE    event_schedule             SET   status          = @errstatus,                   status_code     = @failure_code,                   dep_schedule_id = NULL,                   end_time        = @current_time             WHERE schedule_id     = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id          IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL)             EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' \tEND end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @operation_str varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_upd_event_schedule_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.mm_upd_event_schedule_id    @schedule_id\t\t\tint,    @start_time          datetime,    @status              varchar(254) = NULL,    @recur_value         int = NULL,    @recur_type\t\t    smallint = NULL,    @defer               int = NULL,    @user_id\t\t\t\tint = 0,    @cond_seq\t\t\tint = NULL,    @calling_schedule    int = NULL,    @winuser_id       int = 0  --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User as    declare @new_sched_id int     begin transaction     exec mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @schedule_id, 'Restarted'     exec @new_sched_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     update event_schedule     set next_task_seq = NULL, start_time = @start_time, status = @status, \tdefer_mins = @defer, recur_value = @recur_value, recur_type = @recur_type, \tstatus_code = NULL, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \tbroker_time = NULL, user_id = @user_id, cond_seq = @cond_seq, \tcalling_event = @calling_schedule, dep_schedule_id = null, \tschedule_id = @new_sched_id, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null on  \"Reschedule\" or \"start now\" }    where schedule_id = @schedule_id    --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User    update  event_schedule_info     set schedule_id = @new_sched_id, \t\twindows_user_id = @winuser_id, \t\tjob_exec_time = null\t-- PRD 7.1.49 (Bug Fix #36624)    where        schedule_id  = @schedule_id\t\t   -------------------------------------------     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     return @new_sched_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @status varchar, @recur_value int, @recur_type smallint, @defer int, @user_id int, @cond_seq int, @calling_schedule int, @winuser_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_upd_sched_dependency", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.mm_upd_sched_dependency    @schedule_id   int,    @schedule_dependent_on int as    declare   @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     --begin transaction -- we do a transaction around the whole thing now    update event_schedule        set dep_schedule_id = @schedule_dependent_on       where schedule_id = @schedule_id     --commit transaction    if( 0 = @tran )    begin       if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @schedule_dependent_on int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_automation_job", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_automation_job    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule es          where ( (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is NULL)             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)            and es.event_id in ( select t.event_id from [task] t left outer join [script_task] st \t\t\ton t.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\tand t.cond_seq = st.cond_seq  \t\t\tand t.task_seq = st.task_seq \t\t\twhere ((t.task_type = 10 and st.execution_mode = 0) \t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 22) )        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_current_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_current_schedule \t@computer_id\tint, \t@schedule_id\tint, \t@task_seq\t\tint, \t@boot_env\t\tint as \tdeclare @return_code  int \tset @return_code = null  \tif (@schedule_id = 0) \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks there is has not work, lets make sure. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule es join task t  \t\t\t\ton es.event_id = t.event_id \t\t\t\tand es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = t.task_seq \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and (es.status_code = -1 or es.status_code = -3) \t\t\t\tand ( ( @boot_env = 1 -- BOOT_AUTOMATION = 1 \t\t\t\t\t\tand ( t.task_type = 10 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 11 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 ) ) \t\t\t\t\tor  \t\t\t\t\t( @boot_env != 1 ) )  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \tend \telse \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks it is working on a job. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \t\t\t\tand schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\tand next_task_seq = @task_seq \t\t\t\tand status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\tbegin \t\t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\t\tset @return_code = 0 -- Agent thinks it has a job, but we don't.  \t\t\t-- We think it is working on a different job than the agent thinks. \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\t-- We are in sync with the agent. \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \t\tend \tend  \treturn @return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @boot_env int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_os_version_change", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_os_version_change    @computer_id   int,    @os            varchar(128) as    if (@computer_id = 0)       return     if not exists (select computer_id from computer where computer_id = @computer_id and os = @os)    begin       begin transaction       update computer set last_inventory = null where computer_id = @computer_id       if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @os varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_inventory_group_tree", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_inventory_group_tree \t@user_id int, \t@do_visibility_check int as \tdeclare @cont_folder int \tdeclare @cont_thin_client int  \tselect @cont_folder = 0; \tselect @cont_thin_client = 4;  \t-- display containers with computers also \tselect  \t\tgroup_id as id,  \t\tparent_id as parentid,  \t\t@cont_folder as container,  \t\ticon as icon,  \t\tname,  \t\t0 as proc_type,  \t\t0 as [os_bit],\t \t\t0 \tfrom computer_group cg left outer join #computer_visibility ov  \t\t\ton cg.group_id = ov.object_id where @do_visibility_check = 0 or (ov.user_id = @user_id and (ov.visible > 0)) \tunion \tselect \t\ta.computer_id, \t\ta.group_id, \t\ta.node_type,         a.icon, \t\ta.[name], \t\tcoalesce( \t\t\t( select h.proc_type from hardware h where h.computer_id = a.computer_id), \t\t\t(0) \t\t\t) as proc_type, \t\tcoalesce([os_bit], 32),\t \t\t0 \tfrom \t\tcomputer a left outer join nics n \t\t\ton a.computer_id = n.computer_id \t\twhere a.hidden is null and node_type = @cont_thin_client  \t\t\tand (@do_visibility_check = 0 or exists  \t\t\t\t(select visible from #computer_visibility ov  \t\t\t\t\twhere ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.visible = 1 and ((ov.object_id = a.group_id) or (ov.object_id = -1 and a.group_id is null) \t\t\t\t\tor (a.group_id is null and ov.object_id = a.computer_id) ) ) ) --63670, 63679 --\t\t\t\t\twhere ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.object_id = a.group_id and ov.visible = 1) \torder by 2 asc, 3 asc, 8 asc, 5 asc, 7 asc ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user_id int, @do_visibility_check int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_image_post_config", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_is_image_post_config    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc \t \tif (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) \tbegin \t\treturn -1 \tend  \tselect @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  \t \tif( @deploy_any_event_id != 0 ) \t\tset @next_task_seq = @next_task_seq + 1  \tselect @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_set \t\twhere config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq and reconfig is null)  \tif (@config_set_id is null) \t\treturn -1     return @next_task_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_job_status_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_job_status_info \t@computer_id int as \tselect t.task_type, es.schedule_id, es.next_task_seq, \t\tcase t.task_type \t\t\twhen 10 then\t\t\t\t-- Script \t\t\t\t(select case when location = 1 then 'None' \t\t\t\t\t\t\t when execution_mode = 0 then 'Automation'  \t\t\t\t\t\t\t else 'Production' \t\t\t\t\t\tend  \t\t\t\t\tfrom script_task st \t\t\t\t\twhere st.event_id = t.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.cond_seq = t.cond_seq  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.task_seq = t.task_seq) \t\t\twhen 11 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Reboot \t\t\twhen 12 then 'Production'\t-- Copy File \t\t\twhen 13 then 'Automation'\t-- Registry  \t\t\twhen 14 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Config \t\t\twhen 15 then 'Automation'\t-- Image \t\t\twhen 16 then 'Production'\t-- Install \t\t\twhen 17 then 'Automation'\t-- Unattended Install \t\t\twhen 18 then 'Production'\t-- PCT \t\t\twhen 19 then 'Production'\t-- Inventory \t\t\twhen 21 then 'Production'\t-- Update Agent  \t\t\telse 'None' \t\tend as boot_env \t\tfrom dbo.task t join dbo.event_schedule es  \t\t\ton es.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\t\t\tand t.event_id = es.event_id  \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq  \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq \t\twhere es.status_code is not null  \t\t\tand es.status_code != -2 \t\t\tand es.status_code < 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_lic_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_lic_info    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36) as    declare  @del_expire   datetime     select @del_expire = expire from deleted_computer where mac_addr = @mac_addr     if (@computer_id = 0)    begin       select @del_expire as del_expire    end    else    begin       select expire, limited_license, @del_expire as del_expire          from computer where computer_id = @computer_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_more_work", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_more_work    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule          where (next_task_seq > -1             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end   --LB#35552   -- select computer_id from sessions where platform = 1 and computer_id not in (    select computer_id from sessions where boot_env = 1 and computer_id not in ( -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }       select distinct s.computer_id from sessions s, event_schedule es          where s.computer_id = es.computer_id --LB#35552    and platform = 1 \t       and boot_env = 1\t\t-- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }             and es.start_time <= @time_now             and ( ( es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code < 0 )                   and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in                      ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )                or ( es.event_id = 2000001 and es.status_code is NULL ) ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_expired_time", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_expired_time    @cur_time   datetime as    declare @sched_in_progress int     select top 1 @sched_in_progress = schedule_id from event_schedule where status_code < 0    if (@sched_in_progress is null)       set @sched_in_progress = 0    else       set @sched_in_progress = 1     if exists (select top 1 es.schedule_id       from event_schedule es       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @cur_time          and es.computer_id in (select s.computer_id from sessions s where es.computer_id = s.computer_id          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in \t\t( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ))))    select dateadd (mi, -1, @cur_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress    else    select min (start_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress       from event_schedule       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time >= @cur_time          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_seq_by_sched", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_seq_by_sched    @schedule_id int as    declare @event_id int    declare @cond_seq int    declare @task_seq int    declare @next_sequence int     select @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq       from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     exec @next_sequence = sel_next_sequence @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     return @next_sequence ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_sequence", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_sequence    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    set @next_task_seq = null    select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc     return coalesce (@next_task_seq, -1) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_system_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_system_id    @object_id   varchar(64),    @update      char(1) = 'T' as    declare  @last_used_id int,             @tran         int    declare  @err    varchar(100)     set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction     select @last_used_id = last_used_id + 1       from system_id with (xlock, rowlock)       where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)  \tif 'EVENT_ID' = upper(@object_id) \tBegin \t\tif @last_used_id = 3000000 \t\tbegin \t\t\tSET @last_used_id = 19000000 \t\tend \tend     if (@last_used_id is null)    begin       set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id in selecting object ' + @object_id       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction;       -- raiserror 30008 @err \t  -- THROW 30008, @err, 1 \t  RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)       return 0    end     if (upper(@update) = 'T')    begin       update system_id set last_used_id = @last_used_id          where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)        if (@@error != 0)       begin          set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id updating object ' + @object_id          if (@tran = 0)             rollback transaction;          -- raiserror 30009 @err \t\t -- THROW 30009, @err, 1 \t\t RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)          return 0       end        if (@tran = 0)          commit transaction    end    else    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     return coalesce (@last_used_id, 0) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@object_id varchar, @update char)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_task_seq \t@schedule_id \tint as \tdeclare @ret_val int \tselect top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq \t\tfrom task t, event_schedule es \t\twhere t.event_id = es.event_id \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq \t\t\t\tand es.schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\torder by t.task_seq asc  \tif @ret_val is null \tbegin \t\tset @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 \tend  \treturn @ret_val ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}
