{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_redeploy_tasks", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_redeploy_tasks    @computer_id   int as    declare  @temp_id int,             @history_id int,             @script_tag_id int     select top 1 @temp_id = history_id       from history_view       where ((task_type = 15 and xml_task like '%<Upload>0%')or task_type = 17)     -- Image task or Unattended Install          and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@temp_id is not null)    begin       declare @new_history_id int       declare @min_task_seq int        set @min_task_seq = null       select @min_task_seq = min(task_seq) from task               where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)        if (@min_task_seq is null)       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and redeploy = 1             order by [sequence], history_id desc       end       else       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and [sequence] = @min_task_seq and redeploy = 1              order by history_id desc       end \t\t                 if (@new_history_id != @temp_id)          set @temp_id = @new_history_id        select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view          where history_id < @temp_id             and computer_id = @computer_id             and task_type != 10             and task_type != 11             and task_type != 12 \t    and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        select top 1 @script_tag_id = history_id from history_view          where computer_id = @computer_id             and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%')  and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        -- get the one which was the lastest one ran.       if ((@script_tag_id > @history_id or @history_id is null) and @script_tag_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @script_tag_id - 1       end        if ( @history_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @history_id + 1       end       else       begin          -- if there was script, copy file or reboot prior to image event          -- get the first history_id for this computer          select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view             where history_id < @temp_id                and computer_id = @computer_id \t       and redeploy = 1             order by history_id           if ( @history_id is null)             set @history_id = @temp_id       end        select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id        return    end     -- no image or scripted install found, looking for tag.    select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id          and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%') \t and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@history_id is not null)    begin       select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id       return    end     -- nothing was found, we will send all the history for this computer.    select task_type, xml_task       from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_return_handler", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_return_handler \t@event_id int, \t@cond_seq int, \t@task_seq int, \t@ret_code int = null as declare @count int declare @handler int declare @handlername nvarchar(64)  select @count = count(*) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  if @count < 1    begin \tif @ret_code = 0 \t\tselect @handler = 1 -- continue \telse \t   begin \t\tselect @handler = on_fail \t\t  from task \t\t  where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq \t\t  group by on_fail \t   end    end else    select @handler = handler \tfrom task_return_handlers \twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  select @handler = coalesce (@handler, 0) -- default, stop  if @handler <> 0 AND @handler <> 1 \tselect @handler, [name] from event where event_id = @handler else \tselect @handler, ' '  return @handler ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @ret_code int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_return_handler_status_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure sel_return_handler_status_info @sched_id int, @ret_code int AS declare @retval int declare @event_id int declare @cond_seq int declare @task_seq int  select @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq, @event_id = event_id \tfrom event_schedule where event_schedule.schedule_id = @sched_id  select status, ret_code, result from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and \t\t\t\t\t\t        task_seq = @task_seq and \t\t\t\t\t\t        cond_seq = @cond_seq and \t\t\t\t\t\t         ret_code = @ret_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@sched_id int, @ret_code int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    declare @tmprowscount   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction      \t\tselect @tmprowscount = count(event_id) from copyfile_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from script_task where   username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(distinct event_id) from install_task where (username = @username and password = @oldpassword) or \t\t   (exec_username = @username and exec_password = @oldpassword)  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from capture_pct_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_wol_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_wol_computer    @computer_id      int,    @wol_support      int = null as  if (@wol_support is null or @wol_support = '')       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id    else       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.wol_support = 1                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @wol_support int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_config_item \t@set_expr            varchar(2048), \t@config_set_id       int, \t@target_computer_id  int = null, \t@config_item_id      int = null, \t@history             int = null with execute as owner as begin \tdeclare @sql   nvarchar(2048) \tset     @sql = 'update config_set set ' + @set_expr + ' where config_set_id = @id'  \tif ( @config_item_id is null ) \tbegin \t\tif ( @target_computer_id is not null ) \t\t\tset @sql = @sql + ' and   target_computer_id = ' + cast(@target_computer_id as nvarchar(16)) \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tif ( @target_computer_id is null ) \t\t\tset @sql = @sql + ' and   config_item_id = ' + cast(@config_item_id as nvarchar(16)) \t\telse \t\t\tset @sql = @sql + ' and   config_item_id = ' + cast(@config_item_id as nvarchar(16)) + \t\t\t                  ' and   target_computer_id = ' + cast(@target_computer_id as nvarchar(16)) \tend \tif ( @history = 1 ) \t\tset @sql = @sql + ' and   history_id is null'  \texecute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int', @config_set_id end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@set_expr varchar, @config_set_id int, @target_computer_id int, @config_item_id int, @history int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_deferred_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_deferred_schedule \t@schedule_id int, \t@start_time datetime, \t@current_time datetime, \t@status varchar( 256 ), \t@status_module smallint as     declare @comp_id int  \t-- make sure the schedule is valid \tselect @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id \tif( @comp_id is null ) \tbegin \t   return \tend  \tbegin transaction  \t-- update the event schedule table \tupdate event_schedule \t\tset status_code = null, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \t\t\tstart_time = @start_time, status = @status \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t-- now insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, -1, -1, @status_module  \t-- erase old wol info \texec upd_computer_wol_info @comp_id, null  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tcommit transaction \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_cond_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_cond_seq    @schedule_id   int,    @cond_seq      int,    @status_code   int = NULL,    @status        varchar (254) = NULL,    @exit_code     int = NULL,    @exit_module   smallint = NULL as \tif (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) \t\tset @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is NULL and @status_code is NULL)       update event_schedule set cond_seq = @cond_seq where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else    begin       update event_schedule \t\tset cond_seq = @cond_seq, status_code = @status_code, \t\t\tstatus = @status, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @cond_seq int, @status_code int, @status varchar, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_config_choice", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_config_choice    @schedule_id      int,    @config_choice_id int = null,    @status_code      int = null,    @status           varchar(254) = null as    begin transaction     if (@config_choice_id = 0)    begin       declare @comp_id int \t  select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id       update computer set domain_name = 'WORKGROUP', domain_member = 0 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  if exists (select 1 from nics where computer_id = @comp_id and nic_id = 0) \t\tupdate nics set ip_use_dhcp = 1 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  else \t\tinsert nics (computer_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp) values (@comp_id, 0, 1)    end     if (@status_code is NULL and @status is NULL)    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id,              status_code = @status_code,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @config_choice_id int, @status_code int, @status varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_init_deploy", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_init_deploy    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    begin transaction     update event_schedule set start_time = @start_time       where event_id = @event_id          and next_task_seq > -1          and status_code is null \t\t and cond_seq is null \t\t and initial_deployment = 1     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @start_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq    @schedule_id      int,    @next_task_seq    int,    @status_code      smallint,    @exit_code        int,    @exit_module      smallint,    @status           varchar(254),    @current_time     datetime,    @module           smallint,    @level            smallint,    @taskresult       int as begin     if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0)         set @status_code = 1      declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount      if( 0 = @tran )         begin transaction  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int     SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id      IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL AND @status_code IS NULL AND @status = 'Error ' + LTRIM(@exit_code) + ' during script execution')     BEGIN         DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @dependent_id          SELECT @status = 'Scheduled Job [' + @eventname + '] Due To Return Code Handler: ' + LTRIM(@exit_code)     END      -- update status_log table with schedule info     exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level, @taskresult      -- now insert and fix up history for this item     exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id      -- now update the event_schedule table     update event_schedule         set next_task_seq = @next_task_seq,         status = @status,         status_code = @status_code,         exit_code = @exit_code,         exit_module = @exit_module,         config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null }     where schedule_id = @schedule_id      if( 0 = @tran )     begin         if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction         else             commit transaction     end end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @next_task_seq int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @taskresult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_status    @schedule_id   int,    @status_code   smallint,    @exit_code\t   int,    @exit_module   smallint,    @status        varchar(254),    @broker_time   datetime,    @module        smallint,    @level         smallint,    @log_event     smallint = 0 as    declare @upd_status_code smallint     -- we need to remember the status code that was passed in, but if it's null,    -- we want to get the status code that is currently in the event schedule.    set @upd_status_code = @status_code     if (@upd_status_code is null and @log_event = 1)       select @upd_status_code = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     if (@exit_code is not null ) and ( @exit_code != 0 ) and ( @status_code is not null ) and       ( @status_code > 0 )    begin       set @status_code = 1    end     begin transaction     if (@broker_time is null)    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status,             broker_time = @broker_time          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t--LB#40844        if( @status_code >= 0 )       \t begin      \t\texec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@broker_time        \tend    end     -- use the passed in status code for this function, unlike above where we use our    -- adjusted @use_status_code var.  This is so we can save exit_codes without    -- killing the status_code in the event schedule table.    exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @broker_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @broker_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @log_event smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_status    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36),    @schedule_id   int,    @task_seq      int,    @status        varchar(254),    @status_code   int as    if (@status is null and @status_code is null)       return     begin transaction     if (@status_code is not null and @status is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code,             status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else if (@status_code is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else       update event_schedule          set status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq     if (@@error = 0)       commit transaction    else       rollback transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @status varchar, @status_code int)"}

 end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @serial_num varchar, @uuid varchar, @asset_tag {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_schedule_return_code_event", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.upd_schedule_return_code_event \t@computer_id int, \t@existing_schedule_id int, \t@calling_schedule int, \t@start_time datetime as \tdeclare @new_schedule_id int \tbegin transaction  \texec @new_schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'  \tif (@calling_schedule is not null) \tbegin         update event_schedule \t\tset start_time = dateadd(minute, 1, @start_time) \t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \t\t\tand start_time <= @start_time \t\t\tand status_code is null \t\t\tand schedule_id != @existing_schedule_id \t\t\tand dep_schedule_id is null  \t\tupdate event_schedule \t\tset dep_schedule_id = @new_schedule_id \t\t\twhere schedule_id = @calling_schedule \tend  \tupdate event_schedule \t\tset schedule_id = @new_schedule_id, \t\t\tcalling_event = @calling_schedule, \t\t\tdep_schedule_id = null, \t\t\tstatus_code = null, \t\t\tstatus = '', \t\t\tcond_seq = null, \t\t\tnext_task_seq = null, \t\t\tstart_time = @start_time, \t\t\trecur_type = null, \t\t\trecur_value = null \t\twhere schedule_id = @existing_schedule_id  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \t\treturn \tend     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @existing_schedule_id int, @calling_schedule int, @start_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_schedule_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_schedule_status    @schedule_id         int,    @status_code         smallint,    @exit_code           int,    @exit_module         smallint,    @status              varchar(254) = null,    @current_time        datetime = null,    @module              smallint = null,    @level               smallint = null as    if (@status_code = -99)       set @exit_code = null  \tif (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) \t\tset @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code, \t\t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\t\texit_module = @exit_module          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code, \t\t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id \t--LB#40844 \t if (@status_code >=0 and @current_time is not null) \tbegin   \t\texec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@current_time    \tend     if ( @current_time is not null )    begin       exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level  end -- now insert and fix up history for this item --LB#34907 if ( @exit_code=5 ) begin       exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_schedule_update_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_schedule_update_status    @schedule_id         int,    @status_code         smallint,    @exit_code           int,    @exit_module         smallint,    @status              varchar(254) = null,    @current_time        datetime = null,    @module              smallint = null,    @level               smallint = null as    if (@status_code = -99)       set @status_code = null     if exists (select schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\t\t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id and status_code = 0 and next_task_seq = -1)       return  \tif (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) \t\tset @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code, \t\t\t exit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\t exit_module = @exit_module,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id  --LB#40844 \tif(@status_code >=0 and @current_time is not null) \tbegin \t\texec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@current_time \tend     if ( @current_time is not null )       exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_session", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_session    @computer_id      int,    @status           varchar (254) as    declare  @schedule_id      int,             @event_id         int,             @cond_seq         int,             @next_task_seq    int,             @found            int     set @found = null     select @schedule_id = schedule_id, @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @next_task_seq = next_task_seq from event_schedule       where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code = -3 and computer_id = @computer_id     if (@schedule_id is not null)    begin       select @found = event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq       if (@found is null)          select @found = event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq    end     if (@found is not null)    begin       begin transaction        update event_schedule set status_code = NULL, status = @status where schedule_id = @schedule_id        if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @status varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_set_next_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_set_next_task \t@schedule_id int as \tdeclare @next_seq_id int \tdeclare @retval int  \tselect top 1 @next_seq_id = t.task_seq \t\tfrom task t\tinner join event_schedule es on es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq and es.event_id = t.event_id \t\twhere es.schedule_id = @schedule_id and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq \t\torder by task_seq  \tif (@next_seq_id is not null) \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction  \t\tupdate event_schedule set next_task_seq = @next_seq_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tif (@@error = 0) \t\t\tcommit transaction \t\telse \t\t\trollback transaction  \t\tset @retval = @next_seq_id \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tset @retval = -1 \tend  \treturn @retval ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghost_cmdline", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghost_cmdline]    @event_id\tint,    @new_session_name varchar(50) as    declare @tran int    declare @old_session_name varchar(50)    set @tran = @@trancount     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task  \t  set @old_session_name = SUBSTRING(addl_cmdline,CHARINDEX('\"', addl_cmdline , 1) + 1,LEN(addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('\"', addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('\"', REVERSE(addl_cmdline))), \t  ghcastsrv_cmdline = case when ghcastsrv_cmdline is not null then replace(ghcastsrv_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) else NULL end, \t  addl_cmdline =  replace(addl_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) \t  where event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @new_session_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghostcast_setting", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghostcast_setting]    @event_id\tint,    @ghostcast_setting varchar(10) as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     set @ghostcast_setting = ' ' + @ghostcast_setting     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task set ghcastsrv_cmdline =  \t  case   when CHARINDEX(' -N',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -N%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -T',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -T%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -O',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -O%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)           END \t  where event_id = @event_id and ghcastsrv_cmdline is not NULL             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @ghostcast_setting varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128),    @newpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction  \t\tupdate    copyfile_task \t\tset       password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    script_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          exec_password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (exec_username) = lower (@username)) and (exec_password = @oldpassword) \t\t--the install_task.username and install_task.exec_username appear to always be the same so do not add to the count set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    capture_pct_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar, @newpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_unattend_var", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure upd_unattend_var     @var_id int,     @default_val int,     @var_name varchar(254),     @var_desc varchar(254),     @var_type smallint,     @val_value varchar(256),     @val_displayed [description]=@var_desc, [type]=@var_type                        where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      if(@old_type = 0 and @var_type != 0)     begin       delete from unattend_vars_value where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and unattend_vars_value_id <> @default_val     end      if(@var_type != 0)     begin       update unattend_vars_value set [value]=@val_value, name_displayed=@val_displayed                       where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val     end      if(@var_type = 0)     begin       set @default_val=NULL        select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from (@default_val is null)       begin         insert into unattend_vars_value(unattend_vars_id, [value], name_displayed, [default])                     values(@var_id, @val_value, @val_displayed, 1)          select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                     where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value]=@val_value       end       else       begin         update {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_static_routes_config_items", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing  create procedure wc_del_static_routes_config_items    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint  as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this config_static_route_item    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @config_item_id is not null    begin        -- delete the static routing records of configItemId       begin transaction         delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_static_routes_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "   -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static routing create procedure wc_del_static_routes_config_set    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null   as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id     if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- delete the static routing set entries       begin transaction        \t    delete config_static_route_set where config_set_id = @configSetId                       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction       end       else          commit transaction    end   ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_generate_first_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_generate_first_computer_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64) output as    -- get the name range data from the config_set record    declare @method smallint, @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @method = cname_method, @fixed = cname_fixed, @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append,       @numbers = cname_numbers from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       if @numbers = 1 -- numeric portion       begin          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))          else             set @name = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed       end       else -- alpha portion       begin          -- convert number to ascii character values          declare @alpha varchar(64)          set @alpha = ''          while @addl >= 0          begin                         declare @dval smallint             set @dval = @addl % 26             set @addl = @addl / 26             set @alpha = @alpha + char(@dval + 97)             set @addl = @addl - 1          end          -- reverse the character order to form the final string          set @alpha = reverse(@alpha)          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + @alpha          else             set @name = @alpha + @fixed       end    end    else       set @name = null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_have_computer_for_vm", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_have_computer_for_vm    @vm_uuid varchar(128),    @host_uuid varchar(128),    @vc_computer varchar(256) as    declare @vm_comp_id int        select @vm_comp_id = computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)        if @vm_comp_id is not null    begin       update computer set virtual_machine_host_group_id =           (select virtual_machine_host_group_id from virtual_machine_host_group where computer = @vc_computer),          virtual_machine_host_id = (select computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@host_uuid))          where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)                 select 1    end    else    begin       select 0    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@vm_uuid varchar, @host_uuid varchar, @vc_computer varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_ip    @ip varchar(16),    @ip_out varchar(16) output as    -- break the IP address into integer octet values    declare @octet1 int, @octet2 int, @octet3 int, @octet4 int    declare @dot_index1 int, @dot_index2 int    select @dot_index1 = charindex('.', @ip)    set @octet1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @dot_index1 - 1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index1 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet2 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet3 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = len(@ip)    set @octet4 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - (@dot_index1 - 1)) as int)     -- increment octet values as needed to increment the ip    if @octet4 < 255       set @octet4 = @octet4 + 1    else    begin       set @octet4 = 1       if @octet3 < 255          set @octet3 = @octet3 + 1       else       begin          set @octet3 = 0          if @octet2 < 255             set @octet2 = @octet2 + 1          else          begin             set @octet2 = 0             if @octet1 < 255                set @octet1 = @octet1 + 1             else             begin                set @octet1 = 1                set @octet2 = 1                set @octet3 = 1                set @octet4 = 1             end          end       end    end     set @ip_out = cast(@octet1 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet2 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet3 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet4 as varchar(3)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ip varchar, @ip_out varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64),    @name_out varchar(64) output as    -- Get the name range information from the config_set record    declare @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append, @numbers = cname_numbers,       @fixed = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id    if len(@name) = 0       exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @config_set_id, @name     -- Split the fixed and variable text in the @name passed in    declare @variable_text varchar(64)    declare @fixed_pos int    set @fixed_pos = charindex(@fixed, @name)    if @fixed_pos > 1 -- prefix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, 1, @fixed_pos - 1)    else -- postfix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, len(@fixed) + 1, len(@name) - len(@fixed))           -- Increment the @variable_text    if @numbers = 1    begin       -- numeric variable       set @addl = cast(@variable_text as smallint) + 1       if @append = 1          set @name_out = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))       else          set @name_out = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed    end    else    begin       -- alpha variable       -- test for all Z characters       set @variable_text = upper(@variable_text)       declare @z_count int, @z_loc int       set @z_loc = 0       set @z_count = 0       set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text)       while @z_loc > 0       begin          set @z_count = @z_count + 1          set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text, @z_loc + 1)       end       if len(@variable_text) = @z_count       begin          -- reset to all A characters and add A to the end          set @name_out = replace(@variable_text, 'Z', 'A')          set @name_out = @variable_text + 'A'       end       else       begin          -- advance all needed characters          declare @addl_out varchar(64)          set @addl_out = ''                    declare @char int          declare @increment_done smallint          set @increment_done = 0          while len(@variable_text) > 0          begin             set @char = ascii(substring(@variable_text, len(@variable_text), 1))             if @increment_done = 0             begin                if @char = 90                   set @char = 65                else                begin                   set @char = @char + 1                   set @increment_done = 1                end             end              set @addl_out = @addl_out + char(@char)              if len(@variable_text) > 1                set @variable_text = substring(@variable_text, 1, len(@variable_text) - 1)             else                set @variable_text = ''          end          set @addl_out = reverse(@addl_out)          if @append = 1             set @name_out = @fixed + @addl_out          else             set @name_out = @addl_out + @fixed       end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar, @name_out varchar OUT)"}

declare @single int       set @single = @bayIdx       if @bayIdx is null          select @bayIdx = max(idx) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @missingBay smallint               set @bayIdx = null                select @bayIdx = bay_id from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId                   and idx = @missingBay                if @bayIdx is not {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_condition", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_condition \t@job \tint, \t@name\tvarchar(64) as \tdeclare @condition   int    \tselect @condition = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id = @job    \tif @condition is null \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\tinsert into event_condition (event_id, cond_seq, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (@job, 1, null) \t\tif(@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t\t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @condition = -1 \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\tcommit transaction \t\t\tset @condition = 0 \t\tend \tend    \telse \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\t\tupdate event_condition set cond_seq = @condition + 1 \t\t\t\twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition \t\tif (@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t      \trollback transaction \t\t\tset @condition = -1 \t\tend \t   \telse \t      \tcommit transaction \tend  \tif @condition > -1 \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\t \t\t\tinsert into event_condition (event_id, cond_seq, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (@job, @condition, @name) \t \t\tif (@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t      \t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @condition = -1 \t\tend \t   \telse \t      \t\tcommit transaction \tend  \tselect @condition as cond_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_del_set_right", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_del_set_right    @right int,    @user int,    @grant smallint as    -- determine if the right already exists    declare @granted smallint    select @granted = count(user_id) from securityprivilegelink        where [user_id] = @user and privilege_id = @right     if @granted is null       -- add a new right       if @grant = 1          insert into securityprivilegelink (privilege_id, [user_id])          values (@right, @user)    else       -- remove an existing right       if @grant = 0          delete from securityprivilegelink where privilege_id = @right          and [user_id] = @user ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@right int, @user int, @grant smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_dnsSuffix", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "   -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix create procedure wc_ins_dnsSuffix     @job\t\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,     @dnsSuffix\t\tvarchar(256),    @order                         smallint,    @configSetId int = null,    @computerId int = null as   begin transaction   if @computerId is null     begin                             -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this dns_suffix     if @configSetId is null       begin        select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task       end          -- insert the new dns_suffix record          insert into dns_suffix ( [id], dns_suffix, [order] ) values (@configSetId,  @dnsSuffix, @order )          end      else   --If the new computer is created than                insert into dns_suffix ([id],  dns_suffix, [order] ) values (@computerId, @dnsSuffix, @order)            -- handle errors/commit transaction                if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction        end       else          commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @dnsSuffix varchar, @order smallint, @configSetId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_dnsSuffixItem", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix create procedure wc_ins_dnsSuffixItem    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint,     @order\t\tsmallint,    @dnsSuffix\t\tvarchar(256)     as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task  --  declare @config_set_id int  -- select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task      --  where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task    --declare @config_item_id int    --select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id      -- and target_computer_id = @computer     if @config_item_id  is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          insert into dns_suffix ( [id],dns_suffix, [order] ) values (@config_item_id, @dnsSuffix, @order)              -- handle errors/commit transaction            if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int, @order smallint, @dnsSuffix varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_enclosure    @name  varchar(64),    @model varchar(64),    @bayCount int,    @rack  int,    @ip varchar(20) = null,    @community varchar(256) = null as    -- ensure rack exists    declare @enclosureId int    declare @rackId int    declare @manuf smallint    select @rackId = rack_id, @manuf = manuf_rack from physical_rack where rack_id = @rack     if @rackId is not null and @manuf = 0    begin       -- avoid duplicate enclosures       select @enclosureId = enclosure_id from physical_enclosure where real_name = @name       if @enclosureId is null       begin          -- insert enclosure          exec @enclosureId = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'           insert into physical_enclosure(rack_id, enclosure_id, [name], real_name, model, bay_count, ip_address, community)              values (@rackId, @enclosureId, @name, @name, @model, @bayCount, @ip, @community)       end    end    else       set @enclosureId = -1     return @enclosureId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @model varchar, @bayCount int, @rack int, @ip varchar, @community varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_filter", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- PRD item 7.1.7_and_7.1.8 Active and Inactive computer Filter  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_filter \t@name\tvarchar(64) as \tdeclare @filter   int \tselect @filter = max(filter_id) from filter \tif @filter is null \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\tinsert into filter (filter_id, folder_id, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (8000001, null, null) \t\tif(@@error != 0)\t \t\tbegin \t\t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @filter = -1 \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\tcommit transaction \t\t\tset @filter = 0 \t\tend \tend  \telse if @filter > -1 \tbegin \t\tbegin transaction \t\t \t\t\tinsert into filter (filter_id, folder_id, [name]) \t\t\tvalues (@filter+1, null, @name) \t \t\tif (@@error != 0) \t\tbegin \t      \t\trollback transaction \t\t\tset @filter = -1 \t\tend \t   \telse \t      \t\tcommit transaction \tend  \tselect @filter+1 as filter_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_filter_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- PRD item 7.1.7_and_7.1.8 Active and Inactive computer Filter  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_filter_item    @filter int,    @field int,    @operation int,    @value varchar(256) = null,    @drive varchar(8) = null,    @conjunct smallint = -1 as    -- get the next filter  item id    declare @item   int    select @item = max(item_seq) from filter_condition where filter_id = @filter     if @item is null       set @item = 0    else       set @item = @item + 1     begin transaction     \tinsert into filter_condition (filter_id, item_seq, field_type, oper_type, key_value, drive, conjunct) \t\tvalues (@filter, @item, @field, @operation, @value, @drive, @conjunct)     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @item as item_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@filter int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_folder", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_folder    @name          varchar(64) = null,    @parentId     int = -10 as    begin transaction     declare @folderId int    set @folderId = null    exec @folderId = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'     if(@name is null)       set @name = 'New Folder ' + cast((@folderId - 1000000) as varchar)      if(@parentId = -10)       set @parentId = null        if(@folderId != 0)       insert into event_folder ( folder_id, name, parent_id )        values ( @folderId, @name, @parentId )     if (@@error != 0 or @folderId = 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @folderId as FolderId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @parentId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_install_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create varchar(128),    @exec_password varchar(128),    @svs_action int, -- DE 2.19    @svs_action_force smallint, -- DE 2.19    @svs_layer_guid varchar(36) as    -- collect the highest task sequence value for the event/condition    declare @taskSeq   int    select @taskSeq = task_seq from task where task_seq =        (select top 1 task_seq from task         where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq        order by task_seq desc)    -- increment to get available task sequence slot    if @taskSeq is null       set @taskSeq = 0    else       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1     -- insert a new task (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 0)    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction     -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @filename varchar, @username varchar, @password varchar, @commandLine varchar, @allUsers smallint, {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_job", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_job    @name         varchar(128) = null,    @folder_id    int = -10,    @folder_name  varchar(64) = NULL,    @add_number   int = 0,    @default_event_name\tvarchar(64) = 'New Job',    @default_folder_name varchar(64) = 'New Folder',    @description   varchar(254) = null as    declare @event_id int     exec @event_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_ID'     if (@event_id = 0)    begin       return -1    end     if (@name is null or @name = '')    begin       select @name = @default_event_name    end     if (@add_number > 0)    begin       select @name = @name + ' ' + cast((@event_id - 2000006) as varchar(30))    end     if ( @folder_id < 1 and @folder_name is null)    begin       begin transaction       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description], version) values (@event_id, @name, @description, 1)     end    else    begin       declare @temp_folder_id int        if (@folder_name is null or @folder_name = '')          set @folder_name = @default_folder_name        if (@folder_id < 1)       begin          set @folder_id = null          select @folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where [name] = @folder_name          if (@folder_id is null)             exec @folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'          if (@@error != 0)             set @folder_id = null       end        if (@folder_id is null)          set @temp_folder_id = 1       else          select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id              begin transaction       if (@temp_folder_id) is null          insert into event_folder (folder_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @folder_name)       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description], folder_id, version)           values (@event_id, @name, @description, @folder_id, 1)    end        if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction            select @event_id as event_id    return @event_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @folder_id int, @folder_name varchar, @add_number int, @default_event_name varchar, @default_folder_name varchar, @description varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_loggedon_users", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_ins_loggedon_users    @user_name       varchar(128),     @full_name       varchar(128) as    declare @new_id int    set @new_id = null      insert into loggedon_users (  [user_name], full_name ) values ( @user_name,@full_name )     select @new_id = [user_id] from loggedon_users where [user_name] = @user_name     if (@@error != 0) \treturn 0    return @new_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user_name varchar, @full_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS setting for nic    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    --    -- get the highest nic_id from existing nic_config_item records    declare @maxNicId int    select @maxNicId = max(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId     -- test for {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_static_routes_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "   -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static routing create procedure wc_ins_static_routes_config_item    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint,     @destination\t\tchar(16),    @netmask\t\tchar(16),    @gateway\t\tchar(16),    @interface\t\tchar(16),    @metric\t\tsmallint,    @flag\t\tchar(16),    @ref\t\t\tsmallint,    @use\t\t\tsmallint     as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this static route    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @config_item_id  is not null    begin       -- update the config_static_route_item record       begin transaction \t insert into config_static_route_item (config_item_id,destination,netmask,gateway,interface,metric,flag,ref,[use]) values (@config_item_id, @destination, @netmask, @gateway, @interface, @metric, @flag, @ref, @use)        -- handle errors/commit transaction            if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int, @destination char, @netmask char, @gateway char, @interface char, @metric smallint, @flag char, @ref smallint, @use smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_static_routes_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing  create procedure wc_ins_static_routes_config_set    @job\t\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,     @destination\t\tchar(16),    @netmask\t\tchar(16),    @gateway\t\tchar(16),    @interface\t\tchar(16),    @metric\t\tsmallint,    @flag\t\t\tchar(16),    @ref\t\t\tsmallint,    @use\t\t\tsmallint,    @configSetId \t\tint = null as   begin transaction       -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this static route       if @configSetId is null       begin        select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task       end         if @configSetId  is not null      begin       -- insert the new static route record          insert into config_static_route_set (config_set_id,destination,netmask,gateway,interface,metric,flag,ref,[use]) values (@configSetId, @destination, @netmask, @gateway, @interface, @metric, @flag, @ref, @use)          end         if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction        end       else          commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @destination char, @netmask char, @gateway char, @interface char, @metric smallint, @flag char, @ref smallint, @use smallint, @configSetId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_upate_agent_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_upate_agent_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @task_type   int as    -- collect the highest task sequence value for the event/condition    declare @taskSeq   int    select @taskSeq = task_seq from task where task_seq =        (select top 1 task_seq from task         where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq        order by task_seq desc)    -- increment to get available task sequence slot    if @taskSeq is null       set @taskSeq = 0    else       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1     -- insert a new task    begin transaction       insert into task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type)\t--, type_code)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, @task_type)\t--, null)        insert into task_return_handlers          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, ret_code)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 0)    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction     -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @task_type int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder with level as 1 in temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder with level = level + 1 and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table \tFind max level value which will be max depth for given folder */  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x  @folder_id as int  as  --This SP is same as wc_sel_child_folder_depth but for import where tables are different.  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from x_event_folder where parent_id =@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom x_event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folders", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folders \t@parent_id int as \tif @parent_id = -10 \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id is null \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id = @parent_id \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@parent_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_comp_listview", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_comp_listview \t@id int as \tif @id = -1 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id is null and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse if @id between 5000001 and 8000000 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere computer_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse \tbegin\t \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)  \texec('create table dbo.'+@branch_tablename+ \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(64), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))') \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \tif @id >= 5000001 and @id <= 8000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the computer node \t\t--exec('insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer where computer_id =' +@id) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from computer where computer_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t-- Get the group_id \t\tselect @id = group_id from computer where computer_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get groups down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -1 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the group node \t\t--insert into ##wc_branch (name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, group_id as id, 'group' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer_group where group_id = @id \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) select name, group_id as id, ''group'' as type from computer_group where group_id = @intid'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Computers'', -1, ''group'')')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResults = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_configuration", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_configuration \t@job\t\t\tint, \t@condition\t\tint, \t@task\t\t\tint, \t@computer\t\tint as \tdeclare @configSetId int \tselect @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \t\twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task \tdeclare @configItemId int \tselect @configItemId = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @configSetId \t\tand target_computer_id = @computer  \tselect * from config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId         -- Changed for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & 7.1.53 DNS Suffix         select * from dns_suffix where [id] = @configItemId         select * from config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @configItemId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_name    @id int as    --select computer_id as [id], [name], 'Computer' as type from computer where computer_id = @id    -- Bug #41543 - Rilo controls are missing from the all computers view in the web console     select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c \tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \twhere c.computer_id = @id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_schedules", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_schedules \t@computer_id int as \t\t--Bug #40255: Web Console not showing all computers that have been scheduled for a job \t\tselect\tschd.schedule_id, schd.computer_id, schd.event_id, schd.cond_seq, schd.next_task_seq, schd.start_time, schd.recur_value , schd.recur_type , schd.status_code , schd.status, schd.broker_time, schd.defer_mins, schd.config_choice_id, schd.end_time, schd.dep_schedule_id, schd.user_id, schd.initial_deployment, schd.redeploy_history_id, schd.calling_event, schd.rip_replace_event, schd.exit_code, schd.exit_module, schd._nslastsent,  \t\t\t\tevnt.[name] as 'job_name', comp.[name] as 'computer_name', evntinfo.job_exec_time as 'job_execution_time' \t\tfrom event_schedule as schd  \t\tleft outer join event as evnt on evnt.event_id = schd.event_id \t\tleft outer join computer as comp on schd.computer_id = comp.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join event_schedule_info as evntinfo on schd.schedule_id = evntinfo.schedule_id \t\twhere schd.computer_id = @computer_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}
