{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_permissions", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of permissions for the given user and object create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_permissions    @userId int,    @objectId int as    declare @permission int     --create temp table    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_permissions') is not null       drop table ##wc_last_effective_permissions    create table dbo.##wc_last_effective_permissions (permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)        --get permissions that apply to the object    if @objectId = 2000001 --init_deploy       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where initial_deployment = 1    else if (@objectId >= 1 and @objectId < 1000001) or @objectId = -1 --comp_group, ALL_COMPUTERS       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer_group = 1    else if @objectId = -7 --new_comp_group       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where new_computer_group = 1    else if @objectId >= 5000001 and @objectId <= 8000000 --comp       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer = 1    else if (@objectId >= 11000001 and @objectId < 14000001) or @objectId = -9 --physical_device       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where physical_device = 1    else if @objectId >= 1000001 and @objectId < 2000001 or @objectId = -10 --event_folder       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event_folder = 1    else if @objectId > 2000001 and @objectId < 3000001 --event       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event = 1    else       goto DONE        declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @permissionType varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0      select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights     open permissions_cursor    fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each permission       if @isAdmin > 0 --@isAdmin = 1 When user has admin rights and gets admin rights from one or more admin groups.       begin          select @permissionType = [name] from securitypermission where permission_id = @permission          insert into ##wc_last_effective_permissions values (@permission, 1, @permissionType, @fromAdmin, @permSource,'Administrative Rights', 'Administrative Group',0, @fromGroup)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_permission @userId, @permission, @objectId, 0        fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission    end          -- cleanup cursor    close permissions_cursor    deallocate permissions_cursor     DONE:  --select temp table     select * from ##wc_last_effective_permissions ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @objectId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_rights", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of rights for the user create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_rights     @userId int, \t@tableName varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights' as    declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @rightName varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once    -- Bug #63690     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0,@tableName      --select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights    declare\t@sql    nvarchar(512), \t\t\t@params nvarchar(512) \t\t\t \tset @sql = 'select @SqlisAdmin = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource, @SqlfromGroup = fromGroup from '+@tableName \t \tset @params = N'@SqlisAdmin int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromAdmin smallint OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlpermSource int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromGroup int OUTPUT' \t\t\t\t \texec sp_executesql @sql,@params,@SqlisAdmin=@isAdmin output, @SqlfromAdmin = @fromAdmin output, @SqlpermSource=@permSource output, @SqlfromGroup=@fromGroup output      --make sure temp table is empty    -- Bug #63690    --if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is not null    --   delete from ##wc_last_effective_rights    if object_id(''+@tableName+'') is not null \texec('delete from '+@tableName)        declare rights_cursor cursor for          select privilege_id, [name]          from securityprivilege     open rights_cursor    fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each right       if @isAdmin = 1       begin          select @rightName = [name] from securityprivilege where privilege_id = @right          -- Bug #63690          --insert into ##wc_last_effective_rights values (@right, 1, @rightName, @fromAdmin, @permSource, @fromGroup)          declare @sqlQuery as varchar(128) \t\t set @sqlQuery = 'insert into '+ @tableName +' values ('+cast(@right as varchar(10))+',1,'''+@rightName+''','+cast(@fromAdmin as varchar(10))+','+cast(@permSource as varchar(10))+','+cast(@fromGroup as varchar(10))+')' \t\t exec (@sqlQuery)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_right @userId, @right, 0,@tableName        fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName    end          -- cleanup cursor    close rights_cursor    deallocate rights_cursor      --select temp table   -- Bug #63690    --select * from ##wc_last_effective_rights    exec ('select * from '+@tableName) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @tableName varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_enclosure    @enclosure int as    select e.enclosure_id, e.rack_id, e.[name], e.real_name, e.manuf, e.model, e.bay_count,       e.change_method, e.event_id, e.wait_timeout, e.ip_address, e.community, e.initial_event_id,       r.manuf_rack from physical_enclosure e, physical_rack r     where e.rack_id = r.rack_id and e.enclosure_id = @enclosure ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@enclosure int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_enclosure_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_enclosure_children    @id int as    -- get computers in the bays in the enclosure passed in    -- Bug #41543    select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type,'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end        from physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id        where e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and e.enclosure_id = @id       and b.computer_id = c.computer_id and b.initial_event_id is null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_computers", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_find_computers \t@phrase varchar(128) as \tselect a.computer_id as id, a.name, a.icon, a.status  \tfrom computer a  \twhere a.name like @phrase or  \t\ta.computer_name like @phrase or  \t\ta.ip_hostname like @phrase or  \t\ta.logged_on_user like @phrase or  \t\ta.lic_os_user like @phrase or  \t\ta.serial_num like @phrase or  \t\ta.asset_tag like @phrase or  \t\ta.uuid like @phrase or  \t\ta.os like @phrase or  \t\ta.computer_id like @phrase or  \t\ta.computer_id in  \t\t\t( select b.computer_id from nics b  \t\t\twhere b.mac_addr like @phrase) or \t\ta.computer_id in \t\t\t( select c.id from nic_interface c \t\t\twhere c.ip like @phrase ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@phrase varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_computers_9x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_find_computers_9x    @search varchar(128) as    select a.computer_id as id, a.name, a.icon, a.status from computer a     where (a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows 95%')        or a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows 98%')        or a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows Millennium%'))       and (a.name like @search or        a.computer_name like @search or        a.ip_hostname like @search or        a.logged_on_user like @search or        a.lic_os_user like @search or        a.serial_num like @search or        a.asset_tag like @search or        a.uuid like @search or        a.os like @search or        a.computer_id like @search or        a.computer_id in           ( select b.computer_id from nics b           where b.mac_addr like @search) or       a.computer_id in          ( select c.id from nic_interface c          where c.ip like @search )) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@search varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task    @phrase varchar(128),    @task smallint,    @folderid int as \tif @folderid > -10 \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) -- Don't get Initial Deployment \t\t\tand a.folder_id = @folderid \telse \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@phrase varchar, @task smallint, @folderid int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(128),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subfolder table (for folder IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folders_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_folders_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_folders_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @id        -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end     -- loop through subfolders to gather all children job IDs    declare @subfolder int    select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    while @subfolder is not null    begin       -- get subfolders of this folder       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @subfolder       -- remove this folder from subfolder table       delete from #wc_folders_to_check where [id] = @subfolder       -- get jobs in this folder -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @subfolder       -- get the next subfolder       set @subfolder = null       select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id = @id       -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folderlevel", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.66 Copy job folder create procedure wc_sel_folderlevel  @folder_id int, @level int =1 as \tdeclare @parent_id int \tselect @parent_id=parent_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id \tif @parent_id is not null \tbegin \t\tset @level=@level+1 \t\texec wc_sel_folderlevel @parent_id, @level \tend \telse \t\tselect @level ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int, @level int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subgroup table (for group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_groups_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_groups_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_groups_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root -- Bug #41543 \tinsert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) \t  select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t    left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t    left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t   where c.group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)  \t select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t   left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t   left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id \t where c.group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @id          order by [name]    end     -- loop through subgroups to gather all children computer IDs    declare @subgroup int    select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    while @subgroup is not null    begin       -- get subgroups of this group       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @subgroup       -- remove this group from subgroup table       delete from #wc_groups_to_check where [id] = @subgroup       -- get computers in this group -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) \tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id \twhere c.group_id = @subgroup \torder by c.[name]       -- get the next subgroup       set @subgroup = null       select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer/group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state           from computer where group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer where group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_history", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- PRD item 7.1.46 Allow Administrator to Delete History create procedure dbo.wc_sel_history \t @computer_id \t\tint as \tselect  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id,s.complete_time, s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.user_log, l.user_name, h.app_id,ea.alias,ea.app_path,ea.description, \tconvert(varchar(30),s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time  --Bug #33984 \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id              left outer  join  loggedon_users l on \t\t  s.system_logon_user_id = l.user_id \tleft join external_application ea  \t\ton h.app_id=ea.app_id \t  \twhere (s.status_code is not null)  and    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id)  \torder by h.history_id desc  select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id, h.task_type, h.complete_time, s.[module], s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.status_code, s.status, s.complete_time,s.level,s.return_code_result, \tconvert(varchar(30), s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time, --Bug #33984 \txml_task \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id \twhere    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id ) and h.history_id in (select history_id from status_log_view where status_code is not null)  --Bug #33984 \torder by h.complete_time desc ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename) \t\t \texec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename + \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(128), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))')  \tif @id >= 2000001 and @id <= 3000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the job node \t\tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \t\tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event where event_id = @intid'  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int' \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id  \t\t \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event where event_id ='+ @intid)  \t\t-- Get the folder_id \t\tselect @id = folder_id from event where event_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get folders down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -10 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the folder node \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event_folder where folder_id = @intid';  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid=@id ; \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event_folder where folder_id =' + @id) \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Jobs'', -10, ''folder'')')\t-- Return the completed branch list  \tif @selectResults = 1 \t\texec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_domains", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_domains  \t@jobids    varchar(254)  as  begin transaction \t \tselect msnet_domain_name from config_set  where  \tmsnet_domain_name is not null  \tand config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids)))  \tif @@error != 0 \t\trollback transaction \telse \t\tcommit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_license_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_license_info as    --select * from license_info    --Bug #28067    \tselect remain_days, total_days,serial_number, server as totalserver, client as totalclient, pda as totalpda, nodes as totalnodes  from license_info \t \t--1 \tselect count (computer_id) as server from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 1 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--2 \tselect count (computer_id) as client from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 3 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--3 \tselect count (computer_id) as pda from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 2 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--7 total \tselect count (computer_id) as nodes from computer  where limited_license = 0 and  \tcomputer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_physical_device_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_physical_device_children    @id int -- this param is for compatability and is not used in the procedure as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_physical_device_children') is not null       drop table #wc_physical_device_children    create table dbo.#wc_physical_device_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543     -- iterate through all of the racks    declare @rackId int    declare rack_cursor cursor for       select rack_id from physical_rack    open rack_cursor    fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- get computers in the bays in the enclosures in this rack       -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_physical_device_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)             select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end              from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id              where r.rack_id = e.rack_id and r.rack_id = @rackId              and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and b.computer_id = c.computer_id              and b.initial_event_id is null       -- get next rack ID       fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    end    -- cleanup cursor    close rack_cursor    deallocate rack_cursor     select * from #wc_physical_device_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_reb_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_reb_branch    @id int,    @selectResult int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))    if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null       exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)     exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename +       '([level] int IDENTITY,        [name] varchar(64),        [id] int NOT NULL,        type varchar(20))')  \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500)    -- If node is a Bay    if @id >= 13000001 and @id <= 14000000    begin       -- Get the bay node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)          -- select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type         -- from physical_bay where bay_id = @id') \t\t \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_bay where bay_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ;        -- Get the enclosure_id       select @id = enclosure_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @id    end\t     -- If node is an Enclosure    if @id >= 12000001 and @id <= 13000000    begin       -- Get the enclosure node      -- exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)         -- select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type         -- from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id') \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t       -- Get the rack_id       select @id = rack_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id    end     -- If node is a Rack    if @id >= 11000001 and @id <= 12000000    begin       -- Get the rack node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename +'([name], [id], type)        --  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type        --  from physical_rack where rack_id = @id')  \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_rack where rack_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t    end     -- Add Physical Devices node    --insert into @branch_tablename ([name], [id], type)      -- select 'Physical Devices' as [name], -9 as [id], 'physical devices' as type \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)       select ''Physical Devices'' as [name], -9 as [id], ''physical devices'' as type')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResult = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + 'order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_required_domains", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_required_domains  \t@jobids    varchar(8000), \t@compids    varchar(8000)  as \t--Query on config_set and Config_item table to fetch all required domains. \tselect lower(msnet_domain_name) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_domain_name is not null and msnet_domain_name <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_dns_domain is not null and msnet_dns_domain <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \tunion \tselect lower(domain_name) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere (msnet_dns_domain is null or msnet_dns_domain='')  \t\tand config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \t \t--Query to check whether we should check for computer domain information \t-- IF count is > 0  then check for computer domains as well \tselect count(*) from config_set, config_task  \twhere \tconfig_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_set.config_set_id \t\tand ((use_existing_data=1 and msnet_is_domain_member is null) or (msnet_is_domain_member=1 and ((msnet_domain_name ='' or msnet_domain_name is null) and ( msnet_dns_domain ='' or msnet_dns_domain is null) )) or (use_existing_data=1 and reconfig=1))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar, @compids varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_codes", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_codes    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    \tint as    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_return_code') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_return_code  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_return_code \t\t(code\t\tvarchar(11), \t\t handler\t\tint, \t\t result \t\tint, \t\t status   varchar(256))  \t-- store the default handler \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect 'default' as code, on_fail as handler, on_fail as result, null as status \t\tfrom task where event_id=@jobId and   \t\tcond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq  \t-- get the rest of the handlers \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect ret_code as code, handler, result, status from task_return_handlers \t\twhere event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and\ttask_seq=@taskSeq  \tselect * from ##wc_return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_handler_jobs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_handler_jobs    @jobId int as    -- make a temporary table to store the IDs in    if object_id ('#wc_handler_ids') is null       create table dbo.#wc_handler_ids (job int, primary key (job))    -- store the calling job    insert into #wc_handler_ids values (@jobId)     -- declare needed variables    declare @newJobCount int    declare @handler int    declare @job int    declare @fail int     -- loop through all discovered jobs repeatedly until no new linked jobs are found    set @newJobCount = 1    while @newJobCount > 0    begin       set @newJobCount = 0       -- make a cursor to step through all discovered jobs       declare job_cursor cursor for          select job from #wc_handler_ids       open job_cursor       fetch next from job_cursor into @job       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          -- loop through the linked jobs          -- make a cursor to step through all linked task_return_handlers jobs          declare handler_cursor cursor for             select distinct(handler) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @job                and handler > 2000000 and handler < 3000001 and handler not in --Bug 27827                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open handler_cursor          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@handler)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          end          -- cleanup cursor          close handler_cursor          deallocate handler_cursor           -- make a cursor to step through all linked on_fail jobs          declare fail_cursor cursor for             select distinct(on_fail) from task where event_id = @job                and on_fail > 2000000 and on_fail < 3000001 and event_id not in                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open fail_cursor          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@fail)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          end          -- cleanup cursor          close fail_cursor          deallocate fail_cursor                  fetch next from job_cursor into @job       end       -- cleanup cursor       close job_cursor       deallocate job_cursor    end     -- return the list of jobs discovered    select job from #wc_handler_ids    drop table #wc_handler_ids ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_schedule1", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_schedule1 \t@schedule int as \tdeclare @user int \tselect @user = su.[user_id] from securityuser su, event_schedule es  \twhere es.schedule_id = @schedule and es.[user_id] = su.[user_id]  \tif @user is null \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\t'gznFiP' as 'user_name', 'gznFiP' as user_full_name, '' as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\tu.[name] as 'user_name', u.fullname as user_full_name, u.domain as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e, securityuser u \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \t\t\tand u.[user_id] = s.[user_id] \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_security_authenticate", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_authenticate \t@username \t\tvarchar(64), \t@password\t\tvarchar(64), \t@domain\t\t\tvarchar(50) = null, \t@upnname\t\tvarchar(128) = null as \tdeclare @authenticated tinyint \tset @authenticated = 0 \t \tdeclare @matchUser\tvarchar(64)         declare @matchUPN\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchPwd\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchNetdom    varchar(64) \tdeclare @userId\tint \tdeclare @ad_user smallint  \tif @domain is not null and len(@domain) > 0 \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for  \t\t\tselect [name], upnname, domain, netbiosdomain, [user_id]  \t\t\tfrom securityuser \t\t\twhere (deleted is null or deleted=0) --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\t\t\t\t\t \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif (@matchUser = @username or @matchUPN = @upnname) and (upper(@domain) = upper(@matchPwd) or upper(@matchNetdom) = upper(@domain)) -- @matchPwd is the domain name \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for select [name], [password], [user_id], ad_user from securityuser  where deleted is null or deleted=0  --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif @matchUser = @username and @matchPwd = @password and @ad_user = 0 \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \t \tif @authenticated = 1 and len(@domain) > 0 \t\tset @authenticated = 2 \telse  \t\tset @matchUser = @username --Bug #39428  \tselect @authenticated as authenticated, @userId as [user_id], @matchUser as securityuser ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar, @domain varchar, @upnname varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_computer_location", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_upd_computer_location    @computer_id   int,    @site          varchar(128),    @dept          varchar(128),    @mailstop      varchar(128),    @contact       varchar(128),    @email         varchar(128),    @phone         varchar(128) as    declare @compId int    select @compId = computer_id from location where computer_id=@computer_id      begin transaction    if @compId is null \tbegin  \t\tinsert into location (computer_id, site, dept, mailstop, contact,  \t\t\t\temail, phone) values (@computer_id,  @site, @dept, @mailstop, @contact, \t\t\t\t@email, @phone) \tend    else \tbegin \t\tupdate location set [site] = @site, [dept] = @dept, [mailstop] = @mailstop, \t\t\t[contact] = @contact, [email] = @email, [phone] = @phone \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \tend    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @site varchar, @dept varchar, @mailstop varchar, @contact varchar, @email varchar, @phone varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item\t\t\tint,    @field\t\t\tint,    @operation\t    int,    @value\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null,    @drive\t\t\tvarchar(8)   = null,    @conjunct\t    smallint     = -1,    @token\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null as    begin transaction        update condition_item set field_type = @field, oper_type = @operation, key_value = @value,           drive = @drive, conjunct = @conjunct, token = @token          where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint, @token varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,    @item1\t\tint,    @item2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId\t\t\tint,    @conditionId1\tint,    @conditionId2\tint as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@tempCondId \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as \tupdate config_item  \tset  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  \twhere Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) \tand config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  \t@itemId int as  \tdeclare @domain_name as varchar(512) \tdeclare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)\t  \t-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name \tselect    \t\t@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, \t\t@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))\t\t \t\twhen '' then domain_name \t\telse msnet_dns_domain \t\tend -- case \tfrom config_item  \twhere config_item_id=@itemId  \t-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it \tif @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 \tbegin \t\tselect @username=username, @password=[password]  \t\tfrom domain_accounts  \t\twhere domain=@domain_name\t\t \t \t\tupdate config_item  \t\tset  \t\tmsnet_domain_username=@username, \t\tmsnet_domain_password=@password \t\twhere config_item_id=@itemId \tend\t ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_from_comp", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_comp    @itemId      int,    @computerId  int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with computer record data    declare computer_cursor cursor for       select lic_os_user, lic_os_org, lic_os_key, ip_hostname, computer_name, domain_member,          domain_name, nw_pref_server, {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_ip    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int,    @nic_id int as    -- test for a static IP range    declare @master_ip varchar(16), @duplicate_ip varchar(16), @final_ip varchar(16)    declare @interface_name varchar(64)    declare @interface_id int    declare config_ip_cursor cursor for       select ip, [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @config_set_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open config_ip_cursor    declare item_ip_cursor cursor for       select interface_id from nic_interface where [id] = @config_item_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open item_ip_cursor    fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name    fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       if len(@master_ip) > 0       begin          -- test for duplicate IP usage          set @duplicate_ip = @master_ip          set @final_ip = @master_ip          declare @computer_id int          select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id          while @duplicate_ip is not null          begin             set @duplicate_ip = null             -- test for another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface where [id] >= 5000001 and [id] <= 8000000                 and [id] != @computer_id and ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                and c.target_computer_id != @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to this computer IN THIS CONFIG that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                 and c.target_computer_id = @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip and c.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and [name] != @interface_name             -- get a new IP if a duplicate was found             if @duplicate_ip is not null                exec wc_increment_ip @duplicate_ip, @final_ip output          end           -- update the config_item nic_interface ip value to the non-duplicate found          update nic_interface set ip = @final_ip where interface_id = @interface_id       end        fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name       fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    end    close config_ip_cursor    deallocate config_ip_cursor    close item_ip_cursor    deallocate item_ip_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int, @nic_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_name    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int as    -- test for a name range    declare @method smallint    select @method = cname_method from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       -- test for duplicate name usage       declare @duplicate_name varchar(64), @final_name varchar(64)       --PRD item 7.1.12 Use token: To remove the addition of network adapter       select @final_name = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id       if @final_name in ('%NAME%','%SERIALNUM%','%NODENAME%','%NIC1MACADDR%','%NIC2MACADDR%', \t\t\t'%NIC3MACADDR%','%NIC4MACADDR%','%NIC5MACADDR%','%NIC6MACADDR%','%NIC7MACADDR%','%NIC8MACADDR%') \t update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           \twhere config_item_id = @config_item_id       else       begin       select @final_name = computer_name from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       set @duplicate_name = @final_name       declare @computer_id int       select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       while @duplicate_name is not null       begin          set @duplicate_name = null          -- test for another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from computer where computer_name = @final_name             and computer_id != @computer_id          -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from config_item where target_computer_id != @computer_id             and computer_name = @final_name          -- get a new name if a duplicate was found          if @duplicate_name is not null             exec wc_increment_name @config_set_id, @duplicate_name, @final_name output       end       -- update the config_item computer_name, ip_hostname to the non-duplicate value generated       update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           where config_item_id = @config_item_id    end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic \t@computer_id int, \t@mac_addr varchar(36), \t@ip_use_dhcp smallint, \t@ip_domain varchar(128), \t@ip_dns varchar(512), \t@ip_wins varchar(512), \t@nic_pci_bus int, \t@nic_pci_device int, \t@nic_pci_function int, \t@nic_device_id int, \t@nic_vendor_id int, \t@nic_desc varchar(64), \t@nic_location varchar(64), \t@interface_id int, \t@id int, \t@nic_id int, \t@name varchar(64), \t@ip varchar(16), \t@mask varchar(16), \t@gateway varchar(16), \t@broadcast varchar(16), \t@state int \t as \tbegin \t\tupdate nics set nics.mac_addr = @mac_addr, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_use_dhcp = @ip_use_dhcp, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_domain = @ip_domain, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_dns = @ip_dns, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_wins = @ip_wins, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_bus = @nic_pci_bus, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_device = @nic_pci_device, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_function = @nic_pci_function, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_device_id = @nic_device_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_vendor_id = @nic_vendor_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_desc = @nic_desc, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_location = @nic_location \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere nics.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\tupdate  nic_interface set\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.id = @id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.name = @name, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.ip = @ip, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.mask = @mask, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.gateway = @gateway, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.broadcast = @broadcast, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.state = @state \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere  nic_interface.interface_id = @interface_id; {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint = 1,--PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configItemId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_item_id = @configItemId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @interfaceId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int, @last smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_set record       begin transaction          update nic_config_set set ip_method = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp,wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_set_id = @configSetId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0,    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@nicId int, @interfaceId int, @last smallint, @jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing    @itemId int,    @id int,    @nicId int as    declare @name varchar(64)    declare @ip varchar(16), @mask varchar(16), @gateway varchar(16), @broadcast varchar(16)    declare @state int, @interfaceCount int    set @interfaceCount = 0    -- incremental IP for updates from config_set    declare @increment_ip bit    if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000       set @increment_ip = 1    declare nic_interface_cursor cursor for       select [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state from nic_interface where id = @id       and nic_id = @nicId order by interface_id    open nic_interface_cursor    fetch next from nic_interface_cursor       into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    --Bug #43065 To save computer nic_interface data.    declare @iname varchar(64), @iip varchar(16), @imask varchar(16),        @igateway varchar(16), @ibroadcast varchar(16), @istate int   if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000   begin    select @iname = name, @iip = ip, @imask = mask, @igateway = gateway, @ibroadcast = broadcast, @istate = state from      nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId          if @name is null or len(@name) = 0       set @name = @iname    if @ip is null or len(@ip) = 0       set @ip = @iip    if @mask is null or len(@mask) = 0       set @mask = @imask    if @gateway is null or len(@gateway) = 0       set @gateway = @igateway    if @broadcast is null or len(@broadcast) = 0       set @broadcast = @ibroadcast    if @state is null        set @state = @istate        end    -- remove existing nic_interface objects and always add new ones    delete from nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId     -- update nic_inteface table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- create new record       insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state)          values (@itemId, @nicId, @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state)              if @increment_ip = 1          exec wc_upd_next_ip @id, @itemId, @nicId                 fetch next from nic_interface_cursor          into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    end     close nic_interface_cursor    deallocate nic_interface_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @id int, @nicId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS2", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_task_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_task_order    @jobId\t\tint,    @conditionId\tint,    @taskId1\t\tint,    @taskId2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary task id    declare @tempTaskId   int    select @tempTaskId = max(task_seq) from task where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@conditionId    set @tempTaskId = @tempTaskId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary task id \t   update task set task_seq=@tempTaskId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update task set task_seq=@taskId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary task id with the swap id \t   update task set task_seq=@taskId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@tempTaskId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else \t  commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId int, @taskId1 int, @taskId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fn_diagramobjects", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " \tCREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_diagramobjects()  \tRETURNS int \tWITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo' \tAS \tBEGIN \t\tdeclare @id_upgraddiagrams\t\tint \t\tdeclare @id_sysdiagrams\t\t\tint \t\tdeclare @id_helpdiagrams\t\tint \t\tdeclare @id_helpdiagramdefinition\tint \t\tdeclare @id_creatediagram\tint \t\tdeclare @id_renamediagram\tint \t\tdeclare @id_alterdiagram \tint  \t\tdeclare @id_dropdiagram\t\tint \t\tdeclare @InstalledObjects\tint  \t\tselect @InstalledObjects = 0  \t\tselect \t@id_upgraddiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams'), \t\t\t@id_sysdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sysdiagrams'), \t\t\t@id_helpdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagrams'), \t\t\t@id_helpdiagramdefinition = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagramdefinition'), \t\t\t@id_creatediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_creatediagram'), \t\t\t@id_renamediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_renamediagram'), \t\t\t@id_alterdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_alterdiagram'),  \t\t\t@id_dropdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_dropdiagram')  \t\tif @id_upgraddiagrams is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 1 \t\tif @id_sysdiagrams is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 2 \t\tif @id_helpdiagrams is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 4 \t\tif @id_helpdiagramdefinition is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 8 \t\tif @id_creatediagram is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 16 \t\tif @id_renamediagram is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 32 \t\tif @id_alterdiagram  is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 64 \t\tif @id_dropdiagram is not null \t\t\tselect @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 128 \t\t \t\treturn @InstalledObjects  \tEND \t", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( int OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fn_get_comparable_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function fn_get_comparable_ip (  @ip varchar(15) ) returns bigint as begin  \tdeclare @ip_part1 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part2 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part3 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part4 bigint \tdeclare @first_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @second_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @third_dot_pos smallint  \tset @first_dot_pos = charindex('.', @ip) \tif @first_dot_pos = 0 \t\treturn cast(@ip as bigint)  \tset @second_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@first_dot_pos + 1) \tset @third_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@second_dot_pos + 1)  \tset @ip_part4 = cast(substring(@ip, @third_dot_pos + 1, len(@ip)) as bigint)  \tif(@first_dot_pos!=0) \tbegin \t\tset @ip_part1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part2 = cast(substring(@ip, @first_dot_pos + 1, @second_dot_pos - @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part3 = cast(substring(@ip, @second_dot_pos + 1, @third_dot_pos - @second_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \tend  \treturn @ip_part1 * 1000000000 + @ip_part2 * 1000000 + @ip_part3 * 1000 + @ip_part4  end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( bigint OUT, @ip varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "SplitIDs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function SplitIDs (  @OrderList varchar(8000) ) returns @ParsedList table (  ID int ) as begin \tdeclare @OrderID varchar(10), @Pos int  \tset @OrderList = ltrim(rtrim(@OrderList))+ ',' \tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1)  \tif replace(@OrderList, ',', '') <> '' \tbegin \t\twhile @Pos > 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tset @OrderID = ltrim(rtrim(left(@OrderList, @Pos - 1))) \t\t\tif @OrderID <> '' \t\t\tbegin \t\t\tinsert into @ParsedList (ID) \t\t\tvalues (cast(@OrderID as int)) --Use Appropriate conversion \t\tend  \t\tset @OrderList = right(@OrderList, len(@OrderList) - @Pos) \t\tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1) \tend end  return end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@OrderList varchar)"}
