procedure dbo.complete_schedule \t@schedule_id     int, \t@exit_code       int, \t@status_code     int, \t@exit_module     smallint, \t@next_start_time datetime, \t@current_time    datetime, \t@status          varchar( 256 ), \t@level           smallint, \t@next_task_seq   int,\t -- this is ignored if @next_start_time is not null \t@taskresult      int as \tbegin transaction  \t-- first insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, 0, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult  \t-- now insert and fix up history for this item \texec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id  \t-- update the event schedule table \tif( @next_start_time is null ) \tbegin \t   -- Right now we never want to leave the next_task_seq as null for a completed schedule. \t   -- If it is null, set it to whatever the last sequence was \t   if( @next_task_seq is null ) \t   begin \t      select @next_task_seq = next_task_seq \t         from event_schedule \t   \t     where schedule_id = @schedule_id \t   end  \t\tDECLARE @called_status varchar(MAX),                 @calling_id    int,                 @dependent_id  int  \t\tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \t\tBEGIN \t\t\tDECLARE @event_name    varchar(128) \t\t\tSELECT  @event_name = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN') \t\t\t\tFROM event          AS e \t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\tWHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\t\tIF (@status_code = 0) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Called Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- clear dependent schedule id and set success status for calling schedule \t\t\t\tUPDATE    event_schedule \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL \t\t\t\t\tWHERE schedule_id = @calling_id \t\t\tEND \t\t\tELSE IF (@status_code = 1) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE    es \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  status_code = 1, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL, \t\t\t\t\t\t  next_task_seq = nts.next_task_seq, \t\t\t\t\t\t  end_time = @current_time \t\t\t\t\tFROM  event_schedule AS es \t\t\t\t\tJOIN ( \t\t\t\t\t\tSELECT s.schedule_id, MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tFROM script_task AS t \t\t\t\t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\t\t\t\tWHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tGROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\tWHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE es \t\t\t\t\tSET status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\tstatus_code = 1, \t\t\t\t\t\tdep_schedule_id = NULL, \t\t\t\t\t\tend_time = @current_time \t\t\t\t\tFROM event_schedule AS es \t\t\t\t\tWHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\t\t\tIF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL) \t\t\t\t\tEXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' \t\t\tEND \t\tEND  \t   -- this event is not supposed to recur, all done        update event_schedule             set status_code = @status_code, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module,                 status = @status, end_time = @current_time, next_task_seq = @next_task_seq, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  }             where schedule_id = @schedule_id \tend \telse \tbegin \t\t-- this event will recur, update the status and set the new start time \t\tupdate event_schedule \t\t\tset status_code = null, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module, \t\t\t\tstart_time = @next_start_time, status = @status, end_time = @current_time, \t\t\t\tnext_task_seq = null, cond_seq = null, dep_schedule_id = null,  -- these should be re-evaluated every time, set to null \t\t\t\tconfig_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  } \t\t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t \t\t\tdelete from computer_state where  schedule_id = @schedule_id \tend  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tcommit transaction \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @exit_code int, @status_code int, @exit_module smallint, @next_start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @level smallint, @next_task_seq int, @taskresult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_new_snmp_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  CREATE procedure ins_new_snmp_enclosure   @name varchar(64),   @manuf varchar(64),   @model varchar(64),   @ip_address varchar(20),   @community varchar(256),   @rack_name varchar(64) as   declare @enclosure_id as int,           @tran int,           @status int,           @rack_id int,           @org_name varchar(64)    set @tran = @@trancount    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    select @rack_id=rack_id from physical_rack where name=@rack_name    if(@rack_id is null)   begin     exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'      insert into physical_rack(rack_id, name, real_name, manuf_rack)       values(@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, 1)   end    select @enclosure_id=enclosure_id, @org_name=name from physical_enclosure where manuf=@manuf and model=@model       and ip_address=@ip_address and community=@community and rack_id=@rack_id    if (@enclosure_id is null)   begin     exec @enclosure_id = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'      insert into physical_enclosure(enclosure_id, name, real_name, manuf, model, ip_address, community, rack_id)       values(@enclosure_id, @name, @name, @manuf, @model, @ip_address, @community, @rack_id)      set @status = 1   end   else   begin     if(@org_name = @name)       set @status = 0     else     begin       set @status = 2       update physical_enclosure set name=@name, real_name=@name where enclosure_id=@enclosure_id     end   end    if (@@error != 0)   begin     if (@tran = 0)       rollback transaction   end    if (@tran = 0)   begin     commit transaction     select @enclosure_id, @status   end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @manuf varchar, @model varchar, @ip_address varchar, @community varchar, @rack_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_nic_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_nic_interface    @id int,    @nic_id int,    @interface_id int, \t\t -- -1 means use existing    @name varchar( 64 ) = null,    @ip varchar( 16 ) = null,    @netmask varchar( 16 ) = null,    @gateway varchar( 16 ) = null,    @broadcast varchar( 16 ) = null,    @state int = null as    declare @last_id int    declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     if( -1 = @interface_id )    begin       -- we don't have an existing id, just insert the data and let SQL generate one       insert into nic_interface          ( [id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state )          values          ( @id, @nic_id, @name, @ip, @netmask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state )        -- save the inserted identity so we can return it       set @last_id = @@identity    end    else    begin       -- update the data       update nic_interface  \t     set [id] = @id, nic_id = @nic_id,              [name] = @name, ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,  \t\t\tbroadcast = @broadcast, state = @state          where interface_id = @interface_id              -- the last identity was passed in but return it anyway       set @last_id = @interface_id    end     if( @@error != 0 )    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return -1    end    else    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          commit transaction       return @last_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @nic_id int, @interface_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_nic_interface_for_init_deploy", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_nic_interface_for_init_deploy    @computer_id\t\tint as \tbegin transaction  \tif not exists (select computer_id from nics where computer_id = @computer_id) \t\tinsert into nics (computer_id, nic_id) values (@computer_id, 0)  \tdelete nic_interface where [id] = @computer_id  \tupdate nics \t\tset ip_use_dhcp = nci.ip_use_dhcp, \t\t\tip_domain = nci.ip_domain, \t\t\tip_dns = nci.ip_dns, \t\t\tip_wins = nci.ip_wins \t\tfrom nics n, nic_config_item nci \t\twhere n.computer_id = @computer_id \t\t\tand n.nic_id = nci.nic_id  \tinsert nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state) \t\tselect @computer_id, nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state \t\tfrom nic_interface where [id] = (select config_item_id from config_item where target_computer_id = @computer_id)  \tif @@error = 0 \t\tcommit transaction \telse \t\trollback transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_redeploy_event", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_redeploy_event    @computer_id   int,    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    declare @new_time         datetime,            @schedule_id      int,            @max_history_id   int,            @bootoption_id    int     set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @start_time)     begin transaction     update event_schedule       set start_time = @new_time       where computer_id = @computer_id           and start_time <= @start_time           and status_code = null     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     if (@schedule_id = 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     select @max_history_id = max(history_id) from history_view where computer_id = @computer_id     insert into event_schedule       (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, cond_seq, next_task_seq, start_time, redeploy_history_id, rip_replace_event)    values       (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, null, 0, @start_time, @max_history_id, 1)     select top 1 @bootoption_id=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@event_id order by task_seq    if(@bootoption_id = 1 or @bootoption_id is null)    begin      exec @bootoption_id=sel_default_bootoption_id    end     select @bootoption_id as bootoption_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @start_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure [dbo].[mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task]     @schedule_id   int,     @operation_str varchar(64) as begin \tDECLARE   @calling_id   int \tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int \tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id         AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \tBEGIN \t\tDECLARE @failure_code int,                 @exit_code    int, \t\t        @taskresult   int, \t\t        @exit_module  smallint, \t\t        @level        smallint, \t\t        @current_time datetime         SELECT  @failure_code = 1,                 @exit_code    = 19501,                 @taskresult   = 0,                 @exit_module  = 16,                 @level        = 3,                 @current_time = GETDATE()  \t\tDECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tDECLARE @errstatus   varchar(MAX);         SELECT  @errstatus = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @eventname + '] Was ' + @operation_str \t\t \t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @errstatus, @failure_code, @exit_code, @exit_module,                                  @level, @taskresult  \t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE es             SET status          = @errstatus,                 status_code     = @failure_code,                 dep_schedule_id = NULL,                 next_task_seq   = nts.next_task_seq,                 end_time        = @current_time             FROM event_schedule AS es             JOIN (                 SELECT    s.schedule_id,                           MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq,                           t.cond_seq                     FROM  script_task    AS t                     JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id                     WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq                     GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq                  ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq             WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE    event_schedule             SET   status          = @errstatus,                   status_code     = @failure_code,                   dep_schedule_id = NULL,                   end_time        = @current_time             WHERE schedule_id     = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id          IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL)             EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' \tEND end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @operation_str varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_upd_event_schedule_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.mm_upd_event_schedule_id    @schedule_id\t\t\tint,    @start_time          datetime,    @status              varchar(254) = NULL,    @recur_value         int = NULL,    @recur_type\t\t    smallint = NULL,    @defer               int = NULL,    @user_id\t\t\t\tint = 0,    @cond_seq\t\t\tint = NULL,    @calling_schedule    int = NULL,    @winuser_id       int = 0  --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User as    declare @new_sched_id int     begin transaction     exec mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @schedule_id, 'Restarted'     exec @new_sched_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     update event_schedule     set next_task_seq = NULL, start_time = @start_time, status = @status, \tdefer_mins = @defer, recur_value = @recur_value, recur_type = @recur_type, \tstatus_code = NULL, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \tbroker_time = NULL, user_id = @user_id, cond_seq = @cond_seq, \tcalling_event = @calling_schedule, dep_schedule_id = null, \tschedule_id = @new_sched_id, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null on  \"Reschedule\" or \"start now\" }    where schedule_id = @schedule_id    --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User    update  event_schedule_info     set schedule_id = @new_sched_id, \t\twindows_user_id = @winuser_id, \t\tjob_exec_time = null\t-- PRD 7.1.49 (Bug Fix #36624)    where        schedule_id  = @schedule_id\t\t   -------------------------------------------     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     return @new_sched_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @status varchar, @recur_value int, @recur_type smallint, @defer int, @user_id int, @cond_seq int, @calling_schedule int, @winuser_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_upd_sched_dependency", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.mm_upd_sched_dependency    @schedule_id   int,    @schedule_dependent_on int as    declare   @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     --begin transaction -- we do a transaction around the whole thing now    update event_schedule        set dep_schedule_id = @schedule_dependent_on       where schedule_id = @schedule_id     --commit transaction    if( 0 = @tran )    begin       if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @schedule_dependent_on int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_automation_job", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_automation_job    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule es          where ( (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is NULL)             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)            and es.event_id in ( select t.event_id from [task] t left outer join [script_task] st \t\t\ton t.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\tand t.cond_seq = st.cond_seq  \t\t\tand t.task_seq = st.task_seq \t\t\twhere ((t.task_type = 10 and st.execution_mode = 0) \t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 22) )        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_current_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_current_schedule \t@computer_id\tint, \t@schedule_id\tint, \t@task_seq\t\tint, \t@boot_env\t\tint as \tdeclare @return_code  int \tset @return_code = null  \tif (@schedule_id = 0) \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks there is has not work, lets make sure. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule es join task t  \t\t\t\ton es.event_id = t.event_id \t\t\t\tand es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = t.task_seq \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and (es.status_code = -1 or es.status_code = -3) \t\t\t\tand ( ( @boot_env = 1 -- BOOT_AUTOMATION = 1 \t\t\t\t\t\tand ( t.task_type = 10 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 11 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 ) ) \t\t\t\t\tor  \t\t\t\t\t( @boot_env != 1 ) )  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \tend \telse \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks it is working on a job. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \t\t\t\tand schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\tand next_task_seq = @task_seq \t\t\t\tand status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\tbegin \t\t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\t\tset @return_code = 0 -- Agent thinks it has a job, but we don't.  \t\t\t-- We think it is working on a different job than the agent thinks. \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\t-- We are in sync with the agent. \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \t\tend \tend  \treturn @return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @boot_env int)"}

 end    else    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c \t\t\tjoin event_schedule es on {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_inventory_group_tree", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_inventory_group_tree \t@user_id int, \t@do_visibility_check int as \tdeclare @cont_folder int \tdeclare @cont_thin_client int  \tselect @cont_folder = 0; \tselect @cont_thin_client = 4;  \t-- display containers with computers also \tselect  \t\tgroup_id as id,  \t\tparent_id as parentid,  \t\t@cont_folder as container,  \t\ticon as icon,  \t\tname,  \t\t0 as proc_type,  \t\t0 as [os_bit],\t \t\t0 \tfrom computer_group cg left outer join #computer_visibility ov  \t\t\ton cg.group_id = ov.object_id where @do_visibility_check = 0 or (ov.user_id = @user_id and (ov.visible > 0)) \tunion \tselect \t\ta.computer_id, \t\ta.group_id, \t\ta.node_type,         a.icon, \t\ta.[name], \t\tcoalesce( \t\t\t( select h.proc_type from hardware h where h.computer_id = a.computer_id), \t\t\t(0) \t\t\t) as proc_type, \t\tcoalesce([os_bit], 32),\t \t\t0 \tfrom \t\tcomputer a left outer join nics n \t\t\ton a.computer_id = n.computer_id \t\twhere a.hidden is null and node_type = @cont_thin_client  \t\t\tand (@do_visibility_check = 0 or exists  \t\t\t\t(select visible from #computer_visibility ov  \t\t\t\t\twhere ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.visible = 1 and ((ov.object_id = a.group_id) or (ov.object_id = -1 and a.group_id is null) \t\t\t\t\tor (a.group_id is null and ov.object_id = a.computer_id) ) ) ) --63670, 63679 --\t\t\t\t\twhere ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.object_id = a.group_id and ov.visible = 1) \torder by 2 asc, 3 asc, 8 asc, 5 asc, 7 asc ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user_id int, @do_visibility_check int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_image_post_config", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_is_image_post_config    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc \t \tif (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) \tbegin \t\treturn -1 \tend  \tselect @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  \t \tif( @deploy_any_event_id != 0 ) \t\tset @next_task_seq = @next_task_seq + 1  \tselect @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_set \t\twhere config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq and reconfig is null)  \tif (@config_set_id is null) \t\treturn -1     return @next_task_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_job_status_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_job_status_info \t@computer_id int as \tselect t.task_type, es.schedule_id, es.next_task_seq, \t\tcase t.task_type \t\t\twhen 10 then\t\t\t\t-- Script \t\t\t\t(select case when location = 1 then 'None' \t\t\t\t\t\t\t when execution_mode = 0 then 'Automation'  \t\t\t\t\t\t\t else 'Production' \t\t\t\t\t\tend  \t\t\t\t\tfrom script_task st \t\t\t\t\twhere st.event_id = t.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.cond_seq = t.cond_seq  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.task_seq = t.task_seq) \t\t\twhen 11 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Reboot \t\t\twhen 12 then 'Production'\t-- Copy File \t\t\twhen 13 then 'Automation'\t-- Registry  \t\t\twhen 14 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Config \t\t\twhen 15 then 'Automation'\t-- Image \t\t\twhen 16 then 'Production'\t-- Install \t\t\twhen 17 then 'Automation'\t-- Unattended Install \t\t\twhen 18 then 'Production'\t-- PCT \t\t\twhen 19 then 'Production'\t-- Inventory \t\t\twhen 21 then 'Production'\t-- Update Agent  \t\t\telse 'None' \t\tend as boot_env \t\tfrom dbo.task t join dbo.event_schedule es  \t\t\ton es.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\t\t\tand t.event_id = es.event_id  \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq  \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq \t\twhere es.status_code is not null  \t\t\tand es.status_code != -2 \t\t\tand es.status_code < 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_lic_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_lic_info    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36) as    declare  @del_expire   datetime     select @del_expire = expire from deleted_computer where mac_addr = @mac_addr     if (@computer_id = 0)    begin       select @del_expire as del_expire    end    else    begin       select expire, limited_license, @del_expire as del_expire          from computer where computer_id = @computer_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_more_work", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_more_work    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule          where (next_task_seq > -1             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end   --LB#35552   -- select computer_id from sessions where platform = 1 and computer_id not in (    select computer_id from sessions where boot_env = 1 and computer_id not in ( -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }       select distinct s.computer_id from sessions s, event_schedule es          where s.computer_id = es.computer_id --LB#35552    and platform = 1 \t       and boot_env = 1\t\t-- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }             and es.start_time <= @time_now             and ( ( es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code < 0 )                   and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in                      ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )                or ( es.event_id = 2000001 and es.status_code is NULL ) ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_expired_time", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_expired_time    @cur_time   datetime as    declare @sched_in_progress int     select top 1 @sched_in_progress = schedule_id from event_schedule where status_code < 0    if (@sched_in_progress is null)       set @sched_in_progress = 0    else       set @sched_in_progress = 1     if exists (select top 1 es.schedule_id       from event_schedule es       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @cur_time          and es.computer_id in (select s.computer_id from sessions s where es.computer_id = s.computer_id          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in \t\t( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ))))    select dateadd (mi, -1, @cur_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress    else    select min (start_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress       from event_schedule       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time >= @cur_time          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_seq_by_sched", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_seq_by_sched    @schedule_id int as    declare @event_id int    declare @cond_seq int    declare @task_seq int    declare @next_sequence int     select @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq       from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     exec @next_sequence = sel_next_sequence @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     return @next_sequence ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_sequence", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_sequence    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    set @next_task_seq = null    select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc     return coalesce (@next_task_seq, -1) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_system_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_system_id    @object_id   varchar(64),    @update      char(1) = 'T' as    declare  @last_used_id int,             @tran         int    declare  @err    varchar(100)     set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction     select @last_used_id = last_used_id + 1       from system_id with (xlock, rowlock)       where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)  \tif 'EVENT_ID' = upper(@object_id) \tBegin \t\tif @last_used_id = 3000000 \t\tbegin \t\t\tSET @last_used_id = 19000000 \t\tend \tend     if (@last_used_id is null)    begin       set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id in selecting object ' + @object_id       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction;       -- raiserror 30008 @err \t  -- THROW 30008, @err, 1 \t  RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)       return 0    end     if (upper(@update) = 'T')    begin       update system_id set last_used_id = @last_used_id          where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)        if (@@error != 0)       begin          set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id updating object ' + @object_id          if (@tran = 0)             rollback transaction;          -- raiserror 30009 @err \t\t -- THROW 30009, @err, 1 \t\t RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)          return 0       end        if (@tran = 0)          commit transaction    end    else    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     return coalesce (@last_used_id, 0) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@object_id varchar, @update char)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_task_seq \t@schedule_id \tint as \tdeclare @ret_val int \tselect top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq \t\tfrom task t, event_schedule es \t\twhere t.event_id = es.event_id \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq \t\t\t\tand es.schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\torder by t.task_seq asc  \tif @ret_val is null \tbegin \t\tset @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 \tend  \treturn @ret_val ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_redeploy_tasks", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_redeploy_tasks    @computer_id   int as    declare  @temp_id int,             @history_id int,             @script_tag_id int     select top 1 @temp_id = history_id       from history_view       where ((task_type = 15 and xml_task like '%<Upload>0%')or task_type = 17)     -- Image task or Unattended Install          and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@temp_id is not null)    begin       declare @new_history_id int       declare @min_task_seq int        set @min_task_seq = null       select @min_task_seq = min(task_seq) from task               where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)        if (@min_task_seq is null)       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and redeploy = 1             order by [sequence], history_id desc       end       else       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and [sequence] = @min_task_seq and redeploy = 1              order by history_id desc       end \t\t                 if (@new_history_id != @temp_id)          set @temp_id = @new_history_id        select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view          where history_id < @temp_id             and computer_id = @computer_id             and task_type != 10             and task_type != 11             and task_type != 12 \t    and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        select top 1 @script_tag_id = history_id from history_view          where computer_id = @computer_id             and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%')  and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        -- get the one which was the lastest one ran.       if ((@script_tag_id > @history_id or @history_id is null) and @script_tag_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @script_tag_id - 1       end        if ( @history_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @history_id + 1       end       else       begin          -- if there was script, copy file or reboot prior to image event          -- get the first history_id for this computer          select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view             where history_id < @temp_id                and computer_id = @computer_id \t       and redeploy = 1             order by history_id           if ( @history_id is null)             set @history_id = @temp_id       end        select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id        return    end     -- no image or scripted install found, looking for tag.    select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id          and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%') \t and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@history_id is not null)    begin       select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id       return    end     -- nothing was found, we will send all the history for this computer.    select task_type, xml_task       from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_return_handler", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_return_handler \t@event_id int, \t@cond_seq int, \t@task_seq int, \t@ret_code int = null as declare @count int declare @handler int declare @handlername nvarchar(64)  select @count = count(*) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  if @count < 1    begin \tif @ret_code = 0 \t\tselect @handler = 1 -- continue \telse \t   begin \t\tselect @handler = on_fail \t\t  from task \t\t  where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq \t\t  group by on_fail \t   end    end else    select @handler = handler \tfrom task_return_handlers \twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  select @handler = coalesce (@handler, 0) -- default, stop  if @handler <> 0 AND @handler <> 1 \tselect @handler, [name] from event where event_id = @handler else \tselect @handler, ' '  return @handler ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @ret_code int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_return_handler_status_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure sel_return_handler_status_info @sched_id int, @ret_code int AS declare @retval int declare @event_id int declare @cond_seq int declare @task_seq int  select @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq, @event_id = event_id \tfrom event_schedule where event_schedule.schedule_id = @sched_id  select status, ret_code, result from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and \t\t\t\t\t\t        task_seq = @task_seq and \t\t\t\t\t\t        cond_seq = @cond_seq and \t\t\t\t\t\t         ret_code = @ret_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@sched_id int, @ret_code int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    declare @tmprowscount   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction      \t\tselect @tmprowscount = count(event_id) from copyfile_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from script_task where   username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(distinct event_id) from install_task where (username = @username and password = @oldpassword) or \t\t   (exec_username = @username and exec_password = @oldpassword)  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from capture_pct_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_wol_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_wol_computer    @computer_id      int,    @wol_support      int = null as  if (@wol_support is null or @wol_support = '')       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id    else       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.wol_support = 1                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @wol_support int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sp_alterdiagram", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " \tCREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_alterdiagram \t( \t\t@diagramname \tsysname, \t\t@owner_id\tint\t= null, \t\t@version \tint, \t\t@definition \tvarbinary(max) \t) \tWITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' \tAS \tBEGIN \t\tset nocount on \t \t\tdeclare @theId \t\t\tint \t\tdeclare @retval \t\tint \t\tdeclare @IsDbo \t\t\tint \t\t \t\tdeclare @UIDFound \t\tint \t\tdeclare @DiagId\t\t\tint \t\tdeclare @ShouldChangeUID\tint \t \t\tif(@diagramname is null) \t\tbegin \t\t\tRAISERROR ('Invalid ARG', 16, 1) \t\t\treturn -1 \t\tend \t \t\texecute as caller; \t\tselect @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();\t  \t\tselect @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');  \t\tif(@owner_id is null) \t\t\tselect @owner_id = @theId; \t\trevert; \t \t\tselect @ShouldChangeUID = 0 \t\tselect @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname  \t\t \t\tif(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @theId <> @UIDFound)) \t\tbegin \t\t\tRAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1); \t\t\treturn -3 \t\tend \t \t\tif(@IsDbo <> 0) \t\tbegin \t\t\tif(@UIDFound is null or USER_NAME(@UIDFound) is null) -- invalid principal_id \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tselect @ShouldChangeUID = 1 ; \t\t\tend \t\tend  \t\t-- update dds data\t\t\t \t\tupdate dbo.sysdiagrams set definition = @definition where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  \t\t-- change owner \t\tif(@ShouldChangeUID = 1) \t\t\tupdate dbo.sysdiagrams set principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  \t\t-- update dds version \t\tif(@version is not null) \t\t\tupdate dbo.sysdiagrams set version = @version where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  \t\treturn 0 \tEND \t", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int, @version int, @definition varbinary)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sp_upgraddiagrams", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " \tCREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams \tAS \tBEGIN \t\tIF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagrams') IS NOT NULL \t\t\treturn 0; \t \t\tCREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagrams \t\t( \t\t\tname sysname NOT NULL, \t\t\tprincipal_id int NOT NULL,\t-- we may change it to varbinary(85) \t\t\tdiagram_id int PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY, \t\t\tversion int, \t \t\t\tdefinition varbinary(max) \t\t\tCONSTRAINT UK_principal_name UNIQUE \t\t\t( \t\t\t\tprincipal_id, \t\t\t\tname \t\t\t) \t\t);   \t\t/* Add this if we need to have some form of extended properties for diagrams */ \t\t/* \t\tIF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagram_properties') IS NULL \t\tBEGIN \t\t\tCREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties \t\t\t( \t\t\t\tdiagram_id int, \t\t\t\tname sysname, \t\t\t\tvalue varbinary(max) NOT NULL \t\t\t) \t\tEND \t\t*/  \t\tIF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.dtproperties') IS NOT NULL \t\tbegin \t\t\tinsert into dbo.sysdiagrams \t\t\t( \t\t\t\t[name], \t\t\t\t[principal_id], \t\t\t\t[version], \t\t\t\t[definition] \t\t\t) \t\t\tselect\t  \t\t\t\tconvert(sysname, dgnm.[uvalue]), \t\t\t\tDATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(N'dbo'),\t\t\t-- will change to the sid of sa \t\t\t\t0,\t\t\t\t\t\t\t-- zero for old format, dgdef.[version], \t\t\t\tdgdef.[lvalue] \t\t\tfrom dbo.[dtproperties] dgnm \t\t\t\tinner join dbo.[dtproperties] dggd on dggd.[property] = 'DtgSchemaGUID' and dggd.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]\t \t\t\t\tinner join dbo.[dtproperties] dgdef on dgdef.[property] = 'DtgSchemaDATA' and dgdef.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid] \t\t\t\t \t\t\twhere dgnm.[property] = 'DtgSchemaNAME' and dggd.[uvalue] like N'_EA3E6268-D998-11CE-9454-00AA00A3F36E_'  \t\t\treturn 2; \t\tend \t\treturn 1; \tEND \t", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_computer_ip_mac_addr", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_computer_ip_mac_addr    @computer_id         int,    @ip_addr             varchar (512),    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @nic_id              int = 0 as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = @nic_id     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, ip) values (@computer_id, @nic_id, @ip_addr)    else    begin      if (@ip_addr is not null) \t\tupdate nic_interface set ip = @ip_addr where interface_id = @interface_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @ip_addr varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @nic_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_deferred_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_deferred_schedule \t@schedule_id int, \t@start_time datetime, \t@current_time datetime, \t@status varchar( 256 ), \t@status_module smallint as     declare @comp_id int  \t-- make sure the schedule is valid \tselect @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id \tif( @comp_id is null ) \tbegin \t   return \tend  \tbegin transaction  \t-- update the event schedule table \tupdate event_schedule \t\tset status_code = null, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \t\t\tstart_time = @start_time, status = @status \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t-- now insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, -1, -1, @status_module  \t-- erase old wol info \texec upd_computer_wol_info @comp_id, null  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tcommit transaction \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_cond_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_cond_seq    @schedule_id   int,    @cond_seq      int,    @status_code   int = NULL,    @status        varchar (254) = NULL,    @exit_code     int = NULL,    @exit_module   smallint = NULL as \tif (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) \t\tset @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is NULL and @status_code is NULL)       update event_schedule set cond_seq = @cond_seq where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else    begin       update event_schedule \t\tset cond_seq = @cond_seq, status_code = @status_code, \t\t\tstatus = @status, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @cond_seq int, @status_code int, @status varchar, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_config_choice", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_config_choice    @schedule_id      int,    @config_choice_id int = null,    @status_code      int = null,    @status           varchar(254) = null as    begin transaction     if (@config_choice_id = 0)    begin       declare @comp_id int \t  select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id       update computer set domain_name = 'WORKGROUP', domain_member = 0 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  if exists (select 1 from nics where computer_id = @comp_id and nic_id = 0) \t\tupdate nics set ip_use_dhcp = 1 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  else \t\tinsert nics (computer_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp) values (@comp_id, 0, 1)    end     if (@status_code is NULL and @status is NULL)    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id,              status_code = @status_code,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @config_choice_id int, @status_code int, @status varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq    @schedule_id      int,    @next_task_seq    int,    @status_code      smallint,    @exit_code        int,    @exit_module      smallint,    @status           varchar(254),    @current_time     datetime,    @module           smallint,    @level            smallint,    @taskresult       int as begin     if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0)         set @status_code = 1      declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount      if( 0 = @tran )         begin transaction  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int     SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id      IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL AND @status_code IS NULL AND @status = 'Error ' + LTRIM(@exit_code) + ' during script execution')     BEGIN         DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @dependent_id          SELECT @status = 'Scheduled Job [' + @eventname + '] Due To Return Code Handler: ' + LTRIM(@exit_code)     END      -- update status_log table with schedule info     exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level, @taskresult      -- now insert and fix up history for this item     exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id      -- now update the event_schedule table     update event_schedule         set next_task_seq = @next_task_seq,         status = @status,         status_code = @status_code,         exit_code = @exit_code,         exit_module = @exit_module,         config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null }     where schedule_id = @schedule_id      if( 0 = @tran )     begin         if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction         else             commit transaction     end end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @next_task_seq int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @taskresult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_status    @schedule_id   int,    @status_code   smallint,    @exit_code\t   int,    @exit_module   smallint,    @status        varchar(254),    @broker_time   datetime,    @module        smallint,    @level         smallint,    @log_event     smallint = 0 as    declare @upd_status_code smallint     -- we need to remember the status code that was passed in, but if it's null,    -- we want to get the status code that is currently in the event schedule.    set @upd_status_code = @status_code     if (@upd_status_code is null and @log_event = 1)       select @upd_status_code = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     if (@exit_code is not null ) and ( @exit_code != 0 ) and ( @status_code is not null ) and       ( @status_code > 0 )    begin       set @status_code = 1    end     begin transaction     if (@broker_time is null)    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status,             broker_time = @broker_time          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t--LB#40844        if( @status_code >= 0 )       \t begin      \t\texec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@broker_time        \tend    end     -- use the passed in status code for this function, unlike above where we use our    -- adjusted @use_status_code var.  This is so we can save exit_codes without    -- killing the status_code in the event schedule table.    exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @broker_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @broker_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @log_event smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_status    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36),    @schedule_id   int,    @task_seq      int,    @status        varchar(254),    @status_code   int as    if (@status is null and @status_code is null)       return     begin transaction     if (@status_code is not null and @status is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code,             status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else if (@status_code is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else       update event_schedule          set status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq     if (@@error = 0)       commit transaction    else       rollback transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @status varchar, @status_code int)"}

    insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id) values (@computer_id, 0)     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @serial_num varchar, @uuid varchar, @asset_tag {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_nic_ip_addr", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_nic_ip_addr \t@computer_id   int, \t@mac_addr      varchar(36), \t@ip_address    varchar(16) = null as \tdeclare @temp_id int \tdeclare @high_nic_id   int  \tselect @temp_id = n.computer_id from nics n where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr and n.computer_id = @computer_id  \tif (@temp_id is null) \tbegin \t\tselect @temp_id = min(n.nic_id) from nics n where n.mac_addr is null and n.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\tif (@temp_id is null) \t\tbegin\t\t  \t\t\tset @high_nic_id = null \t\t\tselect @high_nic_id = max(nic_id) from nics where computer_id = @computer_id  \t\t\tbegin transaction  \t\t\tif (@high_nic_id is null) \t\t\t\tinsert into nics (computer_id, nic_id, mac_addr) values (@computer_id, 0, @mac_addr) \t\t\telse \t\t\t\tinsert into nics (computer_id, nic_id, mac_addr) values (@computer_id, @high_nic_id+1, @mac_addr) \t\tend \t\telse  \t\tbegin \t\t\tbegin transaction\t\t\t \t\t\tupdate nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr where nic_id = @temp_id and computer_id = @computer_id \t\tend  \t\tif (@@error != 0) \t\t\trollback transaction \t\telse \t\t\tcommit transaction \t\t \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @ip_address varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_old_nic_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_old_nic_info    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar (36),    @ip_address    varchar (512) = null,    @ip_netmask    varchar (512) = null,    @ip_gateway    varchar (512) = null,    @ip_use_dhcp   smallint = null,    @ip_domain     varchar (128) = null,    @ip_dns        varchar (512) = null,    @ip_wins       varchar (512) = null,    ----7.1.53 begin    @netbios int = null    --7.1.53 end as    begin transaction     delete nics       where computer_id = @computer_id or mac_addr = @mac_addr     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     insert into nics ( \t\t\tcomputer_id, \t\t\tnic_id,                         mac_addr,                         ip_use_dhcp,                         ip_domain,                         ip_dns,                         ip_wins, \t\t\t--7.1.53 begin \t\t\tnetbios \t\t\t--7.1.53 end \t\t\t)                   values                         ( \t\t\t@computer_id, \t\t\t0,                         @mac_addr,                         @ip_use_dhcp,                         @ip_domain,                         @ip_dns,                         @ip_wins, \t\t\t--7.1.53 begin \t\t\t@netbios \t\t\t--7.1.53 end \t\t\t)     exec ins_nic_interface @computer_id, 0, -1, 'eth0', @ip_address, @ip_netmask, @ip_gateway, null, 1     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @ip_address varchar, @ip_netmask varchar, @ip_gateway varchar, @ip_use_dhcp smallint, @ip_domain varchar, @ip_dns varchar, @ip_wins varchar, @netbios int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_physical_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_physical_enclosure    @rack_name\t\tvarchar( 64 ),    @enclosure_name  varchar( 64 ),    @model\t\t\tvarchar( 64 ),    @bay_count       varchar( 64 ),    @manuf           varchar(64) = '' as    declare @enclosure_id int    declare @old_bay_count int    declare @new_bay_count int     -- get the old enclosure information before we update it    select @enclosure_id = enclosure_id, @old_bay_count = bay_count       from physical_enclosure e, physical_rack r \t  where r.[real_name] = @rack_name \t\t and e.[real_name] = @enclosure_name \t\t and r.rack_id = e.rack_id     -- we want to set the bay count to the larger of what is was before,    -- or what we're trying to update it to.  Never make it smaller.    -- this was at HP's request, so that they could use sleves to put    -- more servers in an enclousure than originally fit.    set @new_bay_count = @bay_count    if( @new_bay_count < @old_bay_count )       set @new_bay_count = @old_bay_count     -- now update the enclosure    update physical_enclosure       set bay_count = @new_bay_count, \t  model = @model, \t  manuf = @manuf \t  where enclosure_id = @enclosure_id  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@rack_name varchar, @enclosure_name varchar, @model varchar, @bay_count varchar, @manuf varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_rack_enclosure_bay", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create varchar(64),    @bay_number\t\t\tsmallint,    @used_bays           int,    @computer_id         int,    @computer_name       varchar(64),    @time                datetime,    @init_deploy         varchar(5) = 'no',    @manuf_rack          int = 0,    @manuf               varchar(64) = '',    @group_id\t\t\tint = -7 as    declare   @temp_comp_id    int,              @rack_id         int,              @enclosure_id    int,              @bay_id          int,              @change_method   smallint,              @event_id        int,              @temp_id         int,              @new_comp_made @new_comp_made = 'N'    set @new_schedule_id = null     select   @bay_id = b.bay_id,             @change_method = b.change_method,             @event_id = b.event_id,       \t   @virtual_bay = b.initial_event_id       from  physical_bay b,             physical_enclosure e,             physical_rack r       where r.[real_name] = @rack_name          and e.[real_name] = @enclosure_name          and b.[real_name] = @bay_name          and r.rack_id = e.rack_id          and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id     if (@bay_id is null)    begin       -- Not found, lets create it.       begin transaction        -- If we don't have a computer_id we will get one.       set @change_method = null        if (@computer_id is null or @computer_id = 0)       begin          exec @computer_id =    end           set @new_comp_made = 'Y'       end        delete physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id        set @rack_id = null \t  if (@manuf_rack = 1) \t     select @rack_id = rack_id, @change_method = change_method from physical_rack where [real_name] = @rack_name and manuf_rack = 1       else           select @rack_id = rack_id, @change_method = change_method from physical_rack where [real_name] = @rack_name       if (@rack_id is null)       begin          if (@change_method is null)             set @change_method = 2          exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'          insert into physical_rack (rack_id, [name], real_name, change_method, manuf_rack) values (@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, @change_method, @manuf_rack)       end        set @enclosure_id = null       select @enclosure_id = enclosure_id, @change_method = change_method \t\t\tfrom physical_enclosure where [real_name] = @enclosure_name and rack_id = @rack_id       if (@enclosure_id is null) {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghost_cmdline", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghost_cmdline]    @event_id\tint,    @new_session_name varchar(50) as    declare @tran int    declare @old_session_name varchar(50)    set @tran = @@trancount     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task  \t  set @old_session_name = SUBSTRING(addl_cmdline,CHARINDEX('\"', addl_cmdline , 1) + 1,LEN(addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('\"', addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('\"', REVERSE(addl_cmdline))), \t  ghcastsrv_cmdline = case when ghcastsrv_cmdline is not null then replace(ghcastsrv_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) else NULL end, \t  addl_cmdline =  replace(addl_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) \t  where event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @new_session_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghostcast_setting", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghostcast_setting]    @event_id\tint,    @ghostcast_setting varchar(10) as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     set @ghostcast_setting = ' ' + @ghostcast_setting     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task set ghcastsrv_cmdline =  \t  case   when CHARINDEX(' -N',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -N%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -T',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -T%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -O',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -O%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)           END \t  where event_id = @event_id and ghcastsrv_cmdline is not NULL             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @ghostcast_setting varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128),    @newpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction  \t\tupdate    copyfile_task \t\tset       password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    script_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          exec_password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (exec_username) = lower (@username)) and (exec_password = @oldpassword) \t\t--the install_task.username and install_task.exec_username appear to always be the same so do not add to the count set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    capture_pct_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar, @newpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_unattend_var", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure upd_unattend_var     @var_id int,     @default_val int,     @var_name varchar(254),     @var_desc varchar(254),     @var_type smallint,     @val_value varchar(256),     @val_displayed varchar(256) as     declare @old_type int      begin transaction      select @old_type=[type] from unattend_vars where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      update unattend_vars set [name]=@var_name, [description]=@var_desc, [type]=@var_type                        where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      if(@old_type = 0 and @var_type != 0)     begin       delete from unattend_vars_value where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and unattend_vars_value_id <> @default_val     end      if(@var_type != 0)     begin       update unattend_vars_value set [value]=@val_value, name_displayed=@val_displayed                       where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val     end      if(@var_type = 0)     begin       set @default_val=NULL        select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                       where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value] like @val_value        update unattend_vars_value set [default]=0 where unattend_vars_id=@var_id        if (@default_val is null)       begin         insert into unattend_vars_value(unattend_vars_id, [value], name_displayed, [default])                     values(@var_id, @val_value, @val_displayed, 1)          select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                     where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value]=@val_value       end       else       begin         update unattend_vars_value set [default]=1 where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val       end     end      select @default_val as [val_id], @var_id as [var_id]      commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@var_id int, @default_val int, @var_name varchar, @var_desc varchar, @var_type smallint, @val_value varchar, @val_displayed varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_condition_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_del_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item\t\t    int as    declare @minItem int    select @minItem = min(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    begin transaction       delete from condition_item  \t     where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item       if @minItem = @item       begin          select @item = min(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition          update condition_item set conjunct = -1 where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition             and item_seq = @item       end    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_config_event_for_live_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- this SP is added to fix bug #28880 create procedure wc_del_config_event_for_live_schedule    @jobId         int as    begin transaction     declare @cnt int    declare @reConfig smallint    declare @useExisting smallint     select @reConfig=ct.reconfig ,@useExisting=cs.use_existing_data     from config_set cs join config_task ct on ct.config_set_id = cs.config_set_id     where ct.event_id = @jobId     -- delete only if it is live job     if(@reConfig=1) and (@useExisting=1)    begin \t-- delete if this is scheduled on this computer only  \tselect @cnt=count(target_computer_id)  \tfrom config_item ci join config_task ct on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id  \twhere ct.event_id = @jobId         -- if no schedule on this job then delete this         if (@cnt=0) \t     exec del_event @jobId    end  \t    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_dnsSuffix", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_del_dnsSuffix    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null      as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- delete the dns_suffix data       begin transaction        \t    delete dns_suffix where [id] = @configSetId                       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction       end       else          commit transaction    end  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_generate_first_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_generate_first_computer_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64) output as    -- get the name range data from the config_set record    declare @method smallint, @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @method = cname_method, @fixed = cname_fixed, @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append,       @numbers = cname_numbers from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       if @numbers = 1 -- numeric portion       begin          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))          else             set @name = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed       end       else -- alpha portion       begin          -- convert number to ascii character values          declare @alpha varchar(64)          set @alpha = ''          while @addl >= 0          begin                         declare @dval smallint             set @dval = @addl % 26             set @addl = @addl / 26             set @alpha = @alpha + char(@dval + 97)             set @addl = @addl - 1          end          -- reverse the character order to form the final string          set @alpha = reverse(@alpha)          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + @alpha          else             set @name = @alpha + @fixed       end    end    else       set @name = null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar OUT)"}
