{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_ip    @ip varchar(16),    @ip_out varchar(16) output as    -- break the IP address into integer octet values    declare @octet1 int, @octet2 int, @octet3 int, @octet4 int    declare @dot_index1 int, @dot_index2 int    select @dot_index1 = charindex('.', @ip)    set @octet1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @dot_index1 - 1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index1 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet2 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet3 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = len(@ip)    set @octet4 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - (@dot_index1 - 1)) as int)     -- increment octet values as needed to increment the ip    if @octet4 < 255       set @octet4 = @octet4 + 1    else    begin       set @octet4 = 1       if @octet3 < 255          set @octet3 = @octet3 + 1       else       begin          set @octet3 = 0          if @octet2 < 255             set @octet2 = @octet2 + 1          else          begin             set @octet2 = 0             if @octet1 < 255                set @octet1 = @octet1 + 1             else             begin                set @octet1 = 1                set @octet2 = 1                set @octet3 = 1                set @octet4 = 1             end          end       end    end     set @ip_out = cast(@octet1 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet2 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet3 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet4 as varchar(3)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ip varchar, @ip_out varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64),    @name_out varchar(64) output as    -- Get the name range information from the config_set record    declare @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append, @numbers = cname_numbers,       @fixed = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id    if len(@name) = 0       exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @config_set_id, @name     -- Split the fixed and variable text in the @name passed in    declare @variable_text varchar(64)    declare @fixed_pos int    set @fixed_pos = charindex(@fixed, @name)    if @fixed_pos > 1 -- prefix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, 1, @fixed_pos - 1)    else -- postfix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, len(@fixed) + 1, len(@name) - len(@fixed))           -- Increment the @variable_text    if @numbers = 1    begin       -- numeric variable       set @addl = cast(@variable_text as smallint) + 1       if @append = 1          set @name_out = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))       else          set @name_out = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed    end    else    begin       -- alpha variable       -- test for all Z characters       set @variable_text = upper(@variable_text)       declare @z_count int, @z_loc int       set @z_loc = 0       set @z_count = 0       set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text)       while @z_loc > 0       begin          set @z_count = @z_count + 1          set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text, @z_loc + 1)       end       if len(@variable_text) = @z_count       begin          -- reset to all A characters and add A to the end          set @name_out = replace(@variable_text, 'Z', 'A')          set @name_out = @variable_text + 'A'       end       else       begin          -- advance all needed characters          declare @addl_out varchar(64)          set @addl_out = ''                    declare @char int          declare @increment_done smallint          set @increment_done = 0          while len(@variable_text) > 0          begin             set @char = ascii(substring(@variable_text, len(@variable_text), 1))             if @increment_done = 0             begin                if @char = 90                   set @char = 65                else                begin                   set @char = @char + 1                   set @increment_done = 1                end             end              set @addl_out = @addl_out + char(@char)              if len(@variable_text) > 1                set @variable_text = substring(@variable_text, 1, len(@variable_text) - 1)             else                set @variable_text = ''          end          set @addl_out = reverse(@addl_out)          if @append = 1             set @name_out = @fixed + @addl_out          else             set @name_out = @addl_out + @fixed       end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar, @name_out varchar OUT)"}

dbo.wc_ins_bay    @changeMethod  smallint,    @predefinedJob int,    @enclosure int,    @initialJob int,    @computer int,    @bayIdx int = null,    @icon smallint = 67 as    declare @addedIdx int    set @addedIdx = -1    -- ensure enclosure exists    declare @enclosureId int    select @enclosureId = enclosure_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @enclosure    declare @manuf smallint    select @manuf = manuf_rack from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e        where e.enclosure_id = @enclosure and e.rack_id = r.rack_id    declare @recordsAdded int     if @enclosureId is not null and @manuf = 0    begin       -- determine number of bays that can be added       declare @bayRecCount int       select @bayRecCount = count(bay_id) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @bayCount int       select @bayCount = bay_count from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @bayId int       exec @bayId = sel_next_system_id 'BAY_ID'       declare @single int       set @single = @bayIdx       if @bayIdx is null          select @bayIdx = max(idx) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @missingBay smallint       set @missingBay = 1        -- insert a bay       if @bayRecCount < @bayCount       begin                      if @single is null          begin             while @bayIdx is not null             begin                set @bayIdx = null                select @bayIdx = bay_id from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId                   and idx = @missingBay                if @bayIdx is not null \t\t\t   begin \t\t\t      set @missingBay = @missingBay + 1 \t\t\t   end             end          end          else             set @missingBay = @bayIdx          -- hide the virtual computer          insert into physical_bay(bay_id, enclosure_id, idx, [name], real_name, computer_id, icon,                change_method, event_id, initial_event_id)              values (@bayId, @enclosureId, @missingBay, cast(@missingBay as varchar),                 cast(@missingBay as varchar), @computer, @icon, @changeMethod, @predefinedJob, @initialJob)          set @addedIdx = @missingBay           update computer set hidden=1 where computer_id=@computer       end    end    return @addedIdx ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@changeMethod smallint, @predefinedJob int, @enclosure int, @initialJob int, {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder with level as 1 in temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder with level = level + 1 and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table \tFind max level value which will be max depth for given folder */  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x  @folder_id as int  as  --This SP is same as wc_sel_child_folder_depth but for import where tables are different.  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from x_event_folder where parent_id =@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom x_event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)  \texec('create table dbo.'+@branch_tablename+ \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(64), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))') \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \tif @id >= 5000001 and @id <= 8000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the computer node \t\t--exec('insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer where computer_id =' +@id) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from computer where computer_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t-- Get the group_id \t\tselect @id = group_id from computer where computer_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get groups down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -1 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the group node \t\t--insert into ##wc_branch (name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, group_id as id, 'group' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer_group where group_id = @id \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) select name, group_id as id, ''group'' as type from computer_group where group_id = @intid'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Computers'', -1, ''group'')')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResults = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_configuration", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_configuration \t@job\t\t\tint, \t@condition\t\tint, \t@task\t\t\tint, \t@computer\t\tint as \tdeclare @configSetId int \tselect @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \t\twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task \tdeclare @configItemId int \tselect @configItemId = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @configSetId \t\tand target_computer_id = @computer  \tselect * from config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId         -- Changed for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & 7.1.53 DNS Suffix         select * from dns_suffix where [id] = @configItemId         select * from config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @configItemId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_name    @id int as    --select computer_id as [id], [name], 'Computer' as type from computer where computer_id = @id    -- Bug #41543 - Rilo controls are missing from the all computers view in the web console     select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c \tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \twhere c.computer_id = @id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_schedules", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_schedules \t@computer_id int as \t\t--Bug #40255: Web Console not showing all computers that have been scheduled for a job \t\tselect\tschd.schedule_id, schd.computer_id, schd.event_id, schd.cond_seq, schd.next_task_seq, schd.start_time, schd.recur_value , schd.recur_type , schd.status_code , schd.status, schd.broker_time, schd.defer_mins, schd.config_choice_id, schd.end_time, schd.dep_schedule_id, schd.user_id, schd.initial_deployment, schd.redeploy_history_id, schd.calling_event, schd.rip_replace_event, schd.exit_code, schd.exit_module, schd._nslastsent,  \t\t\t\tevnt.[name] as 'job_name', comp.[name] as 'computer_name', evntinfo.job_exec_time as 'job_execution_time' \t\tfrom event_schedule as schd  \t\tleft outer join event as evnt on evnt.event_id = schd.event_id \t\tleft outer join computer as comp on schd.computer_id = comp.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join event_schedule_info as evntinfo on schd.schedule_id = evntinfo.schedule_id \t\twhere schd.computer_id = @computer_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_permissions", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of permissions for the given user and object create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_permissions    @userId int,    @objectId int as    declare @permission int     --create temp table    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_permissions') is not null       drop table ##wc_last_effective_permissions    create table dbo.##wc_last_effective_permissions (permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)        --get permissions that apply to the {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(128),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subfolder table (for folder IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folders_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_folders_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_folders_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @id        -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end     -- loop through subfolders to gather all children job IDs    declare @subfolder int    select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    while @subfolder is not null    begin       -- get subfolders of this folder       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @subfolder       -- remove this folder from subfolder table       delete from #wc_folders_to_check where [id] = @subfolder       -- get jobs in this folder -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @subfolder       -- get the next subfolder       set @subfolder = null       select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id = @id       -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folderlevel", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.66 Copy job folder create procedure wc_sel_folderlevel  @folder_id int, @level int =1 as \tdeclare @parent_id int \tselect @parent_id=parent_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id \tif @parent_id is not null \tbegin \t\tset @level=@level+1 \t\texec wc_sel_folderlevel @parent_id, @level \tend \telse \t\tselect @level ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int, @level int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subgroup table (for group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_groups_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_groups_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_groups_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root -- Bug #41543 \tinsert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) \t  select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t    left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t    left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t   where c.group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)  \t select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t   left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t   left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id \t where c.group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @id          order by [name]    end     -- loop through subgroups to gather all children computer IDs    declare @subgroup int    select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    while @subgroup is not null    begin       -- get subgroups of this group       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @subgroup       -- remove this group from subgroup table       delete from #wc_groups_to_check where [id] = @subgroup       -- get computers in this group -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) \tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id \twhere c.group_id = @subgroup \torder by c.[name]       -- get the next subgroup       set @subgroup = null       select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer/group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state           from computer where group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer where group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_history", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- PRD item 7.1.46 Allow Administrator to Delete History create procedure dbo.wc_sel_history \t @computer_id \t\tint as \tselect  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id,s.complete_time, s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.user_log, l.user_name, h.app_id,ea.alias,ea.app_path,ea.description, \tconvert(varchar(30),s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time  --Bug #33984 \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id              left outer  join  loggedon_users l on \t\t  s.system_logon_user_id = l.user_id \tleft join external_application ea  \t\ton h.app_id=ea.app_id \t  \twhere (s.status_code is not null)  and    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id)  \torder by h.history_id desc  select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id, h.task_type, h.complete_time, s.[module], s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.status_code, s.status, s.complete_time,s.level,s.return_code_result, \tconvert(varchar(30), s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time, --Bug #33984 \txml_task \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id \twhere    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id ) and h.history_id in (select history_id from status_log_view where status_code is not null)  --Bug #33984 \torder by h.complete_time desc ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename) \t\t \texec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename + \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(128), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))')  \tif @id >= 2000001 and @id <= 3000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the job node \t\tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \t\tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event where event_id = @intid'  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int' \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id  \t\t \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event where event_id ='+ @intid)  \t\t-- Get the folder_id \t\tselect @id = folder_id from event where event_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get folders down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -10 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the folder node \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event_folder where folder_id = @intid';  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid=@id ; \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event_folder where folder_id =' + @id) \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Jobs'', -10, ''folder'')')\t-- Return the completed branch list  \tif @selectResults = 1 \t\texec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_schedules", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_schedules \t@job_id int as \t\t--Bug #40255: Web Console not showing all computers that have been scheduled for a job \t\tselect\tschd.schedule_id, schd.computer_id, schd.event_id, schd.cond_seq, schd.next_task_seq, schd.start_time, schd.recur_value , schd.recur_type , schd.status_code , schd.status, schd.broker_time, schd.defer_mins, schd.config_choice_id, schd.end_time, schd.dep_schedule_id, schd.user_id, schd.initial_deployment, schd.redeploy_history_id, schd.calling_event, schd.rip_replace_event, schd.exit_code, schd.exit_module, schd._nslastsent,  \t\t\t\tevnt.[name] as 'job_name', comp.[name] as 'computer_name',evntinfo.job_exec_time as 'job_execution_time' \t\tfrom event_schedule as schd \t\tleft outer join event as evnt on evnt.event_id = schd.event_id \t\tleft outer join computer as comp on schd.computer_id = comp.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join event_schedule_info as evntinfo on schd.schedule_id = evntinfo.schedule_id \t\twhere schd.event_id = @job_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_license_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_license_info as    --select * from license_info    --Bug #28067    \tselect remain_days, total_days,serial_number, server as totalserver, client as totalclient, pda as totalpda, nodes as totalnodes  from license_info \t \t--1 \tselect count (computer_id) as server from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 1 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--2 \tselect count (computer_id) as client from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 3 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--3 \tselect count (computer_id) as pda from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 2 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--7 total \tselect count (computer_id) as nodes from computer  where limited_license = 0 and  \tcomputer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     select * from nic_config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     select * from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_nic_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_nic_config_set    @jobId\t\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     select * from nic_config_set where config_set_id = @configSetId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_physical_device_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_physical_device_children    @id int -- this param is for compatability and is not used in the procedure as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_physical_device_children') is not null       drop table #wc_physical_device_children    create table dbo.#wc_physical_device_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543     -- iterate through all of the racks    declare @rackId int    declare rack_cursor cursor for       select rack_id from physical_rack    open rack_cursor    fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- get computers in the bays in the enclosures in this rack       -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_physical_device_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)             select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end              from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id              where r.rack_id = e.rack_id and r.rack_id = @rackId              and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and b.computer_id = c.computer_id              and b.initial_event_id is null       -- get next rack ID       fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    end    -- cleanup cursor    close rack_cursor    deallocate rack_cursor     select * from #wc_physical_device_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_reb_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_reb_branch    @id int,    @selectResult int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))    if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null       exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)     exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename +       '([level] int IDENTITY,        [name] varchar(64),        [id] int NOT NULL,        type varchar(20))')  \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500)    -- If node is a Bay    if @id >= 13000001 and @id <= 14000000    begin       -- Get the bay node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)          -- select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type         -- from physical_bay where bay_id = @id') \t\t \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_bay where bay_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ;        -- Get the enclosure_id       select @id = enclosure_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @id    end\t     -- If node is an Enclosure    if @id >= 12000001 and @id <= 13000000    begin       -- Get the enclosure node      -- exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)         -- select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type         -- from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id') \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t       -- Get the rack_id       select @id = rack_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id    end     -- If node is a Rack    if @id >= 11000001 and @id <= 12000000    begin       -- Get the rack node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename +'([name], [id], type)        --  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type        --  from physical_rack where rack_id = @id')  \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_rack where rack_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t    end     -- Add Physical Devices node    --insert into @branch_tablename ([name], [id], type)      -- select 'Physical Devices' as [name], -9 as [id], 'physical devices' as type \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)       select ''Physical Devices'' as [name], -9 as [id], ''physical devices'' as type')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResult = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + 'order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_required_domains", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_required_domains  \t@jobids    varchar(8000), \t@compids    varchar(8000)  as \t--Query on config_set and Config_item table to fetch all required domains. \tselect lower(msnet_domain_name) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_domain_name is not null and msnet_domain_name <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_dns_domain is not null and msnet_dns_domain <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \tunion \tselect lower(domain_name) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere (msnet_dns_domain is null or msnet_dns_domain='')  \t\tand config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \t \t--Query to check whether we should check for computer domain information \t-- IF count is > 0  then check for computer domains as well \tselect count(*) from config_set, config_task  \twhere \tconfig_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_set.config_set_id \t\tand ((use_existing_data=1 and msnet_is_domain_member is null) or (msnet_is_domain_member=1 and ((msnet_domain_name ='' or msnet_domain_name is null) and ( msnet_dns_domain ='' or msnet_dns_domain is null) )) or (use_existing_data=1 and reconfig=1))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar, @compids varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_codes", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_codes    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    \tint as    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_return_code') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_return_code  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_return_code \t\t(code\t\tvarchar(11), \t\t handler\t\tint, \t\t result \t\tint, \t\t status   varchar(256))  \t-- store the default handler \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect 'default' as code, on_fail as handler, on_fail as result, null as status \t\tfrom task where event_id=@jobId and   \t\tcond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq  \t-- get the rest of the handlers \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect ret_code as code, handler, result, status from task_return_handlers \t\twhere event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and\ttask_seq=@taskSeq  \tselect * from ##wc_return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_handler_jobs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_handler_jobs    @jobId int as    -- make a temporary table to store the IDs in    if object_id ('#wc_handler_ids') is null       create table dbo.#wc_handler_ids (job int, primary key (job))    -- store the calling job    insert into #wc_handler_ids values (@jobId)     -- declare needed variables    declare @newJobCount int    declare @handler int    declare @job int    declare @fail int     -- loop through all discovered jobs repeatedly until no new linked jobs are found    set @newJobCount = 1    while @newJobCount > 0    begin       set @newJobCount = 0       -- make a cursor to step through all discovered jobs       declare job_cursor cursor for          select job from #wc_handler_ids       open job_cursor       fetch next from job_cursor into @job       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          -- loop through the linked jobs          -- make a cursor to step through all linked task_return_handlers jobs          declare handler_cursor cursor for             select distinct(handler) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @job                and handler > 2000000 and handler < 3000001 and handler not in --Bug 27827                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open handler_cursor          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@handler)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          end          -- cleanup cursor          close handler_cursor          deallocate handler_cursor           -- make a cursor to step through all linked on_fail jobs          declare fail_cursor cursor for             select distinct(on_fail) from task where event_id = @job                and on_fail > 2000000 and on_fail < 3000001 and event_id not in                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open fail_cursor          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@fail)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          end          -- cleanup cursor          close fail_cursor          deallocate fail_cursor                  fetch next from job_cursor into @job       end       -- cleanup cursor       close job_cursor       deallocate job_cursor    end     -- return the list of jobs discovered    select job from #wc_handler_ids    drop table #wc_handler_ids ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_schedule1", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_schedule1 \t@schedule int as \tdeclare @user int \tselect @user = su.[user_id] from securityuser su, event_schedule es  \twhere es.schedule_id = @schedule and es.[user_id] = su.[user_id]  \tif @user is null \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\t'gznFiP' as 'user_name', 'gznFiP' as user_full_name, '' as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\tu.[name] as 'user_name', u.fullname as user_full_name, u.domain as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e, securityuser u \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \t\t\tand u.[user_id] = s.[user_id] \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_sysprep", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_sysprep    @jobId int,    @task int,    @condition int as  declare @count int  set @count = null  \t select @count= count(*) from  sysprep_answers where event_id = @jobId and task_seq = @task and cond_seq = @condition  if @count != 0    select prefix, suffix, current_suff, use_global, [user_name], org_name,          license_mode, user_count,os, product_key     from sysprep_answers where event_id = @jobId and task_seq = @task and cond_seq = @condition   else     select prefix, suffix, current_suff, use_global, [user_name], org_name,          license_mode, user_count,os, product_key     from sysprep_answers where event_id = 0 and task_seq = 0 and cond_seq = 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @task int, @condition int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_tasktype", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_tasktype \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder  temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table\t */  declare @tbl_folder table (\tfolder_id int\t )   insert into @tbl_folder select folder_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id \tfrom @tbl_folder  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder \tselect folder_id \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select count(t.folder_id),count(e.event_id) from @tbl_folder t,event e where e.folder_id = t.folder_id select distinct task_type from task where task_type not in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder)) select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type from task where task_type in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_taskusers_count", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.14 Centrally Managed Task Password create procedure wc_sel_taskusers_count @username varchar(128), @password varchar(128) as  declare @totalRecordCount  int declare @taskRecordCount  int  set @totalRecordCount = 0 set @taskRecordCount = 0  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from script_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from copyfile_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from install_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from capture_pct_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select @totalRecordCount ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- #32375 - Select all handheld unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld as \tif object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_handleld') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld \t\t(event_id\tint)  \tinsert into ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld \t\t-- Registory task (13), Image task (15) and Capture PCT task (18) not allowed on pocket pc \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom task  \t\twhere task_type=13 or task_type=15 or task_type=18  \t\tunion \t\t-- For pocket pc execution location of script is allowed only on DS Side  \t\tselect distinct event_id  \t\tfrom script_task  \t\twhere (location != 1)   \t\tunion \t\t-- Only reboot is allowed on pocket pc (logoff, shutdown etc not allowed) \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom reboot_task  \t\twhere (reboot_method != 1) \t\t\t \tselect event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- #32375 - Select all linux unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux  as  \tif object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_linux') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux \t\t(event_id\tint)  \tinsert into ##wc_unsafe_job_linux \t\t-- Registory task (13) and Capture PCT task (18) are not allowed on linux \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom task  \t\twhere task_type=13 or task_type=18 \t\t \t\tunion \t\t-- Only Reboot, Shutdown, WakeUp is allowed on linux for reboot task \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom reboot_task  \t\twhere (reboot_method = 8)  \t\t\t \tselect event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_linux ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_ad_user_membership", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " --For bug #37092 - Update AD User-Group membership in table create procedure wc_upd_ad_user_membership    @aduser varchar(50),     @adgroup varchar(50),     @userdomain varchar(1024),     @groupdomain varchar(1024) as \tdeclare @group_id int       \tif @adgroup is not null and @groupdomain is not null \t\tselect @group_id=group_id from securitygroup where upper([name]) = upper(@adgroup) and ad_group = 1 and (upper(ad_group_domain) = upper(@groupdomain) or upper(ad_group_netbiosdomain) = upper(@groupdomain))  \t-- If group exist in database \tif @group_id is not null \tbegin  \t\tdeclare @userId int  \t\tselect @userId = [user_id]  \t\tfrom securityuser  \t\twhere [name] = @aduser and ( upper(domain) = upper(@userdomain) or upper(netbiosdomain) = upper(@userdomain) ) and ad_user<>0  \t\tdeclare @member int  \t\tselect @member = count([user_id])  \t\tfrom securitygroupmember  \t\twhere [user_id] = @userId and group_id = @group_id \t\t \t\tif @userId is not null and @member = 0 \t\t\tinsert into securitygroupmember ([user_id], group_id) values (@userId, @group_id)  \tend  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@aduser varchar, @adgroup varchar, @userdomain varchar, @groupdomain varchar)"}

@msnet_domain_password varchar(256),    @msnet_dns_domain varchar(512), -- Bug #41687    @reboot_after_config smallint -- PRD item 7.1.60 Reboot option as    declare @config_set_id int    select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task        where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task    declare @config_item_id int    select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id       and target_computer_id = @computer        --Microsoft issue: Changes done to handle OU field    declare @msnet_domain_ou varchar(256)    set \t@msnet_domain_ou = null\t    if( \t@domain_member <> 0 )    begin\t \tif ( CHARINDEX('.',@domain_name) > 0) \tbegin \t\tset @msnet_dns_domain = @domain_name \t\tset @domain_name = null\t\t \tend      \tdeclare @ouSplit  int\t    \tset @ouSplit=CHARINDEX('/',@msnet_dns_domain) \tif(@ouSplit>0) \tbegin \t\tset @msnet_domain_ou = SUBSTRING(@msnet_dns_domain, (@ouSplit+1) ,LEN(@msnet_dns_domain)) {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,    @item1\t\tint,    @item2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId\t\t\tint,    @conditionId1\tint,    @conditionId2\tint as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@tempCondId \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as \tupdate config_item  \tset  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  \twhere Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) \tand config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  \t@itemId int as  \tdeclare @domain_name as varchar(512) \tdeclare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)\t  \t-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name \tselect    \t\t@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, \t\t@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))\t\t \t\twhen '' then domain_name \t\telse msnet_dns_domain \t\tend -- case \tfrom config_item  \twhere config_item_id=@itemId  \t-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it \tif @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 \tbegin \t\tselect @username=username, @password=[password]  \t\tfrom domain_accounts  \t\twhere domain=@domain_name\t\t \t \t\tupdate config_item  \t\tset  \t\tmsnet_domain_username=@username, \t\tmsnet_domain_password=@password \t\twhere config_item_id=@itemId \tend\t ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)"}

@nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with nw_pref_tree, nw_nds_context, nw_user_name, nw_login_to_tree,          nw_run_scripts, msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou       from computer where computer_id = @computerId    open computer_cursor msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu,          target_computer_id=@computerId       where config_item_id=@itemId    end     -- cleanup cursor    close computer_cursor    deallocate computer_cursor     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Changes for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @deviceId int, @pciBus int, @pciDevice int, @pciFunction int, @vendorId int, @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @description varchar(64), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDHCP smallint, @winsDHCP smallint -- DNS/Wins DHCP for MSN    -- loop through each of the computer's nic records    declare nic_cursor cursor for       select ip_use_dhcp, @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP     -- update nic_config_item table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- make sure a nic_config_item record exists       declare @configItem int       select @configItem = count(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id=@itemId          and nic_id=@nicId       -- update existing record       if @configItem = 1       begin          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp=@useDhcp, nic_device_id=@deviceId, nic_pci_bus=@pciBus,             nic_pci_device=@pciDevice, nic_pci_function=@pciFunction, nic_vendor_id=@vendorId,             ip_dns=@ipDns, ip_wins=@ipWins, nic_desc=@description, ip_domain=@ipDomain, netbios=@netBIOS,             dns_use_dhcp = @dnsDHCP, wins_use_dhcp = @winsDHCP          where config_item_id=@itemId and nic_id=@nicId          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId                end       -- create new from nic_cursor into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction,           @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP    end     -- cleanup config_static_route_item    \t\t\t      (config_item_id, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use])    \tselect    @itemId, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use]    \tfrom         static_routes where  computer_id = @computerId           -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix       \t-- update existing record    \t-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    \t    \tdelete dns_suffix where [id] = @itemId    \t-- create new records       \t    \tinsert into dns_suffix    \t\t\t      ([id], dns_suffix, [order])    \tselect    @itemId, dns_suffix, [order]    \tfrom      dns_suffix where [id] = @computerId  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_ip    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int,    @nic_id int as    -- test for a static IP range    declare @master_ip varchar(16), @duplicate_ip varchar(16), @final_ip varchar(16)    declare @interface_name varchar(64)    declare @interface_id int    declare config_ip_cursor cursor for       select ip, [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @config_set_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open config_ip_cursor    declare item_ip_cursor cursor for       select interface_id from nic_interface where [id] = @config_item_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open item_ip_cursor    fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name    fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       if len(@master_ip) > 0       begin          -- test for duplicate IP usage          set @duplicate_ip = @master_ip          set @final_ip = @master_ip          declare @computer_id int          select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id          while @duplicate_ip is not null          begin             set @duplicate_ip = null             -- test for another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface where [id] >= 5000001 and [id] <= 8000000                 and [id] != @computer_id and ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                and c.target_computer_id != @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to this computer IN THIS CONFIG that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                 and c.target_computer_id = @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip and c.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and [name] != @interface_name             -- get a new IP if a duplicate was found             if @duplicate_ip is not null                exec wc_increment_ip @duplicate_ip, @final_ip output          end           -- update the config_item nic_interface ip value to the non-duplicate found          update nic_interface set ip = @final_ip where interface_id = @interface_id       end        fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name       fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    end    close config_ip_cursor    deallocate config_ip_cursor    close item_ip_cursor    deallocate item_ip_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int, @nic_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_name    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int as    -- test for a name range    declare @method smallint    select @method = cname_method from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       -- test for duplicate name usage       declare @duplicate_name varchar(64), @final_name varchar(64)       --PRD item 7.1.12 Use token: To remove the addition of network adapter       select @final_name = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id       if @final_name in ('%NAME%','%SERIALNUM%','%NODENAME%','%NIC1MACADDR%','%NIC2MACADDR%', \t\t\t'%NIC3MACADDR%','%NIC4MACADDR%','%NIC5MACADDR%','%NIC6MACADDR%','%NIC7MACADDR%','%NIC8MACADDR%') \t update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           \twhere config_item_id = @config_item_id       else       begin       select @final_name = computer_name from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       set @duplicate_name = @final_name       declare @computer_id int       select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       while @duplicate_name is not null       begin          set @duplicate_name = null          -- test for another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from computer where computer_name = @final_name             and computer_id != @computer_id          -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from config_item where target_computer_id != @computer_id             and computer_name = @final_name          -- get a new name if a duplicate was found          if @duplicate_name is not null             exec wc_increment_name @config_set_id, @duplicate_name, @final_name output       end       -- update the config_item computer_name, ip_hostname to the non-duplicate value generated       update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           where config_item_id = @config_item_id    end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic \t@computer_id int, \t@mac_addr varchar(36), \t@ip_use_dhcp smallint, \t@ip_domain varchar(128), \t@ip_dns varchar(512), \t@ip_wins varchar(512), \t@nic_pci_bus int, \t@nic_pci_device int, \t@nic_pci_function int, \t@nic_device_id int, \t@nic_vendor_id int, \t@nic_desc varchar(64), \t@nic_location varchar(64), \t@interface_id int, \t@id int, \t@nic_id int, \t@name varchar(64), \t@ip varchar(16), \t@mask varchar(16), \t@gateway varchar(16), \t@broadcast varchar(16), \t@state int \t as \tbegin \t\tupdate nics set nics.mac_addr = @mac_addr, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_use_dhcp = @ip_use_dhcp, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_domain = @ip_domain, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_dns = @ip_dns, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_wins = @ip_wins, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_bus = @nic_pci_bus, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_device = @nic_pci_device, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_function = @nic_pci_function, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_device_id = @nic_device_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_vendor_id = @nic_vendor_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_desc = @nic_desc, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_location = @nic_location \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere nics.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\tupdate  nic_interface set\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.id = @id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.name = @name, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.ip = @ip, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.mask = @mask, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.gateway = @gateway, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.broadcast = @broadcast, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.state = @state \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere  nic_interface.interface_id = @interface_id; {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint = 1,--PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configItemId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_item_id = @configItemId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @interfaceId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int, @last smallint)"}
