{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS3", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing    @itemId int,    @id int,    @nicId int as    declare @name varchar(64)    declare @ip varchar(16), @mask varchar(16), @gateway varchar(16), @broadcast varchar(16)    declare @state int, @interfaceCount int    set @interfaceCount = 0    -- incremental IP for updates from config_set    declare @increment_ip bit    if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000       set @increment_ip = 1    declare nic_interface_cursor cursor for       select [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state from nic_interface where id = @id       and nic_id = @nicId order by interface_id    open nic_interface_cursor    fetch next from nic_interface_cursor       into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    --Bug #43065 To save computer nic_interface data.    declare @iname varchar(64), @iip varchar(16), @imask varchar(16),        @igateway varchar(16), @ibroadcast varchar(16), @istate int   if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000   begin    select @iname = name, @iip = ip, @imask = mask, @igateway = gateway, @ibroadcast = broadcast, @istate = state from      nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId          if @name is null or len(@name) = 0       set @name = @iname    if @ip is null or len(@ip) = 0       set @ip = @iip    if @mask is null or len(@mask) = 0       set @mask = @imask    if @gateway is null or len(@gateway) = 0       set @gateway = @igateway    if @broadcast is null or len(@broadcast) = 0       set @broadcast = @ibroadcast    if @state is null        set @state = @istate        end    -- remove existing nic_interface objects and always add new ones    delete from nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId     -- update nic_inteface table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- create new record       insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state)          values (@itemId, @nicId, @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state)              if @increment_ip = 1          exec wc_upd_next_ip @id, @itemId, @nicId                 fetch next from nic_interface_cursor          into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    end     close nic_interface_cursor    deallocate nic_interface_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @id int, @nicId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fn_get_comparable_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function fn_get_comparable_ip (  @ip varchar(15) ) returns bigint as begin  \tdeclare @ip_part1 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part2 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part3 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part4 bigint \tdeclare @first_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @second_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @third_dot_pos smallint  \tset @first_dot_pos = charindex('.', @ip) \tif @first_dot_pos = 0 \t\treturn cast(@ip as bigint)  \tset @second_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@first_dot_pos + 1) \tset @third_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@second_dot_pos + 1)  \tset @ip_part4 = cast(substring(@ip, @third_dot_pos + 1, len(@ip)) as bigint)  \tif(@first_dot_pos!=0) \tbegin \t\tset @ip_part1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part2 = cast(substring(@ip, @first_dot_pos + 1, @second_dot_pos - @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part3 = cast(substring(@ip, @second_dot_pos + 1, @third_dot_pos - @second_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \tend  \treturn @ip_part1 * 1000000000 + @ip_part2 * 1000000 + @ip_part3 * 1000 + @ip_part4  end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( bigint OUT, @ip varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "SplitIDs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function SplitIDs (  @OrderList varchar(8000) ) returns @ParsedList table (  ID int ) as begin \tdeclare @OrderID varchar(10), @Pos int  \tset @OrderList = ltrim(rtrim(@OrderList))+ ',' \tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1)  \tif replace(@OrderList, ',', '') <> '' \tbegin \t\twhile @Pos > 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tset @OrderID = ltrim(rtrim(left(@OrderList, @Pos - 1))) \t\t\tif @OrderID <> '' \t\t\tbegin \t\t\tinsert into @ParsedList (ID) \t\t\tvalues (cast(@OrderID as int)) --Use Appropriate conversion \t\tend  \t\tset @OrderList = right(@OrderList, len(@OrderList) - @Pos) \t\tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1) \tend end  return end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@OrderList varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "complete_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.complete_schedule \t@schedule_id     int, \t@exit_code       int, \t@status_code     int, \t@exit_module     smallint, \t@next_start_time datetime, \t@current_time    datetime, \t@status          varchar( 256 ), \t@level           smallint, \t@next_task_seq   int,\t -- this is ignored if @next_start_time is not null \t@taskresult      int as \tbegin transaction  \t-- first insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, 0, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult  \t-- now insert and fix up history for this item \texec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id  \t-- update the event schedule table \tif( @next_start_time is null ) \tbegin \t   -- Right now we never want to leave the next_task_seq as null for a completed schedule. \t   -- If it is null, set it to whatever the last sequence was \t   if( @next_task_seq is null ) \t   begin \t      select @next_task_seq = next_task_seq \t         from event_schedule \t   \t     where schedule_id = @schedule_id \t   end  \t\tDECLARE @called_status varchar(MAX),                 @calling_id    int,                 @dependent_id  int  \t\tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \t\tBEGIN \t\t\tDECLARE @event_name    varchar(128) \t\t\tSELECT  @event_name = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN') \t\t\t\tFROM event          AS e \t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\tWHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\t\tIF (@status_code = 0) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Called Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- clear dependent schedule id and set success status for calling schedule \t\t\t\tUPDATE    event_schedule \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL \t\t\t\t\tWHERE schedule_id = @calling_id \t\t\tEND \t\t\tELSE IF (@status_code = 1) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE    es \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  status_code = 1, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL, \t\t\t\t\t\t  next_task_seq = nts.next_task_seq, \t\t\t\t\t\t  end_time = @current_time \t\t\t\t\tFROM  event_schedule AS es \t\t\t\t\tJOIN ( \t\t\t\t\t\tSELECT s.schedule_id, MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tFROM script_task AS t \t\t\t\t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\t\t\t\tWHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tGROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\tWHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE es \t\t\t\t\tSET status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\tstatus_code = 1, \t\t\t\t\t\tdep_schedule_id = NULL, \t\t\t\t\t\tend_time = @current_time \t\t\t\t\tFROM event_schedule AS es \t\t\t\t\tWHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\t\t\tIF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL) \t\t\t\t\tEXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' \t\t\tEND \t\tEND  \t   -- this event is not supposed to recur, all done        update event_schedule             set status_code = @status_code, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module,                 status = @status, end_time = @current_time, next_task_seq = @next_task_seq, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  }             where schedule_id = @schedule_id \tend \telse \tbegin \t\t-- this event will recur, update the status and set the new start time \t\tupdate event_schedule \t\t\tset status_code = null, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module, \t\t\t\tstart_time = @next_start_time, status = @status, end_time = @current_time, \t\t\t\tnext_task_seq = null, cond_seq = null, dep_schedule_id = null,  -- these should be re-evaluated every time, set to null \t\t\t\tconfig_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  } \t\t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t \t\t\tdelete from computer_state where  schedule_id = @schedule_id \tend  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tcommit transaction \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @exit_code int, @status_code int, @exit_module smallint, @next_start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @level smallint, @next_task_seq int, @taskresult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "del_session", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure del_session    @computer_id      int,    @status           varchar (254),    @clear_wol_time   int = 1 as    declare  @schedule_id      int,             @event_id         int,             @cond_seq         int,             @next_task_seq    int,             @found            int     set @found = null     if not exists (select computer_id from computer where computer_id = @computer_id)       return 0     select @schedule_id = schedule_id, @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @next_task_seq = next_task_seq from event_schedule       where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code = -3 and computer_id = @computer_id     if (@schedule_id is not null)    begin       select @found = event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq       if (@found is null)          select @found = event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq    end     begin transaction     if (@found is not null)    begin       update event_schedule set status_code = NULL, status = @status where schedule_id = @schedule_id       if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 1       end    end     delete sessions where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 1    end     if (@clear_wol_time != 0)    begin       update computer set last_wol_attempt = null where computer_id = @computer_id        if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 1       end    end     commit transaction     return 1 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @status varchar, @clear_wol_time int)"}

2000006) as varchar(30))    end     if ( @folder_id < 1 and @folder_name is null)    begin       begin transaction       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description]) values (@event_id, @name, @description)    end    else    begin       declare @temp_folder_id int        if (@folder_name is null or @folder_name = '')          set @folder_name = @default_folder_name        if (@folder_id < 1)       begin          set @folder_id = null          select @folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where [name] = @folder_name          if (@folder_id is null)             exec @folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'          if (@@error != 0)             set @folder_id = null       end        if (@folder_id is null)          set @temp_folder_id = 1       else          select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id        begin transaction       if (@temp_folder_id) is null          insert into event_folder (folder_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @folder_name)       insert into event (event_id, [name], folder_id,  [description]) values (@event_id, @name, @folder_id, @description)    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @event_id as event_id    return @event_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @folder_id int, @folder_name varchar, @add_number int, @default_event_name varchar, @default_folder_name varchar, @description varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_folder_by_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_folder_by_id    @folder_name   varchar(64),    @folder_id     int,    @parent_id     int = null as    declare @folder_id_in_use int,            @temp_parent_id int,            @temp_folder_name varchar(64)     select @folder_id_in_use = folder_id, @temp_parent_id = parent_id, @temp_folder_name = [name] from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id     if (@folder_id_in_use is null)    begin       -- the folder id is not in use just create it       insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @parent_id, @folder_name)    end    else    begin       -- the folder id is in use --      if (@temp_folder_name = @folder_name and (@temp_parent_id = @parent_id or (@temp_parent_id is null and @parent_id is null)))       if (@temp_parent_id = @parent_id or (@temp_parent_id is null and @parent_id is null))       begin          -- the id is being used as a system id, done          return       end       else       begin  -- the system id is being used by a non system folder          declare @new_id int           begin transaction          exec @new_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'           -- give existing folder new id          update event_folder set folder_id = @new_id where folder_id = @folder_id          if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return          end           -- add the new system folder          insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @parent_id, @folder_name)          if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return          end           commit transaction       end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_name varchar, @folder_id int, @parent_id int)"}

     goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = exec @history_id = ins_history_registry_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id = @event_id task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_type = 19)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_get_inventory_task @computer_id, @event_id, return 0       end        commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @task_seq int, @cond_seq int, @schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_new_snmp_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  CREATE procedure ins_new_snmp_enclosure   @name varchar(64),   @manuf varchar(64),   @model varchar(64),   @ip_address varchar(20),   @community varchar(256),   @rack_name varchar(64) as   declare @enclosure_id as int,           @tran int,           @status int,           @rack_id int,           @org_name varchar(64)    set @tran = @@trancount    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    select @rack_id=rack_id from physical_rack where name=@rack_name    if(@rack_id is null)   begin     exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'      insert into physical_rack(rack_id, name, real_name, manuf_rack)       values(@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, 1)   end    select @enclosure_id=enclosure_id, @org_name=name from physical_enclosure where manuf=@manuf and model=@model       and ip_address=@ip_address and community=@community and rack_id=@rack_id    if (@enclosure_id is null)   begin     exec @enclosure_id = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'      insert into physical_enclosure(enclosure_id, name, real_name, manuf, model, ip_address, community, rack_id)       values(@enclosure_id, @name, @name, @manuf, @model, @ip_address, @community, @rack_id)      set @status = 1   end   else   begin     if(@org_name = @name)       set @status = 0     else     begin       set @status = 2       update physical_enclosure set name=@name, real_name=@name where enclosure_id=@enclosure_id     end   end    if (@@error != 0)   begin     if (@tran = 0)       rollback transaction   end    if (@tran = 0)   begin     commit transaction     select @enclosure_id, @status   end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @manuf varchar, @model varchar, @ip_address varchar, @community varchar, @rack_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_nic_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_nic_interface    @id int,    @nic_id int,    @interface_id int, \t\t -- -1 means use existing    @name varchar( 64 ) = null,    @ip varchar( 16 ) = null,    @netmask varchar( 16 ) = null,    @gateway varchar( 16 ) = null,    @broadcast varchar( 16 ) = null,    @state int = null as    declare @last_id int    declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     if( -1 = @interface_id )    begin       -- we don't have an existing id, just insert the data and let SQL generate one       insert into nic_interface          ( [id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state )          values          ( @id, @nic_id, @name, @ip, @netmask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state )        -- save the inserted identity so we can return it       set @last_id = @@identity    end    else    begin       -- update the data       update nic_interface  \t     set [id] = @id, nic_id = @nic_id,              [name] = @name, ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,  \t\t\tbroadcast = @broadcast, state = @state          where interface_id = @interface_id              -- the last identity was passed in but return it anyway       set @last_id = @interface_id    end     if( @@error != 0 )    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return -1    end    else    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          commit transaction       return @last_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @nic_id int, @interface_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_redeploy_event", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_redeploy_event    @computer_id   int,    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    declare @new_time         datetime,            @schedule_id      int,            @max_history_id   int,            @bootoption_id    int     set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @start_time)     begin transaction     update event_schedule       set start_time = @new_time       where computer_id = @computer_id           and start_time <= @start_time           and status_code = null     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     if (@schedule_id = 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     select @max_history_id = max(history_id) from history_view where computer_id = @computer_id     insert into event_schedule       (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, cond_seq, next_task_seq, start_time, redeploy_history_id, rip_replace_event)    values       (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, null, 0, @start_time, @max_history_id, 1)     select top 1 @bootoption_id=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@event_id order by task_seq    if(@bootoption_id = 1 or @bootoption_id is null)    begin      exec @bootoption_id=sel_default_bootoption_id    end     select @bootoption_id as bootoption_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @start_time datetime)"}

  if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     if (@tran = 0)       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_code {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_session", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_session    @computer_id   int,    @engine_id     int,    @engine_ip     varchar(32),    @last_update   datetime,    @client_ip\t  varchar(32),    @platform\t  smallint,     @boot_env\t  smallint  -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes } as    declare  @session_id    int     select @session_id = session_id from sessions where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@session_id is null)    begin       if (@engine_ip) is not null       begin          begin transaction           exec @session_id = sel_next_system_id 'SESSION_ID'           if (@session_id = 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return 0          end           insert into sessions             (session_id, computer_id, engine_id, address, last_update, client_ip, platform, boot_env) -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }          values             (@session_id, @computer_id, @engine_id, @engine_ip, @last_update, @client_ip, @platform, @boot_env) -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }           if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction          else             commit transaction       end       else       begin          set @session_id = 0       end    end    else     begin    -- Update sessions value, if it is not deleted from database due to any reasons.       update sessions set computer_id = @computer_id,engine_id=@engine_id,address=@engine_ip,last_update=@last_update,client_ip=@client_ip,platform=@platform,boot_env=@boot_env \t  where session_id = @session_id    end     return @session_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @engine_id int, @engine_ip varchar, @last_update datetime, @client_ip varchar, @platform smallint, @boot_env smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_wait_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_wait_task \t@event_id\t\tint, \t@cond_seq\t\tint, \t@task_seq\t\tint, \t@wait_time\t\tint=0, \t@bootoption_id int = null,\t\t\t     @bootoption_cpu_arch int = 0 as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     insert into wait_task    ( \tevent_id, \tcond_seq, \ttask_seq, \twait_time    )    values    ( \t@event_id, \t@cond_seq, \t@task_seq, \t@wait_time    )     update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch = @bootoption_cpu_arch where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq     -- only commit or rollback based on whether or not we were in a transaction    if( 0 = @tran )    begin       if (@@error = 0)          commit transaction       else          rollback transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @wait_time int, @bootoption_id int, @bootoption_cpu_arch int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "is_need_check_visibility", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[is_need_check_visibility]     @user_id int, \t@obj_id  int AS BEGIN     DECLARE @need_check int     SELECT  @need_check = 1      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM database_info WHERE req_login = 1 AND enforce_visibility = 1)         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securityprivilegelink l                         LEFT JOIN securitygroupmember   m ON m.group_id = l.[user_id]                         WHERE     l.privilege_id = 1 AND @user_id IN (l.[user_id], m.[user_id]) )         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securitygroupmember    m                         JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                         WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                         AND       p.[object_id] = @obj_id AND p.[allow] > 0 )         SET @need_check = 0      RETURN  @need_check END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user_id int, @obj_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure [dbo].[mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task]     @schedule_id   int,     @operation_str varchar(64) as begin \tDECLARE   @calling_id   int \tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int \tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id         AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \tBEGIN \t\tDECLARE @failure_code int,                 @exit_code    int, \t\t        @taskresult   int, \t\t        @exit_module  smallint, \t\t        @level        smallint, \t\t        @current_time datetime         SELECT  @failure_code = 1,                 @exit_code    = 19501,                 @taskresult   = 0,                 @exit_module  = 16,                 @level        = 3,                 @current_time = GETDATE()  \t\tDECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tDECLARE @errstatus   varchar(MAX);         SELECT  @errstatus = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @eventname + '] Was ' + @operation_str \t\t \t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @errstatus, @failure_code, @exit_code, @exit_module,                                  @level, @taskresult  \t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE es             SET status          = @errstatus,                 status_code     = @failure_code,                 dep_schedule_id = NULL,                 next_task_seq   = nts.next_task_seq,                 end_time        = @current_time             FROM event_schedule AS es             JOIN (                 SELECT    s.schedule_id,                           MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq,                           t.cond_seq                     FROM  script_task    AS t                     JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id                     WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq                     GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq                  ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq             WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE    event_schedule             SET   status          = @errstatus,                   status_code     = @failure_code,                   dep_schedule_id = NULL,                   end_time        = @current_time             WHERE schedule_id     = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id          IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL)             EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' \tEND end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @operation_str varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_upd_event_schedule_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.mm_upd_event_schedule_id    @schedule_id\t\t\tint,    @start_time          datetime,    @status              varchar(254) = NULL,    @recur_value         int = NULL,    @recur_type\t\t    smallint = NULL,    @defer               int = NULL,    @user_id\t\t\t\tint = 0,    @cond_seq\t\t\tint = NULL,    @calling_schedule    int = NULL,    @winuser_id       int = 0  --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User as    declare @new_sched_id int     begin transaction     exec mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @schedule_id, 'Restarted'     exec @new_sched_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     update event_schedule     set next_task_seq = NULL, start_time = @start_time, status = @status, \tdefer_mins = @defer, recur_value = @recur_value, recur_type = @recur_type, \tstatus_code = NULL, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \tbroker_time = NULL, user_id = @user_id, cond_seq = @cond_seq, \tcalling_event = @calling_schedule, dep_schedule_id = null, \tschedule_id = @new_sched_id, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null on  \"Reschedule\" or \"start now\" }    where schedule_id = @schedule_id    --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User    update  event_schedule_info     set schedule_id = @new_sched_id, \t\twindows_user_id = @winuser_id, \t\tjob_exec_time = null\t-- PRD 7.1.49 (Bug Fix #36624)    where        schedule_id  = @schedule_id\t\t   -------------------------------------------     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     return @new_sched_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @status varchar, @recur_value int, @recur_type smallint, @defer int, @user_id int, @cond_seq int, @calling_schedule int, @winuser_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_upd_sched_dependency", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.mm_upd_sched_dependency    @schedule_id   int,    @schedule_dependent_on int as    declare   @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     --begin transaction -- we do a transaction around the whole thing now    update event_schedule        set dep_schedule_id = @schedule_dependent_on       where schedule_id = @schedule_id     --commit transaction    if( 0 = @tran )    begin       if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @schedule_dependent_on int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_automation_job", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_automation_job    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule es          where ( (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is NULL)             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)            and es.event_id in ( select t.event_id from [task] t left outer join [script_task] st \t\t\ton t.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\tand t.cond_seq = st.cond_seq  \t\t\tand t.task_seq = st.task_seq \t\t\twhere ((t.task_type = 10 and st.execution_mode = 0) \t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 22) )        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_current_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_current_schedule \t@computer_id\tint, \t@schedule_id\tint, \t@task_seq\t\tint, \t@boot_env\t\tint as \tdeclare @return_code  int \tset @return_code = null  \tif (@schedule_id = 0) \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks there is has not work, lets make sure. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule es join task t  \t\t\t\ton es.event_id = t.event_id \t\t\t\tand es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = t.task_seq \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and (es.status_code = -1 or es.status_code = -3) \t\t\t\tand ( ( @boot_env = 1 -- BOOT_AUTOMATION = 1 \t\t\t\t\t\tand ( t.task_type = 10 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 11 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 ) ) \t\t\t\t\tor  \t\t\t\t\t( @boot_env != 1 ) )  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \tend \telse \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks it is working on a job. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \t\t\t\tand schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\tand next_task_seq = @task_seq \t\t\t\tand status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\tbegin \t\t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\t\tset @return_code = 0 -- Agent thinks it has a job, but we don't.  \t\t\t-- We think it is working on a different job than the agent thinks. \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\t-- We are in sync with the agent. \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \t\tend \tend  \treturn @return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @boot_env int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_os_version_change", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_os_version_change    @computer_id   int,    @os            varchar(128) as    if (@computer_id = 0)       return     if not exists (select computer_id from computer where computer_id = @computer_id and os = @os)    begin       begin transaction       update computer set last_inventory = null where computer_id = @computer_id       if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @os varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_copy_event", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_copy_event    @folder_id      int,    @src_event_id   int,    @event_prefix   varchar(16),    @nested         tinyint = 0\t as    begin transaction  \t/* get the new ID from the system table */ {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_expired_schedules_machines", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines    @time      datetime,    @wol_wait  int = 60,    @to_all    char(1) = 'Y' as    declare @wol_time datetime    set @wol_time = DATEADD(second, -@wol_wait, @time)     --    -- I changed the join on the nic_interface table to a left outer join because there are no    -- entries in the nic_interface table if BootWorks is the only agent that's connected to the    -- database.  This is because we don't want BootWorks to update the nic_interface table    -- because it's supposed to be used for the production OS.    -- This fixes bug #24899.    --     if (@to_all = 'Y')    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c \t\t    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id \t\t\tjoin nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null \t\t\t-- see comment above about left outer join \t\t\tleft outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) \t\t    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) \t\t\tand es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  \t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere es.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) \t\torder by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end    else    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c \t\t\tjoin event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id \t\t\tjoin nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null \t\t\t-- see comment above about left outer join \t\t\tleft outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where c.wol_support = 1             and (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) \t\t    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0  and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) \t\t\tand es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  \t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere es.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) \t\torder by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@time datetime, @wol_wait int, @to_all char)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_expired_schedules_machines_ignore_last_wol_attempt", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines_ignore_last_wol_attempt    @time      datetime as       select top 1 c.computer_id           from computer c \t\t    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id \t\t\tjoin nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null \t\t\t-- see comment above about left outer join \t\t\tleft outer join nic_interface ni on ni.id = n.computer_id          where -- (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time) and  \t\t\tes.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) \t\t      and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) \t\tand es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  \t\t\t\twhere es.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\t\t\tand ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) \t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2)  \t\t\t\t) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_find_next_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_find_next_computer     @BeginID char(7),     @SearchTable varchar(255),     @SearchColumn varchar(255),     @SearchData varchar(255) as declare @Children TABLE (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int) declare @RowCnt int declare @MaxRows int declare @ExecSql nvarchar(2048) --LB#74365  create table #GroupOrder (group_id int, parent_id int, name varchar(64), search_order int) insert into #GroupOrder (group_id, parent_id, name, search_order)   select group_id, parent_id, name, 2147483647   from computer_group    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id IS NULL AND group_id != -7 order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end  create table  #SortedComputers (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, computer_id int) insert     into      #SortedComputers (computer_id)     select    c.computer_id     from      computer    c     left join #GroupOrder g on c.group_id = g.group_id     order by  isnull(g.search_order, case when c.node_type IS NULL then 2147483647                                           when c.node_type < 3     then 1 else NULL end) DESC, c.name  select @ExecSql =  case @SearchTable   when 'nic_interface' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.id AND            t.' + @SearchColumn + ' LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   when 'all_fields' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM   #SortedComputers s LEFT OUTER JOIN             computer c ON s.computer_id = c.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nics n ON s.computer_id = n.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nic_interface i ON s.computer_id = i.id LEFT OUTER JOIN             physical_bay p ON s.computer_id = p.computer_id      WHERE (c.computer_id LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_key) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.computer_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.asset_tag) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.serial_num) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.logged_on_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.uuid) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(n.mac_addr) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             i.ip LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(p.real_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''') AND             s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   else     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.computer_id AND            LOWER(t.' + @SearchColumn + ') LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum' end execute sp_executesql @ExecSql drop table #SortedComputers drop table #GroupOrder ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@BeginID char, @SearchTable varchar, @SearchColumn varchar, @SearchData varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_find_next_computer_set_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_find_next_computer_set_order (@GroupID int) as begin   declare @Children table (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int)   declare @RowCnt int   declare @MaxRows int   declare @ExecSql nvarchar(255)    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id = @GroupID order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end    update #GroupOrder set search_order = (select MIN(search_order) - 1 from #GroupOrder) where group_id = @GroupID  end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@GroupID int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_boot_optionid_valid", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_is_boot_optionid_valid  @bootoption_id int as begin declare @returnoptionid as int  if object_id ('dbo.x_bootoptions') is not null begin   set @returnoptionid = (select top 1 bo.bootoption_id from boot_options bo, x_bootoptions xbo     where bo.bootoption_type = xbo.bootoption_type and     bo.pxe_description = xbo.pxe_description and xbo.bootoption_id = @bootoption_id) end else   set @returnoptionid = 0  return @returnoptionid end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@bootoption_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast]  \t@event_id\tint as BEGIN \tdeclare @event_count int      SET @event_count = 0 \tselect @event_count = count(event_id)  \t\tfrom image_task \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0  \tif( @event_count > 0 ) \tbegin \t\t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast_first_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast_first_task]  \t@event_id\tint as BEGIN \tdeclare @task_count int      SET @task_count = 0 \tselect @task_count = count(event_id)  \t\tfrom image_task \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0  \t\t       and task_seq =(select min(task_seq) from task where event_id = @event_id)  \tif( @task_count > 0 ) \tbegin \t\t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_event_master", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- is this event a master event create procedure sel_is_event_master \t@event_id\tint as \tdeclare @event_unique_id as uniqueidentifier  \tselect @event_unique_id = master_guid \t\tfrom event \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and master_server is null  \tif( @event_unique_id is not NULL ) \tbegin \t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_event_master_assigned", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- is this event linked to a master event create procedure sel_is_event_master_assigned \t@event_id\tint as \tdeclare @event_unique_id as uniqueidentifier  \tselect @event_unique_id = master_guid \t\tfrom event \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and master_server is not null  \tif( @event_unique_id is not NULL ) \tbegin \t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_image_post_config", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_is_image_post_config    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc \t \tif (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) \tbegin \t\treturn -1 \tend  \tselect @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  \t \tif( @deploy_any_event_id != 0 ) \t\tset @next_task_seq = @next_task_seq + 1  \tselect @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_set \t\twhere config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq and reconfig is null)  \tif (@config_set_id is null) \t\treturn -1     return @next_task_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_next_task_deploy_anywhere", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_is_next_task_deploy_anywhere    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc \t \tif (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) \tbegin \t\treturn -1 \tend  \tselect @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  \t \tif( @deploy_any_event_id is null) \t\treturn -1 \t \treturn \t@next_task_seq\t\t\t\t ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_post_config_in_prod", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_is_post_config_in_prod @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @prep_image   int   set @prep_image=-1   select @prep_image=prepare_image from image_task where  \t\t\tevent_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq   return @prep_image ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_rejected_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create proc sel_is_rejected_computer    @mac_addr   varchar(512) as    --declare @retVal varchar(12)    select rc.computer_id       from reject_computer rc,            reject_mac_addrs rma       where (rc.serial_num in (@mac_addr) or          rc.asset_tag in (@mac_addr)) or          (rma.mac_addr in (@mac_addr) and          rma.computer_id = rc.computer_id) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@mac_addr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_job_status_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_job_status_info \t@computer_id int as \tselect t.task_type, es.schedule_id, es.next_task_seq, \t\tcase t.task_type \t\t\twhen 10 then\t\t\t\t-- Script \t\t\t\t(select case when location = 1 then 'None' \t\t\t\t\t\t\t when execution_mode = 0 then 'Automation'  \t\t\t\t\t\t\t else 'Production' \t\t\t\t\t\tend  \t\t\t\t\tfrom script_task st \t\t\t\t\twhere st.event_id = t.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.cond_seq = t.cond_seq  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.task_seq = t.task_seq) \t\t\twhen 11 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Reboot \t\t\twhen 12 then 'Production'\t-- Copy File \t\t\twhen 13 then 'Automation'\t-- Registry  \t\t\twhen 14 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Config \t\t\twhen 15 then 'Automation'\t-- Image \t\t\twhen 16 then 'Production'\t-- Install \t\t\twhen 17 then 'Automation'\t-- Unattended Install \t\t\twhen 18 then 'Production'\t-- PCT \t\t\twhen 19 then 'Production'\t-- Inventory \t\t\twhen 21 then 'Production'\t-- Update Agent  \t\t\telse 'None' \t\tend as boot_env \t\tfrom dbo.task t join dbo.event_schedule es  \t\t\ton es.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\t\t\tand t.event_id = es.event_id  \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq  \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq \t\twhere es.status_code is not null  \t\t\tand es.status_code != -2 \t\t\tand es.status_code < 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_lic_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_lic_info    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36) as    declare  @del_expire   datetime     select @del_expire = expire from deleted_computer where mac_addr = @mac_addr     if (@computer_id = 0)    begin       select @del_expire as del_expire    end    else    begin       select expire, limited_license, @del_expire as del_expire          from computer where computer_id = @computer_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_max_free_disk_space", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_max_free_disk_space    @computer_id      int as    declare @free int     select @free = max(free)\tfrom logical_drive       where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@free is null)       set @free = -1     return @free ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_more_work", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_more_work    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule          where (next_task_seq > -1             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end   --LB#35552   -- select computer_id from sessions where platform = 1 and computer_id not in (    select computer_id from sessions where boot_env = 1 and computer_id not in ( -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }       select distinct s.computer_id from sessions s, event_schedule es          where s.computer_id = es.computer_id --LB#35552    and platform = 1 \t       and boot_env = 1\t\t-- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }             and es.start_time <= @time_now             and ( ( es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code < 0 )                   and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in                      ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )                or ( es.event_id = 2000001 and es.status_code is NULL ) ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_expired_time", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_expired_time    @cur_time   datetime as    declare @sched_in_progress int     select top 1 @sched_in_progress = schedule_id from event_schedule where status_code < 0    if (@sched_in_progress is null)       set @sched_in_progress = 0    else       set @sched_in_progress = 1     if exists (select top 1 es.schedule_id       from event_schedule es       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @cur_time          and es.computer_id in (select s.computer_id from sessions s where es.computer_id = s.computer_id          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in \t\t( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ))))    select dateadd (mi, -1, @cur_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress    else    select min (start_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress       from event_schedule       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time >= @cur_time          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_seq_by_sched", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_seq_by_sched    @schedule_id int as    declare @event_id int    declare @cond_seq int    declare @task_seq int    declare @next_sequence int     select @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq       from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     exec @next_sequence = sel_next_sequence @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     return @next_sequence ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_sequence", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_sequence    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    set @next_task_seq = null    select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc     return coalesce (@next_task_seq, -1) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_system_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_system_id    @object_id   varchar(64),    @update      char(1) = 'T' as    declare  @last_used_id int,             @tran         int    declare  @err    varchar(100)     set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction     select @last_used_id = last_used_id + 1       from system_id with (xlock, rowlock)       where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)  \tif 'EVENT_ID' = upper(@object_id) \tBegin \t\tif @last_used_id = 3000000 \t\tbegin \t\t\tSET @last_used_id = 19000000 \t\tend \tend     if (@last_used_id is null)    begin       set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id in selecting object ' + @object_id       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction;       -- raiserror 30008 @err \t  -- THROW 30008, @err, 1 \t  RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)       return 0    end     if (upper(@update) = 'T')    begin       update system_id set last_used_id = @last_used_id          where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)        if (@@error != 0)       begin          set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id updating object ' + @object_id          if (@tran = 0)             rollback transaction;          -- raiserror 30009 @err \t\t -- THROW 30009, @err, 1 \t\t RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)          return 0       end        if (@tran = 0)          commit transaction    end    else    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     return coalesce (@last_used_id, 0) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@object_id varchar, @update char)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_task_seq \t@schedule_id \tint as \tdeclare @ret_val int \tselect top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq \t\tfrom task t, event_schedule es \t\twhere t.event_id = es.event_id \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq \t\t\t\tand es.schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\torder by t.task_seq asc  \tif @ret_val is null \tbegin \t\tset @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 \tend  \treturn @ret_val ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_task_seq_copy", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_task_seq_copy @event_id bigint, @cond_seq int as declare @ret_val int  \tselect top 1 @ret_val = task_seq from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq  order by  task_seq desc  \tif @ret_val is null \tbegin \t\tset @ret_val = -1 \tend  \tset @ret_val = @ret_val +1  \treturn @ret_val ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id bigint, @cond_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_node_type", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_node_type    @computer_id int as    declare @ret smallint     -- just return the node type for this computer    select @ret = node_type from computer where computer_id = @computer_id     return @ret ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_platform_for_bootoption_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_platform_for_bootoption_id    @bootopt_id  int as \tdeclare @bootopt_type int  \tif (@bootopt_id = 1 or @bootopt_id is null) \tbegin \t\tselect @bootopt_id = default_boot_option from database_info \tend  \tselect @bootopt_type = bootoption_type from boot_options where bootoption_id = @bootopt_id  \treturn @bootopt_type ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@bootopt_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_pxe_computerid", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sel_pxe_computerid] \t@uuid varchar(64), \t@macid varchar(36), \t@serial varchar(80), \t@ip varchar(16) AS BEGIN \t--SELECT computer_id FROM computer a \t--WHERE \t \t--\ta.serial_num like @serial or  \t--\ta.uuid = @uuid and \t\t \t--\ta.computer_id in  \t--\t\t( select b.computer_id from nics b  \t--\t\twhere b.mac_addr = @macid) or \t--\ta.computer_id in \t--\t\t( select c.id from nic_interface c \t--\t\twhere c.ip like @ip )      SELECT top 1 computer_id FROM nics WHERE mac_addr = @macid  END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@uuid varchar, @macid varchar, @serial varchar, @ip varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_pxe_machine_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure sel_pxe_machine_status    @start_time   datetime,    @computer_id  int = 0 as    if (@computer_id != 0)    begin       exec upd_next_task_seq @start_time \t\tselect c.serial_num, c.asset_tag, c.uuid, n.mac_addr, coalesce ( \t\t        (select 'Automation' from event_schedule es \t\t         \twhere es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id \t\t            and (es.event_id in (select it.event_id from image_task it \t\t                                 where it.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and it.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and it.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from registry_task rt \t\t                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from unattended_install_task rt \t\t                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t            or es.event_id in (select st.event_id from script_task st \t\t                                 where st.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and st.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and st.task_seq = es.next_task_seq \t\t                                    and st.execution_mode = 0) \t\t\t\t\tor es.event_id in (select w.event_id from wait_task w \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t where w.event_id = es.event_id \t\t\t\t\t                        and w.cond_seq = es.cond_seq                                             and w.task_seq = es.next_task_seq))), \t         (select 'Reboot' from event_schedule es \t            where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id \t               and (es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from reboot_task rt \t                                    where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t                                       and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t                                       and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t\t\t   or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from config_task rt \t                                    where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t                                       and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t                                       and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq))), \t\t         'Production') as 'boot', 0 as 'count', {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    declare @tmprowscount   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction      \t\tselect @tmprowscount = count(event_id) from copyfile_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from script_task where   username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(distinct event_id) from install_task where (username = @username and password = @oldpassword) or \t\t   (exec_username = @username and exec_password = @oldpassword)  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from capture_pct_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_task_scheduled", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure sel_task_scheduled    @computer_id   int as    declare @tsk_type as int     select @tsk_type = task_type from task ts, event_schedule es where es.event_id = ts.event_id \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.cond_seq = ts.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = ts.task_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.status_code = -1 \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.computer_id = @computer_id  return @tsk_type ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_tc_job_tree", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_tc_job_tree    @SoftwarePackages varchar(50),    @nFolderIcon int,    @nBaseIcon int as \tdeclare @software_packages_folder_id int  \tdeclare @job_folder table \t(\t \t\tfolder_id int \t)  \t--Make sure we have a Software Packages folder under Thin Client System folder \tselect @software_packages_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder  \t\twhere parent_id = 1000009 and name = @SoftwarePackages \tif @software_packages_folder_id is null \tbegin \t\texec @software_packages_folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID' \t\tinsert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, name) values (@software_packages_folder_id, 1000009, @SoftwarePackages) \tend  \tdeclare @tmp_folder_id int \tdeclare folder_cursor cursor for select folder_id from @job_folder  \tinsert into @job_folder (folder_id) values (@software_packages_folder_id)  \topen folder_cursor \tfetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id  \tselect @tmp_folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  \twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \tbegin \t\t--add any subfolders \t\tinsert into @job_folder (folder_id) select ef.folder_id from event_folder ef where ef.parent_id = @tmp_folder_id\t\t \t\tfetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id \tend  \tclose folder_cursor \tdeallocate folder_cursor  \tdelete from @job_folder where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  \t--Get the imediate child folders of @software_packages_folder_id    select       folder_id,       null,        200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union \t--Get the sub folders of @software_packages_folder_id's children folders    select       folder_id,       parent_id,       200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    union \t--Get immediate child jobs of @software_packages_folder_id    select\t       event_id,       null,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union \t--Get jobs from @software_packages_folder_id's child folders    select       event_id,       folder_id,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    order by 2, 6, 5, 1 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@SoftwarePackages varchar, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_unattend_task_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_unattend_task_data     @event_id int,     @cond_seq int,     @task_seq int as    select t3.active, t3.value, t3.value_id, t3.vars_id, t3.vars_name, t3.type, t1.unattend_section_id as section_id,          t1.name as section_name, t3.unattend_id   from unattended_install_task t2, unattend_section t1   left join (select t1.event_id as [event_id], t1.cond_seq as [cond_seq], t1.task_seq as [task_seq], t1.active as [active],                     t1.unattend_vars_value as [value], t1.unattend_vars_value_id as [value_id],                     t2.unattend_vars_id as [vars_id], t2.name as [vars_name], t2.type as [type],                     t1.unattend_txt_data_id as [unattend_id], t3.unattend_section_id as section_id              from unattend_txt_data t1, unattend_vars t2, unattend_section t3, unattend_vars_value t4              where t1.unattend_vars_value_id = t4.unattend_vars_value_id and t4.unattend_vars_id = t2.unattend_vars_id and                    t2.unattend_section_id = t3.unattend_section_id) t3   on t3.section_id=t1.unattend_section_id and t3.event_id=@event_id and t3.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t3.task_seq=@task_seq   where t1.unattend_setup_id=t2.unattend_setup_id and t2.event_id=@event_id and t2.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t2.task_seq=@task_seq order by t1.unattend_section_id   ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_wol_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_wol_computer    @computer_id      int,    @wol_support      int = null as  if (@wol_support is null or @wol_support = '')       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id    else       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.wol_support = 1                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @wol_support int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_computer_ip_mac_addr", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_computer_ip_mac_addr    @computer_id         int,    @ip_addr             varchar (512),    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @nic_id              int = 0 as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = @nic_id     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, ip) values (@computer_id, @nic_id, @ip_addr)    else    begin      if (@ip_addr is not null) \t\tupdate nic_interface set ip = @ip_addr where interface_id = @interface_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @ip_addr varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @nic_id int)"}
