{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_computer_nic_pci", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure [dbo].[upd_computer_nic_pci] @PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar(128) as declare @nNicId int declare @nConfigItemId int begin transaction  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  \tand nic_pci_bus = @PciBus     and nic_pci_device = @PciDevice     and nic_pci_function = @PciFunction \tand mac_addr = @strMacaddr \t  if(@nNicId is not NULL) begin \tcommit transaction \treturn end  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  \tand nic_pci_bus is NULL      and nic_pci_device is NULL     and nic_pci_function is NULL   if(@nNicId is NULL) begin \tcommit transaction \treturn end  if exists (select n.computer_id from nics n where n.mac_addr = @strMacaddr) \t\tupdate nics set mac_addr = null where mac_addr = @strMacaddr  update nics set nic_pci_device = @PciDevice, \t\t\t\tnic_pci_bus = @PciBus, \t\t\t\tnic_pci_function = @PciFunction, \t\t\t\tmac_addr = @strMacaddr where nic_id = @nNicId and computer_id = @computer_id  if (@@error != 0) \t\trollback transaction \telse \t\tcommit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_deferred_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_deferred_schedule \t@schedule_id int, \t@start_time datetime, \t@current_time datetime, \t@status varchar( 256 ), \t@status_module smallint as     declare @comp_id int  \t-- make sure the schedule is valid \tselect @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id \tif( @comp_id is null ) \tbegin \t   return \tend  \tbegin transaction  \t-- update the event schedule table \tupdate event_schedule \t\tset status_code = null, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \t\t\tstart_time = @start_time, status = @status \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t-- now insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, -1, -1, @status_module  \t-- erase old wol info \texec upd_computer_wol_info @comp_id, null  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tcommit transaction \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_cond_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_cond_seq    @schedule_id   int,    @cond_seq      int,    @status_code   int = NULL,    @status        varchar (254) = NULL,    @exit_code     int = NULL,    @exit_module   smallint = NULL as \tif (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) \t\tset @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is NULL and @status_code is NULL)       update event_schedule set cond_seq = @cond_seq where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else    begin       update event_schedule \t\tset cond_seq = @cond_seq, status_code = @status_code, \t\t\tstatus = @status, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @cond_seq int, @status_code int, @status varchar, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_config_choice", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_config_choice    @schedule_id      int,    @config_choice_id int = null,    @status_code      int = null,    @status           varchar(254) = null as    begin transaction     if (@config_choice_id = 0)    begin       declare @comp_id int \t  select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id       update computer set domain_name = 'WORKGROUP', domain_member = 0 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  if exists (select 1 from nics where computer_id = @comp_id and nic_id = 0) \t\tupdate nics set ip_use_dhcp = 1 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  else \t\tinsert nics (computer_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp) values (@comp_id, 0, 1)    end     if (@status_code is NULL and @status is NULL)    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id,              status_code = @status_code,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @config_choice_id int, @status_code int, @status varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_init_deploy", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_init_deploy    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    begin transaction     update event_schedule set start_time = @start_time       where event_id = @event_id          and next_task_seq > -1          and status_code is null \t\t and cond_seq is null \t\t and initial_deployment = 1     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @start_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq    @schedule_id      int,    @next_task_seq    int,    @status_code      smallint,    @exit_code        int,    @exit_module      smallint,    @status           varchar(254),    @current_time     datetime,    @module           smallint,    @level            smallint,    @taskresult       int as begin     if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0)         set @status_code = 1      declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount      if( 0 = @tran )         begin transaction  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int     SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id      IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL AND @status_code IS NULL AND @status = 'Error ' + LTRIM(@exit_code) + ' during script execution')     BEGIN         DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @dependent_id          SELECT @status = 'Scheduled Job [' + @eventname + '] Due To Return Code Handler: ' + LTRIM(@exit_code)     END      -- update status_log table with schedule info     exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level, @taskresult      -- now insert and fix up history for this item     exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id      -- now update the event_schedule table     update event_schedule         set next_task_seq = @next_task_seq,         status = @status,         status_code = @status_code,         exit_code = @exit_code,         exit_module = @exit_module,         config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null }     where schedule_id = @schedule_id      if( 0 = @tran )     begin         if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction         else             commit transaction     end end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @next_task_seq int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @taskresult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_status    @schedule_id   int,    @status_code   smallint,    @exit_code\t   int,    @exit_module   smallint,    @status        varchar(254),    @broker_time   datetime,    @module        smallint,    @level         smallint,    @log_event     smallint = 0 as    declare @upd_status_code smallint     -- we need to remember the status code that was passed in, but if it's null,    -- we want to get the status code that is currently in the event schedule.    set @upd_status_code = @status_code     if (@upd_status_code is null and @log_event = 1)       select @upd_status_code = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     if (@exit_code is not null ) and ( @exit_code != 0 ) and ( @status_code is not null ) and       ( @status_code > 0 )    begin       set @status_code = 1    end     begin transaction     if (@broker_time is null)    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status,             broker_time = @broker_time          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t--LB#40844        if( @status_code >= 0 )       \t begin      \t\texec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@broker_time        \tend    end     -- use the passed in status code for this function, unlike above where we use our    -- adjusted @use_status_code var.  This is so we can save exit_codes without    -- killing the status_code in the event schedule table.    exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @broker_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @broker_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @log_event smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_status    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36),    @schedule_id   int,    @task_seq      int,    @status        varchar(254),    @status_code   int as    if (@status is null and @status_code is null)       return     begin transaction     if (@status_code is not null and @status is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code,             status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else if (@status_code is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else       update event_schedule          set status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq     if (@@error = 0)       commit transaction    else       rollback transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @status varchar, @status_code int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghostcast_setting", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghostcast_setting]    @event_id\tint,    @ghostcast_setting varchar(10) as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     set @ghostcast_setting = ' ' + @ghostcast_setting     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task set ghcastsrv_cmdline =  \t  case   when CHARINDEX(' -N',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -N%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -T',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -T%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -O',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -O%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)           END \t  where event_id = @event_id and ghcastsrv_cmdline is not NULL             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @ghostcast_setting varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128),    @newpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction  \t\tupdate    copyfile_task \t\tset       password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    script_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          exec_password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (exec_username) = lower (@username)) and (exec_password = @oldpassword) \t\t--the install_task.username and install_task.exec_username appear to always be the same so do not add to the count set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    capture_pct_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar, @newpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_unattend_var", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure upd_unattend_var     @var_id int,     @default_val int,     @var_name varchar(254),     @var_desc varchar(254),     @var_type smallint,     @val_value varchar(256),     @val_displayed varchar(256) as     declare @old_type int      begin transaction      select @old_type=[type] from unattend_vars where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      update unattend_vars set [name]=@var_name, [description]=@var_desc, [type]=@var_type                        where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      if(@old_type = 0 and @var_type != 0)     begin       delete from unattend_vars_value where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and unattend_vars_value_id <> @default_val     end      if(@var_type != 0)     begin       update unattend_vars_value set [value]=@val_value, name_displayed=@val_displayed                       where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val     end      if(@var_type = 0)     begin       set @default_val=NULL        select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                       where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value] like @val_value        update unattend_vars_value set [default]=0 where unattend_vars_id=@var_id        if (@default_val is null)       begin         insert into unattend_vars_value(unattend_vars_id, [value], name_displayed, [default])                     values(@var_id, @val_value, @val_displayed, 1)          select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                     where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value]=@val_value       end       else       begin         update unattend_vars_value set [default]=1 where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val       end     end      select @default_val as [val_id], @var_id as [var_id]      commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@var_id int, @default_val int, @var_name varchar, @var_desc varchar, @var_type smallint, @val_value varchar, @val_displayed varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_condition_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_del_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item\t\t    int as    declare @minItem int    select @minItem = min(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    begin transaction       delete from condition_item  \t     where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item       if @minItem = @item       begin          select @item = min(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition          update condition_item set conjunct = -1 where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition             and item_seq = @item       end    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_config_event_for_live_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- this SP is added to fix bug #28880 create procedure wc_del_config_event_for_live_schedule    @jobId         int as    begin transaction     declare @cnt int    declare @reConfig smallint    declare @useExisting smallint     select @reConfig=ct.reconfig ,@useExisting=cs.use_existing_data     from config_set cs join config_task ct on ct.config_set_id = cs.config_set_id     where ct.event_id = @jobId     -- delete only if it is live job     if(@reConfig=1) and (@useExisting=1)    begin \t-- delete if this is scheduled on this computer only  \tselect @cnt=count(target_computer_id)  \tfrom config_item ci join config_task ct on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id  \twhere ct.event_id = @jobId         -- if no schedule on this job then delete this         if (@cnt=0) \t     exec del_event @jobId    end  \t    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_dnsSuffix", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_del_dnsSuffix    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null      as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- delete the dns_suffix data       begin transaction        \t    delete dns_suffix where [id] = @configSetId                       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction       end       else          commit transaction    end  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_dnsSuffixItem", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix create procedure wc_del_dnsSuffixItem    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint  as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this dns_suffix    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task   -- declare @config_set_id int   -- select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task      --  where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task    --declare @config_item_id int    --select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id     --  and target_computer_id = @computer     if @config_item_id is not null    begin       -- delete the dns_suffix records of configItemId       begin transaction         delete dns_suffix where [id] = @config_item_id              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_static_routes_config_items", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing  create procedure wc_del_static_routes_config_items    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint  as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this config_static_route_item    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @config_item_id is not null    begin        -- delete the static routing records of configItemId       begin transaction         delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_generate_first_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_generate_first_computer_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64) output as    -- get the name range data from the config_set record    declare @method smallint, @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @method = cname_method, @fixed = cname_fixed, @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append,       @numbers = cname_numbers from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       if @numbers = 1 -- numeric portion       begin          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))          else             set @name = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed       end       else -- alpha portion       begin          -- convert number to ascii character values          declare @alpha varchar(64)          set @alpha = ''          while @addl >= 0          begin                         declare @dval smallint             set @dval = @addl % 26             set @addl = @addl / 26             set @alpha = @alpha + char(@dval + 97)             set @addl = @addl - 1          end          -- reverse the character order to form the final string          set @alpha = reverse(@alpha)          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + @alpha          else             set @name = @alpha + @fixed       end    end    else       set @name = null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_have_computer_for_vm", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_have_computer_for_vm    @vm_uuid varchar(128),    @host_uuid varchar(128),    @vc_computer varchar(256) as    declare @vm_comp_id int        select @vm_comp_id = computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)        if @vm_comp_id is not null    begin       update computer set virtual_machine_host_group_id =           (select virtual_machine_host_group_id from virtual_machine_host_group where computer = @vc_computer),          virtual_machine_host_id = (select computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@host_uuid))          where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)                 select 1    end    else    begin       select 0    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@vm_uuid varchar, @host_uuid varchar, @vc_computer varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_ip    @ip varchar(16),    @ip_out varchar(16) output as    -- break the IP address into integer octet values    declare @octet1 int, @octet2 int, @octet3 int, @octet4 int    declare @dot_index1 int, @dot_index2 int    select @dot_index1 = charindex('.', @ip)    set @octet1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @dot_index1 - 1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index1 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet2 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet3 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = len(@ip)    set @octet4 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - (@dot_index1 - 1)) as int)     -- increment octet values as needed to increment the ip    if @octet4 < 255       set @octet4 = @octet4 + 1    else    begin       set @octet4 = 1       if @octet3 < 255          set @octet3 = @octet3 + 1       else       begin          set @octet3 = 0          if @octet2 < 255             set @octet2 = @octet2 + 1          else          begin             set @octet2 = 0             if @octet1 < 255                set @octet1 = @octet1 + 1             else             begin                set @octet1 = 1                set @octet2 = 1                set @octet3 = 1                set @octet4 = 1             end          end       end    end     set @ip_out = cast(@octet1 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet2 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet3 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet4 as varchar(3)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ip varchar, @ip_out varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64),    @name_out varchar(64) output as    -- Get the name range information from the config_set record    declare @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append, @numbers = cname_numbers,       @fixed = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id    if len(@name) = 0       exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @config_set_id, @name     -- Split the fixed and variable text in the @name passed in    declare @variable_text varchar(64)    declare @fixed_pos int    set @fixed_pos = charindex(@fixed, @name)    if @fixed_pos > 1 -- prefix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, 1, @fixed_pos - 1)    else -- postfix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, len(@fixed) + 1, len(@name) - len(@fixed))           -- Increment the @variable_text    if @numbers = 1    begin       -- numeric variable       set @addl = cast(@variable_text as smallint) + 1       if @append = 1          set @name_out = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))       else          set @name_out = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed    end    else    begin       -- alpha variable       -- test for all Z characters       set @variable_text = upper(@variable_text)       declare @z_count int, @z_loc int       set @z_loc = 0       set @z_count = 0       set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text)       while @z_loc > 0       begin          set @z_count = @z_count + 1          set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text, @z_loc + 1)       end       if len(@variable_text) = @z_count       begin          -- reset to all A characters and add A to the end          set @name_out = replace(@variable_text, 'Z', 'A')          set @name_out = @variable_text + 'A'       end       else       begin          -- advance all needed characters          declare @addl_out varchar(64)          set @addl_out = ''                    declare @char int          declare @increment_done smallint          set @increment_done = 0          while len(@variable_text) > 0          begin             set @char = ascii(substring(@variable_text, len(@variable_text), 1))             if @increment_done = 0             begin                if @char = 90                   set @char = 65                else                begin                   set @char = @char + 1                   set @increment_done = 1                end             end              set @addl_out = @addl_out + char(@char)              if len(@variable_text) > 1                set @variable_text = substring(@variable_text, 1, len(@variable_text) - 1)             else                set @variable_text = ''          end          set @addl_out = reverse(@addl_out)          if @append = 1             set @name_out = @fixed + @addl_out          else             set @name_out = @addl_out + @fixed       end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar, @name_out varchar OUT)"}

select @manuf = manuf_rack from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e        where e.enclosure_id = @enclosure and e.rack_id = r.rack_id    declare @recordsAdded int     if @enclosureId is not null declare @single int       set @single = @bayIdx       if @bayIdx is null          select @bayIdx = max(idx) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @missingBay smallint {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS setting for nic    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- get the highest nic_id from existing nic_config_item records    declare @maxNicId int    select @maxNicId = max(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId     -- test for valid records    declare @nicId int    set @nicId = @maxNicId    if @configItemId is not null and @maxNicId is not null    begin       -- generate the generic NIC description       set @nicId = @nicId + 2       declare @nicDesc varchar(64)       set @nicDesc = 'Network Adapter ' + cast(@nicId as varchar)        -- insert the new nic_config_item record       begin transaction          insert into nic_config_item (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, ip_domain, ip_dns,              ip_wins, nic_desc, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp) values (@configItemId, @nicId, @ipMethod, @domainSuffix, @dns,             @wins, @nicDesc, @netbios, @dns_use_dhcp, @wins_use_dhcp)              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end        -- return the new nic_id or -1 on error    select @nicId as nic_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- give unnamed intefaces a default name    if @name is null    begin       declare @maxInterface varchar(64)       select @maxInterface = max([name]) from nic_interface where [id] = @id and          nic_id = @nicId       declare @colonIndex int       select @colonIndex = charindex(@maxInterface, ':')       if @colonIndex > 0       begin          declare @numLen int          select @numLen = len(@maxInterface) - @colonIndex          declare @num varchar(7)          set @colonIndex = @colonIndex + 1          select @num = substring(@maxInterface, @colonIndex, @numLen)          declare @interfaceNum int          set @interfaceNum = cast(@num as int)          if @interfaceNum is null             set @interfaceNum = 0          else             set @interfaceNum = @interfaceNum + 1          set @name = 'eth' + cast(@nicId as varchar) + ':' + cast(@interfaceNum as varchar)       end    end     -- check for duplicate IP Interface name    declare @nameMatch varchar(64)    select @nameMatch = [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId       and [name] like @name    if @nameMatch is null    begin       -- add the IP interface       begin transaction          insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway,              broadcast, state) values (@id, @nicId, @name, @ip, @netmask,              @gateway, @broadcast, @state)       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_set_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_set_interface    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @nicId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface            select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- give unnamed intefaces a default name    if @name is null    begin       declare @maxInterface varchar(64)       select @maxInterface = max([name]) from nic_interface where [id] = @id and          nic_id = @nicId       declare @colonIndex int       select @colonIndex = charindex(@maxInterface, ':')       if @colonIndex > 0       begin          declare @numLen int          select @numLen = len(@maxInterface) - {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_pct_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder with level as 1 in temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder with level = level + 1 and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table \tFind max level value which will be max depth for given folder */  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x  @folder_id as int  as  --This SP is same as wc_sel_child_folder_depth but for import where tables are different.  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from x_event_folder where parent_id =@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom x_event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folders", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folders \t@parent_id int as \tif @parent_id = -10 \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id is null \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id = @parent_id \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@parent_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_comp_listview", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_comp_listview \t@id int as \tif @id = -1 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id is null and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse if @id between 5000001 and 8000000 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere computer_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse \tbegin\t \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)  \texec('create table dbo.'+@branch_tablename+ \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(64), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))') \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \tif @id >= 5000001 and @id <= 8000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the computer node \t\t--exec('insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer where computer_id =' +@id) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from computer where computer_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t-- Get the group_id \t\tselect @id = group_id from computer where computer_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get groups down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -1 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the group node \t\t--insert into ##wc_branch (name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, group_id as id, 'group' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer_group where group_id = @id \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) select name, group_id as id, ''group'' as type from computer_group where group_id = @intid'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Computers'', -1, ''group'')')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResults = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_configuration", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_configuration \t@job\t\t\tint, \t@condition\t\tint, \t@task\t\t\tint, \t@computer\t\tint as \tdeclare @configSetId int \tselect @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \t\twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task \tdeclare @configItemId int \tselect @configItemId = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @configSetId \t\tand target_computer_id = @computer  \tselect * from config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId         -- Changed for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & 7.1.53 DNS Suffix         select * from dns_suffix where [id] = @configItemId         select * from config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @configItemId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_name    @id int as    --select computer_id as [id], [name], 'Computer' as type from computer where computer_id = @id    -- Bug #41543 - Rilo controls are missing from the all computers view in the web console     select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c \tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \twhere c.computer_id = @id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_permissions", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of permissions for the given user and object create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_permissions    @userId int,    @objectId int as    declare @permission int     --create temp table    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_permissions') is not null       drop table ##wc_last_effective_permissions    create table dbo.##wc_last_effective_permissions (permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)        --get permissions that apply to the object    if @objectId = 2000001 --init_deploy       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where initial_deployment = 1    else if (@objectId >= 1 and @objectId < 1000001) or @objectId = -1 --comp_group, ALL_COMPUTERS       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer_group = 1    else if @objectId = -7 --new_comp_group       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where new_computer_group = 1    else if @objectId >= 5000001 and @objectId <= 8000000 --comp       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer = 1    else if (@objectId >= 11000001 and @objectId < 14000001) or @objectId = -9 --physical_device       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where physical_device = 1    else if @objectId >= 1000001 and @objectId < 2000001 or @objectId = -10 --event_folder       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event_folder = 1    else if @objectId > 2000001 and @objectId < 3000001 --event       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event = 1    else       goto DONE        declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @permissionType varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0      select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights     open permissions_cursor    fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each permission       if @isAdmin > 0 --@isAdmin = 1 When user has admin rights and gets admin rights from one or more admin groups.       begin          select @permissionType = [name] from securitypermission where permission_id = @permission          insert into ##wc_last_effective_permissions values (@permission, 1, @permissionType, @fromAdmin, @permSource,'Administrative Rights', 'Administrative Group',0, @fromGroup)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_permission @userId, @permission, @objectId, 0        fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission    end          -- cleanup cursor    close permissions_cursor    deallocate permissions_cursor     DONE:  --select temp table     select * from ##wc_last_effective_permissions ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @objectId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_rights", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of rights for the user create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_rights     @userId int, \t@tableName varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights' as    declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @rightName varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once    -- Bug #63690     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0,@tableName      --select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights    declare\t@sql    nvarchar(512), \t\t\t@params nvarchar(512) \t\t\t \tset @sql = 'select @SqlisAdmin = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource, @SqlfromGroup = fromGroup from '+@tableName \t \tset @params = N'@SqlisAdmin int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromAdmin smallint OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlpermSource int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromGroup int OUTPUT' \t\t\t\t \texec sp_executesql @sql,@params,@SqlisAdmin=@isAdmin output, @SqlfromAdmin = @fromAdmin output, @SqlpermSource=@permSource output, @SqlfromGroup=@fromGroup output      --make sure temp table is empty    -- Bug #63690    --if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is not null    --   delete from ##wc_last_effective_rights    if object_id(''+@tableName+'') is not null \texec('delete from '+@tableName)        declare rights_cursor cursor for          select privilege_id, [name]          from securityprivilege     open rights_cursor    fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each right       if @isAdmin = 1       begin          select @rightName = [name] from securityprivilege where privilege_id = @right          -- Bug #63690          --insert into ##wc_last_effective_rights values (@right, 1, @rightName, @fromAdmin, @permSource, @fromGroup)          declare @sqlQuery as varchar(128) \t\t set @sqlQuery = 'insert into '+ @tableName +' values ('+cast(@right as varchar(10))+',1,'''+@rightName+''','+cast(@fromAdmin as varchar(10))+','+cast(@permSource as varchar(10))+','+cast(@fromGroup as varchar(10))+')' \t\t exec (@sqlQuery)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_right @userId, @right, 0,@tableName        fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName    end          -- cleanup cursor    close rights_cursor    deallocate rights_cursor      --select temp table   -- Bug #63690    --select * from ##wc_last_effective_rights    exec ('select * from '+@tableName) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @tableName varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_enclosure_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_enclosure_children    @id int as    -- get computers in the bays in the enclosure passed in    -- Bug #41543    select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type,'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end        from physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id        where e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and e.enclosure_id = @id       and b.computer_id = c.computer_id and b.initial_event_id is null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task    @phrase varchar(128),    @task smallint,    @folderid int as \tif @folderid > -10 \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) -- Don't get Initial Deployment \t\t\tand a.folder_id = @folderid \telse \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@phrase varchar, @task smallint, @folderid int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(128),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subfolder table (for folder IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folders_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_folders_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_folders_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @id        -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end     -- loop through subfolders to gather all children job IDs    declare @subfolder int    select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    while @subfolder is not null    begin       -- get subfolders of this folder       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @subfolder       -- remove this folder from subfolder table       delete from #wc_folders_to_check where [id] = @subfolder       -- get jobs in this folder -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @subfolder       -- get the next subfolder       set @subfolder = null       select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id = @id       -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folderlevel", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.66 Copy job folder create procedure wc_sel_folderlevel  @folder_id int, @level int =1 as \tdeclare @parent_id int \tselect @parent_id=parent_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id \tif @parent_id is not null \tbegin \t\tset @level=@level+1 \t\texec wc_sel_folderlevel @parent_id, @level \tend \telse \t\tselect @level ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int, @level int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create  -- get the next subgroup       set @subgroup = null       select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer/group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state           from computer where group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer where group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_history", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- PRD item 7.1.46 Allow Administrator to Delete History create procedure dbo.wc_sel_history \t @computer_id \t\tint as \tselect  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id,s.complete_time, s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.user_log, l.user_name, h.app_id,ea.alias,ea.app_path,ea.description, \tconvert(varchar(30),s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time  --Bug #33984 \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id              left outer  join  loggedon_users l on \t\t  s.system_logon_user_id = l.user_id \tleft join external_application ea  \t\ton h.app_id=ea.app_id \t  \twhere (s.status_code is not null)  and    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id)  \torder by h.history_id desc  select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id, h.task_type, h.complete_time, s.[module], s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.status_code, s.status, s.complete_time,s.level,s.return_code_result, \tconvert(varchar(30), s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time, --Bug #33984 \txml_task \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id \twhere    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id ) and h.history_id in (select history_id from status_log_view where status_code is not null)  --Bug #33984 \torder by h.complete_time desc ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename) \t\t \texec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename + \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(128), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))')  \tif @id >= 2000001 and @id <= 3000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the job node \t\tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \t\tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event where event_id = @intid'  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int' \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id  \t\t \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event where event_id ='+ @intid)  \t\t-- Get the folder_id \t\tselect @id = folder_id from event where event_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get folders down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -10 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the folder node \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event_folder where folder_id = @intid';  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid=@id ; \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event_folder where folder_id =' + @id) \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Jobs'', -10, ''folder'')')\t-- Return the completed branch list  \tif @selectResults = 1 \t\texec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_license_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_license_info as    --select * from license_info    --Bug #28067    \tselect remain_days, total_days,serial_number, server as totalserver, client as totalclient, pda as totalpda, nodes as totalnodes  from license_info \t \t--1 \tselect count (computer_id) as server from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 1 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--2 \tselect count (computer_id) as client from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 3 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--3 \tselect count (computer_id) as pda from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 2 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--7 total \tselect count (computer_id) as nodes from computer  where limited_license = 0 and  \tcomputer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_physical_device_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_physical_device_children    @id int -- this param is for compatability and is not used in the procedure as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_physical_device_children') is not null       drop table #wc_physical_device_children    create table dbo.#wc_physical_device_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543     -- iterate through all of the racks    declare @rackId int    declare rack_cursor cursor for       select rack_id from physical_rack    open rack_cursor    fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- get computers in the bays in the enclosures in this rack       -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_physical_device_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)             select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end              from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id              where r.rack_id = e.rack_id and r.rack_id = @rackId              and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and b.computer_id = c.computer_id              and b.initial_event_id is null       -- get next rack ID       fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    end    -- cleanup cursor    close rack_cursor    deallocate rack_cursor     select * from #wc_physical_device_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_reb_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_reb_branch    @id int,    @selectResult int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))    if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null       exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)     exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename +       '([level] int IDENTITY,        [name] varchar(64),        [id] int NOT NULL,        type varchar(20))')  \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500)    -- If node is a Bay    if @id >= 13000001 and @id <= 14000000    begin       -- Get the bay node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)          -- select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type         -- from physical_bay where bay_id = @id') \t\t \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_bay where bay_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ;        -- Get the enclosure_id       select @id = enclosure_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @id    end\t     -- If node is an Enclosure    if @id >= 12000001 and @id <= 13000000    begin       -- Get the enclosure node      -- exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)         -- select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type         -- from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id') \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t       -- Get the rack_id       select @id = rack_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id    end     -- If node is a Rack    if @id >= 11000001 and @id <= 12000000    begin       -- Get the rack node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename +'([name], [id], type)        --  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type        --  from physical_rack where rack_id = @id')  \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_rack where rack_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t    end     -- Add Physical Devices node    --insert into @branch_tablename ([name], [id], type)      -- select 'Physical Devices' as [name], -9 as [id], 'physical devices' as type \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)       select ''Physical Devices'' as [name], -9 as [id], ''physical devices'' as type')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResult = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + 'order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_required_domains", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_required_domains  \t@jobids    varchar(8000), \t@compids    varchar(8000)  as \t--Query on config_set and Config_item table to fetch all required domains. \tselect lower(msnet_domain_name) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_domain_name is not null and msnet_domain_name <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_dns_domain is not null and msnet_dns_domain <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \tunion \tselect lower(domain_name) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere (msnet_dns_domain is null or msnet_dns_domain='')  \t\tand config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \t \t--Query to check whether we should check for computer domain information \t-- IF count is > 0  then check for computer domains as well \tselect count(*) from config_set, config_task  \twhere \tconfig_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_set.config_set_id \t\tand ((use_existing_data=1 and msnet_is_domain_member is null) or (msnet_is_domain_member=1 and ((msnet_domain_name ='' or msnet_domain_name is null) and ( msnet_dns_domain ='' or msnet_dns_domain is null) )) or (use_existing_data=1 and reconfig=1))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar, @compids varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_codes", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_codes    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    \tint as    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_return_code') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_return_code  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_return_code \t\t(code\t\tvarchar(11), \t\t handler\t\tint, \t\t result \t\tint, \t\t status   varchar(256))  \t-- store the default handler \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect 'default' as code, on_fail as handler, on_fail as result, null as status \t\tfrom task where event_id=@jobId and   \t\tcond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq  \t-- get the rest of the handlers \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect ret_code as code, handler, result, status from task_return_handlers \t\twhere event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and\ttask_seq=@taskSeq  \tselect * from ##wc_return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_handler_jobs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_handler_jobs    @jobId int as    -- make a temporary table to store the IDs in    if object_id ('#wc_handler_ids') is null       create table dbo.#wc_handler_ids (job int, primary key (job))    -- store the calling job    insert into #wc_handler_ids values (@jobId)     -- declare needed variables    declare @newJobCount int    declare @handler int    declare @job int    declare @fail int     -- loop through all discovered jobs repeatedly until no new linked jobs are found    set @newJobCount = 1    while @newJobCount > 0    begin       set @newJobCount = 0       -- make a cursor to step through all discovered jobs       declare job_cursor cursor for          select job from #wc_handler_ids       open job_cursor       fetch next from job_cursor into @job       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          -- loop through the linked jobs          -- make a cursor to step through all linked task_return_handlers jobs          declare handler_cursor cursor for             select distinct(handler) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @job                and handler > 2000000 and handler < 3000001 and handler not in --Bug 27827                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open handler_cursor          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@handler)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          end          -- cleanup cursor          close handler_cursor          deallocate handler_cursor           -- make a cursor to step through all linked on_fail jobs          declare fail_cursor cursor for             select distinct(on_fail) from task where event_id = @job                and on_fail > 2000000 and on_fail < 3000001 and event_id not in                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open fail_cursor          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@fail)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          end          -- cleanup cursor          close fail_cursor          deallocate fail_cursor                  fetch next from job_cursor into @job       end       -- cleanup cursor       close job_cursor       deallocate job_cursor    end     -- return the list of jobs discovered    select job from #wc_handler_ids    drop table #wc_handler_ids ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}
