{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_schedule1", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_schedule1 \t@schedule int as \tdeclare @user int \tselect @user = su.[user_id] from securityuser su, event_schedule es  \twhere es.schedule_id = @schedule and es.[user_id] = su.[user_id]  \tif @user is null \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\t'gznFiP' as 'user_name', 'gznFiP' as user_full_name, '' as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\tu.[name] as 'user_name', u.fullname as user_full_name, u.domain as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e, securityuser u \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \t\t\tand u.[user_id] = s.[user_id] \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_security_authenticate", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_authenticate \t@username \t\tvarchar(64), \t@password\t\tvarchar(64), \t@domain\t\t\tvarchar(50) = null, \t@upnname\t\tvarchar(128) = null as \tdeclare @authenticated tinyint \tset @authenticated = 0 \t \tdeclare @matchUser\tvarchar(64)         declare @matchUPN\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchPwd\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchNetdom    varchar(64) \tdeclare @userId\tint \tdeclare @ad_user smallint  \tif @domain is not null and len(@domain) > 0 \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for  \t\t\tselect [name], upnname, domain, netbiosdomain, [user_id]  \t\t\tfrom securityuser \t\t\twhere (deleted is null or deleted=0) --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\t\t\t\t\t \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif (@matchUser = @username or @matchUPN = @upnname) and (upper(@domain) = upper(@matchPwd) or upper(@matchNetdom) = upper(@domain)) -- @matchPwd is the domain name \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for select [name], [password], [user_id], ad_user from securityuser  where deleted is null or deleted=0  --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif @matchUser = @username and @matchPwd = @password and @ad_user = 0 \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \t \tif @authenticated = 1 and len(@domain) > 0 \t\tset @authenticated = 2 \telse  \t\tset @matchUser = @username --Bug #39428  \tselect @authenticated as authenticated, @userId as [user_id], @matchUser as securityuser ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar, @domain varchar, @upnname varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_tasktype", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_tasktype \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder  temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table\t */  declare @tbl_folder table (\tfolder_id int\t )   insert into @tbl_folder select folder_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id \tfrom @tbl_folder  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder \tselect folder_id \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select count(t.folder_id),count(e.event_id) from @tbl_folder t,event e where e.folder_id = t.folder_id select distinct task_type from task where task_type not in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder)) select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type from task where task_type in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_taskusers_count", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.14 Centrally Managed Task Password create procedure wc_sel_taskusers_count @username varchar(128), @password varchar(128) as  declare @totalRecordCount  int declare @taskRecordCount  int  set @totalRecordCount = 0 set @taskRecordCount = 0  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from script_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from copyfile_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from install_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from capture_pct_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select @totalRecordCount ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- #32375 - Select all handheld unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld as \tif object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_handleld') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld \t\t(event_id\tint)  \tinsert into ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld \t\t-- Registory task (13), Image task (15) and Capture PCT task (18) not allowed on pocket pc \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom task  \t\twhere task_type=13 or task_type=15 or task_type=18  \t\tunion \t\t-- For pocket pc execution location of script is allowed only on DS Side  \t\tselect distinct event_id  \t\tfrom script_task  \t\twhere (location != 1)   \t\tunion \t\t-- Only reboot is allowed on pocket pc (logoff, shutdown etc not allowed) \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom reboot_task  \t\twhere (reboot_method != 1) \t\t\t \tselect event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- #32375 - Select all linux unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux  as  \tif object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_linux') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux \t\t(event_id\tint)  \tinsert into ##wc_unsafe_job_linux \t\t-- Registory task (13) and Capture PCT task (18) are not allowed on linux \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom task  \t\twhere task_type=13 or task_type=18 \t\t \t\tunion \t\t-- Only Reboot, Shutdown, WakeUp is allowed on linux for reboot task \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom reboot_task  \t\twhere (reboot_method = 8)  \t\t\t \tselect event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_linux ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_computer_location", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_upd_computer_location    @computer_id   int,    @site          varchar(128),    @dept          varchar(128),    @mailstop      varchar(128),    @contact       varchar(128),    @email         varchar(128),    @phone         varchar(128) as    declare @compId int    select @compId = computer_id from location where computer_id=@computer_id      begin transaction    if @compId is null \tbegin  \t\tinsert into location (computer_id, site, dept, mailstop, contact,  \t\t\t\temail, phone) values (@computer_id,  @site, @dept, @mailstop, @contact, \t\t\t\t@email, @phone) \tend    else \tbegin \t\tupdate location set [site] = @site, [dept] = @dept, [mailstop] = @mailstop, \t\t\t[contact] = @contact, [email] = @email, [phone] = @phone \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \tend    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @site varchar, @dept varchar, @mailstop varchar, @contact varchar, @email varchar, @phone varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item\t\t\tint,    @field\t\t\tint,    @operation\t    int,    @value\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null,    @drive\t\t\tvarchar(8)   = null,    @conjunct\t    smallint     = -1,    @token\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null as    begin transaction        update condition_item set field_type = @field, oper_type = @operation, key_value = @value,           drive = @drive, conjunct = @conjunct, token = @token          where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint, @token varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,    @item1\t\tint,    @item2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId\t\t\tint,    @conditionId1\tint,    @conditionId2\tint as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@tempCondId \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as \tupdate config_item  \tset  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  \twhere Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) \tand config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  \t@itemId int as  \tdeclare @domain_name as varchar(512) \tdeclare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)\t  \t-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name \tselect    \t\t@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, \t\t@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))\t\t \t\twhen '' then domain_name \t\telse msnet_dns_domain \t\tend -- case \tfrom config_item  \twhere config_item_id=@itemId  \t-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it \tif @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 \tbegin \t\tselect @username=username, @password=[password]  \t\tfrom domain_accounts  \t\twhere domain=@domain_name\t\t \t \t\tupdate config_item  \t\tset  \t\tmsnet_domain_username=@username, \t\tmsnet_domain_password=@password \t\twhere config_item_id=@itemId \tend\t ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_from_comp", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_comp    @itemId      int,    @computerId  int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with computer record data    declare computer_cursor cursor for       select lic_os_user, lic_os_org, lic_os_key, ip_hostname, computer_name, domain_member,          domain_name, nw_pref_server, nw_pref_tree, nw_nds_context, nw_user_name, nw_login_to_tree,          nw_run_scripts, msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou       from computer where computer_id = @computerId    open computer_cursor    fetch next from computer_cursor       into @licOsUser, @licOsOrg, @licOsKey, @ipHostname, @computerName, @domainMember, @domainName,       @nwPrefServer, @nwPrefTree, @nwNdsContext, @nwUserName, @nwLoginToTree, @nwRunScripts,       @msnetDnsDomain, @msnetDomainOu     -- update the config_item table with the variable data    if @@fetch_status = 0    begin       update config_item set lic_os_user=@licOsUser, lic_os_org=@licOsOrg, lic_os_key=@licOsKey,          ip_hostname=@ipHostname, computer_name=@computerName, domain_member=@domainMember,          domain_name=@domainName, nw_pref_server=@nwPrefServer, nw_pref_tree=@nwPrefTree,          nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,          nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu,          target_computer_id=@computerId       where config_item_id=@itemId    end     -- cleanup cursor    close computer_cursor    deallocate computer_cursor     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Changes for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @deviceId int, @pciBus int, @pciDevice int, @pciFunction int, @vendorId int, @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @description varchar(64), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDHCP smallint, @winsDHCP smallint -- DNS/Wins DHCP for MSN    -- loop through each of the computer's nic records    declare nic_cursor cursor for       select ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device, nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id,           ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, nic_id, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp  from nics where computer_id=@computerId       order by nic_id    open nic_cursor    fetch next from nic_cursor       into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins,        @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP     -- update nic_config_item table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- make sure a nic_config_item record exists       declare @configItem int       select @configItem = count(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id=@itemId          and nic_id=@nicId       -- update existing record       if @configItem = 1       begin          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp=@useDhcp, nic_device_id=@deviceId, nic_pci_bus=@pciBus,             nic_pci_device=@pciDevice, nic_pci_function=@pciFunction, nic_vendor_id=@vendorId,             ip_dns=@ipDns, ip_wins=@ipWins, nic_desc=@description, ip_domain=@ipDomain, netbios=@netBIOS,             dns_use_dhcp = @dnsDHCP, wins_use_dhcp = @winsDHCP          where config_item_id=@itemId and nic_id=@nicId          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId                end       -- create new record       else       begin          insert into nic_config_item             (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device,              nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id, ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp)          values             (@itemId, @nicId, @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId,             @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP)          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId       end       fetch next from nic_cursor into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction,           @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP    end     -- cleanup    close nic_cursor    deallocate nic_cursor                 -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing    \t-- update existing record    \t-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    \t           delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @itemId           \t    \t-- create new records\t           \tinsert into config_static_route_item    \t\t\t      (config_item_id, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use])    \tselect    @itemId, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use]    \tfrom         static_routes where  computer_id = @computerId           -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix       \t-- update existing record    \t-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    \t    \tdelete dns_suffix where [id] = @itemId    \t-- create new records       \t    \tinsert into dns_suffix    \t\t\t      ([id], dns_suffix, [order])    \tselect    @itemId, dns_suffix, [order]    \tfrom      dns_suffix where [id] = @computerId  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @computerId int)"}

create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_set    @itemId      int,    @setId\t\tint as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64),  @uaMustChange smallint, @uaCannotChange smallint, @uaPwNeverExpires smallint,       @uaPrompt smallint     -- fill the variables with config_set record data    select @licOsUser = lic_os_user, nw_pref_server, @inwPrefTree = nw_pref_tree,        @inwNdsContext = nw_nds_context, @inwUserName = nw_user_name, @inwLoginToTree = nw_login_to_tree,       @inwRunScripts = nw_run_scripts, @iuaMustChange = ua_must_change, @iuaCannotChange = ua_cannot_change,        @iuaPwNeverExpires = ua_pw_never_expires, @iuaPrompt = ua_prompt       from config_item where config_item_id=@itemId         -- determine which fields to update    -- strings    if @computerName is null or len(@computerName) = 0       set @computerName = @icomputerName    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    if ((@domainName is null or len(@domainName) = 0) and (@msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0))    begin       set @domainName =     set @nwNdsContext = @inwNdsContext    if @licOsUser is null or len(@licOsUser) = 0       set @licOsUser = @ilicOsUser    if @licOsOrg is null or len(@licOsOrg) = 0       set @licOsOrg = @ilicOsOrg    if @licOsKey is null or len(@licOsKey) = 0       set @licOsKey = @ilicOsKey    if @ipHostname is null or len(@ipHostname) = 0       set @ipHostname = @iipHostname    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    --if @msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0       --set @msnetDnsDomain = @imsnetDnsDomain    if @uaUsername is null or set @uaPassword = @iuaPassword    if @uaGroups is null or len(@uaGroups) = 0       set @uaGroups = @iuaGroups    -- bools    if @domainMember is null or @domainMember = 2       set @domainMember =  if @uaMustChange is null or @uaMustChange = 2       set @uaMustChange = @iuaMustChange    if @uaCannotChange is null or @uaCannotChange = 2       set @uaCannotChange = @iuaCannotChange    if nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,       nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu, ua_pw_never_expires=@uaPwNeverExpires, msnet_domain_username=@msnetDomainUsername,        msnet_domain_password=@msnetDomainPassword, reboot_after_config = @reboot_after_config       where config_item_id=@itemId    exec wc_upd_next_name @setId, @itemId     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Change for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDhcp smallint, @winsDhcp smallint     -- declare @iuseDhcp smallint, @inetBIOS smallint          declare @iipDns varchar(512), @iipWins varchar(512), @iipDomain varchar(128)          declare @idnsDhcp smallint, @iwinsDhcp smallint {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_ip    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int,    @nic_id int as    -- test for a static IP range    declare @master_ip varchar(16), @duplicate_ip varchar(16), @final_ip varchar(16)    declare @interface_name varchar(64)    declare @interface_id int    declare config_ip_cursor cursor for       select ip, [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @config_set_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open config_ip_cursor    declare item_ip_cursor cursor for       select interface_id from nic_interface where [id] = @config_item_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open item_ip_cursor    fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name    fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       if len(@master_ip) > 0       begin          -- test for duplicate IP usage          set @duplicate_ip = @master_ip          set @final_ip = @master_ip          declare @computer_id int          select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id          while @duplicate_ip is not null          begin             set @duplicate_ip = null             -- test for another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface where [id] >= 5000001 and [id] <= 8000000                 and [id] != @computer_id and ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                and c.target_computer_id != @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to this computer IN THIS CONFIG that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                 and c.target_computer_id = @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip and c.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and [name] != @interface_name             -- get a new IP if a duplicate was found             if @duplicate_ip is not null                exec wc_increment_ip @duplicate_ip, @final_ip output          end           -- update the config_item nic_interface ip value to the non-duplicate found          update nic_interface set ip = @final_ip where interface_id = @interface_id       end        fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name       fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    end    close config_ip_cursor    deallocate config_ip_cursor    close item_ip_cursor    deallocate item_ip_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int, @nic_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_name    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int as    -- test for a name range    declare @method smallint    select @method = cname_method from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       -- test for duplicate name usage       declare @duplicate_name varchar(64), @final_name varchar(64)       --PRD item 7.1.12 Use token: To remove the addition of network adapter       select @final_name = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id       if @final_name in ('%NAME%','%SERIALNUM%','%NODENAME%','%NIC1MACADDR%','%NIC2MACADDR%', \t\t\t'%NIC3MACADDR%','%NIC4MACADDR%','%NIC5MACADDR%','%NIC6MACADDR%','%NIC7MACADDR%','%NIC8MACADDR%') \t update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           \twhere config_item_id = @config_item_id       else       begin       select @final_name = computer_name from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       set @duplicate_name = @final_name       declare @computer_id int       select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       while @duplicate_name is not null       begin          set @duplicate_name = null          -- test for another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from computer where computer_name = @final_name             and computer_id != @computer_id          -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from config_item where target_computer_id != @computer_id             and computer_name = @final_name          -- get a new name if a duplicate was found          if @duplicate_name is not null             exec wc_increment_name @config_set_id, @duplicate_name, @final_name output       end       -- update the config_item computer_name, ip_hostname to the non-duplicate value generated       update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           where config_item_id = @config_item_id    end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic \t@computer_id int, \t@mac_addr varchar(36), \t@ip_use_dhcp smallint, \t@ip_domain varchar(128), \t@ip_dns varchar(512), \t@ip_wins varchar(512), \t@nic_pci_bus int, \t@nic_pci_device int, \t@nic_pci_function int, \t@nic_device_id int, \t@nic_vendor_id int, \t@nic_desc varchar(64), \t@nic_location varchar(64), \t@interface_id int, \t@id int, \t@nic_id int, \t@name varchar(64), \t@ip varchar(16), \t@mask varchar(16), \t@gateway varchar(16), \t@broadcast varchar(16), \t@state int \t as \tbegin \t\tupdate nics set nics.mac_addr = @mac_addr, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_use_dhcp = @ip_use_dhcp, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_domain = @ip_domain, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_dns = @ip_dns, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_wins = @ip_wins, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_bus = @nic_pci_bus, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_device = @nic_pci_device, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_function = @nic_pci_function, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_device_id = @nic_device_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_vendor_id = @nic_vendor_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_desc = @nic_desc, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_location = @nic_location \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere nics.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\tupdate  nic_interface set\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.id = @id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.name = @name, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.ip = @ip, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.mask = @mask, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.gateway = @gateway, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.broadcast = @broadcast, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.state = @state \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere  nic_interface.interface_id = @interface_id; \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @ip_use_dhcp smallint, @ip_domain varchar, @ip_dns varchar, @ip_wins varchar, @nic_pci_bus int, @nic_pci_device int, @nic_pci_function int, @nic_device_id int, @nic_vendor_id int, @nic_desc varchar, @nic_location varchar, @interface_id int, @id int, @nic_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @mask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint = 1,--PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configItemId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_item_id = @configItemId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @interfaceId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int, @last smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_set record       begin transaction          update nic_config_set set ip_method = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp,wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_set_id = @configSetId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0,    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@nicId int, @interfaceId int, @last smallint, @jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing    @itemId int,    @id int,    @nicId int as    declare @name varchar(64)    declare @ip varchar(16), @mask varchar(16), @gateway varchar(16), @broadcast varchar(16)    declare @state int, @interfaceCount int    set @interfaceCount = 0    -- incremental IP for updates from config_set    declare @increment_ip bit    if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000       set @increment_ip = 1    declare nic_interface_cursor cursor for       select [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state from nic_interface where id = @id       and nic_id = @nicId order by interface_id    open nic_interface_cursor    fetch next from nic_interface_cursor       into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    --Bug #43065 To save computer nic_interface data.    declare @iname varchar(64), @iip varchar(16), @imask varchar(16),        @igateway varchar(16), @ibroadcast varchar(16), @istate int   if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000   begin    select @iname = name, @iip = ip, @imask = mask, @igateway = gateway, @ibroadcast = broadcast, @istate = state from      nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId          if @name is null or len(@name) = 0       set @name = @iname    if @ip is null or len(@ip) = 0       set @ip = @iip    if @mask is null or len(@mask) = 0       set @mask = @imask    if @gateway is null or len(@gateway) = 0       set @gateway = @igateway    if @broadcast is null or len(@broadcast) = 0       set @broadcast = @ibroadcast    if @state is null        set @state = @istate        end    -- remove existing nic_interface objects and always add new ones    delete from nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId     -- update nic_inteface table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- create new record       insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state)          values (@itemId, @nicId, @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state)              if @increment_ip = 1          exec wc_upd_next_ip @id, @itemId, @nicId                 fetch next from nic_interface_cursor          into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    end     close nic_interface_cursor    deallocate nic_interface_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @id int, @nicId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_pct_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_pct_task    @jobId       \tint,    @condSeq     \tint,    @taskSeq\t\t\tint,    @filename\t\tvarchar(254),    @directory\t\tvarchar(254),    @commandLine\t\tvarchar(254),--bug #45749    @username\t\tvarchar(64),    @password\t\tvarchar(64),    @pkgPassword\t\tvarchar(64),    @domain\t\t\tsmallint,    @local\t\t\tsmallint,    @customUsers\t\tvarchar(128),    @customGroups\tvarchar(128),    @condOffset\t\tsmallint,    @condType\t\tsmallint,    @dateType\t\tsmallint as    update capture_pct_task set template_file=@filename, folder=@directory,       addl_cmd_line=@commandLine, username=@username, [password]=@password,       pkg_password=@pkgPassword, domain_users=@domain, local_users=@local,       custom_users=@customUsers, custom_groups=@customGroups, last_accessed=@condType,       last_value=@condOffset, last_scale=@dateType    where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @filename varchar, @directory varchar, @commandLine varchar, @username varchar, @password varchar, @pkgPassword varchar, @domain smallint, @local smallint, @customUsers varchar, @customGroups varchar, @condOffset smallint, @condType smallint, @dateType smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_power_control_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_power_control_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq\t\tint,    @type    \tsmallint,    @forceApps\tsmallint as    -- update the power control task    begin transaction       update reboot_task set          reboot_method=@type, [force]=@forceApps          where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction     select @@error as error ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @type smallint, @forceApps smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_schedule    @schedule int,    @computer int,    @job int,    @startTime datetime,    @recur int,    @recurType smallint,    @defer int,    @dependantScheduleId int     as    if @dependantScheduleId <= 100000000 or @dependantScheduleId > 200000000        set @dependantScheduleId = null    begin transaction       update event_schedule set computer_id = @computer, start_time = @startTime,           recur_value = @recur, recur_type = @recurType, defer_mins = @defer,           dep_schedule_id = @dependantScheduleId, status_code = null, status = '',          next_task_seq = 0, cond_seq = null, broker_time = null, end_time = null,          exit_code = null, exit_module = null  where schedule_id = @schedule \t  --Bug #36624 To set job_exec_time null at reschudule. \t  update event_schedule_info set job_exec_time = null where schedule_id = @schedule    if @@error != 0    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule int, @computer int, @job int, @startTime datetime, @recur int, @recurType smallint, @defer int, @dependantScheduleId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_schedule_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create  procedure wc_upd_schedule_info  \t@schedule_id \tint,     @user_id\tint,     @app_id int =0 --Enhance ASDK - change to update extaernal App ID as \tdeclare @scheduleCount int \tset @scheduleCount = 0               select @scheduleCount=count(schedule_id ) from event_schedule_info where schedule_id=@schedule_id               begin transaction \t\tif @scheduleCount > 0  \t\tupdate event_schedule_info set windows_user_id =  @user_id, app_id=@app_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t else  \t\tinsert into event_schedule_info (schedule_id,windows_user_id) values(@schedule_id,@user_id) \t\t  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \t\treturn \tend  \tcommit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @user_id int, @app_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_script_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_script_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq\t\tint,    @scriptFile\tvarchar(256),    @script\t\tvarchar(6000),    @description varchar(128),    @platform\tsmallint,    @runAtServer smallint,    @window\t\tsmallint,    @username\tvarchar(128) = null,    @password\tvarchar(128) = null,     -- PRD Item 7.2.2 Extend Run Script task    @addlcmdline varchar(512)=null,    @bootoption_id int=null, --PRD item 7.1.1 PXE pre boot option    @execution_mode smallint=1, --PRD UI changes of Automation    @bootimage_arch int=0,    @execute_options smallint=0 as       update script_task set script_file=@scriptFile, script=@script,  \t     [description]=@description, os_reqd=@platform, location=@runAtServer, \t\t window=@window, username=@username, password=@password,addl_cmdline=@addlcmdline, execution_mode=@execution_mode, execute_options=@execute_options \t  where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq \t   \t  update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch=@bootimage_arch where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @scriptFile varchar, @script varchar, @description varchar, @platform smallint, @runAtServer smallint, @window smallint, @username varchar, @password varchar, @addlcmdline varchar, @bootoption_id int, @execution_mode smallint, @bootimage_arch int, @execute_options smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_security_group", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_security_group    @group int,    @name varchar(50),    @description varchar(256) as    declare @groupId int    select @groupId = [group_id] from securitygroup where [group_id] = @group    declare @duplicate varchar(64)     --set @duplicate = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security    --select @duplicate = [name] from securitygroup where [group_id] != @group and [name] = @name      -- add group    --if @duplicate is  null    --begin    if @groupId is not null    begin       update securitygroup set [name] = @name, [description] = @description where [group_id] = @groupId    end    --end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@group int, @name varchar, @description varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_task_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_task_order    @jobId\t\tint,    @conditionId\tint,    @taskId1\t\tint,    @taskId2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary task id    declare @tempTaskId   int    select @tempTaskId = max(task_seq) from task where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@conditionId    set @tempTaskId = @tempTaskId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary task id \t   update task set task_seq=@tempTaskId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update task set task_seq=@taskId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary task id with the swap id \t   update task set task_seq=@taskId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@tempTaskId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else \t  commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId int, @taskId1 int, @taskId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_taskusers", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.14 Centrally Managed Task Password create procedure wc_upd_taskusers  @userName varchar(128), @oldPassword varchar(128), @newPassword varchar(128) as  declare @updatedRecords  int  set @updatedRecords =0  update    script_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update    copyfile_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update   install_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update   capture_pct_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  select @updatedRecords  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userName varchar, @oldPassword varchar, @newPassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS4", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_user", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_user    @user int,    @username varchar(100),    @fullName varchar(128),    @description varchar(128),    @password varchar(100) = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security as    declare @userId int    select @userId = [user_id] from securityuser where [user_id] = @user    declare @duplicate varchar(64)     --set @duplicate = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security    --select @duplicate = [name] from securityuser where [user_id] != @user and [name] = @username       -- update user      --if @duplicate is  null    --begin    if @userId is not null    begin       declare @domain varchar(50)       select @domain = domain from securityuser where [user_id] = @userId        if len(@domain) > 0       begin          -- only the description can be edited for domain accounts          update securityuser set [description] = @description where [user_id] = @userId       end       else       begin \t\t\tif len(@password) >0 \t\t\tbegin          update securityuser set [name] = @username, fullname = @fullName, [description] = @description,             [password] = @password where [user_id] = @userId       end \t\t\telse \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tupdate securityuser set [name] = @username, fullname = @fullName, [description] = @description \t\t\t\t\twhere [user_id] = @userId \t\t\tend \t\tend    end   --end    ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user int, @username varchar, @fullName varchar, @description varchar, @password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fn_get_comparable_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function fn_get_comparable_ip (  @ip varchar(15) ) returns bigint as begin  \tdeclare @ip_part1 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part2 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part3 bigint \tdeclare @ip_part4 bigint \tdeclare @first_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @second_dot_pos smallint \tdeclare @third_dot_pos smallint  \tset @first_dot_pos = charindex('.', @ip) \tif @first_dot_pos = 0 \t\treturn cast(@ip as bigint)  \tset @second_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@first_dot_pos + 1) \tset @third_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@second_dot_pos + 1)  \tset @ip_part4 = cast(substring(@ip, @third_dot_pos + 1, len(@ip)) as bigint)  \tif(@first_dot_pos!=0) \tbegin \t\tset @ip_part1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part2 = cast(substring(@ip, @first_dot_pos + 1, @second_dot_pos - @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \t\tset @ip_part3 = cast(substring(@ip, @second_dot_pos + 1, @third_dot_pos - @second_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) \tend  \treturn @ip_part1 * 1000000000 + @ip_part2 * 1000000 + @ip_part3 * 1000 + @ip_part4  end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( bigint OUT, @ip varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "SplitIDs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function SplitIDs (  @OrderList varchar(8000) ) returns @ParsedList table (  ID int ) as begin \tdeclare @OrderID varchar(10), @Pos int  \tset @OrderList = ltrim(rtrim(@OrderList))+ ',' \tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1)  \tif replace(@OrderList, ',', '') <> '' \tbegin \t\twhile @Pos > 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tset @OrderID = ltrim(rtrim(left(@OrderList, @Pos - 1))) \t\t\tif @OrderID <> '' \t\t\tbegin \t\t\tinsert into @ParsedList (ID) \t\t\tvalues (cast(@OrderID as int)) --Use Appropriate conversion \t\tend  \t\tset @OrderList = right(@OrderList, len(@OrderList) - @Pos) \t\tset @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1) \tend end  return end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@OrderList varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "complete_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.complete_schedule \t@schedule_id     int, \t@exit_code       int, \t@status_code     int, \t@exit_module     smallint, \t@next_start_time datetime, \t@current_time    datetime, \t@status          varchar( 256 ), \t@level           smallint, \t@next_task_seq   int,\t -- this is ignored if @next_start_time is not null \t@taskresult      int as \tbegin transaction  \t-- first insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, 0, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult  \t-- now insert and fix up history for this item \texec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id  \t-- update the event schedule table \tif( @next_start_time is null ) \tbegin \t   -- Right now we never want to leave the next_task_seq as null for a completed schedule. \t   -- If it is null, set it to whatever the last sequence was \t   if( @next_task_seq is null ) \t   begin \t      select @next_task_seq = next_task_seq \t         from event_schedule \t   \t     where schedule_id = @schedule_id \t   end  \t\tDECLARE @called_status varchar(MAX),                 @calling_id    int,                 @dependent_id  int  \t\tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \t\tBEGIN \t\t\tDECLARE @event_name    varchar(128) \t\t\tSELECT  @event_name = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN') \t\t\t\tFROM event          AS e \t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\tWHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\t\tIF (@status_code = 0) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Called Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- clear dependent schedule id and set success status for calling schedule \t\t\t\tUPDATE    event_schedule \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL \t\t\t\t\tWHERE schedule_id = @calling_id \t\t\tEND \t\t\tELSE IF (@status_code = 1) \t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\tSELECT @called_status = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status \t\t\t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult \t\t\t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\t\t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE    es \t\t\t\t\tSET   status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\t  status_code = 1, \t\t\t\t\t\t  dep_schedule_id = NULL, \t\t\t\t\t\t  next_task_seq = nts.next_task_seq, \t\t\t\t\t\t  end_time = @current_time \t\t\t\t\tFROM  event_schedule AS es \t\t\t\t\tJOIN ( \t\t\t\t\t\tSELECT s.schedule_id, MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tFROM script_task AS t \t\t\t\t\t\t\tJOIN event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id \t\t\t\t\t\t\tWHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tGROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\tWHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task table \t\t\t\tUPDATE es \t\t\t\t\tSET status = @called_status, \t\t\t\t\t\tstatus_code = 1, \t\t\t\t\t\tdep_schedule_id = NULL, \t\t\t\t\t\tend_time = @current_time \t\t\t\t\tFROM event_schedule AS es \t\t\t\t\tWHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\t\t\tIF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL) \t\t\t\t\tEXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' \t\t\tEND \t\tEND  \t   -- this event is not supposed to recur, all done        update event_schedule             set status_code = @status_code, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module,                 status = @status, end_time = @current_time, next_task_seq = @next_task_seq, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  }             where schedule_id = @schedule_id \tend \telse \tbegin \t\t-- this event will recur, update the status and set the new start time \t\tupdate event_schedule \t\t\tset status_code = null, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module, \t\t\t\tstart_time = @next_start_time, status = @status, end_time = @current_time, \t\t\t\tnext_task_seq = null, cond_seq = null, dep_schedule_id = null,  -- these should be re-evaluated every time, set to null \t\t\t\tconfig_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  } \t\t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t \t\t\tdelete from computer_state where  schedule_id = @schedule_id \tend  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tcommit transaction \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @exit_code int, @status_code int, @exit_module smallint, @next_start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @level smallint, @next_task_seq int, @taskresult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "del_session", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure del_session    @computer_id      int,    @status           varchar (254),    @clear_wol_time   int = 1 as    declare  @schedule_id      int,             @event_id         int,             @cond_seq         int,             @next_task_seq    int,             @found            int     set @found = null     if not exists (select computer_id from computer where computer_id = @computer_id)       return 0     select @schedule_id = schedule_id, @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @next_task_seq = next_task_seq from event_schedule       where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code = -3 and computer_id = @computer_id     if (@schedule_id is not null)    begin       select @found = event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq       if (@found is null)          select @found = event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq    end     begin transaction     if (@found is not null)    begin       update event_schedule set status_code = NULL, status = @status where schedule_id = @schedule_id       if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 1       end    end     delete sessions where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 1    end     if (@clear_wol_time != 0)    begin       update computer set last_wol_attempt = null where computer_id = @computer_id        if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 1       end    end     commit transaction     return 1 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @status varchar, @clear_wol_time int)"}

2000006) as varchar(30))    end     if ( @folder_id < 1 and @folder_name is null)    begin       begin transaction       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description]) values (@event_id, @name, @description)    end    else    begin       declare @temp_folder_id int        if (@folder_name is null or @folder_name = '')          set @folder_name = @default_folder_name        if (@folder_id < 1)       begin          set @folder_id = null          select @folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where [name] = @folder_name          if (@folder_id is null)             exec @folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'          if (@@error != 0)             set @folder_id = null       end        if (@folder_id is null)          set @temp_folder_id = 1       else          select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id        begin transaction       if (@temp_folder_id) is null          insert into event_folder (folder_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @folder_name)       insert into event (event_id, [name], folder_id,  [description]) values (@event_id, @name, @folder_id, @description)    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @event_id as event_id    return @event_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @folder_id int, @folder_name varchar, @add_number int, @default_event_name varchar, @default_folder_name varchar, @description varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_folder_by_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_folder_by_id    @folder_name   varchar(64),    @folder_id     int,    @parent_id     int = null as    declare @folder_id_in_use int,            @temp_parent_id int,            @temp_folder_name varchar(64)     select @folder_id_in_use = folder_id, @temp_parent_id = parent_id, @temp_folder_name = [name] from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id     if (@folder_id_in_use is null)    begin       -- the folder id is not in use just create it       insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @parent_id, @folder_name)    end    else    begin       -- the folder id is in use --      if (@temp_folder_name = @folder_name and (@temp_parent_id = @parent_id or (@temp_parent_id is null and @parent_id is null)))       if (@temp_parent_id = @parent_id or (@temp_parent_id is null and @parent_id is null))       begin          -- the id is being used as a system id, done          return       end       else       begin  -- the system id is being used by a non system folder          declare @new_id int           begin transaction          exec @new_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'           -- give existing folder new id          update event_folder set folder_id = @new_id where folder_id = @folder_id          if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return          end           -- add the new system folder          insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @parent_id, @folder_name)          if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return          end           commit transaction       end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_name varchar, @folder_id int, @parent_id int)"}

     goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = exec @history_id = ins_history_registry_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_wait_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     --HLS task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_type = 19)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_get_inventory_task @computer_id, @event_id, return 0       end        commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @task_seq int, @cond_seq int, @schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_new_snmp_enclosure", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  CREATE procedure ins_new_snmp_enclosure   @name varchar(64),   @manuf varchar(64),   @model varchar(64),   @ip_address varchar(20),   @community varchar(256),   @rack_name varchar(64) as   declare @enclosure_id as int,           @tran int,           @status int,           @rack_id int,           @org_name varchar(64)    set @tran = @@trancount    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    select @rack_id=rack_id from physical_rack where name=@rack_name    if(@rack_id is null)   begin     exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'      insert into physical_rack(rack_id, name, real_name, manuf_rack)       values(@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, 1)   end    select @enclosure_id=enclosure_id, @org_name=name from physical_enclosure where manuf=@manuf and model=@model       and ip_address=@ip_address and community=@community and rack_id=@rack_id    if (@enclosure_id is null)   begin     exec @enclosure_id = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'      insert into physical_enclosure(enclosure_id, name, real_name, manuf, model, ip_address, community, rack_id)       values(@enclosure_id, @name, @name, @manuf, @model, @ip_address, @community, @rack_id)      set @status = 1   end   else   begin     if(@org_name = @name)       set @status = 0     else     begin       set @status = 2       update physical_enclosure set name=@name, real_name=@name where enclosure_id=@enclosure_id     end   end    if (@@error != 0)   begin     if (@tran = 0)       rollback transaction   end    if (@tran = 0)   begin     commit transaction     select @enclosure_id, @status   end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @manuf varchar, @model varchar, @ip_address varchar, @community varchar, @rack_name varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_nic_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_nic_interface    @id int,    @nic_id int,    @interface_id int, \t\t -- -1 means use existing    @name varchar( 64 ) = null,    @ip varchar( 16 ) = null,    @netmask varchar( 16 ) = null,    @gateway varchar( 16 ) = null,    @broadcast varchar( 16 ) = null,    @state int = null as    declare @last_id int    declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     if( -1 = @interface_id )    begin       -- we don't have an existing id, just insert the data and let SQL generate one       insert into nic_interface          ( [id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state )          values          ( @id, @nic_id, @name, @ip, @netmask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state )        -- save the inserted identity so we can return it       set @last_id = @@identity    end    else    begin       -- update the data       update nic_interface  \t     set [id] = @id, nic_id = @nic_id,              [name] = @name, ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,  \t\t\tbroadcast = @broadcast, state = @state          where interface_id = @interface_id              -- the last identity was passed in but return it anyway       set @last_id = @interface_id    end     if( @@error != 0 )    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return -1    end    else    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          commit transaction       return @last_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @nic_id int, @interface_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_redeploy_event", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_redeploy_event    @computer_id   int,    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    declare @new_time         datetime,            @schedule_id      int,            @max_history_id   int,            @bootoption_id    int     set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @start_time)     begin transaction     update event_schedule       set start_time = @new_time       where computer_id = @computer_id           and start_time <= @start_time           and status_code = null     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     if (@schedule_id = 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     select @max_history_id = max(history_id) from history_view where computer_id = @computer_id     insert into event_schedule       (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, cond_seq, next_task_seq, start_time, redeploy_history_id, rip_replace_event)    values       (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, null, 0, @start_time, @max_history_id, 1)     select top 1 @bootoption_id=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@event_id order by task_seq    if(@bootoption_id = 1 or @bootoption_id is null)    begin      exec @bootoption_id=sel_default_bootoption_id    end     select @bootoption_id as bootoption_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @start_time datetime)"}

  if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     if (@tran = 0)       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_code {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_session", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_session    @computer_id   int,    @engine_id     int,    @engine_ip     varchar(32),    @last_update   datetime,    @client_ip\t  varchar(32),    @platform\t  smallint,     @boot_env\t  smallint  -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes } as    declare  @session_id    int     select @session_id = session_id from sessions where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@session_id is null)    begin       if (@engine_ip) is not null       begin          begin transaction           exec @session_id = sel_next_system_id 'SESSION_ID'           if (@session_id = 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return 0          end           insert into sessions             (session_id, computer_id, engine_id, address, last_update, client_ip, platform, boot_env) -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }          values             (@session_id, @computer_id, @engine_id, @engine_ip, @last_update, @client_ip, @platform, @boot_env) -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }           if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction          else             commit transaction       end       else       begin          set @session_id = 0       end    end    else     begin    -- Update sessions value, if it is not deleted from database due to any reasons.       update sessions set computer_id = @computer_id,engine_id=@engine_id,address=@engine_ip,last_update=@last_update,client_ip=@client_ip,platform=@platform,boot_env=@boot_env \t  where session_id = @session_id    end     return @session_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @engine_id int, @engine_ip varchar, @last_update datetime, @client_ip varchar, @platform smallint, @boot_env smallint)"}
