{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "ins_wait_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure ins_wait_task \t@event_id\t\tint, \t@cond_seq\t\tint, \t@task_seq\t\tint, \t@wait_time\t\tint=0, \t@bootoption_id int = null,\t\t\t     @bootoption_cpu_arch int = 0 as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     insert into wait_task    ( \tevent_id, \tcond_seq, \ttask_seq, \twait_time    )    values    ( \t@event_id, \t@cond_seq, \t@task_seq, \t@wait_time    )     update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch = @bootoption_cpu_arch where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq     -- only commit or rollback based on whether or not we were in a transaction    if( 0 = @tran )    begin       if (@@error = 0)          commit transaction       else          rollback transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @wait_time int, @bootoption_id int, @bootoption_cpu_arch int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "is_need_check_visibility", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[is_need_check_visibility]     @user_id int, \t@obj_id  int AS BEGIN     DECLARE @need_check int     SELECT  @need_check = 1      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM database_info WHERE req_login = 1 AND enforce_visibility = 1)         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securityprivilegelink l                         LEFT JOIN securitygroupmember   m ON m.group_id = l.[user_id]                         WHERE     l.privilege_id = 1 AND @user_id IN (l.[user_id], m.[user_id]) )         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securitygroupmember    m                         JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                         WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                         AND       p.[object_id] = @obj_id AND p.[allow] > 0 )         SET @need_check = 0      RETURN  @need_check END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user_id int, @obj_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure [dbo].[mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task]     @schedule_id   int,     @operation_str varchar(64) as begin \tDECLARE   @calling_id   int \tSELECT    @calling_id = calling_event         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int \tSELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id         AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  \tIF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) \tBEGIN \t\tDECLARE @failure_code int,                 @exit_code    int, \t\t        @taskresult   int, \t\t        @exit_module  smallint, \t\t        @level        smallint, \t\t        @current_time datetime         SELECT  @failure_code = 1,                 @exit_code    = 19501,                 @taskresult   = 0,                 @exit_module  = 16,                 @level        = 3,                 @current_time = GETDATE()  \t\tDECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t\tDECLARE @errstatus   varchar(MAX);         SELECT  @errstatus = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @eventname + '] Was ' + @operation_str \t\t \t\t-- insert status_log for calling schedule \t\texec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @errstatus, @failure_code, @exit_code, @exit_module,                                  @level, @taskresult  \t\t-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule \t\texec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE es             SET status          = @errstatus,                 status_code     = @failure_code,                 dep_schedule_id = NULL,                 next_task_seq   = nts.next_task_seq,                 end_time        = @current_time             FROM event_schedule AS es             JOIN (                 SELECT    s.schedule_id,                           MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq,                           t.cond_seq                     FROM  script_task    AS t                     JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id                     WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq                     GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq                  ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq             WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t \t\t-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task \t\tUPDATE    event_schedule             SET   status          = @errstatus,                   status_code     = @failure_code,                   dep_schedule_id = NULL,                   end_time        = @current_time             WHERE schedule_id     = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id          IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL)             EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' \tEND end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @operation_str varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mm_upd_event_schedule_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.mm_upd_event_schedule_id    @schedule_id\t\t\tint,    @start_time          datetime,    @status              varchar(254) = NULL,    @recur_value         int = NULL,    @recur_type\t\t    smallint = NULL,    @defer               int = NULL,    @user_id\t\t\t\tint = 0,    @cond_seq\t\t\tint = NULL,    @calling_schedule    int = NULL,    @winuser_id       int = 0  --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User as    declare @new_sched_id int     begin transaction     exec mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @schedule_id, 'Restarted'     exec @new_sched_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     update event_schedule     set next_task_seq = NULL, start_time = @start_time, status = @status, \tdefer_mins = @defer, recur_value = @recur_value, recur_type = @recur_type, \tstatus_code = NULL, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \tbroker_time = NULL, user_id = @user_id, cond_seq = @cond_seq, \tcalling_event = @calling_schedule, dep_schedule_id = null, \tschedule_id = @new_sched_id, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null on  \"Reschedule\" or \"start now\" }    where schedule_id = @schedule_id    --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User    update  event_schedule_info     set schedule_id = @new_sched_id, \t\twindows_user_id = @winuser_id, \t\tjob_exec_time = null\t-- PRD 7.1.49 (Bug Fix #36624)    where        schedule_id  = @schedule_id\t\t   -------------------------------------------     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     return @new_sched_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @status varchar, @recur_value int, @recur_type smallint, @defer int, @user_id int, @cond_seq int, @calling_schedule int, @winuser_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_automation_job", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_automation_job    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule es          where ( (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is NULL)             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)            and es.event_id in ( select t.event_id from [task] t left outer join [script_task] st \t\t\ton t.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\tand t.cond_seq = st.cond_seq  \t\t\tand t.task_seq = st.task_seq \t\t\twhere ((t.task_type = 10 and st.execution_mode = 0) \t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 \t\t\tor t.task_type = 22) )        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_current_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_current_schedule \t@computer_id\tint, \t@schedule_id\tint, \t@task_seq\t\tint, \t@boot_env\t\tint as \tdeclare @return_code  int \tset @return_code = null  \tif (@schedule_id = 0) \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks there is has not work, lets make sure. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule es join task t  \t\t\t\ton es.event_id = t.event_id \t\t\t\tand es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = t.task_seq \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and (es.status_code = -1 or es.status_code = -3) \t\t\t\tand ( ( @boot_env = 1 -- BOOT_AUTOMATION = 1 \t\t\t\t\t\tand ( t.task_type = 10 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 11 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 13 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 15 \t\t\t\t\t\tor t.task_type = 17 ) ) \t\t\t\t\tor  \t\t\t\t\t( @boot_env != 1 ) )  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \tend \telse \tbegin \t\t-- The agent thinks it is working on a job. \t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \t\t\t\tand schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\tand next_task_seq = @task_seq \t\t\t\tand status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\tbegin \t\t\tselect top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule \t\t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  \t\t\tif (@return_code is null) \t\t\t\tset @return_code = 0 -- Agent thinks it has a job, but we don't.  \t\t\t-- We think it is working on a different job than the agent thinks. \t\tend \t\telse \t\tbegin \t\t\t-- We are in sync with the agent. \t\t\tset @return_code = 0 \t\tend \tend  \treturn @return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @boot_env int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_check_os_version_change", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_check_os_version_change    @computer_id   int,    @os            varchar(128) as    if (@computer_id = 0)       return     if not exists (select computer_id from computer where computer_id = @computer_id and os = @os)    begin       begin transaction       update computer set last_inventory = null where computer_id = @computer_id       if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @os varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "mth_copy_event", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure mth_copy_event    @folder_id      int,    @src_event_id   int,    @event_prefix   varchar(16),    @nested         tinyint = 0\t as    begin transaction  \t/* get the new ID from the system table */ \tdeclare @new_event_id int \texec @new_event_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_ID'     -- determine if there is already a folder with this    --    name in the destination    declare @strippass smallint {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_expired_schedules_machines", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines    @time      datetime,    @wol_wait  int = 60,    @to_all    char(1) = 'Y' as    declare @wol_time datetime    set @wol_time = DATEADD(second, -@wol_wait, @time)     --    -- I changed the join on the nic_interface table to a left outer join because there are no    -- entries in the nic_interface table if BootWorks is the only agent that's connected to the    -- database.  This is because we don't want BootWorks to update the nic_interface table    -- because it's supposed to be used for the production OS.    -- This fixes bug #24899.    --     if (@to_all = 'Y')    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c \t\t    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id \t\t\tjoin nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null \t\t\t-- see comment above about left outer join \t\t\tleft outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) \t\t    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) \t\t\tand es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  \t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere es.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) \t\torder by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end    else    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c \t\t\tjoin event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id \t\t\tjoin nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null \t\t\t-- see comment above about left outer join \t\t\tleft outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where c.wol_support = 1             and (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) \t\t    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0  and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) \t\t\tand es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  \t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere es.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) \t\torder by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@time datetime, @wol_wait int, @to_all char)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_expired_schedules_machines_ignore_last_wol_attempt", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines_ignore_last_wol_attempt    @time      datetime as       select top 1 c.computer_id           from computer c \t\t    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id \t\t\tjoin nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null \t\t\t-- see comment above about left outer join \t\t\tleft outer join nic_interface ni on ni.id = n.computer_id          where -- (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time) and  \t\t\tes.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) \t\t      and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) \t\tand es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  \t\t\t\twhere es.event_id = st.event_id  \t\t\t\t\tand ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) \t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2)  \t\t\t\t) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_find_next_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_find_next_computer     @BeginID char(7),     @SearchTable varchar(255),     @SearchColumn varchar(255),     @SearchData varchar(255) as declare @Children TABLE (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int) declare @RowCnt int declare @MaxRows int declare @ExecSql nvarchar(2048) --LB#74365  create table #GroupOrder (group_id int, parent_id int, name varchar(64), search_order int) insert into #GroupOrder (group_id, parent_id, name, search_order)   select group_id, parent_id, name, 2147483647   from computer_group    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id IS NULL AND group_id != -7 order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end  create table  #SortedComputers (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, computer_id int) insert     into      #SortedComputers (computer_id)     select    c.computer_id     from      computer    c     left join #GroupOrder g on c.group_id = g.group_id     order by  isnull(g.search_order, case when c.node_type IS NULL then 2147483647                                           when c.node_type < 3     then 1 else NULL end) DESC, c.name  select @ExecSql =  case @SearchTable   when 'nic_interface' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.id AND            t.' + @SearchColumn + ' LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   when 'all_fields' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM   #SortedComputers s LEFT OUTER JOIN             computer c ON s.computer_id = c.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nics n ON s.computer_id = n.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nic_interface i ON s.computer_id = i.id LEFT OUTER JOIN             physical_bay p ON s.computer_id = p.computer_id      WHERE (c.computer_id LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_key) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.computer_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.asset_tag) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.serial_num) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.logged_on_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.uuid) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(n.mac_addr) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             i.ip LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(p.real_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''') AND             s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   else     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.computer_id AND            LOWER(t.' + @SearchColumn + ') LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum' end execute sp_executesql @ExecSql drop table #SortedComputers drop table #GroupOrder ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@BeginID char, @SearchTable varchar, @SearchColumn varchar, @SearchData varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_find_next_computer_set_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_find_next_computer_set_order (@GroupID int) as begin   declare @Children table (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int)   declare @RowCnt int   declare @MaxRows int   declare @ExecSql nvarchar(255)    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id = @GroupID order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end    update #GroupOrder set search_order = (select MIN(search_order) - 1 from #GroupOrder) where group_id = @GroupID  end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@GroupID int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_boot_optionid_valid", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_is_boot_optionid_valid  @bootoption_id int as begin declare @returnoptionid as int  if object_id ('dbo.x_bootoptions') is not null begin   set @returnoptionid = (select top 1 bo.bootoption_id from boot_options bo, x_bootoptions xbo     where bo.bootoption_type = xbo.bootoption_type and     bo.pxe_description = xbo.pxe_description and xbo.bootoption_id = @bootoption_id) end else   set @returnoptionid = 0  return @returnoptionid end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@bootoption_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast]  \t@event_id\tint as BEGIN \tdeclare @event_count int      SET @event_count = 0 \tselect @event_count = count(event_id)  \t\tfrom image_task \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0  \tif( @event_count > 0 ) \tbegin \t\t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast_first_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast_first_task]  \t@event_id\tint as BEGIN \tdeclare @task_count int      SET @task_count = 0 \tselect @task_count = count(event_id)  \t\tfrom image_task \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0  \t\t       and task_seq =(select min(task_seq) from task where event_id = @event_id)  \tif( @task_count > 0 ) \tbegin \t\t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_event_master", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- is this event a master event create procedure sel_is_event_master \t@event_id\tint as \tdeclare @event_unique_id as uniqueidentifier  \tselect @event_unique_id = master_guid \t\tfrom event \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and master_server is null  \tif( @event_unique_id is not NULL ) \tbegin \t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_event_master_assigned", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " -- is this event linked to a master event create procedure sel_is_event_master_assigned \t@event_id\tint as \tdeclare @event_unique_id as uniqueidentifier  \tselect @event_unique_id = master_guid \t\tfrom event \t\twhere event_id = @event_id and master_server is not null  \tif( @event_unique_id is not NULL ) \tbegin \t\treturn 1 \tend  \treturn 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_image_post_config", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_is_image_post_config    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc \t \tif (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) \tbegin \t\treturn -1 \tend  \tselect @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  \t \tif( @deploy_any_event_id != 0 ) \t\tset @next_task_seq = @next_task_seq + 1  \tselect @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_set \t\twhere config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq and reconfig is null)  \tif (@config_set_id is null) \t\treturn -1     return @next_task_seq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_next_task_deploy_anywhere", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_is_next_task_deploy_anywhere    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc \t \tif (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) \tbegin \t\treturn -1 \tend  \tselect @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  \t\t\twhere event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  \t \tif( @deploy_any_event_id is null) \t\treturn -1 \t \treturn \t@next_task_seq\t\t\t\t ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_post_config_in_prod", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_is_post_config_in_prod @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @prep_image   int   set @prep_image=-1   select @prep_image=prepare_image from image_task where  \t\t\tevent_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq   return @prep_image ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_is_rejected_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create proc sel_is_rejected_computer    @mac_addr   varchar(512) as    --declare @retVal varchar(12)    select rc.computer_id       from reject_computer rc,            reject_mac_addrs rma       where (rc.serial_num in (@mac_addr) or          rc.asset_tag in (@mac_addr)) or          (rma.mac_addr in (@mac_addr) and          rma.computer_id = rc.computer_id) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@mac_addr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_job_status_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_job_status_info \t@computer_id int as \tselect t.task_type, es.schedule_id, es.next_task_seq, \t\tcase t.task_type \t\t\twhen 10 then\t\t\t\t-- Script \t\t\t\t(select case when location = 1 then 'None' \t\t\t\t\t\t\t when execution_mode = 0 then 'Automation'  \t\t\t\t\t\t\t else 'Production' \t\t\t\t\t\tend  \t\t\t\t\tfrom script_task st \t\t\t\t\twhere st.event_id = t.event_id  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.cond_seq = t.cond_seq  \t\t\t\t\t\tand st.task_seq = t.task_seq) \t\t\twhen 11 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Reboot \t\t\twhen 12 then 'Production'\t-- Copy File \t\t\twhen 13 then 'Automation'\t-- Registry  \t\t\twhen 14 then 'Both'\t\t\t-- Config \t\t\twhen 15 then 'Automation'\t-- Image \t\t\twhen 16 then 'Production'\t-- Install \t\t\twhen 17 then 'Automation'\t-- Unattended Install \t\t\twhen 18 then 'Production'\t-- PCT \t\t\twhen 19 then 'Production'\t-- Inventory \t\t\twhen 21 then 'Production'\t-- Update Agent  \t\t\telse 'None' \t\tend as boot_env \t\tfrom dbo.task t join dbo.event_schedule es  \t\t\ton es.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\t\t\tand t.event_id = es.event_id  \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq  \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq \t\twhere es.status_code is not null  \t\t\tand es.status_code != -2 \t\t\tand es.status_code < 0 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_lic_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_lic_info    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36) as    declare  @del_expire   datetime     select @del_expire = expire from deleted_computer where mac_addr = @mac_addr     if (@computer_id = 0)    begin       select @del_expire as del_expire    end    else    begin       select expire, limited_license, @del_expire as del_expire          from computer where computer_id = @computer_id    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_max_free_disk_space", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_max_free_disk_space    @computer_id      int as    declare @free int     select @free = max(free)\tfrom logical_drive       where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@free is null)       set @free = -1     return @free ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_more_work", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_more_work    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule          where (next_task_seq > -1             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end   --LB#35552   -- select computer_id from sessions where platform = 1 and computer_id not in (    select computer_id from sessions where boot_env = 1 and computer_id not in ( -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }       select distinct s.computer_id from sessions s, event_schedule es          where s.computer_id = es.computer_id --LB#35552    and platform = 1 \t       and boot_env = 1\t\t-- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }             and es.start_time <= @time_now             and ( ( es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code < 0 )                   and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in                      ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )                or ( es.event_id = 2000001 and es.status_code is NULL ) ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_expired_time", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_expired_time    @cur_time   datetime as    declare @sched_in_progress int     select top 1 @sched_in_progress = schedule_id from event_schedule where status_code < 0    if (@sched_in_progress is null)       set @sched_in_progress = 0    else       set @sched_in_progress = 1     if exists (select top 1 es.schedule_id       from event_schedule es       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @cur_time          and es.computer_id in (select s.computer_id from sessions s where es.computer_id = s.computer_id          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in \t\t( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ))))    select dateadd (mi, -1, @cur_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress    else    select min (start_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress       from event_schedule       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time >= @cur_time          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) ) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_seq_by_sched", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_seq_by_sched    @schedule_id int as    declare @event_id int    declare @cond_seq int    declare @task_seq int    declare @next_sequence int     select @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq       from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     exec @next_sequence = sel_next_sequence @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     return @next_sequence ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_sequence", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_sequence    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    set @next_task_seq = null    select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc     return coalesce (@next_task_seq, -1) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_system_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_system_id    @object_id   varchar(64),    @update      char(1) = 'T' as    declare  @last_used_id int,             @tran         int    declare  @err    varchar(100)     set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction     select @last_used_id = last_used_id + 1       from system_id with (xlock, rowlock)       where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)  \tif 'EVENT_ID' = upper(@object_id) \tBegin \t\tif @last_used_id = 3000000 \t\tbegin \t\t\tSET @last_used_id = 19000000 \t\tend \tend     if (@last_used_id is null)    begin       set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id in selecting object ' + @object_id       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction;       -- raiserror 30008 @err \t  -- THROW 30008, @err, 1 \t  RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)       return 0    end     if (upper(@update) = 'T')    begin       update system_id set last_used_id = @last_used_id          where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)        if (@@error != 0)       begin          set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id updating object ' + @object_id          if (@tran = 0)             rollback transaction;          -- raiserror 30009 @err \t\t -- THROW 30009, @err, 1 \t\t RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)          return 0       end        if (@tran = 0)          commit transaction    end    else    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     return coalesce (@last_used_id, 0) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@object_id varchar, @update char)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_task_seq \t@schedule_id \tint as \tdeclare @ret_val int \tselect top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq \t\tfrom task t, event_schedule es \t\twhere t.event_id = es.event_id \t\t\t\tand t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t\t\tand t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq \t\t\t\tand es.schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t\t\torder by t.task_seq asc  \tif @ret_val is null \tbegin \t\tset @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 \tend  \treturn @ret_val ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_next_task_seq_copy", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_next_task_seq_copy @event_id bigint, @cond_seq int as declare @ret_val int  \tselect top 1 @ret_val = task_seq from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq  order by  task_seq desc  \tif @ret_val is null \tbegin \t\tset @ret_val = -1 \tend  \tset @ret_val = @ret_val +1  \treturn @ret_val ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id bigint, @cond_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_platform_for_bootoption_id", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_platform_for_bootoption_id    @bootopt_id  int as \tdeclare @bootopt_type int  \tif (@bootopt_id = 1 or @bootopt_id is null) \tbegin \t\tselect @bootopt_id = default_boot_option from database_info \tend  \tselect @bootopt_type = bootoption_type from boot_options where bootoption_id = @bootopt_id  \treturn @bootopt_type ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@bootopt_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_pxe_computerid", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sel_pxe_computerid] \t@uuid varchar(64), \t@macid varchar(36), \t@serial varchar(80), \t@ip varchar(16) AS BEGIN \t--SELECT computer_id FROM computer a \t--WHERE \t \t--\ta.serial_num like @serial or  \t--\ta.uuid = @uuid and \t\t \t--\ta.computer_id in  \t--\t\t( select b.computer_id from nics b  \t--\t\twhere b.mac_addr = @macid) or \t--\ta.computer_id in \t--\t\t( select c.id from nic_interface c \t--\t\twhere c.ip like @ip )      SELECT top 1 computer_id FROM nics WHERE mac_addr = @macid  END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@uuid varchar, @macid varchar, @serial varchar, @ip varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_pxe_machine_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure sel_pxe_machine_status    @start_time   datetime,    @computer_id  int = 0 as    if (@computer_id != 0)    begin       exec upd_next_task_seq @start_time \t\tselect c.serial_num, c.asset_tag, c.uuid, n.mac_addr, coalesce ( \t\t        (select 'Automation' from event_schedule es \t\t         \twhere es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id \t\t            and (es.event_id in (select it.event_id from image_task it \t\t                                 where it.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and it.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and it.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from registry_task rt \t\t                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from unattended_install_task rt \t\t                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t            or es.event_id in (select st.event_id from script_task st \t\t                                 where st.event_id = es.event_id \t\t                                    and st.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t\t                                    and st.task_seq = es.next_task_seq \t\t                                    and st.execution_mode = 0) \t\t\t\t\tor es.event_id in (select w.event_id from wait_task w \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t where w.event_id = es.event_id \t\t\t\t\t                        and w.cond_seq = es.cond_seq                                             and w.task_seq = es.next_task_seq))), \t         (select 'Reboot' from event_schedule es \t            where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id \t               and (es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from reboot_task rt \t                                    where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t                                       and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t                                       and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) \t\t\t\t   or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from config_task rt \t                                    where rt.event_id = es.event_id \t                                       and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq \t                                       and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq))), \t\t         'Production') as 'boot', 0 as 'count', {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    declare @tmprowscount   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction      \t\tselect @tmprowscount = count(event_id) from copyfile_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from script_task where   username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(distinct event_id) from install_task where (username = @username and password = @oldpassword) or \t\t   (exec_username = @username and exec_password = @oldpassword)  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  \t\tselect @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from capture_pct_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_task_scheduled", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure sel_task_scheduled    @computer_id   int as    declare @tsk_type as int     select @tsk_type = task_type from task ts, event_schedule es where es.event_id = ts.event_id \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.cond_seq = ts.cond_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.next_task_seq = ts.task_seq \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.status_code = -1 \t\t\t\t\t\t\tand es.computer_id = @computer_id  return @tsk_type ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_tc_job_tree", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_tc_job_tree    @SoftwarePackages varchar(50),    @nFolderIcon int,    @nBaseIcon int as \tdeclare @software_packages_folder_id int  \tdeclare @job_folder table \t(\t \t\tfolder_id int \t)  \t--Make sure we have a Software Packages folder under Thin Client System folder \tselect @software_packages_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder  \t\twhere parent_id = 1000009 and name = @SoftwarePackages \tif @software_packages_folder_id is null \tbegin \t\texec @software_packages_folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID' \t\tinsert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, name) values (@software_packages_folder_id, 1000009, @SoftwarePackages) \tend  \tdeclare @tmp_folder_id int \tdeclare folder_cursor cursor for select folder_id from @job_folder  \tinsert into @job_folder (folder_id) values (@software_packages_folder_id)  \topen folder_cursor \tfetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id  \tselect @tmp_folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  \twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \tbegin \t\t--add any subfolders \t\tinsert into @job_folder (folder_id) select ef.folder_id from event_folder ef where ef.parent_id = @tmp_folder_id\t\t \t\tfetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id \tend  \tclose folder_cursor \tdeallocate folder_cursor  \tdelete from @job_folder where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  \t--Get the imediate child folders of @software_packages_folder_id    select       folder_id,       null,        200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union \t--Get the sub folders of @software_packages_folder_id's children folders    select       folder_id,       parent_id,       200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    union \t--Get immediate child jobs of @software_packages_folder_id    select\t       event_id,       null,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union \t--Get jobs from @software_packages_folder_id's child folders    select       event_id,       folder_id,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    order by 2, 6, 5, 1 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@SoftwarePackages varchar, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_unattend_task_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure sel_unattend_task_data     @event_id int,     @cond_seq int,     @task_seq int as    select t3.active, t3.value, t3.value_id, t3.vars_id, t3.vars_name, t3.type, t1.unattend_section_id as section_id,          t1.name as section_name, t3.unattend_id   from unattended_install_task t2, unattend_section t1   left join (select t1.event_id as [event_id], t1.cond_seq as [cond_seq], t1.task_seq as [task_seq], t1.active as [active],                     t1.unattend_vars_value as [value], t1.unattend_vars_value_id as [value_id],                     t2.unattend_vars_id as [vars_id], t2.name as [vars_name], t2.type as [type],                     t1.unattend_txt_data_id as [unattend_id], t3.unattend_section_id as section_id              from unattend_txt_data t1, unattend_vars t2, unattend_section t3, unattend_vars_value t4              where t1.unattend_vars_value_id = t4.unattend_vars_value_id and t4.unattend_vars_id = t2.unattend_vars_id and                    t2.unattend_section_id = t3.unattend_section_id) t3   on t3.section_id=t1.unattend_section_id and t3.event_id=@event_id and t3.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t3.task_seq=@task_seq   where t1.unattend_setup_id=t2.unattend_setup_id and t2.event_id=@event_id and t2.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t2.task_seq=@task_seq order by t1.unattend_section_id   ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "sel_wol_computer", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure sel_wol_computer    @computer_id      int,    @wol_support      int = null as  if (@wol_support is null or @wol_support = '')       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id    else       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.wol_support = 1                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id \t       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @wol_support int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_computer_ip_mac_addr", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_computer_ip_mac_addr    @computer_id         int,    @ip_addr             varchar (512),    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @nic_id              int = 0 as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = @nic_id     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, ip) values (@computer_id, @nic_id, @ip_addr)    else    begin      if (@ip_addr is not null) \t\tupdate nic_interface set ip = @ip_addr where interface_id = @interface_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @ip_addr varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @nic_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_computer_nic_pci", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure [dbo].[upd_computer_nic_pci] @PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar(128) as declare @nNicId int declare @nConfigItemId int begin transaction  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  \tand nic_pci_bus = @PciBus     and nic_pci_device = @PciDevice     and nic_pci_function = @PciFunction \tand mac_addr = @strMacaddr \t  if(@nNicId is not NULL) begin \tcommit transaction \treturn end  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  \tand nic_pci_bus is NULL      and nic_pci_device is NULL     and nic_pci_function is NULL   if(@nNicId is NULL) begin \tcommit transaction \treturn end  if exists (select n.computer_id from nics n where n.mac_addr = @strMacaddr) \t\tupdate nics set mac_addr = null where mac_addr = @strMacaddr  update nics set nic_pci_device = @PciDevice, \t\t\t\tnic_pci_bus = @PciBus, \t\t\t\tnic_pci_function = @PciFunction, \t\t\t\tmac_addr = @strMacaddr where nic_id = @nNicId and computer_id = @computer_id  if (@@error != 0) \t\trollback transaction \telse \t\tcommit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_deferred_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_deferred_schedule \t@schedule_id int, \t@start_time datetime, \t@current_time datetime, \t@status varchar( 256 ), \t@status_module smallint as     declare @comp_id int  \t-- make sure the schedule is valid \tselect @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id \tif( @comp_id is null ) \tbegin \t   return \tend  \tbegin transaction  \t-- update the event schedule table \tupdate event_schedule \t\tset status_code = null, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, \t\t\tstart_time = @start_time, status = @status \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t-- now insert stuff into the log data \texec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, -1, -1, @status_module  \t-- erase old wol info \texec upd_computer_wol_info @comp_id, null  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tcommit transaction \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_cond_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_cond_seq    @schedule_id   int,    @cond_seq      int,    @status_code   int = NULL,    @status        varchar (254) = NULL,    @exit_code     int = NULL,    @exit_module   smallint = NULL as \tif (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) \t\tset @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is NULL and @status_code is NULL)       update event_schedule set cond_seq = @cond_seq where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else    begin       update event_schedule \t\tset cond_seq = @cond_seq, status_code = @status_code, \t\t\tstatus = @status, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module \t\twhere schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @cond_seq int, @status_code int, @status varchar, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_config_choice", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_config_choice    @schedule_id      int,    @config_choice_id int = null,    @status_code      int = null,    @status           varchar(254) = null as    begin transaction     if (@config_choice_id = 0)    begin       declare @comp_id int \t  select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id       update computer set domain_name = 'WORKGROUP', domain_member = 0 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  if exists (select 1 from nics where computer_id = @comp_id and nic_id = 0) \t\tupdate nics set ip_use_dhcp = 1 where computer_id = @comp_id \t  else \t\tinsert nics (computer_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp) values (@comp_id, 0, 1)    end     if (@status_code is NULL and @status is NULL)    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id,              status_code = @status_code,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @config_choice_id int, @status_code int, @status varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_init_deploy", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_init_deploy    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    begin transaction     update event_schedule set start_time = @start_time       where event_id = @event_id          and next_task_seq > -1          and status_code is null \t\t and cond_seq is null \t\t and initial_deployment = 1     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @start_time datetime)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq    @schedule_id      int,    @next_task_seq    int,    @status_code      smallint,    @exit_code        int,    @exit_module      smallint,    @status           varchar(254),    @current_time     datetime,    @module           smallint,    @level            smallint,    @taskresult       int as begin     if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0)         set @status_code = 1      declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount      if( 0 = @tran )         begin transaction  \tDECLARE   @dependent_id   int     SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id      IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL AND @status_code IS NULL AND @status = 'Error ' + LTRIM(@exit_code) + ' during script execution')     BEGIN         DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @dependent_id          SELECT @status = 'Scheduled Job [' + @eventname + '] Due To Return Code Handler: ' + LTRIM(@exit_code)     END      -- update status_log table with schedule info     exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level, @taskresult      -- now insert and fix up history for this item     exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id      -- now update the event_schedule table     update event_schedule         set next_task_seq = @next_task_seq,         status = @status,         status_code = @status_code,         exit_code = @exit_code,         exit_module = @exit_module,         config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null }     where schedule_id = @schedule_id      if( 0 = @tran )     begin         if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction         else             commit transaction     end end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @next_task_seq int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @taskresult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_schedule_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_schedule_status    @schedule_id   int,    @status_code   smallint,    @exit_code\t   int,    @exit_module   smallint,    @status        varchar(254),    @broker_time   datetime,    @module        smallint,    @level         smallint,    @log_event     smallint = 0 as    declare @upd_status_code smallint     -- we need to remember the status code that was passed in, but if it's null,    -- we want to get the status code that is currently in the event schedule.    set @upd_status_code = @status_code     if (@upd_status_code is null and @log_event = 1)       select @upd_status_code = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     if (@exit_code is not null ) and ( @exit_code != 0 ) and ( @status_code is not null ) and       ( @status_code > 0 )    begin       set @status_code = 1    end     begin transaction     if (@broker_time is null)    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, \t\t\texit_code = @exit_code, \t\t\texit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status,             broker_time = @broker_time          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id  \t--LB#40844        if( @status_code >= 0 )       \t begin      \t\texec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@broker_time        \tend    end     -- use the passed in status code for this function, unlike above where we use our    -- adjusted @use_status_code var.  This is so we can save exit_codes without    -- killing the status_code in the event schedule table.    exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @broker_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @broker_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @log_event smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_event_status", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_event_status    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36),    @schedule_id   int,    @task_seq      int,    @status        varchar(254),    @status_code   int as    if (@status is null and @status_code is null)       return     begin transaction     if (@status_code is not null and @status is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code,             status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else if (@status_code is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else       update event_schedule          set status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq     if (@@error = 0)       commit transaction    else       rollback transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @status varchar, @status_code int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_ghostcast_setting", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghostcast_setting]    @event_id\tint,    @ghostcast_setting varchar(10) as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     set @ghostcast_setting = ' ' + @ghostcast_setting     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  \t  update image_task set ghcastsrv_cmdline =  \t  case   when CHARINDEX(' -N',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -N%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -T',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -T%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  \t\t\t when CHARINDEX(' -O',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -O%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)           END \t  where event_id = @event_id and ghcastsrv_cmdline is not NULL             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @ghostcast_setting varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_task_password", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure upd_task_password    @username\t\tvarchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128),    @newpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction  \t\tupdate    copyfile_task \t\tset       password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    script_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    install_task \t\tset          exec_password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (exec_username) = lower (@username)) and (exec_password = @oldpassword) \t\t--the install_task.username and install_task.exec_username appear to always be the same so do not add to the count set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  \t\tupdate    capture_pct_task \t\tset          password =@newpassword \t\twhere     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) \t\tset @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar, @newpassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "upd_unattend_var", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure upd_unattend_var     @var_id int,     @default_val int,     @var_name varchar(254),     @var_desc varchar(254),     @var_type smallint,     @val_value varchar(256),     @val_displayed varchar(256) as     declare @old_type int      begin transaction      select @old_type=[type] from unattend_vars where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      update unattend_vars set [name]=@var_name, [description]=@var_desc, [type]=@var_type                        where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      if(@old_type = 0 and @var_type != 0)     begin       delete from unattend_vars_value where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and unattend_vars_value_id <> @default_val     end      if(@var_type != 0)     begin       update unattend_vars_value set [value]=@val_value, name_displayed=@val_displayed                       where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val     end      if(@var_type = 0)     begin       set @default_val=NULL        select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                       where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value] like @val_value        update unattend_vars_value set [default]=0 where unattend_vars_id=@var_id        if (@default_val is null)       begin         insert into unattend_vars_value(unattend_vars_id, [value], name_displayed, [default])                     values(@var_id, @val_value, @val_displayed, 1)          select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                     where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value]=@val_value       end       else       begin         update unattend_vars_value set [default]=1 where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val       end     end      select @default_val as [val_id], @var_id as [var_id]      commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@var_id int, @default_val int, @var_name varchar, @var_desc varchar, @var_type smallint, @val_value varchar, @val_displayed varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_condition_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_del_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item\t\t    int as    declare @minItem int    select @minItem = min(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    begin transaction       delete from condition_item  \t     where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item       if @minItem = @item       begin          select @item = min(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition          update condition_item set conjunct = -1 where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition             and item_seq = @item       end    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_config_event_for_live_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- this SP is added to fix bug #28880 create procedure wc_del_config_event_for_live_schedule    @jobId         int as    begin transaction     declare @cnt int    declare @reConfig smallint    declare @useExisting smallint     select @reConfig=ct.reconfig ,@useExisting=cs.use_existing_data     from config_set cs join config_task ct on ct.config_set_id = cs.config_set_id     where ct.event_id = @jobId     -- delete only if it is live job     if(@reConfig=1) and (@useExisting=1)    begin \t-- delete if this is scheduled on this computer only  \tselect @cnt=count(target_computer_id)  \tfrom config_item ci join config_task ct on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id  \twhere ct.event_id = @jobId         -- if no schedule on this job then delete this         if (@cnt=0) \t     exec del_event @jobId    end  \t    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_dnsSuffix", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_del_dnsSuffix    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null      as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- delete the dns_suffix data       begin transaction        \t    delete dns_suffix where [id] = @configSetId                       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction       end       else          commit transaction    end  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_dnsSuffixItem", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix create procedure wc_del_dnsSuffixItem    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint  as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this dns_suffix    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task   -- declare @config_set_id int   -- select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task      --  where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task    --declare @config_item_id int    --select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id     --  and target_computer_id = @computer     if @config_item_id is not null    begin       -- delete the dns_suffix records of configItemId       begin transaction         delete dns_suffix where [id] = @config_item_id              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_del_static_routes_config_items", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing  create procedure wc_del_static_routes_config_items    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computer\t\tint  as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this config_static_route_item    declare @config_item_id int       select @config_item_id = i.config_item_id from  config_item i,  config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computer  and i.config_set_id = t.config_set_id        and t.event_id =  @job\t        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @config_item_id is not null    begin        -- delete the static routing records of configItemId       begin transaction         delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction      end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}
