{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_generate_first_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_generate_first_computer_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64) output as    -- get the name range data from the config_set record    declare @method smallint, @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @method = cname_method, @fixed = cname_fixed, @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append,       @numbers = cname_numbers from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       if @numbers = 1 -- numeric portion       begin          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))          else             set @name = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed       end       else -- alpha portion       begin          -- convert number to ascii character values          declare @alpha varchar(64)          set @alpha = ''          while @addl >= 0          begin                         declare @dval smallint             set @dval = @addl % 26             set @addl = @addl / 26             set @alpha = @alpha + char(@dval + 97)             set @addl = @addl - 1          end          -- reverse the character order to form the final string          set @alpha = reverse(@alpha)          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + @alpha          else             set @name = @alpha + @fixed       end    end    else       set @name = null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_have_computer_for_vm", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_have_computer_for_vm    @vm_uuid varchar(128),    @host_uuid varchar(128),    @vc_computer varchar(256) as    declare @vm_comp_id int        select @vm_comp_id = computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)        if @vm_comp_id is not null    begin       update computer set virtual_machine_host_group_id =           (select virtual_machine_host_group_id from virtual_machine_host_group where computer = @vc_computer),          virtual_machine_host_id = (select computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@host_uuid))          where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)                 select 1    end    else    begin       select 0    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@vm_uuid varchar, @host_uuid varchar, @vc_computer varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_ip    @ip varchar(16),    @ip_out varchar(16) output as    -- break the IP address into integer octet values    declare @octet1 int, @octet2 int, @octet3 int, @octet4 int    declare @dot_index1 int, @dot_index2 int    select @dot_index1 = charindex('.', @ip)    set @octet1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @dot_index1 - 1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index1 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet2 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet3 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = len(@ip)    set @octet4 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - (@dot_index1 - 1)) as int)     -- increment octet values as needed to increment the ip    if @octet4 < 255       set @octet4 = @octet4 + 1    else    begin       set @octet4 = 1       if @octet3 < 255          set @octet3 = @octet3 + 1       else       begin          set @octet3 = 0          if @octet2 < 255             set @octet2 = @octet2 + 1          else          begin             set @octet2 = 0             if @octet1 < 255                set @octet1 = @octet1 + 1             else             begin                set @octet1 = 1                set @octet2 = 1                set @octet3 = 1                set @octet4 = 1             end          end       end    end     set @ip_out = cast(@octet1 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet2 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet3 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet4 as varchar(3)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ip varchar, @ip_out varchar OUT)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_increment_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_increment_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64),    @name_out varchar(64) output as    -- Get the name range information from the config_set record    declare @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append, @numbers = cname_numbers,       @fixed = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id    if len(@name) = 0       exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @config_set_id, @name     -- Split the fixed and variable text in the @name passed in    declare @variable_text varchar(64)    declare @fixed_pos int    set @fixed_pos = charindex(@fixed, @name)    if @fixed_pos > 1 -- prefix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, 1, @fixed_pos - 1)    else -- postfix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, len(@fixed) + 1, len(@name) - len(@fixed))           -- Increment the @variable_text    if @numbers = 1    begin       -- numeric variable       set @addl = cast(@variable_text as smallint) + 1       if @append = 1          set @name_out = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))       else          set @name_out = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed    end    else    begin       -- alpha variable       -- test for all Z characters       set @variable_text = upper(@variable_text)       declare @z_count int, @z_loc int       set @z_loc = 0       set @z_count = 0       set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text)       while @z_loc > 0       begin          set @z_count = @z_count + 1          set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text, @z_loc + 1)       end       if len(@variable_text) = @z_count       begin          -- reset to all A characters and add A to the end          set @name_out = replace(@variable_text, 'Z', 'A')          set @name_out = @variable_text + 'A'       end       else       begin          -- advance all needed characters          declare @addl_out varchar(64)          set @addl_out = ''                    declare @char int          declare @increment_done smallint          set @increment_done = 0          while len(@variable_text) > 0          begin             set @char = ascii(substring(@variable_text, len(@variable_text), 1))             if @increment_done = 0             begin                if @char = 90                   set @char = 65                else                begin                   set @char = @char + 1                   set @increment_done = 1                end             end              set @addl_out = @addl_out + char(@char)              if len(@variable_text) > 1                set @variable_text = substring(@variable_text, 1, len(@variable_text) - 1)             else                set @variable_text = ''          end          set @addl_out = reverse(@addl_out)          if @append = 1             set @name_out = @fixed + @addl_out          else             set @name_out = @addl_out + @fixed       end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar, @name_out varchar OUT)"}

declare @single int       set @single = @bayIdx       if @bayIdx is null          select @bayIdx = max(idx) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @missingBay smallint {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS setting for nic    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- get the highest nic_id from existing nic_config_item records    declare @maxNicId int    select @maxNicId = max(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId     -- test for valid records    declare @nicId int    set @nicId = @maxNicId    if @configItemId is not null and @maxNicId is not null    begin       -- generate the generic NIC description       set @nicId = @nicId + 2       declare @nicDesc varchar(64)       set @nicDesc = 'Network Adapter ' + cast(@nicId as varchar)        -- insert the new nic_config_item record       begin transaction          insert into nic_config_item (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, ip_domain, ip_dns,              ip_wins, nic_desc, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp) values (@configItemId, @nicId, @ipMethod, @domainSuffix, @dns,             @wins, @nicDesc, @netbios, @dns_use_dhcp, @wins_use_dhcp)              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end        -- return the new nic_id or -1 on error    select @nicId as nic_id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- give unnamed intefaces a default name    if @name is null    begin       declare @maxInterface varchar(64)       select @maxInterface = max([name]) from nic_interface where [id] = @id and          nic_id = @nicId       declare @colonIndex int       select @colonIndex = charindex(@maxInterface, ':')       if @colonIndex > 0       begin          declare @numLen int          select @numLen = len(@maxInterface) - @colonIndex          declare @num varchar(7)          set @colonIndex = @colonIndex + 1          select @num = substring(@maxInterface, @colonIndex, @numLen)          declare @interfaceNum int          set @interfaceNum = cast(@num as int)          if @interfaceNum is null             set @interfaceNum = 0          else             set @interfaceNum = @interfaceNum + 1          set @name = 'eth' + cast(@nicId as varchar) + ':' + cast(@interfaceNum as varchar)       end    end     -- check for duplicate IP Interface name    declare @nameMatch varchar(64)    select @nameMatch = [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId       and [name] like @name    if @nameMatch is null    begin       -- add the IP interface       begin transaction          insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway,              broadcast, state) values (@id, @nicId, @name, @ip, @netmask,              @gateway, @broadcast, @state)       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_nic_config_set_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_set_interface    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @nicId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface            select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- give unnamed intefaces a default name    if @name is null    begin       declare @maxInterface varchar(64)       select @maxInterface = max([name]) from nic_interface where [id] = @id and          nic_id = @nicId       declare @colonIndex int       select @colonIndex = charindex(@maxInterface, ':')       if @colonIndex > 0       begin          declare @numLen int          select @numLen = len(@maxInterface) - {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_ins_pct_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder with level as 1 in temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder with level = level + 1 and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table \tFind max level value which will be max depth for given folder */  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x  @folder_id as int  as  --This SP is same as wc_sel_child_folder_depth but for import where tables are different.  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (\tfolder_id int, \t[name] varchar(64), \t[level]\tint )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from x_event_folder where parent_id =@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id,[name],[level]  \tfrom @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder_depth \tselect folder_id, [name], @level + 1 \tfrom x_event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_child_folders", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folders \t@parent_id int as \tif @parent_id = -10 \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id is null \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect * from event_folder where parent_id = @parent_id \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@parent_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_comp_listview", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_comp_listview \t@id int as \tif @id = -1 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id is null and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse if @id between 5000001 and 8000000 \tbegin \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere computer_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend \telse \tbegin\t \t\tselect c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], c.icon, c.status \t\t\tfrom computer c \t\t\twhere group_id = @id and (hidden is null or hidden != 1) \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)  \texec('create table dbo.'+@branch_tablename+ \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(64), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))') \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \tif @id >= 5000001 and @id <= 8000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the computer node \t\t--exec('insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer where computer_id =' +@id) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from computer where computer_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t-- Get the group_id \t\tselect @id = group_id from computer where computer_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get groups down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -1 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the group node \t\t--insert into ##wc_branch (name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, group_id as id, 'group' as type \t\t--\tfrom computer_group where group_id = @id \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) select name, group_id as id, ''group'' as type from computer_group where group_id = @intid'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Computers'', -1, ''group'')')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResults = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_configuration", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_configuration \t@job\t\t\tint, \t@condition\t\tint, \t@task\t\t\tint, \t@computer\t\tint as \tdeclare @configSetId int \tselect @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  \t\twhere event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task \tdeclare @configItemId int \tselect @configItemId = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @configSetId \t\tand target_computer_id = @computer  \tselect * from config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId         -- Changed for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & 7.1.53 DNS Suffix         select * from dns_suffix where [id] = @configItemId         select * from config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @configItemId ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_computer_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_name    @id int as    --select computer_id as [id], [name], 'Computer' as type from computer where computer_id = @id    -- Bug #41543 - Rilo controls are missing from the all computers view in the web console     select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c \tleft outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  \twhere c.computer_id = @id ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_permissions", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of permissions for the given user and object create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_permissions    @userId int,    @objectId int as    declare @permission int     --create temp table    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_permissions') is not null       drop table ##wc_last_effective_permissions    create table dbo.##wc_last_effective_permissions (permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)        --get permissions that apply to the object    if @objectId = 2000001 --init_deploy       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where initial_deployment = 1    else if (@objectId >= 1 and @objectId < 1000001) or @objectId = -1 --comp_group, ALL_COMPUTERS       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer_group = 1    else if @objectId = -7 --new_comp_group       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where new_computer_group = 1    else if @objectId >= 5000001 and @objectId <= 8000000 --comp       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer = 1    else if (@objectId >= 11000001 and @objectId < 14000001) or @objectId = -9 --physical_device       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where physical_device = 1    else if @objectId >= 1000001 and @objectId < 2000001 or @objectId = -10 --event_folder       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event_folder = 1    else if @objectId > 2000001 and @objectId < 3000001 --event       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event = 1    else       goto DONE        declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @permissionType varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0      select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights     open permissions_cursor    fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each permission       if @isAdmin > 0 --@isAdmin = 1 When user has admin rights and gets admin rights from one or more admin groups.       begin          select @permissionType = [name] from securitypermission where permission_id = @permission          insert into ##wc_last_effective_permissions values (@permission, 1, @permissionType, @fromAdmin, @permSource,'Administrative Rights', 'Administrative Group',0, @fromGroup)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_permission @userId, @permission, @objectId, 0        fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission    end          -- cleanup cursor    close permissions_cursor    deallocate permissions_cursor     DONE:  --select temp table     select * from ##wc_last_effective_permissions ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @objectId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_effective_rights", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     --return a dataset of rights for the user create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_rights     @userId int, \t@tableName varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights' as    declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @rightName varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once    -- Bug #63690     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0,@tableName      --select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights    declare\t@sql    nvarchar(512), \t\t\t@params nvarchar(512) \t\t\t \tset @sql = 'select @SqlisAdmin = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource, @SqlfromGroup = fromGroup from '+@tableName \t \tset @params = N'@SqlisAdmin int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromAdmin smallint OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlpermSource int OUTPUT, ' + \t\t\t\t  N'@SqlfromGroup int OUTPUT' \t\t\t\t \texec sp_executesql @sql,@params,@SqlisAdmin=@isAdmin output, @SqlfromAdmin = @fromAdmin output, @SqlpermSource=@permSource output, @SqlfromGroup=@fromGroup output      --make sure temp table is empty    -- Bug #63690    --if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is not null    --   delete from ##wc_last_effective_rights    if object_id(''+@tableName+'') is not null \texec('delete from '+@tableName)        declare rights_cursor cursor for          select privilege_id, [name]          from securityprivilege     open rights_cursor    fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each right       if @isAdmin = 1       begin          select @rightName = [name] from securityprivilege where privilege_id = @right          -- Bug #63690          --insert into ##wc_last_effective_rights values (@right, 1, @rightName, @fromAdmin, @permSource, @fromGroup)          declare @sqlQuery as varchar(128) \t\t set @sqlQuery = 'insert into '+ @tableName +' values ('+cast(@right as varchar(10))+',1,'''+@rightName+''','+cast(@fromAdmin as varchar(10))+','+cast(@permSource as varchar(10))+','+cast(@fromGroup as varchar(10))+')' \t\t exec (@sqlQuery)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_right @userId, @right, 0,@tableName        fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName    end          -- cleanup cursor    close rights_cursor    deallocate rights_cursor      --select temp table   -- Bug #63690    --select * from ##wc_last_effective_rights    exec ('select * from '+@tableName) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @tableName varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_enclosure_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_enclosure_children    @id int as    -- get computers in the bays in the enclosure passed in    -- Bug #41543    select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type,'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end        from physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id        where e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and e.enclosure_id = @id       and b.computer_id = c.computer_id and b.initial_event_id is null ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_computers_9x", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_find_computers_9x    @search varchar(128) as    select a.computer_id as id, a.name, a.icon, a.status from computer a     where (a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows 95%')        or a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows 98%')        or a.computer_id in (select uf.computer_id from computer uf where uf.os like '%Windows Millennium%'))       and (a.name like @search or        a.computer_name like @search or        a.ip_hostname like @search or        a.logged_on_user like @search or        a.lic_os_user like @search or        a.serial_num like @search or        a.asset_tag like @search or        a.uuid like @search or        a.os like @search or        a.computer_id like @search or        a.computer_id in           ( select b.computer_id from nics b           where b.mac_addr like @search) or       a.computer_id in          ( select c.id from nic_interface c          where c.ip like @search )) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@search varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_sel_find_jobs_by_task    @phrase varchar(128),    @task smallint,    @folderid int as \tif @folderid > -10 \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) -- Don't get Initial Deployment \t\t\tand a.folder_id = @folderid \telse \t\tselect a.event_id, a.name, a.master_server  \t\tfrom event a  \t\twhere a.event_id <> 2000001 and ( (a.name like @phrase or a.description like @phrase) \t\t\tand a.event_id in (select distinct(event_id) from task where task_type = @task )) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@phrase varchar, @task smallint, @folderid int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(128),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subfolder table (for folder IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folders_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_folders_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_folders_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @id        -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end     -- loop through subfolders to gather all children job IDs    declare @subfolder int    select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    while @subfolder is not null    begin       -- get subfolders of this folder       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @subfolder       -- remove this folder from subfolder table       delete from #wc_folders_to_check where [id] = @subfolder       -- get jobs in this folder -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @subfolder       -- get the next subfolder       set @subfolder = null       select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folder_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id = @id       -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_folderlevel", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.66 Copy job folder create procedure wc_sel_folderlevel  @folder_id int, @level int =1 as \tdeclare @parent_id int \tselect @parent_id=parent_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id \tif @parent_id is not null \tbegin \t\tset @level=@level+1 \t\texec wc_sel_folderlevel @parent_id, @level \tend \telse \t\tselect @level ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int, @level int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create  -- get the next subgroup       set @subgroup = null       select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_group_children_state", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer/group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state           from computer where group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer where group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_history", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- PRD item 7.1.46 Allow Administrator to Delete History create procedure dbo.wc_sel_history \t @computer_id \t\tint as \tselect  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id,s.complete_time, s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.user_log, l.user_name, h.app_id,ea.alias,ea.app_path,ea.description, \tconvert(varchar(30),s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time  --Bug #33984 \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id              left outer  join  loggedon_users l on \t\t  s.system_logon_user_id = l.user_id \tleft join external_application ea  \t\ton h.app_id=ea.app_id \t  \twhere (s.status_code is not null)  and    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id)  \torder by h.history_id desc  select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id, h.task_type, h.complete_time, s.[module], s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,\t \ts.status_code, s.status, s.complete_time,s.level,s.return_code_result, \tconvert(varchar(30), s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time, --Bug #33984 \txml_task \tfrom     history_view h inner join \tstatus_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id \twhere    \t(h.computer_id = @computer_id ) and h.history_id in (select history_id from status_log_view where status_code is not null)  --Bug #33984 \torder by h.complete_time desc ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_job_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_branch \t@id int, \t@selectResults int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) \tif object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null \t\texec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename) \t\t \texec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename + \t\t'([level] \tint IDENTITY, \t \t name \t\tvarchar(128), \t\t id\t\t\tint NOT NULL, \t\t type\t\tvarchar(8))')  \tif @id >= 2000001 and @id <= 3000000 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the job node \t\tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \t\tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event where event_id = @intid'  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int' \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id  \t\t \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t--\tselect name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event where event_id ='+ @intid)  \t\t-- Get the folder_id \t\tselect @id = folder_id from event where event_id = @id \tend\t  \t-- Get folders down branch to root node \twhile @id is not null and @id != -10 \tbegin \t\t-- Get the folder node \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  \t\t\t\t\t\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t\t\t\t\tfrom event_folder where folder_id = @intid';  \t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid=@id ; \t\t--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t--\tselect name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type \t\t--\tfrom event_folder where folder_id =' + @id) \t\t \t\t-- Get the parent_id \t\tdeclare @oldId int \t\tset @oldId = @id \t\tset @id = null \t\tselect @id = parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @oldId \tend  \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) \t\t values (''All Jobs'', -10, ''folder'')')\t-- Return the completed branch list  \tif @selectResults = 1 \t\texec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_license_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_license_info as    --select * from license_info    --Bug #28067    \tselect remain_days, total_days,serial_number, server as totalserver, client as totalclient, pda as totalpda, nodes as totalnodes  from license_info \t \t--1 \tselect count (computer_id) as server from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 1 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--2 \tselect count (computer_id) as client from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 3 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--3 \tselect count (computer_id) as pda from computer  where (limited_license = 0) and  \tnode_type = 2 and (( prod_name not like '%hp t5%' and prod_name not like '%futro%' ) or  \tprod_name is null) and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where  \tmac_addr is null)  \t--7 total \tselect count (computer_id) as nodes from computer  where limited_license = 0 and  \tcomputer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_physical_device_children", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_physical_device_children    @id int -- this param is for compatability and is not used in the procedure as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_physical_device_children') is not null       drop table #wc_physical_device_children    create table dbo.#wc_physical_device_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543     -- iterate through all of the racks    declare @rackId int    declare rack_cursor cursor for       select rack_id from physical_rack    open rack_cursor    fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- get computers in the bays in the enclosures in this rack       -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_physical_device_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)             select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end              from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  \t\tleft outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  \t\tleft outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id              where r.rack_id = e.rack_id and r.rack_id = @rackId              and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and b.computer_id = c.computer_id              and b.initial_event_id is null       -- get next rack ID       fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    end    -- cleanup cursor    close rack_cursor    deallocate rack_cursor     select * from #wc_physical_device_children ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_reb_branch", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_reb_branch    @id int,    @selectResult int = 1 as \tdeclare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) \tset @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))    if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null       exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)     exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename +       '([level] int IDENTITY,        [name] varchar(64),        [id] int NOT NULL,        type varchar(20))')  \tdeclare @strsql nvarchar(500) \tdeclare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500)    -- If node is a Bay    if @id >= 13000001 and @id <= 14000000    begin       -- Get the bay node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)          -- select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type         -- from physical_bay where bay_id = @id') \t\t \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_bay where bay_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ;        -- Get the enclosure_id       select @id = enclosure_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @id    end\t     -- If node is an Enclosure    if @id >= 12000001 and @id <= 13000000    begin       -- Get the enclosure node      -- exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)         -- select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type         -- from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id') \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t       -- Get the rack_id       select @id = rack_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id    end     -- If node is a Rack    if @id >= 11000001 and @id <= 12000000    begin       -- Get the rack node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename +'([name], [id], type)        --  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type        --  from physical_rack where rack_id = @id')  \t\tset @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  \t\t\t\t\t  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type \t\t\t\t\t  from physical_rack where rack_id = @intid'; \t\t\tset @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; \t\t\texecute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; \t\t    end     -- Add Physical Devices node    --insert into @branch_tablename ([name], [id], type)      -- select 'Physical Devices' as [name], -9 as [id], 'physical devices' as type \texec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)       select ''Physical Devices'' as [name], -9 as [id], ''physical devices'' as type')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResult = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + 'order by [level] desc') ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResult int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_required_domains", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_required_domains  \t@jobids    varchar(8000), \t@compids    varchar(8000)  as \t--Query on config_set and Config_item table to fetch all required domains. \tselect lower(msnet_domain_name) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_domain_name is not null and msnet_domain_name <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_set  \t\twhere  \t\tmsnet_dns_domain is not null and msnet_dns_domain <>'' \t\tand config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \tunion \tselect lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \tunion \tselect lower(domain_name) as domain from config_item, config_task  \t\twhere (msnet_dns_domain is null or msnet_dns_domain='')  \t\tand config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand domain_member=1 \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id \t\tand reconfig =1  \t\tand target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) \t \t--Query to check whether we should check for computer domain information \t-- IF count is > 0  then check for computer domains as well \tselect count(*) from config_set, config_task  \twhere \tconfig_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) \t\tand config_task.config_set_id = config_set.config_set_id \t\tand ((use_existing_data=1 and msnet_is_domain_member is null) or (msnet_is_domain_member=1 and ((msnet_domain_name ='' or msnet_domain_name is null) and ( msnet_dns_domain ='' or msnet_dns_domain is null) )) or (use_existing_data=1 and reconfig=1))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar, @compids varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_codes", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_codes    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    \tint as    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_return_code') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_return_code  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_return_code \t\t(code\t\tvarchar(11), \t\t handler\t\tint, \t\t result \t\tint, \t\t status   varchar(256))  \t-- store the default handler \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect 'default' as code, on_fail as handler, on_fail as result, null as status \t\tfrom task where event_id=@jobId and   \t\tcond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq  \t-- get the rest of the handlers \tinsert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) \t\tselect ret_code as code, handler, result, status from task_return_handlers \t\twhere event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and\ttask_seq=@taskSeq  \tselect * from ##wc_return_code ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_return_handler_jobs", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_handler_jobs    @jobId int as    -- make a temporary table to store the IDs in    if object_id ('#wc_handler_ids') is null       create table dbo.#wc_handler_ids (job int, primary key (job))    -- store the calling job    insert into #wc_handler_ids values (@jobId)     -- declare needed variables    declare @newJobCount int    declare @handler int    declare @job int    declare @fail int     -- loop through all discovered jobs repeatedly until no new linked jobs are found    set @newJobCount = 1    while @newJobCount > 0    begin       set @newJobCount = 0       -- make a cursor to step through all discovered jobs       declare job_cursor cursor for          select job from #wc_handler_ids       open job_cursor       fetch next from job_cursor into @job       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          -- loop through the linked jobs          -- make a cursor to step through all linked task_return_handlers jobs          declare handler_cursor cursor for             select distinct(handler) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @job                and handler > 2000000 and handler < 3000001 and handler not in --Bug 27827                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open handler_cursor          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@handler)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          end          -- cleanup cursor          close handler_cursor          deallocate handler_cursor           -- make a cursor to step through all linked on_fail jobs          declare fail_cursor cursor for             select distinct(on_fail) from task where event_id = @job                and on_fail > 2000000 and on_fail < 3000001 and event_id not in                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open fail_cursor          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@fail)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          end          -- cleanup cursor          close fail_cursor          deallocate fail_cursor                  fetch next from job_cursor into @job       end       -- cleanup cursor       close job_cursor       deallocate job_cursor    end     -- return the list of jobs discovered    select job from #wc_handler_ids    drop table #wc_handler_ids ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_schedule1", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_sel_schedule1 \t@schedule int as \tdeclare @user int \tselect @user = su.[user_id] from securityuser su, event_schedule es  \twhere es.schedule_id = @schedule and es.[user_id] = su.[user_id]  \tif @user is null \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\t'gznFiP' as 'user_name', 'gznFiP' as user_full_name, '' as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tselect s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  \t\t\ts.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  \t\t\ts.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  \t\t\tu.[name] as 'user_name', u.fullname as user_full_name, u.domain as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  \t\t\ts.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  \t\tfrom event_schedule s, computer c, event e, securityuser u \t\twhere s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule \t\t\tand u.[user_id] = s.[user_id] \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_security_authenticate", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_authenticate \t@username \t\tvarchar(64), \t@password\t\tvarchar(64), \t@domain\t\t\tvarchar(50) = null, \t@upnname\t\tvarchar(128) = null as \tdeclare @authenticated tinyint \tset @authenticated = 0 \t \tdeclare @matchUser\tvarchar(64)         declare @matchUPN\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchPwd\tvarchar(64) \tdeclare @matchNetdom    varchar(64) \tdeclare @userId\tint \tdeclare @ad_user smallint  \tif @domain is not null and len(@domain) > 0 \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for  \t\t\tselect [name], upnname, domain, netbiosdomain, [user_id]  \t\t\tfrom securityuser \t\t\twhere (deleted is null or deleted=0) --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\t\t\t\t\t \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif (@matchUser = @username or @matchUPN = @upnname) and (upper(@domain) = upper(@matchPwd) or upper(@matchNetdom) = upper(@domain)) -- @matchPwd is the domain name \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \telse \tbegin \t\tdeclare secuser_cursor cursor for select [name], [password], [user_id], ad_user from securityuser  where deleted is null or deleted=0  --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI \t\topen secuser_cursor \t \t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\twhile @@fetch_status = 0 \t\tbegin \t\t\tif @matchUser = @username and @matchPwd = @password and @ad_user = 0 \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tset @authenticated = 1 \t\t\t\tbreak \t\t\tend \t\t\tfetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user \t\tend\t \t\tclose secuser_cursor \t\tdeallocate secuser_cursor \tend \t \tif @authenticated = 1 and len(@domain) > 0 \t\tset @authenticated = 2 \telse  \t\tset @matchUser = @username --Bug #39428  \tselect @authenticated as authenticated, @userId as [user_id], @matchUser as securityuser ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar, @domain varchar, @upnname varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_tasktype", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure dbo.wc_sel_tasktype \t@folder_id as int as /* \tselect all child folder of current folder  temp table. \tFor each this folder find child folder and store this in temp table. \trepeat this step for all rows in temp table\t */  declare @tbl_folder table (\tfolder_id int\t )   insert into @tbl_folder select folder_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for \tselect folder_id \tfrom @tbl_folder  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id while @@fetch_status = 0 begin \tinsert into @tbl_folder \tselect folder_id \tfrom event_folder \twhere parent_id=@folder_id\t  \tfetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select count(t.folder_id),count(e.event_id) from @tbl_folder t,event e where e.folder_id = t.folder_id select distinct task_type from task where task_type not in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder)) select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type from task where task_type in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder))  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_taskusers_count", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.14 Centrally Managed Task Password create procedure wc_sel_taskusers_count @username varchar(128), @password varchar(128) as  declare @totalRecordCount  int declare @taskRecordCount  int  set @totalRecordCount = 0 set @taskRecordCount = 0  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from script_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from copyfile_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from install_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from capture_pct_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select @totalRecordCount ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- #32375 - Select all handheld unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld as \tif object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_handleld') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld \t\t(event_id\tint)  \tinsert into ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld \t\t-- Registory task (13), Image task (15) and Capture PCT task (18) not allowed on pocket pc \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom task  \t\twhere task_type=13 or task_type=15 or task_type=18  \t\tunion \t\t-- For pocket pc execution location of script is allowed only on DS Side  \t\tselect distinct event_id  \t\tfrom script_task  \t\twhere (location != 1)   \t\tunion \t\t-- Only reboot is allowed on pocket pc (logoff, shutdown etc not allowed) \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom reboot_task  \t\twhere (reboot_method != 1) \t\t\t \tselect event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- #32375 - Select all linux unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux  as  \tif object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_linux') is not null \t\tdrop table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux  \t-- make a temporary table \tcreate table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux \t\t(event_id\tint)  \tinsert into ##wc_unsafe_job_linux \t\t-- Registory task (13) and Capture PCT task (18) are not allowed on linux \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom task  \t\twhere task_type=13 or task_type=18 \t\t \t\tunion \t\t-- Only Reboot, Shutdown, WakeUp is allowed on linux for reboot task \t\tselect distinct event_id \t\tfrom reboot_task  \t\twhere (reboot_method = 8)  \t\t\t \tselect event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_linux ", "Metadata": null}
