{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_computer_location", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure wc_upd_computer_location    @computer_id   int,    @site          varchar(128),    @dept          varchar(128),    @mailstop      varchar(128),    @contact       varchar(128),    @email         varchar(128),    @phone         varchar(128) as    declare @compId int    select @compId = computer_id from location where computer_id=@computer_id      begin transaction    if @compId is null \tbegin  \t\tinsert into location (computer_id, site, dept, mailstop, contact,  \t\t\t\temail, phone) values (@computer_id,  @site, @dept, @mailstop, @contact, \t\t\t\t@email, @phone) \tend    else \tbegin \t\tupdate location set [site] = @site, [dept] = @dept, [mailstop] = @mailstop, \t\t\t[contact] = @contact, [email] = @email, [phone] = @phone \t\t\twhere computer_id = @computer_id \tend    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @site varchar, @dept varchar, @mailstop varchar, @contact varchar, @email varchar, @phone varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item\t\t\tint,    @field\t\t\tint,    @operation\t    int,    @value\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null,    @drive\t\t\tvarchar(8)   = null,    @conjunct\t    smallint     = -1,    @token\t\t\tvarchar(256) = null as    begin transaction        update condition_item set field_type = @field, oper_type = @operation, key_value = @value,           drive = @drive, conjunct = @conjunct, token = @token          where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint, @token varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_item_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job\t\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,    @item1\t\tint,    @item2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id \t   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  \t      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_condition_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId\t\t\tint,    @conditionId1\tint,    @conditionId2\tint as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId \t\t  and cond_seq=@tempCondId \t   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730 ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_data", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as \tupdate config_item  \tset  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  \twhere Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) \tand config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId)) ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  \t@itemId int as  \tdeclare @domain_name as varchar(512) \tdeclare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)\t  \t-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name \tselect    \t\t@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, \t\t@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))\t\t \t\twhen '' then domain_name \t\telse msnet_dns_domain \t\tend -- case \tfrom config_item  \twhere config_item_id=@itemId  \t-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it \tif @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 \tbegin \t\tselect @username=username, @password=[password]  \t\tfrom domain_accounts  \t\twhere domain=@domain_name\t\t \t \t\tupdate config_item  \t\tset  \t\tmsnet_domain_username=@username, \t\tmsnet_domain_password=@password \t\twhere config_item_id=@itemId \tend\t ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_config_item_from_comp", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_comp    @itemId      int,    @computerId  int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with computer record data    declare computer_cursor cursor for       select lic_os_user, lic_os_org, lic_os_key, ip_hostname, computer_name, domain_member,          domain_name, nw_pref_server, nw_pref_tree, nw_nds_context, nw_user_name, nw_login_to_tree,          nw_run_scripts, msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou       from computer where computer_id = @computerId    open computer_cursor    fetch next from computer_cursor       into @licOsUser, @licOsOrg, @licOsKey, @ipHostname, @computerName, @domainMember, @domainName,       @nwPrefServer, @nwPrefTree, @nwNdsContext, @nwUserName, @nwLoginToTree, @nwRunScripts,       @msnetDnsDomain, @msnetDomainOu     -- update the config_item table with the variable data    if @@fetch_status = 0    begin       update config_item set lic_os_user=@licOsUser, lic_os_org=@licOsOrg, lic_os_key=@licOsKey,          ip_hostname=@ipHostname, computer_name=@computerName, domain_member=@domainMember,          domain_name=@domainName, nw_pref_server=@nwPrefServer, nw_pref_tree=@nwPrefTree,          nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,          nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu,          target_computer_id=@computerId       where config_item_id=@itemId    end     -- cleanup cursor    close computer_cursor    deallocate computer_cursor     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Changes for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @deviceId int, @pciBus int, @pciDevice int, @pciFunction int, @vendorId int, @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @description varchar(64), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDHCP smallint, @winsDHCP smallint -- DNS/Wins DHCP for MSN    -- loop through each of the computer's nic records    declare nic_cursor cursor for       select ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device, nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id,           ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, nic_id, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp  from nics where computer_id=@computerId       order by nic_id    open nic_cursor    fetch next from nic_cursor       into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins,        @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP     -- update nic_config_item table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- make sure a nic_config_item record exists       declare @configItem int       select @configItem = count(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id=@itemId          and nic_id=@nicId       -- update existing record       if @configItem = 1       begin          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp=@useDhcp, nic_device_id=@deviceId, nic_pci_bus=@pciBus,             nic_pci_device=@pciDevice, nic_pci_function=@pciFunction, nic_vendor_id=@vendorId,             ip_dns=@ipDns, ip_wins=@ipWins, nic_desc=@description, ip_domain=@ipDomain, netbios=@netBIOS,             dns_use_dhcp = @dnsDHCP, wins_use_dhcp = @winsDHCP          where config_item_id=@itemId and nic_id=@nicId          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId                end       -- create new record       else       begin          insert into nic_config_item             (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device,              nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id, ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp)          values             (@itemId, @nicId, @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId,             @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP)          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId       end       fetch next from nic_cursor into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction,           @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP    end     -- cleanup    close nic_cursor    deallocate nic_cursor                 -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing    \t-- update existing record    \t-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    \t           delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @itemId           \t    \t-- create new records\t           \tinsert into config_static_route_item    \t\t\t      (config_item_id, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use])    \tselect    @itemId, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use]    \tfrom         static_routes where  computer_id = @computerId           -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix       \t-- update existing record    \t-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    \t    \tdelete dns_suffix where [id] = @itemId    \t-- create new records       \t    \tinsert into dns_suffix    \t\t\t      ([id], dns_suffix, [order])    \tselect    @itemId, dns_suffix, [order]    \tfrom      dns_suffix where [id] = @computerId  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @computerId int)"}

create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_set    @itemId      int,    @setId\t\tint as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @uaFullName varchar(256), @uaPassword varchar(128),       @uaGroups varchar(256), @reboot_after_config smallint    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint,       @uaMustChange smallint, @uaCannotChange smallint, @uaPwNeverExpires smallint,       @uaPrompt smallint     -- fill the variables with config_set record data    select @licOsUser = lic_os_user, nw_pref_server, @inwPrefTree = nw_pref_tree,        @inwNdsContext = nw_nds_context, @inwUserName = nw_user_name, @inwLoginToTree = nw_login_to_tree,       @inwRunScripts = nw_run_scripts, @iuaMustChange = ua_must_change, @iuaCannotChange = ua_cannot_change,        @iuaPwNeverExpires = ua_pw_never_expires, @iuaPrompt = ua_prompt       from config_item where config_item_id=@itemId         -- determine which fields to update    -- strings    if @computerName is null or len(@computerName) = 0       set @computerName = @icomputerName    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    if ((@domainName is null or len(@domainName) = 0) and (@msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0))    begin       set @domainName =     set @nwNdsContext = @inwNdsContext    if @licOsUser is null or len(@licOsUser) = 0       set @licOsUser = @ilicOsUser    if @licOsOrg is null or len(@licOsOrg) = 0       set @licOsOrg = @ilicOsOrg    if @licOsKey is null or len(@licOsKey) = 0       set @licOsKey = @ilicOsKey    if @ipHostname is null or len(@ipHostname) = 0       set @ipHostname = @iipHostname    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    --if @msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0       --set @msnetDnsDomain = @imsnetDnsDomain    if @uaUsername is null or set @uaPassword = @iuaPassword    if @uaGroups is null or len(@uaGroups) = 0       set @uaGroups = @iuaGroups    -- bools    if @domainMember is null or @domainMember = 2       set @domainMember =  if @uaMustChange is null or @uaMustChange = 2       set @uaMustChange = @iuaMustChange    if @uaCannotChange is null or @uaCannotChange = 2       set @uaCannotChange = @iuaCannotChange    if nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,       nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu, ua_pw_never_expires=@uaPwNeverExpires, msnet_domain_username=@msnetDomainUsername,        msnet_domain_password=@msnetDomainPassword, reboot_after_config = @reboot_after_config       where config_item_id=@itemId    exec wc_upd_next_name @setId, @itemId     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Change for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix declare @iuseDhcp smallint, @inetBIOS smallint          declare @iipDns varchar(512), @iipWins varchar(512), @iipDomain varchar(128)          declare @idnsDhcp smallint, @iwinsDhcp smallint {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_ip", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_ip    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int,    @nic_id int as    -- test for a static IP range    declare @master_ip varchar(16), @duplicate_ip varchar(16), @final_ip varchar(16)    declare @interface_name varchar(64)    declare @interface_id int    declare config_ip_cursor cursor for       select ip, [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @config_set_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open config_ip_cursor    declare item_ip_cursor cursor for       select interface_id from nic_interface where [id] = @config_item_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open item_ip_cursor    fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name    fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       if len(@master_ip) > 0       begin          -- test for duplicate IP usage          set @duplicate_ip = @master_ip          set @final_ip = @master_ip          declare @computer_id int          select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id          while @duplicate_ip is not null          begin             set @duplicate_ip = null             -- test for another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface where [id] >= 5000001 and [id] <= 8000000                 and [id] != @computer_id and ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                and c.target_computer_id != @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to this computer IN THIS CONFIG that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                 and c.target_computer_id = @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip and c.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and [name] != @interface_name             -- get a new IP if a duplicate was found             if @duplicate_ip is not null                exec wc_increment_ip @duplicate_ip, @final_ip output          end           -- update the config_item nic_interface ip value to the non-duplicate found          update nic_interface set ip = @final_ip where interface_id = @interface_id       end        fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name       fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    end    close config_ip_cursor    deallocate config_ip_cursor    close item_ip_cursor    deallocate item_ip_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int, @nic_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_next_name", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_name    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int as    -- test for a name range    declare @method smallint    select @method = cname_method from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       -- test for duplicate name usage       declare @duplicate_name varchar(64), @final_name varchar(64)       --PRD item 7.1.12 Use token: To remove the addition of network adapter       select @final_name = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id       if @final_name in ('%NAME%','%SERIALNUM%','%NODENAME%','%NIC1MACADDR%','%NIC2MACADDR%', \t\t\t'%NIC3MACADDR%','%NIC4MACADDR%','%NIC5MACADDR%','%NIC6MACADDR%','%NIC7MACADDR%','%NIC8MACADDR%') \t update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           \twhere config_item_id = @config_item_id       else       begin       select @final_name = computer_name from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       set @duplicate_name = @final_name       declare @computer_id int       select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       while @duplicate_name is not null       begin          set @duplicate_name = null          -- test for another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from computer where computer_name = @final_name             and computer_id != @computer_id          -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from config_item where target_computer_id != @computer_id             and computer_name = @final_name          -- get a new name if a duplicate was found          if @duplicate_name is not null             exec wc_increment_name @config_set_id, @duplicate_name, @final_name output       end       -- update the config_item computer_name, ip_hostname to the non-duplicate value generated       update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           where config_item_id = @config_item_id    end    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic \t@computer_id int, \t@mac_addr varchar(36), \t@ip_use_dhcp smallint, \t@ip_domain varchar(128), \t@ip_dns varchar(512), \t@ip_wins varchar(512), \t@nic_pci_bus int, \t@nic_pci_device int, \t@nic_pci_function int, \t@nic_device_id int, \t@nic_vendor_id int, \t@nic_desc varchar(64), \t@nic_location varchar(64), \t@interface_id int, \t@id int, \t@nic_id int, \t@name varchar(64), \t@ip varchar(16), \t@mask varchar(16), \t@gateway varchar(16), \t@broadcast varchar(16), \t@state int \t as \tbegin \t\tupdate nics set nics.mac_addr = @mac_addr, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_use_dhcp = @ip_use_dhcp, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_domain = @ip_domain, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_dns = @ip_dns, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.ip_wins = @ip_wins, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_bus = @nic_pci_bus, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_device = @nic_pci_device, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_pci_function = @nic_pci_function, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_device_id = @nic_device_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_vendor_id = @nic_vendor_id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_desc = @nic_desc, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nics.nic_location = @nic_location \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere nics.computer_id = @computer_id  \t\tupdate  nic_interface set\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.id = @id, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.name = @name, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.ip = @ip, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.mask = @mask, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.gateway = @gateway, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.broadcast = @broadcast, \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t nic_interface.state = @state \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twhere  nic_interface.interface_id = @interface_id; \tend ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @ip_use_dhcp smallint, @ip_domain varchar, @ip_dns varchar, @ip_wins varchar, @nic_pci_bus int, @nic_pci_device int, @nic_pci_function int, @nic_device_id int, @nic_vendor_id int, @nic_desc varchar, @nic_location varchar, @interface_id int, @id int, @nic_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @mask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,     @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint = 1,--PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configItemId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_item_id = @configItemId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId\t\tint,    @condition\t\tint,     @task\t\tint,     @computerId\t\tint,    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @interfaceId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int, @last smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @nicId\t\tint,    @domainSuffix\tvarchar(128),    @ipMethod\t\tsmallint,     @wins\t\tvarchar(512),    @dns\t\t\tvarchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_set record       begin transaction          update nic_config_set set ip_method = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp,wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_set_id = @configSetId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface    @nicId\t\tint,    @interfaceId\t\tint,    @last\t\tsmallint = 0,    @jobId\t\tint = null,    @condition\t\tint = null,     @task\t\tint = null,    @configSetId\t\tint = null,    @ip\t\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @netmask\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @gateway\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @broadcast\t\tvarchar(16) = null,    @name\t\tvarchar(64) = null,    @state\t\tint = null as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@nicId int, @interfaceId int, @last smallint, @jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing    @itemId int,    @id int,    @nicId int as    declare @name varchar(64)    declare @ip varchar(16), @mask varchar(16), @gateway varchar(16), @broadcast varchar(16)    declare @state int, @interfaceCount int    set @interfaceCount = 0    -- incremental IP for updates from config_set    declare @increment_ip bit    if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000       set @increment_ip = 1    declare nic_interface_cursor cursor for       select [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state from nic_interface where id = @id       and nic_id = @nicId order by interface_id    open nic_interface_cursor    fetch next from nic_interface_cursor       into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    --Bug #43065 To save computer nic_interface data.    declare @iname varchar(64), @iip varchar(16), @imask varchar(16),        @igateway varchar(16), @ibroadcast varchar(16), @istate int   if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000   begin    select @iname = name, @iip = ip, @imask = mask, @igateway = gateway, @ibroadcast = broadcast, @istate = state from      nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId          if @name is null or len(@name) = 0       set @name = @iname    if @ip is null or len(@ip) = 0       set @ip = @iip    if @mask is null or len(@mask) = 0       set @mask = @imask    if @gateway is null or len(@gateway) = 0       set @gateway = @igateway    if @broadcast is null or len(@broadcast) = 0       set @broadcast = @ibroadcast    if @state is null        set @state = @istate        end    -- remove existing nic_interface objects and always add new ones    delete from nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId     -- update nic_inteface table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- create new record       insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state)          values (@itemId, @nicId, @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state)              if @increment_ip = 1          exec wc_upd_next_ip @id, @itemId, @nicId                 fetch next from nic_interface_cursor          into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    end     close nic_interface_cursor    deallocate nic_interface_cursor ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @id int, @nicId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_pct_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_pct_task    @jobId       \tint,    @condSeq     \tint,    @taskSeq\t\t\tint,    @filename\t\tvarchar(254),    @directory\t\tvarchar(254),    @commandLine\t\tvarchar(254),--bug #45749    @username\t\tvarchar(64),    @password\t\tvarchar(64),    @pkgPassword\t\tvarchar(64),    @domain\t\t\tsmallint,    @local\t\t\tsmallint,    @customUsers\t\tvarchar(128),    @customGroups\tvarchar(128),    @condOffset\t\tsmallint,    @condType\t\tsmallint,    @dateType\t\tsmallint as    update capture_pct_task set template_file=@filename, folder=@directory,       addl_cmd_line=@commandLine, username=@username, [password]=@password,       pkg_password=@pkgPassword, domain_users=@domain, local_users=@local,       custom_users=@customUsers, custom_groups=@customGroups, last_accessed=@condType,       last_value=@condOffset, last_scale=@dateType    where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @filename varchar, @directory varchar, @commandLine varchar, @username varchar, @password varchar, @pkgPassword varchar, @domain smallint, @local smallint, @customUsers varchar, @customGroups varchar, @condOffset smallint, @condType smallint, @dateType smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_power_control_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_power_control_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq\t\tint,    @type    \tsmallint,    @forceApps\tsmallint as    -- update the power control task    begin transaction       update reboot_task set          reboot_method=@type, [force]=@forceApps          where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction     select @@error as error ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @type smallint, @forceApps smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_schedule", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_schedule    @schedule int,    @computer int,    @job int,    @startTime datetime,    @recur int,    @recurType smallint,    @defer int,    @dependantScheduleId int     as    if @dependantScheduleId <= 100000000 or @dependantScheduleId > 200000000        set @dependantScheduleId = null    begin transaction       update event_schedule set computer_id = @computer, start_time = @startTime,           recur_value = @recur, recur_type = @recurType, defer_mins = @defer,           dep_schedule_id = @dependantScheduleId, status_code = null, status = '',          next_task_seq = 0, cond_seq = null, broker_time = null, end_time = null,          exit_code = null, exit_module = null  where schedule_id = @schedule \t  --Bug #36624 To set job_exec_time null at reschudule. \t  update event_schedule_info set job_exec_time = null where schedule_id = @schedule    if @@error != 0    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule int, @computer int, @job int, @startTime datetime, @recur int, @recurType smallint, @defer int, @dependantScheduleId int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_schedule_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create  procedure wc_upd_schedule_info  \t@schedule_id \tint,     @user_id\tint,     @app_id int =0 --Enhance ASDK - change to update extaernal App ID as \tdeclare @scheduleCount int \tset @scheduleCount = 0               select @scheduleCount=count(schedule_id ) from event_schedule_info where schedule_id=@schedule_id               begin transaction \t\tif @scheduleCount > 0  \t\tupdate event_schedule_info set windows_user_id =  @user_id, app_id=@app_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id \t\t else  \t\tinsert into event_schedule_info (schedule_id,windows_user_id) values(@schedule_id,@user_id) \t\t  \tif (@@error != 0) \tbegin \t\trollback transaction \t\treturn \tend  \tcommit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @user_id int, @app_id int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_script_task", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_script_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq\t\tint,    @scriptFile\tvarchar(256),    @script\t\tvarchar(6000),    @description varchar(128),    @platform\tsmallint,    @runAtServer smallint,    @window\t\tsmallint,    @username\tvarchar(128) = null,    @password\tvarchar(128) = null,     -- PRD Item 7.2.2 Extend Run Script task    @addlcmdline varchar(512)=null,    @bootoption_id int=null, --PRD item 7.1.1 PXE pre boot option    @execution_mode smallint=1, --PRD UI changes of Automation    @bootimage_arch int=0,    @execute_options smallint=0 as       update script_task set script_file=@scriptFile, script=@script,  \t     [description]=@description, os_reqd=@platform, location=@runAtServer, \t\t window=@window, username=@username, password=@password,addl_cmdline=@addlcmdline, execution_mode=@execution_mode, execute_options=@execute_options \t  where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq \t   \t  update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch=@bootimage_arch where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @scriptFile varchar, @script varchar, @description varchar, @platform smallint, @runAtServer smallint, @window smallint, @username varchar, @password varchar, @addlcmdline varchar, @bootoption_id int, @execution_mode smallint, @bootimage_arch int, @execute_options smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_security_group", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_security_group    @group int,    @name varchar(50),    @description varchar(256) as    declare @groupId int    select @groupId = [group_id] from securitygroup where [group_id] = @group    declare @duplicate varchar(64)     --set @duplicate = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security    --select @duplicate = [name] from securitygroup where [group_id] != @group and [name] = @name      -- add group    --if @duplicate is  null    --begin    if @groupId is not null    begin       update securitygroup set [name] = @name, [description] = @description where [group_id] = @groupId    end    --end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@group int, @name varchar, @description varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_task_order", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "     create procedure dbo.wc_upd_task_order    @jobId\t\tint,    @conditionId\tint,    @taskId1\t\tint,    @taskId2\t\tint as    -- get a temporary task id    declare @tempTaskId   int    select @tempTaskId = max(task_seq) from task where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@conditionId    set @tempTaskId = @tempTaskId + 1     begin transaction \t   -- set the original item id to the temporary task id \t   update task set task_seq=@tempTaskId where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId1 \t \t   -- set the swap item id to the original id \t   update task set task_seq=@taskId1 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId2 \t \t   -- replace the temporary task id with the swap id \t   update task set task_seq=@taskId2 where event_id=@jobId  \t      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@tempTaskId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else \t  commit transaction ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId int, @taskId1 int, @taskId2 int)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_taskusers", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  -- For PRD item 7.1.14 Centrally Managed Task Password create procedure wc_upd_taskusers  @userName varchar(128), @oldPassword varchar(128), @newPassword varchar(128) as  declare @updatedRecords  int  set @updatedRecords =0  update    script_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update    copyfile_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update   install_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update   capture_pct_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  select @updatedRecords  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@userName varchar, @oldPassword varchar, @newPassword varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "GSS5", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "wc_upd_user", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "  create procedure dbo.wc_upd_user    @user int,    @username varchar(100),    @fullName varchar(128),    @description varchar(128),    @password varchar(100) = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security as    declare @userId int    select @userId = [user_id] from securityuser where [user_id] = @user    declare @duplicate varchar(64)     --set @duplicate = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security    --select @duplicate = [name] from securityuser where [user_id] != @user and [name] = @username       -- update user      --if @duplicate is  null    --begin    if @userId is not null    begin       declare @domain varchar(50)       select @domain = domain from securityuser where [user_id] = @userId        if len(@domain) > 0       begin          -- only the description can be edited for domain accounts          update securityuser set [description] = @description where [user_id] = @userId       end       else       begin \t\t\tif len(@password) >0 \t\t\tbegin          update securityuser set [name] = @username, fullname = @fullName, [description] = @description,             [password] = @password where [user_id] = @userId       end \t\t\telse \t\t\tbegin \t\t\t\tupdate securityuser set [name] = @username, fullname = @fullName, [description] = @description \t\t\t\t\twhere [user_id] = @userId \t\t\tend \t\tend    end   --end    ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@user int, @username varchar, @fullName varchar, @description varchar, @password varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "IdentityAutomation", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fnSprintf", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create function [dbo].[fnSprintf] (@s varchar(MAX),                  @params varchar(MAX), @separator char(1) = ',') returns varchar(MAX) as begin declare @p varchar(MAX) declare @paramlen int  set @params = @params + @separator set @paramlen = len(@params) while not @params = '' begin     set @p = left(@params+@separator, charindex(@separator, @params)-1)     set @s = STUFF(@s, charindex('%s', @s), 2, @p)     set @params = substring(@params, len(@p)+2, @paramlen) end return @s end ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( varchar OUT, @s varchar, @params varchar, @separator char)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "IdentityAutomation", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "AD", "Object_Name": "PullFromAD", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE PROCEDURE [AD].[PullFromAD] AS  --------------------------------------------------------------------- /* \tThis is the variable table that holds information from AD. \tThe columns can have any name and type you want, ideally \tmatching with your end product. DECLARE @nAsciiValue smallint\t\t\t\t\t\t-- A numeric representation of the character cursor.  SELECT @nAsciiValue = 65\t\t\t\t\t\t\t-- Initialize the character cursor, CHAR(65) is 'A'  \tWHILE @nAsciiValue < 91\t\t\t\t\t\t\t-- As long as the character cursor isn't past 'Z' \tBEGIN  \t\tSELECT @sChar= CHAR(@nAsciiValue)\t\t\t-- Get the character value from the cursor number \t\t--------------------------------------------------------------------- \t\t/*  \t\t\tThis is the main query. 'fnSprintf' is a custom function to \t\t\tget around the character limit in SQL strings.  \t\t\tThe Domain Controller entdc9 was recommended as of 3/16/18  \t\t\tas entdc2 has been decommissioned.             The Domain Controller entdc16 was recommended as of 6/26/19             as entdc9 has been decommissioned. \t\t*/ \t\t--------------------------------------------------------------------- \t\tSET @query = (select dbo.fnSprintf('\t\t\t \t\tSELECT\t\t\t\t\t\t   employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath \t\tFROM OPENQUERY( ADSI, ''SELECT employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath \t\t\tFROM ''''LDAP://entdc16.d204.ipsd.net/ou=Staff,ou=_1Support_and_System_Group,ou=_d204,dc=d204,dc=ipsd,dc=net''''WHERE objectCategory = ''''Person'''' AND SAMAccountName = ''''%s*'''' '' )', @SChar, default))  \t\tINSERT @ResultTable\t\t\t\t\t\t\t-- Insert the results of the current loop into the result table \t\tEXEC( @query )\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t  \t\tSELECT @nAsciiValue = @nAsciiValue + 1\t\t    -- Iterate the character cursor     PRINT 'Finished ' + @sChar + '. Looping.'\t\t\t-- Shows progress via messages. \tEND;  PRINT 'All done'\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t-- 26 loops later.  --------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Get Tech OU, Server Team, and Disabled Accounts ---------------------------------------------------------------------  SET @query = (select dbo.fnSprintf('\t\t\t SELECT\t\t\t\t\t\t   employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath FROM OPENQUERY( ADSI, ''SELECT employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath \tFROM ''''LDAP://entdc16.d204.ipsd.net/ou=Tech,ou=_1Support_and_System_Group,ou=_d204,dc=d204,dc=ipsd,dc=net''''WHERE objectCategory = ''''Person'''' '' ) UNION SELECT\t\t\t\t\t\t   employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath FROM OPENQUERY( ADSI, ''SELECT employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath \tFROM ''''LDAP://entdc16.d204.ipsd.net/ou=_d204_exchange_users,dc=d204,dc=ipsd,dc=net''''WHERE objectCategory = ''''Person'''' '' ) UNION SELECT\t\t\t\t\t\t   employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath FROM OPENQUERY( ADSI, ''SELECT employeeID, sAMAccountName, cn, givenName, sn, mail, telephoneNumber, userAccountControl, ADsPath FROM ''''LDAP://entdc16.d204.ipsd.net/ou=Disabled 2019-20 O365,ou=_disabled_accounts,dc=d204,dc=ipsd,dc=net''''WHERE objectCategory = ''''Person'''' '' ) ' , NULL,  default))  INSERT @ResultTable EXEC( @query )  --------------------------------------------------------------------- /*  \tWith the temporary table fully populated, you can now do \tsomething with it. Insert it into a DB, print a report, etc. */ ---------------------------------------------------------------------  TRUNCATE TABLE [AD].[StaffADList]; INSERT INTO [AD].[StaffADList] SELECT    ISNULL(employeeID,'') AS employeeID , ISNULL(sAMAccountName,'') AS sAMAccountName , ISNULL(cn, '') AS cn , ISNULL(firstName,'') AS firstName , ISNULL(lastName,'') AS lastName , ISNULL(email,'') AS email , ISNULL(telephoneNumber,'') AS phone , CASE AccountStatus      WHEN '512' THEN 'Active'      WHEN '514' THEN 'Inactive'      WHEN '66048' THEN 'Active'   -- Password Never Expires      WHEN '66050' THEN 'Inactive' -- Password Never Expires      WHEN '544' THEN 'Active'     -- Password Not Required!      ELSE AccountStatus END AS accountStatus , SUBSTRING(     REPLACE(ADsPath, 'LDAP://entdc16.d204.ipsd.net/CN=' + cn + ',OU=', ''),     1,     CHARINDEX(',',REPLACE(ADsPath, 'LDAP://entdc16.d204.ipsd.net/CN=' + cn + ',OU=', ''),0) -1     ) AS 'ou' FROM @ResultTable  WHERE   -- Tons of cleanup involved. May have been easier to grab OU and filter from that     ISNULL(email,'') NOT LIKE '%listserv%' AND ISNULL(email,'') NOT LIKE '%service-now%' AND ISNULL(email,'') NOT LIKE '%aramark%' AND ISNULL(email,'') NOT LIKE '%mxtoolbox%' AND ISNULL(email,'') NOT IN ('schoolbdcathypiehl@wowway.com', '928266743@k12.ipsd.org', 'journal@bma.int', '6387821@k12.ipsd.org' ) AND ISNULL(lastName,'') NOT AND ISNULL(lastName,'') NOT LIKE '%Test%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE '%d204' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'd204%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE '%guest%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'cr[_]%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'gngr[_]%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'gr[_]%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'hill%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'hs[_]%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'mv[_]%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'mvhs[_]%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'nv%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'wv%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT LIKE 'ng[_]%' AND ISNULL(sAMAccountName, '') NOT IN (     'ardtest', 'altiris_package', 'audit1', 'chrone_stem'     , {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "catalog", "Object_Name": "dm_execution_performance_counters", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "CREATE FUNCTION [catalog].[dm_execution_performance_counters](@execution_id bigint = NULL) RETURNS @ret TABLE ([execution_id] bigint,  [counter_name] sysname,  [counter_value] bigint) WITH EXECUTE AS CALLER AS BEGIN     IF (@execution_id IS NULL)     BEGIN         DECLARE @current_execution_id bigint         DECLARE @current_execution_guid uniqueidentifier         DECLARE execution_cursor CURSOR LOCAL             FOR SELECT [execution_id],[dump_id] FROM [catalog].[executions] WHERE [status] = 2         OPEN execution_cursor         FETCH NEXT FROM execution_cursor             INTO @current_execution_id,@current_execution_guid         WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)         BEGIN             IF [internal].[check_permission]             (               4,               @execution_id,                     1             ) = 1             BEGIN                 INSERT INTO @ret                 SELECT [execution_id] ,                        [counter_name] ,                        [counter_value]                 FROM [internal].[get_execution_perf_counters](@current_execution_id,@current_execution_guid)                     END             FETCH NEXT FROM execution_cursor                 INTO @current_execution_id,@current_execution_guid                    END         CLOSE execution_cursor         DEALLOCATE execution_cursor     END     ELSE     BEGIN         IF [internal].[check_permission]         (            4,            @execution_id,                  1         ) = 1         BEGIN             DECLARE @execution_guid uniqueidentifier             SELECT @execution_guid = [dump_id] FROM [catalog].[executions] WHERE [execution_id] = @execution_id AND [status] = 2             IF (@execution_guid IS NOT NULL)             BEGIN                 INSERT INTO @ret                 SELECT [execution_id] ,                        [counter_name] ,                        [counter_value]                 FROM [internal].[get_execution_perf_counters](@execution_id,@execution_guid)\t             END         END     END     RETURN END  ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@execution_id bigint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "check_permission", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE FUNCTION [internal].[check_permission] (     @object_type SMALLINT,     @object_id BIGINT,     @permission_type SMALLINT ) RETURNS BIT AS BEGIN     DECLARE @Result BIT          IF (IS_MEMBER('ssis_admin') = 1) OR (IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin') = 1) OR (0 = 1)         RETURN 1      \tIF (@object_type = 4 AND @permission_type = 1 AND IS_MEMBER('ssis_logreader') = 1) \t\tRETURN 1 \t\t     IF EXISTS      (         SELECT [permission_type]         FROM [catalog].[effective_object_permissions]         WHERE              [object_type] = @object_type         AND [object_id] = @object_id         AND [permission_type] = @permission_type     )         SET @Result = 1     ELSE         SET @Result = 0        RETURN @Result END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( bit OUT, @object_type smallint, @object_id bigint, @permission_type smallint)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "enable_scaleout", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE PROCEDURE [internal].[enable_scaleout]   @agent_password\t\t\tNVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL  AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON  IF (IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin') <> 1) \tBEGIN \t\tRAISERROR(27260, 16, 1) WITH NOWAIT \t\tRETURN 1 \tEND  DECLARE @accountName AS SYSNAME DECLARE @strExec NVARCHAR (MAX) DECLARE @instance_version NVARCHAR(1024) DECLARE @master_registry_path NVARCHAR(MAX) DECLARE @key_value NVARCHAR(1024)  SET @instance_version = SUBSTRING (CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS VARCHAR(20)),1,2) + N'0'; SET @master_registry_path = N'SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Microsoft SQL Server\\\\' + @instance_version + N'\\\\DTS\\\\Setup\\\\SQL_IS_Master'; EXEC master.dbo.xp_regread 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE',@master_registry_path, N'Version', @key_value output;  IF @key_value IS NULL \tBEGIN \t\tRAISERROR(27261, 16, 1) WITH NOWAIT \t\tRETURN 1 \tEND  SET @accountName = N'NT Service\\SSISScaleOutMaster140' IF (SUSER_SID(@accountName) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.server_principals WHERE NAME = @accountName)) BEGIN \tPRINT N'Adding login for ' + @accountName  \tSET @strExec = N'CREATE LOGIN ' + QUOTENAME(@accountName) + ' FROM WINDOWS' \tEXEC (@strExec)  \tIF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.database_principals where name = 'SSISScaleOutMasterUser140') \t\tDROP USER SSISScaleOutMasterUser140  \tSET @strExec = N'CREATE USER SSISScaleOutMasterUser140 for login '  + QUOTENAME(@accountName)  \tEXEC (@strExec)  \tSET @strExec = N'sp_addrolemember ''ssis_admin'', ''SSISScaleOutMasterUser140''' \tEXEC (@strExec) END   IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.server_principals where name = '##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentLogin##')     DROP LOGIN ##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentLogin##  EXEC ('CREATE LOGIN ##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentLogin## WITH PASSWORD =''' + @agent_password+''', CHECK_POLICY = OFF')  IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.database_principals where name = '##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentUser##') \tDROP USER ##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentUser##  CREATE USER ##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentUser## FOR LOGIN ##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentLogin##  EXEC sp_addrolemember 'ssis_cluster_worker', '##MS_SSISLogDBWorkerAgentUser##'  IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM [SSISDB].[catalog].[master_properties] WHERE [property_name] = 'IS_SCALEOUT_ENABLED') \tUPDATE [internal].[master_properties] SET [property_value] = 'TRUE' WHERE [property_name] = 'IS_SCALEOUT_ENABLED' ELSE \tINSERT INTO [internal].[master_properties] VALUES ('IS_SCALEOUT_ENABLED', 'TRUE')  END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: (@agent_password nvarchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "StoredProcedure", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "update_permission", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE PROCEDURE [internal].[update_permission]     @object_type SMALLINT,     @object_id BIGINT,     @principal_id INTEGER,     @permission_type SMALLINT,     @is_deny BIT,     @grantor_id INTEGER AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON     DECLARE @ret INTEGER     DECLARE @is_role BIT     DECLARE @sid [internal].[adt_sid]     DECLARE @grantor_sid [internal].[adt_sid]               SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE                    DECLARE @tran_count INT = @@TRANCOUNT; {"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "catalog", "Object_Name": "packages", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [catalog].[packages] AS SELECT     pkgs.[package_id],             pkgs.[name],             pkgs.[package_guid],             pkgs.[description],            pkgs.[package_format_version],             pkgs.[version_major],              pkgs.[version_minor],             pkgs.[version_build],             pkgs.[version_comments],             pkgs.[version_guid],             pkgs.[project_id],            pkgs.[entry_point],            pkgs.[validation_status],            pkgs.[last_validation_time] FROM       [internal].[packages] pkgs INNER JOIN [internal].[projects] proj ON             (pkgs.[project_version_lsn] = proj.[object_version_lsn]             AND pkgs.[project_id] = proj.[project_id]) INNER JOIN            [internal].[object_versions] vers ON ( vers.[object_type] =20 AND            vers.[object_id] = proj.[project_id]             AND vers.[object_version_lsn] = proj.[object_version_lsn])             WHERE      pkgs.[project_id] in (SELECT [id] FROM [internal].[current_user_readable_projects])            OR (IS_MEMBER('ssis_admin') = 1)            OR (IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin') = 1)            OR (IS_MEMBER('ssis_logreader') = 1)            OR (0 = 1) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "catalog", "Object_Name": "validations", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [catalog].[validations] AS SELECT     vals.[validation_id],             vals.[environment_scope],             vals.[validate_type],            vals.[folder_name],            vals.[project_name],                     vals.[project_lsn],            vals.[use32bitruntime],            vals.[reference_id],             opers.[operation_type],            opers.[object_name],              opers.[object_type],             opers.[object_id],             opers.[start_time],             opers.[end_time],             opers.[status],             opers.[caller_sid],             opers.[caller_name],             opers.[process_id],            opers.[stopped_by_sid],             opers.[stopped_by_name],            opers.[operation_guid] as [dump_id],            opers.[server_name],            opers.[machine_name] FROM       [internal].[validations] vals INNER JOIN [internal].[operations] opers             ON vals.[validation_id] = opers.[operation_id] WHERE      opers.[operation_id] in (SELECT [id] FROM [internal].[current_user_readable_operations])            OR (IS_MEMBER('ssis_admin') = 1)            OR (IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin') = 1)            OR (IS_MEMBER('ssis_logreader') = 1) \t\t   OR (0 = 1) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "catalog", "Object_Name": "worker_agent_perfcounter", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [catalog].[worker_agent_perfcounter] AS \tSELECT [WorkerAgentId], [PerfCounterName], [PerfCounterValue], [TimeStamp] \tFROM [internal].[worker_agent_perfcounter] \tWhere ((IS_MEMBER('ssis_admin') = 1) OR (IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin') = 1) OR (IS_MEMBER('ssis_cluster_executor') = 1)) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "catalog", "Object_Name": "worker_agents", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [catalog].[worker_agents] AS \tSELECT [WorkerAgentId], [IsEnabled], [DisplayName], [Description], [MachineName], [Tags], [UserAccount], [LastOnlineTime] \tFROM [internal].[worker_agents] \tWhere ((IS_MEMBER('ssis_admin') = 1) OR (IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin') = 1) OR (IS_MEMBER('ssis_cluster_executor') = 1)) ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "current_user_object_permissions", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [internal].[current_user_object_permissions] AS SELECT     obj.[object_type],            obj.[object_id],            obj.[permission_type],             obj.[sid],            obj.[is_role],            obj.[is_deny] FROM       [internal].[object_permissions] AS obj INNER JOIN [sys].[database_principals] AS pri ON obj.[sid] = pri.[sid] WHERE      ((pri.[type] = 'S' OR pri.[type] = 'U') AND obj.[sid] = USER_SID (DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID())) OR ((pri.[type] = 'G' OR pri.[type] = 'R') AND IS_MEMBER(pri.name)=1) \t ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "current_user_readable_environments", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [internal].[current_user_readable_environments] AS SELECT     [object_id] AS [ID] FROM       [catalog].[effective_object_permissions] WHERE      [object_type] = 3            AND  [permission_type] = 1 ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "current_user_readable_folders", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [internal].[current_user_readable_folders] AS SELECT     [object_id] AS [ID] FROM       [catalog].[effective_object_permissions] WHERE      [object_type] = 1            AND  [permission_type] = 1 ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "current_user_readable_operations", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [internal].[current_user_readable_operations] AS SELECT     [object_id] AS [ID] FROM       [catalog].[effective_object_permissions] WHERE      [object_type] = 4            AND  [permission_type] = 1 ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "current_user_readable_projects", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [internal].[current_user_readable_projects] AS SELECT     [object_id] AS [ID] FROM       [catalog].[effective_object_permissions] WHERE      [object_type] = 2            AND  [permission_type] = 1 ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "execution_info", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [internal].[execution_info] AS SELECT     execs.[execution_id],             execs.[folder_name],             execs.[project_name],             execs.[package_name],            execs.[reference_id],            execs.[reference_type],             execs.[environment_folder_name],             execs.[environment_name],             execs.[project_lsn],             execs.[executed_as_sid],             execs.[executed_as_name],             execs.[use32bitruntime],              opers.[operation_type],             opers.[created_time],              opers.[object_type],             opers.[object_id],            opers.[status],             opers.[start_time],             opers.[end_time],              opers.[caller_sid],             opers.[caller_name],             opers.[process_id],             opers.[stopped_by_sid],             opers.[stopped_by_name],            opers.[operation_guid] as [dump_id],            opers.[server_name],            opers.[machine_name] FROM       [internal].[executions] execs INNER JOIN [internal].[operations] opers             ON execs.[execution_id]= opers.[operation_id] WHERE      opers.[operation_id] in (SELECT id FROM [internal].[current_user_readable_operations])            OR (IS_MEMBER('ssis_admin') = 1)            OR (IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin') = 1)  ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "object_folders", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " CREATE VIEW [internal].[object_folders] AS SELECT     2 AS [object_type],            p.[project_id] AS [object_id],             p.[name] AS [object_name],             p.[folder_id],             f.[name] AS [folder_name] FROM       [internal].[projects] p INNER JOIN [internal].[folders] f ON p.[folder_id] = f.[folder_id]  Union ALL SELECT     3 AS [object_type],             e.[environment_id] AS [object_id],             e.[environment_name] AS [object_name],             e.[folder_id],             f.[name] AS [folder_name] FROM       [internal].[environments] e INNER JOIN [internal].[folders] f ON e.[folder_id] = f.[folder_id] ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlProd1", "Database_Name": "SSISDB", "Object_Type": "View", "Schema_Name": "internal", "Object_Name": "object_permissions", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": " create view [internal].[object_permissions] AS SELECT     CAST(1 AS SmallInt) AS [object_type],             [object_id],             [sid],            [permission_type],            [is_role],            [is_deny],            [grantor_sid] FROM       [internal].[folder_permissions] UNION ALL SELECT     CAST(2 AS SmallInt) AS [object_type],             [object_id],             [sid],            [permission_type],            [is_role],            [is_deny],            [grantor_sid] FROM       [internal].[project_permissions] UNION ALL SELECT     CAST(3 AS SmallInt) AS [object_type],             [object_id],            [sid],            [permission_type],            [is_role],            [is_deny],            [grantor_sid] FROM       [internal].[environment_permissions] UNION ALL SELECT     CAST(4 AS SmallInt) AS [object_type],             [object_id],             [sid],            [permission_type],            [is_role],            [is_deny],            [grantor_sid] FROM       [internal].[operation_permissions] ", "Metadata": null}

{"Server": "sqlDev1", "Database_Name": "ParentVue", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fnSprintf", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "-- ============================================= -- Author:\t\tRobert I. -- Create date: <2020-05-25 -- Description:\tNeed to query AD, lovingly stole this function from DW3. -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSprintf] (@s varchar(MAX),                  @params varchar(MAX), @separator char(1) = ',') returns varchar(MAX) AS BEGIN declare @p varchar(MAX) declare @paramlen int  set @params = @params + @separator set @paramlen = len(@params) while not @params = '' begin     set @p = left(@params+@separator, charindex(@separator, @params)-1)     set @s = STUFF(@s, charindex('%s', @s), 2, @p)     set @params = substring(@params, len(@p)+2, @paramlen) end return @s END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( varchar OUT, @s varchar, @params varchar, @separator char)"}

{"Server": "sqlDev1", "Database_Name": "Robert", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fnBirds", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "CREATE FUNCTION fnBirds (@StudentID uniqueidentifier) RETURNS VARCHAR(8000) AS BEGIN         DECLARE @Conf VARCHAR(8000)         SELECT @Conf = ''         SELECT @Conf = @Conf + [CONFERENCEINFO]         FROM [conCatTest2]         WHERE [STUDENT_GU] = @StudentID         AND [CONFERENCEINFO] IS NOT NULL         ORDER BY [SORTORDER] --yes we can sort   RETURN @Conf END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( varchar OUT, @StudentID uniqueidentifier)"}

{"Server": "sqlDev1", "Database_Name": "Robert", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fnGetBooks", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "CREATE FUNCTION fnGetBooks (@AuthorID INT)   RETURNS VARCHAR(8000) AS BEGIN          DECLARE @BookList VARCHAR(8000)  SELECT @BookList =(           SELECT  BookName + ', ' AS [text()]        FROM    Books  WHERE AuthorID = @AuthorID         AND BookName IS NOT NULL      ORDER BY BookName        FOR XML PATH('') )           RETURN LEFT(@BookList,(LEN(@BookList) -1)) END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( varchar OUT, @AuthorID int)"}

{"Server": "sqlDev1", "Database_Name": "Robert", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "fnGetBooks2", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "CREATE FUNCTION fnGetBooks2 (@AuthorID INT) RETURNS VARCHAR(8000) AS BEGIN         DECLARE @BookList VARCHAR(8000)         SELECT @BookList = ''         SELECT @BookList = @BookList + BookName +','         FROM Books         WHERE AuthorID = @AuthorID         AND BookName IS NOT NULL         ORDER BY BookName --yes we can sort   RETURN LEFT(@BookList,(LEN(@BookList) -1)) END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( varchar OUT, @AuthorID int)"}

{"Server": "sqlDev1", "Database_Name": "SNAP", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "RemoveSpecialChars", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "-- ============================================= -- Author:\t\tRobert I. -- Create date: 06-22-20 -- Description:\tRemove Special Characters. As used in eSchool. -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[RemoveSpecialChars] ( \t@s varchar(256) ) RETURNS varchar(256) AS BEGIN    if @s is null       return null \tset @s = (SELECT @s Collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1253_CI_AI)    declare @s2 varchar(256)    set @s2 = ''    declare @l int    set @l = len(@s)    declare @p int    set @p = 1    while @p <= @l begin       declare @c int       set @c = ascii(substring(@s, @p, 1))        \t  --letters only \t  if  @c between 65 and 90 or @c between 97 and 122          set @s2 = @s2 + char(@c)       set @p = @p + 1       end    if len(@s2) = 0       return null    return @s2 END ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( varchar OUT, @s varchar)"}

{"Server": "sqlDev1", "Database_Name": "SNAP", "Object_Type": "Function", "Schema_Name": "dbo", "Object_Name": "TitleCase", "Parent_Object": null, "Object_Definition": "-- ============================================= -- Author:\t\tRobert I. -- Create date: 06-22-2020 -- Description:\tStole this from eSchool. -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[TitleCase]  ( \t@InputString VARCHAR(4000) ) RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS BEGIN \tDECLARE @Index INT \tDECLARE @Char CHAR(1) \tDECLARE @OutputString VARCHAR(255) \tSET @OutputString = LOWER(@InputString)\t\t--Start with everything in lower case \tSET @OutputString =\tSTUFF(@OutputString, 1, 1,UPPER(SUBSTRING(@InputString,1,1))) -- Overlay the first char of string with its upper case char \tSET @Index = 2\t-- We already know that the first char is upper case, so get ready to look through the string at the 2nd position \tWHILE @Index <= LEN(@InputString) \t\tBEGIN \t\tSET @Char = SUBSTRING(@InputString, @Index, 1) --Get a char from the string \t\tIF @Char IN (' ', ';', ':', '!', '?', ',', '.', '_', '-', '/', '&','''','(') --Is the char a delimeter char? If so, the next letter should be capitalize \t\t\tIF @Index + 1 <= LEN(@InputString) \t\t\t\tBEGIN \t\t\t\t\tIF @Char != '''' OR UPPER(SUBSTRING(@InputString, @Index + 1, 1)) != 'S' \t\t\t\t\t\tSET @OutputString = \t\t\t\t\t\tSTUFF(@OutputString, @Index + 1, 1,UPPER(SUBSTRING(@InputString, @Index + 1, 1))) \t\t\t\tEND \t\t\tSET @Index = @Index + 1 \tEND \tRETURN ISNULL(@OutputString,'') END   ", "Metadata": "PARAMETERS: ( varchar OUT, @InputString varchar)"}
